def find_related_items_for_issue(issue_description: str, project_id: int, issue_id: int) -> Optional[str]:
    """
    Uses the global vector store to find items related to a new issue and formats them as a comment.
    """
    try:
        from core.prompts import ISSUE_TRIAGE_PROMPT # Import the new prompt
        with global_chroma_lock:
            client = get_global_chroma_client()
            collection = client.get_or_create_collection(name="global_search")

            if collection.count() == 0:
                return None

            # Query for items across all projects to find similar patterns
            search_results = collection.query(
                query_texts=[issue_description],
                n_results=5,
                include=['metadatas', 'documents'] # type: ignore
            )

        if not search_results or not search_results['ids'][0]:
            return None

        # --- NEW: Build context for the new prompt ---
        results_context_parts = []
        
        for i in range(len(search_results['ids'][0])):
            meta = search_results['metadatas'][0][i]
            doc_text = search_results['documents'][0][i]
            
            # Don't link to the issue we just created
            if meta.get('entity_type') == 'issue' and str(meta.get('entity_id')) == str(issue_id): # type: ignore
                continue

            item_type = meta.get('entity_type', 'item').replace("_", " ").title() # type: ignore
            item_name = meta.get('name', 'Untitled') # type: ignore
            item_project_id = meta.get('project_id') # type: ignore
            
            # Try to get project name for context
            project_name = ""
            if item_project_id:
                proj_row = fetch_one("SELECT name FROM projects WHERE id = ?", (item_project_id,))
                if proj_row:
                    project_name = f" (in {proj_row[0]})"

            results_context_parts.append(f"- **{item_type}{project_name}:** *{item_name}*\n  - Context: {doc_text[:200]}...")

        if not results_context_parts:
            return None
            
        search_results_context = "\n".join(results_context_parts)
        
        # --- NEW: Call the LLM with the new prompt ---
        system_prompt = ISSUE_TRIAGE_PROMPT.format(
            issue_description=issue_description,
            search_results_context=search_results_context
        )
        
        ai_comment = generate_ai_response(prompt="Generate the triage comment.", system_prompt=system_prompt, temperature=0.3)
        
        return ai_comment

    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error in AI Triage: {e}")
        return None

def parse_email_thread_heuristically(email_body: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Heuristically splits an email thread based on common delimiters like -----Original Message-----
    or headers (From: / To: / Sent: / Date:).
    Raw email text is always newest-first, so each part is tagged with its position
    (0 = newest / top of file) to allow correct ordering when dates are equal or missing.
    """
    import re
    from datetime import datetime
    delimiters = [
        r'-+\s*Original\s+Message\s*-+',
        r'-+\s*Forwarded\s+message\s*-+',
        r'_{3,}',
        r'^-{3,}\s*$'
    ]
    combined_delims = '|'.join(delimiters)
    parts = re.split(combined_delims, email_body, flags=re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE)
    
    # Check for Gmail style: "On ..., ... wrote:"
    if len(parts) <= 1:
        gmail_matches = list(re.finditer(r'^On\s+.*\s+wrote:\s*$', email_body, flags=re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE))
        if gmail_matches:
            messages = []
            last_idx = 0
            for match in gmail_matches:
                start, end = match.span()
                messages.append(email_body[last_idx:start].strip())
                last_idx = end
            messages.append(email_body[last_idx:].strip())
            parts = messages

    # Check for inline Outlook header blocks if still a single part
    if len(parts) <= 1:
        lines = email_body.split('\n')
        split_indices = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(lines):
            line = lines[i].strip()
            if re.match(r'^From:\s*', line, re.IGNORECASE):
                # Look ahead up to 5 lines to find other headers
                has_other_header = False
                for j in range(i + 1, min(i + 5, len(lines))):
                    next_line = lines[j].strip()
                    if re.match(r'^(To|Sent|Date|Subject|Cc):\s*', next_line, re.IGNORECASE):
                        has_other_header = True
                        break
                if has_other_header:
                    split_indices.append(i)
            i += 1
            
        if split_indices:
            messages = []
            last_idx = 0
            for idx in split_indices:
                if idx > last_idx:
                    messages.append('\n'.join(lines[last_idx:idx]).strip())
                last_idx = idx
            messages.append('\n'.join(lines[last_idx:]).strip())
            parts = [p for p in messages if p]

    parsed_parts = []
    for part in parts:
        part = part.strip()
        if not part:
            continue
            
        lines = part.split('\n')
        msg_from = "Unknown"
        msg_to = ""
        msg_cc = ""
        # Default to a sentinel so unparseable messages sort after real ones
        msg_date = ""
        msg_subject = ""
        
        body_start_idx = 0
        parsing_headers = True
        
        for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
            line_str = line.strip()
            if not line_str:
                if parsing_headers:
                    body_start_idx = idx + 1
                continue
            
            from_match = re.match(r'^From:\s*(.*)', line_str, re.IGNORECASE)
            to_match = re.match(r'^To:\s*(.*)', line_str, re.IGNORECASE)
            cc_match = re.match(r'^Cc:\s*(.*)', line_str, re.IGNORECASE)
            sent_match = re.match(r'^(Sent|Date):\s*(.*)', line_str, re.IGNORECASE)
            subj_match = re.match(r'^Subject:\s*(.*)', line_str, re.IGNORECASE)
            
            if parsing_headers and (from_match or to_match or cc_match or sent_match or subj_match):
                if from_match:
                    msg_from = from_match.group(1).strip()
                elif to_match:
                    msg_to = to_match.group(1).strip()
                elif cc_match:
                    msg_cc = cc_match.group(1).strip()
                elif sent_match:
                    msg_date = sent_match.group(2).strip()
                elif subj_match:
                    msg_subject = subj_match.group(1).strip()
                body_start_idx = idx + 1
            else:
                parsing_headers = False
                break
                
        msg_body = '\n'.join(lines[body_start_idx:]).strip()
        
        # _raw_position is 0 for the top (newest) part; used as tiebreaker in ensure_chronological_order
        parsed_parts.append({
            "from": msg_from,
            "to": msg_to,
            "cc": msg_cc,
            "date": msg_date,
            "body": msg_body,
            "subject": msg_subject,
            "_raw_position": len(parsed_parts)
        })
        
    return ensure_chronological_order(parsed_parts, reverse_raw_pos=True)

def split_email_thread(email_body: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Uses local AI to split a multi-reply email thread into a list of messages ordered from oldest to newest.
    Each message dictionary contains keys: 'from', 'to', 'cc', 'date', 'body', 'subject'.
    Falls back to a heuristic parsing if AI fails or returns invalid output.
    """
    from datetime import datetime
    from core.prompts import SPLIT_EMAIL_THREAD_PROMPT
    if not email_body or not email_body.strip():
        return []
        
    try:
        response_str = generate_ai_response(
            prompt="Parse this email thread.",
            system_prompt=SPLIT_EMAIL_THREAD_PROMPT.format(email_body=email_body[:15000]), # truncate to prevent context overflow
            temperature=0.0
        )
        
        # Clean response if wrapped in markdown code blocks
        if "```" in response_str:
            parts = response_str.split("```")
            for part in parts:
                cleaned_part = part.strip()
                if cleaned_part.startswith("json"):
                    cleaned_part = cleaned_part[4:].strip()
                if (cleaned_part.startswith("[") and cleaned_part.endswith("]")) or (cleaned_part.startswith("{") and cleaned_part.endswith("}")):
                    response_str = cleaned_part
                    break

        thread_messages = json.loads(response_str)
        if isinstance(thread_messages, list):
            valid_messages = []
            for i, msg in enumerate(thread_messages):
                if isinstance(msg, dict) and 'from' in msg and 'body' in msg:
                    valid_messages.append({
                        "from": str(msg.get("from", "Unknown")),
                        "to": str(msg.get("to", "")),
                        "cc": str(msg.get("cc", "")),
                        "date": str(msg.get("date", "")),
                        "body": str(msg.get("body", "")),
                        "subject": str(msg.get("subject", "No Subject")),
                        "_raw_position": i  # 0 = first in AI output (usually oldest per prompt)
                    })
            if valid_messages:
                return ensure_chronological_order(valid_messages, reverse_raw_pos=False)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"AI Email Thread Splitting failed: {e}")
        
    return parse_email_thread_heuristically(email_body)

def ensure_chronological_order(messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], reverse_raw_pos: bool = True) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Ensure messages are ordered from oldest to newest (ascending by date).

    Email text is always structured newest-first, so `_raw_position` (0 = newest)
    is used as a tiebreaker: a higher _raw_position means an older message, so
    when dates are equal or unparseable we sort by DESCENDING _raw_position to
    correctly place older messages first.
    """
    if len(messages) <= 1:
        # Strip internal metadata before returning
        for m in messages:
            m.pop('_raw_position', None)
        return messages

    import dateutil.parser as date_parser
    from datetime import datetime

    n = len(messages)

    def sort_key(item: tuple):
        idx, msg = item
        raw_pos = msg.get('_raw_position', idx)  # fall back to enumerate index
        try:
            dt = date_parser.parse(msg.get('date', ''), default=datetime.min)
        except Exception:
            dt = datetime.max
        # Primary: parsed datetime ascending; Secondary: raw_position DESCENDING if reverse_raw_pos
        # (higher raw_position = deeper in the email = older message for heuristic)
        tiebreaker = -raw_pos if reverse_raw_pos else raw_pos
        return (dt, tiebreaker)

    try:
        indexed = list(enumerate(messages))
        indexed.sort(key=sort_key)
        sorted_messages = [msg for _, msg in indexed]
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Failed to sort messages chronologically: {e}")
        sorted_messages = messages

    # Remove internal metadata key before returning
    for m in sorted_messages:
        m.pop('_raw_position', None)

    return sorted_messages


def generate_weekly_project_status_narratives() -> None:
    """
    Automated status justification background function (Item 87).
    Runs weekly to evaluate tracking indicators for all active projects
    and drafts status narratives using the local Llama 3 model,
    saving the results in `ai_project_status_drafts`.
    """
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta
    from core.prompts import PROJECT_NARRATIVE_GENERATOR_PROMPT
    from core.database_utils import execute
    
    logger.info("🤖 Starting automated weekly status narrative generation...")
    
    # 1. Fetch active projects (not deleted, and status not Complete or Withdrawn)
    projects_df = query(
        "SELECT id, name, status, rag_status FROM projects WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('Complete', 'Withdrawn')"
    )
    if projects_df.empty:
        logger.info("No active projects found to generate status narratives.")
        return

    for _, project in projects_df.iterrows():
        project_id = int(project['id'])
        project_name = str(project['name'])
        current_rag = str(project['rag_status'] or 'Green')

        # --- A. Compile Milestone Status and Statistics ---
        milestones_df = query(
            "SELECT name, planned_date, actual_date, status FROM project_milestones WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY planned_date ASC",
            (project_id,)
        )
        if milestones_df.empty:
            milestone_status = "No milestones registered."
        else:
            total_m = len(milestones_df)
            status_counts = milestones_df['status'].value_counts().to_dict()
            status_str = ", ".join([f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in status_counts.items()])
            
            # Calculate achieved milestones statistics
            achieved_keys = ['Achieved', 'Complete', 'Completed', 'Passed']
            achieved_count = sum(status_counts.get(k, 0) for k in achieved_keys)
            pct_achieved = (achieved_count / total_m * 100) if total_m > 0 else 0.0
            
            # Upcoming milestones
            upcoming_count = len(milestones_df[milestones_df['status'].isin(['Planned', 'Upcoming'])])
            
            delayed_df = milestones_df[milestones_df['status'].isin(['Delayed', 'At Risk'])]
            delayed_names = ""
            if not delayed_df.empty:
                delayed_names = " (Delayed/At Risk: " + ", ".join([f"'{r['name']}'" for _, r in delayed_df.iterrows()]) + ")"
            
            milestone_status = (
                f"Total milestones: {total_m} ({status_str}){delayed_names}. "
                f"Milestone Statistics: {achieved_count}/{total_m} achieved ({pct_achieved:.1f}%), "
                f"{upcoming_count} upcoming planned milestones."
            )

        # --- B. Compile Unresolved High Risks and Recent Risk Changes ---
        risks_df = query(
            "SELECT description, impact, mitigation FROM risks WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 AND status != 'Closed' AND (impact LIKE '%High%' OR impact LIKE '%Critical%')",
            (project_id,)
        )
        if risks_df.empty:
            unresolved_high = "No unresolved high or critical risks."
        else:
            unresolved_high = "; ".join([
                f"'{r['description']}' (Impact: {r['impact']}, Mitigation: {r['mitigation']})"
                for _, r in risks_df.iterrows()
            ])

        # Query recent risk updates from risk_history in the last 7 days
        recent_risk_updates_df = query(
            """
            SELECT r.description, rh.update_date, rh.update_text 
            FROM risk_history rh
            JOIN risks r ON rh.risk_id = r.id
            WHERE r.project_id = ? AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND rh.update_date >= date('now', '-7 days')
            ORDER BY rh.update_date DESC
            """,
            (project_id,)
        )
        if recent_risk_updates_df.empty:
            recent_risk_changes = "No risk changes logged in the last 7 days."
        else:
            recent_risk_changes = "; ".join([
                f"Risk '{r['description']}' updated on {r['update_date']}: {r['update_text']}"
                for _, r in recent_risk_updates_df.iterrows()
            ])

        unresolved_risks = (
            f"Active High/Critical Risks: {unresolved_high} | "
            f"Recent Risk Changes (last 7 days): {recent_risk_changes}"
        )

        # --- C. Compile Task Velocity and Metric Summaries ---
        # Tasks completed in the last 28 days
        completed_df = query(
            "SELECT date_completed FROM actions WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 AND status IN ('Closed', 'Done', 'Completed') AND date_completed >= date('now', '-28 days')",
            (project_id,)
        )
        completed_count = len(completed_df)
        velocity = completed_count / 4.0

        # Total open tasks
        open_df = query(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM actions WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Done', 'Completed')",
            (project_id,)
        )
        open_tasks = int(open_df.iloc[0]['count']) if not open_df.empty else 0

        # Calculate task completion rate metric relative to total actions
        total_actions_df = query(
            "SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM actions WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0",
            (project_id,)
        )
        total_actions = int(total_actions_df.iloc[0]['count']) if not total_actions_df.empty else 0
        completion_rate = (completed_count / total_actions * 100) if total_actions > 0 else 0.0

        velocity_metrics = (
            f"Completed in last 4 weeks: {completed_count} tasks. "
            f"Weekly velocity: {velocity:.2f} tasks/week. "
            f"Open tasks remaining: {open_tasks}. "
            f"Metric Summaries: Task completion rate: {completion_rate:.1f}% (total actions: {total_actions})."
        )

        # --- D. Compile Sentiment Shifts ---
        # Fetch emails
        emails_df = query(
            "SELECT date_sent as date, sentiment_score, body FROM emails WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0",
            (project_id,)
        )
        # Fetch meetings
        meetings_df = query(
            "SELECT date, sentiment_score, summary FROM meetings WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0",
            (project_id,)
        )
        
        comms = []
        for _, row in emails_df.iterrows():
            d = str(row['date'])
            score = row['sentiment_score']
            if score is None or (isinstance(score, float) and pd.isna(score)):
                try:
                    score = analyze_sentiment(row['body'] or "")['polarity']
                except Exception:
                    score = 0.0
            comms.append({'date': d, 'sentiment': float(score)})
            
        for _, row in meetings_df.iterrows():
            d = str(row['date'])
            score = row['sentiment_score']
            if score is None or (isinstance(score, float) and pd.isna(score)):
                try:
                    score = analyze_sentiment(row['summary'] or "")['polarity']
                except Exception:
                    score = 0.0
            comms.append({'date': d, 'sentiment': float(score)})
            
        comms = sorted(comms, key=lambda x: x['date'])
        
        if not comms:
            sentiment_shifts = "No communication sentiment data available."
        else:
            # 14-day cutoff
            cutoff_date = (datetime.now() - timedelta(days=14)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            recent_comms = [c for c in comms if c['date'] >= cutoff_date]
            historical_comms = [c for c in comms if c['date'] < cutoff_date]
            
            if not recent_comms and len(comms) >= 2:
                split_idx = max(1, len(comms) - 3)
                recent_comms = comms[split_idx:]
                historical_comms = comms[:split_idx]
            elif not historical_comms and len(comms) >= 2:
                split_idx = min(len(comms) - 1, 3)
                historical_comms = comms[:split_idx]
                recent_comms = comms[split_idx:]
                
            if recent_comms and historical_comms:
                recent_avg = sum(c['sentiment'] for c in recent_comms) / len(recent_comms)
                historical_avg = sum(c['sentiment'] for c in historical_comms) / len(historical_comms)
                shift = recent_avg - historical_avg
                sentiment_shifts = (
                    f"Recent Average (last {len(recent_comms)} comms): {recent_avg:.2f}. "
                    f"Historical Average (first {len(historical_comms)} comms): {historical_avg:.2f}. "
                    f"Sentiment Shift: {shift:+.2f}."
                )
            elif recent_comms:
                recent_avg = sum(c['sentiment'] for c in recent_comms) / len(recent_comms)
                sentiment_shifts = f"Recent Average (only data available, {len(recent_comms)} comms): {recent_avg:.2f}. No historical baseline for shift calculation."
            else:
                sentiment_shifts = "Insufficient communications to calculate sentiment shifts."

        # --- E. Format Prompt and Generate Narrative ---
        prompt = PROJECT_NARRATIVE_GENERATOR_PROMPT.format(
            milestone_status=milestone_status,
            unresolved_risks=unresolved_risks,
            velocity_metrics=velocity_metrics,
            sentiment_shifts=sentiment_shifts
        )
        
        try:
            logger.info(f"Generating weekly status draft for project '{project_name}' (ID: {project_id})...")
            draft_narrative = generate_ai_response(prompt=prompt, temperature=0.3, bypass_cache=True)
            draft_narrative = draft_narrative.strip()
            
            # Save to ai_project_status_drafts
            created_at_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
            execute_silent(
                """INSERT INTO ai_project_status_drafts (project_id, draft_narrative, rag_status, created_at)
                   VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                (project_id, draft_narrative, current_rag, created_at_str)
            )
            
            # Trigger targeted cache invalidation
            # Querying the max id first
            max_id_row = fetch_one("SELECT max(id) FROM ai_project_status_drafts WHERE project_id = ?", (project_id,))
            if max_id_row and max_id_row[0]:
                execute(
                    "UPDATE ai_project_status_drafts SET project_id = project_id WHERE id = ?",
                    (int(max_id_row[0]),)
                )
            
            logger.info(f"Successfully saved AI status justification narrative draft for project {project_id}.")
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to generate weekly status narrative for project {project_id}: {e}")

    logger.info("🤖 Weekly status justification narrative generation complete.")

# assets/fonts configuration path
FONT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / 'assets' / 'fonts'

def add_markdown_to_doc(doc, text: str):
    """A simple markdown parser for python-docx."""
    if not text:
        return

    lines = text.split('\n')
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        if not line:
            i += 1
            continue

        # Setext Header Check
        if i + 1 < len(lines):
            next_line = lines[i+1].strip()
            if next_line and all(c == '=' for c in next_line):
                doc.add_paragraph(line, style='Heading 1')
                i += 2
                continue
            if next_line and all(c == '-' for c in next_line):
                doc.add_paragraph(line, style='Heading 2')
                i += 2
                continue

        p = doc.add_paragraph()
        if line.startswith('# '):
            p.text = line[2:]
            p.style = 'Heading 1'
        elif line.startswith('## '):
            p.text = line[3:]
            p.style = 'Heading 2'
        elif line.startswith('### '):
            p.text = line[4:]
            p.style = 'Heading 3'
        elif line.startswith(('* ', '- ')):
            p.text = line[2:]
            p.style = 'List Bullet'
        elif re.match(r'\d+\.\s', line):
            p.text = line
            p.style = 'List Paragraph'
        else:
            p.clear()
            parts = re.split(r'(\*\*.*?\*\*|\*.*?\*)', line)
            for part in parts:
                if part.startswith('**') and part.endswith('**'):
                    p.add_run(part[2:-2]).bold = True
                elif part.startswith('*') and part.endswith('*'):
                    p.add_run(part[1:-1]).italic = True
                else:
                    p.add_run(part)
        i += 1


class ReportPDF(FPDF):
    def __init__(self, orientation='P', unit='mm', format='A4', title=''):
        super().__init__(orientation, unit, format)
        self.report_title = title
        self.set_left_margin(15)
        self.set_right_margin(15)
        self.has_unicode_font = False
        
        # --- UNICODE FONT SETUP ---
        try:
            if (FONT_DIR / 'DejaVuSans.ttf').exists():
                self.add_font('DejaVu', '', str(FONT_DIR / 'DejaVuSans.ttf'), uni=True)
                self.add_font('DejaVu', 'B', str(FONT_DIR / 'DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf'), uni=True)
                self.add_font('DejaVu', 'I', str(FONT_DIR / 'DejaVuSans-Oblique.ttf'), uni=True)
                self.has_unicode_font = True
        except Exception:
            self.has_unicode_font = False

    def _get_font_family(self):
        return 'DejaVu' if self.has_unicode_font else 'Arial'

    def header(self):
        # NHS Blue Header bar
        self.set_fill_color(0, 94, 184) 
        self.rect(0, 0, self.w, 20, 'F')
        
        # NHS Logo Block (white solid box with NHS Blue text "NHS")
        self.set_fill_color(255, 255, 255)
        self.rect(self.w - 30, 4, 15, 12, 'F')
        
        # Safe coordinate boundaries to handle massive or unspaced file/subject names
        self.set_xy(15, 2) 
        self.set_font(self._get_font_family(), 'B', 12) 
        self.set_text_color(255, 255, 255)
        
        try:
            display_title = self.report_title[:100] # Hard limit
            if len(display_title) > 60 and ' ' not in display_title[:60]:
                display_title = display_title[:57] + "..."
            self.multi_cell(self.w - 50, 5, display_title, border=0, align='L')
        except Exception:
            try:
                self.multi_cell(self.w - 50, 5, "Report", border=0, align='L') # Fallback to a very simple title
            except Exception:
                pass # Absolute fallback

        self.set_xy(15, 12)
        self.set_font(self._get_font_family(), '', 9)
        self.set_text_color(255, 255, 255)
        self.cell(self.w - 50, 5, f"Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%d %B %Y')}", 0, ln=1, align='L')
        
        # Render NHS logo text inside the logo block
        self.set_xy(self.w - 30, 4)
        self.set_font(self._get_font_family(), 'B', 12)
        self.set_text_color(0, 94, 184) # NHS Blue
        self.cell(15, 12, "NHS", border=0, align='C')
        
        # Reset positioning safely below the header banner zone
        self.set_xy(15, 25)

    def footer(self):
        self.set_y(-15)
        self.set_font(self._get_font_family(), 'I', 8)
        self.set_text_color(128, 128, 128)
        self.cell(0, 10, f'People Portal Programme - Page {self.page_no()}', 0, 0, 'C')

    def chapter_title(self, title, level=1):
        font_family = self._get_font_family()
        if not self.has_unicode_font:
            title = ''.join(c for c in title if ord(c) < 128)

        if level == 1:
            self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 14)
            self.set_text_color(0, 94, 184) 
        else: 
            self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 12)
            self.set_text_color(0, 0, 0)
            
        # Added cell structure wrap protection for long titles
        clean_title = str(title).replace('\r', '').replace('\n', ' ')
        try:
            self.multi_cell(0, 6, clean_title)
        except Exception:
            chunk_size = 60
            for i in range(0, len(clean_title), chunk_size):
                try:
                    self.multi_cell(0, 6, clean_title[i:i+chunk_size])
                except Exception:
                    pass # Absolute safety net
        self.ln(4)

    def chapter_body(self, body):
        self.set_font(self._get_font_family(), '', 10)
        self.set_text_color(0, 0, 0)
        body_text = str(body)
        if not self.has_unicode_font:
            body_text = ''.join(c for c in body_text if ord(c) < 128)
        
        for line in str(body_text).splitlines():
            clean_line = line.replace('\r', '') # Clean carriage returns
            try:
                self.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_line)
            except Exception:
                # Fallback for very long unbreakable strings
                chunk_size = 80
                for i in range(0, len(clean_line), chunk_size):
                    try:
                        self.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_line[i:i+chunk_size])
                    except Exception:
                        pass # If even a small chunk fails, just skip it.
        self.ln(5)

    def _render_formatted_text(self, text, default_style=''):
        font_family = self._get_font_family()
        parts = re.split(r'(\*\*.*?\*\*|\*.*?\*)', text)
        try:
            with open("/Volumes/Crucial X9 Pro For Mac/Project Management/pdf_debug.log", "a") as debug_f:
                debug_f.write(f"TEXT: {repr(text)}\n")
                debug_f.write(f"PARTS: {repr(parts)}\n")
        except Exception:
            pass
        for part in parts:
            if not part:
                continue
            if part.startswith('**') and part.endswith('**'):
                self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 10)
                self.write(5, part[2:-2])
            elif part.startswith('*') and part.endswith('*'):
                self.set_font(font_family, 'I', 10)
                self.write(5, part[1:-1])
            else:
                self.set_font(font_family, default_style, 10)
                self.write(5, part)
        self.set_font(font_family, default_style, 10)

    def markdown_to_pdf(self, text: str):
        """A robust markdown parser for FPDF with formatting support."""
        if not text:
            return
        font_family = self._get_font_family()

        lines = str(text).split('\n')
        i = 0
        while i < len(lines):
            line = lines[i].strip()
            if not line:
                i += 1
                continue

            if not self.has_unicode_font:
                line = ''.join(c for c in line if ord(c) < 128)

            # Setext Header Check
            if i + 1 < len(lines):
                next_line = lines[i+1].strip()
                if next_line and all(c == '=' for c in next_line):
                    self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 16)
                    self.multi_cell(0, 7, line, ln=1)
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if next_line and all(c == '-' for c in next_line):
                    self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 14)
                    self.multi_cell(0, 6, line, ln=1)
                    i += 2
                    continue

            # Horizontal Rule
            if line in ['---', '***', '___']:
                self.ln(5)
                self.line(self.get_x(), self.get_y(), self.w - self.r_margin, self.get_y())
                self.ln(5)
                i += 1
                continue

            # Check markdown line prefixes and use safe multi_cell chunk loops
            try:
                if line.startswith('# '):
                    self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 16)
                    clean_line = line[2:].replace('**', '').replace('*', '')
                    self.multi_cell(0, 7, clean_line, ln=1)
                elif line.startswith('## '):
                    self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 14)
                    clean_line = line[3:].replace('**', '').replace('*', '')
                    self.multi_cell(0, 6, clean_line, ln=1)
                elif line.startswith('### '):
                    self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 12)
                    clean_line = line[4:].replace('**', '').replace('*', '')
                    self.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_line, ln=1)
                elif line.startswith('#### '):
                    self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 11)
                    clean_line = line[5:].replace('**', '').replace('*', '')
                    self.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_line, ln=1)
                elif line.startswith('##### '):
                    self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 10)
                    clean_line = line[6:].replace('**', '').replace('*', '')
                    self.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_line, ln=1)
                elif line.startswith(('* ', '- ')):
                    if self.x != self.l_margin:
                        self.ln()
                    self.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
                    bullet = '•' if self.has_unicode_font else '*'
                    self.cell(5, 5, bullet, 0, 0)
                    self._render_formatted_text(line[2:])
                    self.ln()
                elif re.match(r'\d+\.\s', line):
                    if self.x != self.l_margin:
                        self.ln()
                    self.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
                    match = re.match(r'(\d+\.)\s(.*)', line)
                    if match:
                        self.cell(8, 5, match.group(1))
                        self._render_formatted_text(match.group(2))
                        self.ln()
                else:
                    if self.x != self.l_margin:
                        self.ln()
                    self._render_formatted_text(line)
                    self.ln()
            except Exception as e:
                import traceback
                try:
                    with open("/Volumes/Crucial X9 Pro For Mac/Project Management/pdf_error.log", "a") as log_f:
                        log_f.write(f"Exception processing line: {repr(line)}\n")
                        log_f.write(f"Exception: {e}\n")
                        traceback.print_exc(file=log_f)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                # Absolute fallback wrapper block for unspaced layout strings inside markdown content
                chunk_size = 80
                for k in range(0, len(line), chunk_size):
                    try:
                        self.multi_cell(0, 5, line[k:k+chunk_size])
                    except Exception:
                        pass # Absolute safety net
            i += 1

    def add_df_to_pdf(self, df: pd.DataFrame, col_widths: list):
        if df.empty:
            return
        font_family = self._get_font_family()
        self.set_font(font_family, 'B', 9)
        self.set_fill_color(220, 220, 220)
        # Headers
        for i, col_name in enumerate(df.columns):
            h_text = str(col_name)
            if not self.has_unicode_font:
                h_text = h_text.replace("↳", "->").replace("👤", "*")
                h_text = ''.join(c for c in h_text if ord(c) < 128)
            self.cell(col_widths[i], 7, h_text, 1, 0, 'C', fill=True)
        self.ln()
        # Data
        self.set_font(font_family, '', 8)
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            for i, item in enumerate(row):
                val_str = str(item)
                if not self.has_unicode_font:
                    val_str = val_str.replace("↳", "->").replace("👤", "*")
                    val_str = ''.join(c for c in val_str if ord(c) < 128)
                self.cell(col_widths[i], 6, val_str, 1)
            self.ln()
        self.ln(5)


class ExecutiveReport(ReportPDF):
    def __init__(self, orientation='P', unit='mm', format='A4'):
        super().__init__(orientation, unit, format, title='National Status Report')


def generate_national_pdf(red_alerts: pd.DataFrame, phase_counts: pd.DataFrame, burnout_data: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    pdf = ExecutiveReport()
    pdf.add_page()
    
    font_family = pdf._get_font_family()
    
    # 1. PHASE DISTRIBUTION SECTION
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 16)
    pdf.set_text_color(0, 94, 184)
    pdf.cell(0, 10, "1. Rollout Phase Distribution", 0, ln=1)  
    pdf.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
    pdf.set_text_color(0, 0, 0)
    
    for _, row in phase_counts.iterrows():
        pdf.cell(100, 7, f"{row['Phase']}:", 1)
        pdf.cell(40, 7, f"{row['Count']} Projects", 1, ln=1, align='C')  
    pdf.ln(10)

    # 2. RED ALERT SECTION
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 16)
    pdf.set_text_color(212, 53, 28) 
    pdf.cell(0, 10, "2. Critical Red Alerts", 0, ln=1)  
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 10)
    pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240)
    pdf.cell(65, 8, "Trust", 1, ln=0, align='L', fill=True)  
    pdf.cell(65, 8, "Stream", 1, ln=0, align='L', fill=True)  
    pdf.cell(50, 8, "Critical Risks", 1, ln=1, align='C', fill=True)  
    
    pdf.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
    for _, row in red_alerts.iterrows():
        pdf.cell(65, 8, str(row['Trust']), 1)
        pdf.cell(65, 8, str(row['Stream']), 1)
        pdf.cell(50, 8, str(row['critical_count']), 1, ln=1, align='C')  
    pdf.ln(10)

    # 3. CAPACITY SECTION
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 16)
    pdf.set_text_color(0, 94, 184)
    pdf.cell(0, 10, "3. Advisor Capacity & Burnout Risk", 0, ln=1)  
    pdf.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
    pdf.set_text_color(0, 0, 0)
    
    for _, row in burnout_data.iterrows():
        score = row['Score']
        warning = " [HIGH LOAD]" if score > 10 else ""
        pdf.cell(100, 8, f"{row['Name']}{warning}", 1)
        pdf.cell(40, 8, f"Score: {score:.1f}", 1, ln=1, align='C')  

    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_chat_pdf(chat_msgs: List[Dict[str, Any]], project_name: str, org_name: str) -> bytes:
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f"AI Consultation: {project_name}")
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Organisation: {org_name} | Date: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")

    for msg in chat_msgs:
        role = "Project Manager" if msg['role'] == 'user' else ("System" if msg['role'] == 'system' else "AI Assistant")
        if role == "System": continue
        font_family = pdf._get_font_family()
        pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 10)
        pdf.write(5, f"{role}:")
        pdf.ln()
        pdf.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
        
        # Wrapped call mechanics
        pdf.chapter_body(msg['content'])
    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_digest_pdf(df: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    pdf = ReportPDF(title='Weekly National Project Digest')
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Report Period: Last 7 Days | Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")

    if df.empty:
        pdf.chapter_body("No updates found for this period.")
    else:
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            pdf.chapter_title(f"{row['Org']} - {row['Project']}", level=1)
            pdf.chapter_body(f"Meeting Date: {row['date']}")
            
            if row.get('summary'):
                pdf.chapter_title("Executive Summary", level=2)
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row['summary']))
            
            if row.get('decisions'):
                pdf.chapter_title("Key Decisions", level=2)
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row['decisions']))
            
            if row.get('next_steps'):
                pdf.chapter_title("Strategic Outlook", level=2)
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row['next_steps']))

            pdf.ln(5)
    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_minutes_pdf(df_meetings: pd.DataFrame, project_name: str, org_name: str) -> bytes:
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f'Meeting Minutes: {project_name}')
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Organisation: {org_name}\nExport Date: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")

    for _, row in df_meetings.iterrows():
        date_display = ""
        try:
            if pd.notna(row.get('start_time')):
                date_display = dparser.parse(str(row['start_time'])).strftime('%d %B %Y, %H:%M')
            elif pd.notna(row.get('date')):
                date_display = pd.to_datetime(row['date']).strftime('%d %B %Y')
        except (dparser.ParserError, ValueError, TypeError):
            date_display = str(row.get('date', 'Unknown Date'))
        
        pdf.chapter_title(f"Meeting Date: {date_display}", level=1)
        pdf.chapter_title("Attendees", level=2)
        pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row.get('attendees', 'N/A')))
        
        pdf.chapter_title("Executive Summary", level=2)
        pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row.get('summary', 'N/A')))
        
        pdf.chapter_title("Thematic Discussion", level=2)
        pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row.get('thematic', 'N/A')))
        
        pdf.chapter_title("Decisions Made", level=2)
        pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row.get('decisions', 'N/A')))
        
        if 'consortium_notes' in row.index and pd.notna(row['consortium_notes']) and row['consortium_notes']:
            pdf.chapter_title("Consortium Notes", level=2)
            pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row['consortium_notes']))

        pdf.chapter_title("Strategic Outlook", level=2)
        pdf.markdown_to_pdf(str(row.get('next_steps', 'N/A')))
        
        pdf.ln(5)
    return bytes(pdf.output())


def export_minutes_to_word(df_meetings: pd.DataFrame, project_name: str, org_name: str) -> bytes:
    """Generates a Word document from a dataframe of meeting minutes."""
    doc = Document()
    doc.add_heading(f'Meeting Minutes Export: {project_name}', 0)
    doc.add_paragraph(f"Organisation: {org_name}")
    doc.add_paragraph(f"Export Date: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
    doc.add_paragraph("-" * 50)

    for _, row in df_meetings.iterrows():
        doc.add_heading(f"Meeting Date: {row['date']}", level=1)
        
        doc.add_heading("Attendees", level=2)
        add_markdown_to_doc(doc, str(row.get('attendees', 'N/A')))
        
        doc.add_heading("Executive Summary", level=2)
        add_markdown_to_doc(doc, str(row.get('summary', 'N/A')))
        
        doc.add_heading("Thematic Discussion", level=2)
        add_markdown_to_doc(doc, str(row.get('thematic', 'N/A')))
        
        doc.add_heading("Decisions Made", level=2)
        add_markdown_to_doc(doc, str(row.get('decisions', 'N/A')))
        
        if 'consortium_notes' in row.index and pd.notna(row['consortium_notes']) and row['consortium_notes']:
            doc.add_heading("Consortium Notes", level=2)
            add_markdown_to_doc(doc, str(row.get('consortium_notes', 'N/A')))

        doc.add_heading("Strategic Outlook", level=2)
        add_markdown_to_doc(doc, str(row.get('next_steps', 'N/A')))
        
        doc.add_paragraph("-" * 50)

    output = io.BytesIO()
    doc.save(output)
    return output.getvalue()


def to_meeting_prep_doc(project_name: str, org_name: str, df_actions: pd.DataFrame, df_risks: pd.DataFrame, df_history: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    """Generates a briefing dossier for CoPilot."""
    doc = Document()
    doc.add_heading(f'Pre-Meeting Briefing: {project_name}', 0)
    doc.add_paragraph(f"Organisation: {org_name}")
    
    doc.add_heading('📋 Current Open Actions', level=1) 
    if not df_actions.empty:
        table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=3); hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
        hdr_cells[0].text, hdr_cells[1].text, hdr_cells[2].text = 'Task', 'Owner', 'Due'
        for _, row in df_actions.iterrows():
            row_cells = table.add_row().cells
            row_cells[0].text, row_cells[1].text, row_cells[2].text = str(row['task']), str(row['assigned_to']), str(row['due_date'])
    
    doc.add_heading('⚠️ Active Risks', level=1) 
    if not df_risks.empty:
        for _, row in df_risks.iterrows():
            p = doc.add_paragraph(style='List Bullet')
            p.add_run(f"[{row['impact']}] ").bold = True
            p.add_run(f"{row['description']}")
            
    output = io.BytesIO()
    doc.save(output)
    return output.getvalue()


def generate_dossier_pdf(project_name: str, org_name: str, df_actions: pd.DataFrame, df_risks: pd.DataFrame, df_history: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f'Pre-Meeting Briefing: {project_name}')
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Organisation: {org_name}")
    
    pdf.chapter_title('Current Open Actions', level=1)
    if not df_actions.empty:
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_actions[['task', 'assigned_to', 'due_date']], col_widths=[90, 40, 30])
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No open actions.")
    
    pdf.chapter_title('Active Risks', level=1)
    if not df_risks.empty:
        font_family = pdf._get_font_family()
        for _, row in df_risks.iterrows():
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 10)
            pdf.write(5, f"[{row['impact']}] ")
            pdf.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
            pdf.ln() 
            pdf.markdown_to_pdf(row['description'])
            
            if pd.notna(row['mitigation']):
                pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 10)
                pdf.write(5, "Mitigation: ")
                pdf.ln()
                pdf.set_font(font_family, '', 10)
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(row['mitigation'])
            pdf.ln(2)
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No active risks.")
            
    pdf.chapter_title('Historical Meeting Context', level=1)
    if not df_history.empty:
        for _, row in df_history.iterrows():
            pdf.chapter_title(f"Meeting: {row['date']}", level=2)
            if row['summary']: pdf.markdown_to_pdf(f"**Summary:** {row['summary']}")
            if row['decisions']: pdf.markdown_to_pdf(f"**Decisions:** {row['decisions']}")
            if 'consortium_notes' in row.index and pd.notna(row['consortium_notes']) and row['consortium_notes']:
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(f"**Consortium Notes:** {row['consortium_notes']}")
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No historical meetings.")
        
    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_project_status_pdf(project_name: str, org_name: str, audience: str, report_content: str) -> bytes:
    """Generates a PDF for an AI-generated project status report."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f'Project Status Report: {project_name}')
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Organisation: {org_name}")
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Audience: {audience}")
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Report Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
    pdf.ln(5)

    pdf.chapter_title(f"AI-Generated Status Report for {project_name}", level=1)
    pdf.markdown_to_pdf(report_content)
    pdf.ln(5)

    return bytes(pdf.output())

def generate_change_summary_pdf(project_name: str, org_name: str, df_adkar: pd.DataFrame, adkar_chart: Optional[alt.Chart], progress_data: Dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
    """Generates a PDF summary of the Change Management dashboard."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f'Change Summary: {project_name}')
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Organisation: {org_name}\nReport Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
    pdf.ln(5)

    pdf.chapter_title("Project-Wide ADKAR Profile", level=1)
    if adkar_chart is not None and not df_adkar.empty:
        try:
            chart_png_bytes = vlc.vegalite_to_png(adkar_chart.to_dict())
            image_stream = io.BytesIO(chart_png_bytes)
            page_width = pdf.w - pdf.l_margin - pdf.r_margin
            pdf.image(image_stream, x=pdf.l_margin, w=page_width)
            pdf.ln(5)
        except Exception as e:
            pdf.chapter_body(f"[ADKAR chart could not be rendered in PDF. Error: {e}]")
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No ADKAR assessments have been completed yet.")

    pdf.chapter_title("Framework Progress", level=1)
    if progress_data:
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 10)
        pdf.cell(90, 8, "Framework", 1, 0, 'L')
        pdf.cell(40, 8, "Completion", 1, 1, 'C')
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 10)
        for name, data in progress_data.items():
            pdf.cell(90, 8, name, 1, 0, 'L')
            if data.get('total') == "N/A":
                completion_text = f"{data['completed']} items"
            else:
                completion_text = f"{data['completed']} / {data['total']} ({data['progress']:.0f}%)"
            pdf.cell(40, 8, completion_text, 1, 1, 'C')
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No framework progress data available.")

    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_prosci_pdf(df_prosci: pd.DataFrame, chart: Optional[alt.Chart] = None) -> bytes:
    pdf = ReportPDF(title='Prosci® Risk Analysis Report')
    pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Report Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")

    pdf.chapter_title("Prosci Risk Grid Overview", level=1)
    overview_text = (
        "The Prosci Risk Grid plots organisations based on two key dimensions: "
        "Change Characteristics and Organisational Attributes. Each dimension is scored "
        "from 15 to 75. A mid-point of 45 is used to delineate risk quadrants:\n"
        "- **High Risk:** Both Change Characteristics and Organisational Attributes scores are above 45.\n"
        "- **Low Risk:** Both Change Characteristics and Organisational Attributes scores are 45 or below.\n"
        "- **Medium Risk:** Scores fall into other combinations (one above 45, one below).\n"
        "The 'Risk Score' is a simple sum of the Change Characteristics and Organisational Attributes, "
        "providing an overall indicator of change risk."
    )
    pdf.markdown_to_pdf(overview_text)
    pdf.ln(5)

    if chart is not None:
        pdf.chapter_title("Prosci Risk Grid", level=1)
        try:
            chart_png_bytes = vlc.vegalite_to_png(chart.to_dict())
            page_width = pdf.w - pdf.l_margin - pdf.r_margin
            image_stream = io.BytesIO(chart_png_bytes)
            pdf.image(image_stream, x=pdf.l_margin, w=page_width)
            pdf.ln(5)
        except Exception as e:
            pdf.chapter_body(f"[Chart could not be rendered in PDF. Error: {e}]")

    if pdf.get_y() + 40 > pdf.h - pdf.b_margin: 
        pdf.add_page()

    pdf.chapter_title("Risk Ranking Table", level=1)
    if not df_prosci.empty:
        df_display = df_prosci[['Rank', 'Organisation', 'Risk Category', 'Risk Score']].copy()
        page_width = pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin
        proportions = {'Rank': 0.10, 'Organisation': 0.50, 'Risk Category': 0.25, 'Risk Score': 0.15}
        col_widths = [page_width * proportions[col] for col in df_display.columns]

        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 9)
        pdf.set_fill_color(220, 220, 220) 
        pdf.set_text_color(0, 94, 184) 
        for i, col_name in enumerate(df_display.columns):
            pdf.cell(col_widths[i], 7, str(col_name), 1, 0, 'C', fill=True)
        pdf.ln()

        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
        pdf.set_text_color(0, 0, 0) 
        
        color_map = {
            'High Risk': (255, 204, 203),   
            'Medium Risk': (255, 255, 224), 
            'Low Risk': (204, 255, 204)    
        }

        for _, row in df_display.iterrows():
            fill_color = color_map.get(row['Risk Category'], (255, 255, 255)) 
            pdf.set_fill_color(*fill_color)
            for i, item in enumerate(row):
                pdf.cell(col_widths[i], 6, str(item), 1, 0, 'L', fill=True)
            pdf.ln()
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No Prosci risk data available for ranking.")

    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_regional_directory_pdf(directory_data: Dict[str, Any], photo_map: Dict[str, Any]) -> bytes:
    """Generates a PDF of the regional directory, optimized for many members."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(orientation='P', format='A3', title='Regional Directory')
 
    region_names = sorted(directory_data.keys())
    if not region_names:
        pdf.add_page()
        pdf.chapter_body("No regional data available.")
        return bytes(pdf.output())

    col1_roles = [
        ("Senior Implementation Leads (SILs)", "sils"),
        ("Implementation Leads (ILs)", "ils"),
        ("Implementation Managers (IMs)", "ims"),
        ("Implementation Advisors (IAs)", "ias"),
    ]
    col2_roles = [
        ("Senior Solution Readiness Leads (SSRLs)", "ssrls"),
        ("Solution Readiness Leads (SRLs)", "srls"),
        ("Senior Change & Enablement Leads (SCELs)", "scels"),
        ("Change & Enablement Leads (CELs)", "cels"),
    ]

    member_block_width = 35
    member_block_height = 40
    page_width = pdf.w - pdf.l_margin - pdf.r_margin
    col_width = (page_width / 2) - 5 
    col1_x_start = pdf.l_margin
    col2_x_start = pdf.l_margin + col_width + 10

    for region in region_names:
        any_members_in_region = any(directory_data[region].get(role_key) for _, role_key in col1_roles + col2_roles)
        if not any_members_in_region:
            continue

        pdf.add_page()
        pdf.chapter_title(region, level=1)

        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 11)
        pdf.set_text_color(0, 94, 184) 
        
        title_y_start = pdf.get_y()
        pdf.set_x(col1_x_start)
        pdf.multi_cell(col_width, 6, "NHSBSA Readiness and Implementation Team", 0, 'C')
        y_after_col1 = pdf.get_y()

        pdf.set_xy(col2_x_start, title_y_start) 
        pdf.multi_cell(col_width, 6, "Consortium Teams", 0, 'C')
        y_after_col2 = pdf.get_y()

        pdf.set_y(max(y_after_col1, y_after_col2)) 
        pdf.ln(5) 
        
        initial_y = pdf.get_y()

        # --- RENDER COLUMN 1 ---
        pdf.set_y(initial_y)

        for role_title, role_key in col1_roles:
            members = directory_data[region].get(role_key, [])
            if not members:
                continue

            pdf.set_x(col1_x_start)
            pdf.chapter_title(role_title, level=2)
            pdf.set_x(col1_x_start)

            for member_name in members:
                if pdf.get_x() + member_block_width > col1_x_start + col_width:
                    pdf.ln(member_block_height)
                    pdf.set_x(col1_x_start)

                current_x = pdf.get_x()
                current_y = pdf.get_y()

                if photo_map.get(member_name):
                    try:
                        img_bytes = base64.b64decode(photo_map[member_name][0])
                        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes)) as img:
                            if img.mode in ('RGBA', 'P'): img = img.convert('RGB')
                            cropped_img = ImageOps.fit(img, (200, 200), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                            jpeg_buffer = io.BytesIO()
                            cropped_img.save(jpeg_buffer, format='JPEG', quality=85)
                            jpeg_buffer.seek(0)
                            pdf.image(jpeg_buffer, x=current_x, y=current_y, w=30, h=30, type='JPEG')
                    except Exception:
                        pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240); pdf.rect(current_x, current_y, 30, 30, 'F')
                else: 
                    pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240); pdf.rect(current_x, current_y, 30, 30, 'F')
                    if pdf.has_unicode_font:
                        pdf.set_xy(current_x, current_y + 10); pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 20); pdf.multi_cell(30, 5, '👤', 0, 'C')

                pdf.set_xy(current_x, current_y + 30); pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8); pdf.multi_cell(30, 4, member_name, 0, 'C')
                pdf.set_xy(current_x + member_block_width, current_y)
            
            pdf.ln(member_block_height)

        # --- RENDER COLUMN 2 ---
        pdf.set_y(initial_y) 

        for role_title, role_key in col2_roles:
            members = directory_data[region].get(role_key, [])
            if not members:
                continue

            pdf.set_x(col2_x_start)
            pdf.chapter_title(role_title, level=2)
            pdf.set_x(col2_x_start)
            
            for member_name in members:
                if pdf.get_x() + member_block_width > col2_x_start + col_width:
                    pdf.ln(member_block_height)
                    pdf.set_x(col2_x_start)

                current_x = pdf.get_x()
                current_y = pdf.get_y()

                if photo_map.get(member_name):
                    try:
                        img_bytes = base64.b64decode(photo_map[member_name][0])
                        with Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes)) as img:
                            if img.mode in ('RGBA', 'P'): img = img.convert('RGB')
                            cropped_img = ImageOps.fit(img, (200, 200), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                            jpeg_buffer = io.BytesIO()
                            cropped_img.save(jpeg_buffer, format='JPEG', quality=85)
                            jpeg_buffer.seek(0)
                            pdf.image(jpeg_buffer, x=current_x, y=current_y, w=30, h=30, type='JPEG')
                    except Exception:
                        pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240); pdf.rect(current_x, current_y, 30, 30, 'F')
                else: 
                    pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240); pdf.rect(current_x, current_y, 30, 30, 'F')
                    if pdf.has_unicode_font:
                        pdf.set_xy(current_x, current_y + 10); pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 20); pdf.multi_cell(30, 5, '👤', 0, 'C')

                pdf.set_xy(current_x, current_y + 30); pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8); pdf.multi_cell(30, 4, member_name, 0, 'C')
                pdf.set_xy(current_x + member_block_width, current_y)

            pdf.ln(member_block_height)
    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_pdf_from_docx(docx_path: str) -> bytes:
    """Generates a PDF from an encrypted .docx file's content."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=os.path.basename(docx_path))
    pdf.add_page()
    
    try:
        docx_bytes = decrypt_file(docx_path)
        doc = Document(io.BytesIO(docx_bytes))
        
        for para in doc.paragraphs:
            if para.text.strip():
                pdf.chapter_body(para.text)
            
    except Exception as e:
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 12)
        pdf.set_text_color(255, 0, 0)
        pdf.multi_cell(0, 10, f"Error converting DOCX to PDF: {e}")

    return pdf.output()


def generate_pdf_from_msg(msg_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> bytes:
    """Generates a PDF from an .msg file's content cleanly with total width enforcement."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f"Email: {filename[:50]}") # Enforce strict string boundary limit on filename
    pdf.add_page()

    try:
        msg = extract_msg.Message(io.BytesIO(msg_bytes))

        # Extract headers safely
        subject = msg.subject or 'No Subject'
        from_ = msg.sender or 'Unknown Sender'
        to_ = msg.to or 'Unknown Recipient'
        cc_ = msg.cc or ''
        date_str = "Unknown Date"
        try:
            raw_date = msg.date
            if raw_date:
                date_str = dparser.parse(str(raw_date), fuzzy=True).strftime('%d %B %Y, %H:%M')
        except Exception:
            if raw_date:
                date_str = str(raw_date)[:30] # Force truncate string layout if parsing acts up

        pdf.chapter_title(subject, level=1)
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 9)
        pdf.set_text_color(128, 128, 128)
        
        # Render headers strictly line-by-line using chunk parsing mechanics
        headers = [f"From: {from_}", f"To: {to_}"]
        if cc_:
            headers.append(f"CC: {cc_}")
        headers.append(f"Date: {date_str}")
        
        for header_line in headers:
            # Clean out carriage returns that can mess up line geometry calculations
            clean_header = str(header_line).replace('\r', '').replace('\n', ' ')
            try:
                pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_header)
            except Exception:
                chunk_size = 60
                for i in range(0, len(clean_header), chunk_size):
                    try:
                        pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_header[i:i+chunk_size])
                    except Exception:
                        pass # Absolute safety layer against catastrophic string formatting anomalies
        
        pdf.ln(10)

        # Extract and write chunked body text via core wrapped engine
        body_text = msg.body or ""
        pdf.chapter_body(body_text)

    except Exception as e:
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 12)
        pdf.set_text_color(255, 0, 0)
        try:
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 10, f"Error converting MSG to PDF: {str(e)[:50]}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    return pdf.output()


def generate_pdf_from_eml(eml_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> bytes:
    """Generates a PDF from an .eml file's content cleanly with total width enforcement."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f"Email: {filename[:50]}") # Enforce strict string boundary limit on filename
    import email
    from email import policy
    pdf.add_page()

    try:
        msg = email.message_from_bytes(eml_bytes, policy=policy.default)

        # Extract headers safely
        subject = msg.get('subject', 'No Subject')
        from_ = msg.get('from', 'Unknown Sender')
        to_ = msg.get('to', 'Unknown Recipient')
        cc_ = msg.get('cc', '')
        date_str = "Unknown Date"
        try:
            raw_date = msg.get('date')
            if raw_date:
                date_str = dparser.parse(str(raw_date), fuzzy=True).strftime('%d %B %Y, %H:%M')
        except Exception:
            if raw_date:
                date_str = str(raw_date)[:30]

        pdf.chapter_title(subject, level=1)
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 9)
        pdf.set_text_color(128, 128, 128)
        
        # Render headers strictly line-by-line using chunk parsing mechanics
        headers = [f"From: {from_}", f"To: {to_}"]
        if cc_:
            headers.append(f"CC: {cc_}")
        headers.append(f"Date: {date_str}")
        
        for header_line in headers:
            clean_header = str(header_line).replace('\r', '').replace('\n', ' ')
            try:
                pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_header)
            except Exception:
                chunk_size = 60
                for i in range(0, len(clean_header), chunk_size):
                    try:
                        pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, clean_header[i:i+chunk_size])
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    
        pdf.ln(10)

        # Extract text body
        body_text = ""
        if msg.is_multipart():
            for part in msg.walk():
                content_type = part.get_content_type()
                content_disposition = str(part.get("Content-Disposition"))
                if content_type == "text/plain" and "attachment" not in content_disposition:
                    body_text = part.get_payload(decode=True).decode(errors="replace")
                    break
        else:
            body_text = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode(errors="replace")

        pdf.chapter_body(body_text)

    except Exception as e:
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 12)
        pdf.set_text_color(255, 0, 0)
        try:
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 10, f"Error converting EML to PDF: {str(e)[:50]}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    return pdf.output()


def generate_site_visit_pack_pdf(
    project_name: str,
    org_name: str,
    systems_landscape: str,
    checklist_data: list,
    df_actions: pd.DataFrame,
    df_risks: pd.DataFrame,
    df_stakeholders: pd.DataFrame,
    df_meetings: pd.DataFrame
) -> bytes:
    """Generates a structured, printable A4 PDF site briefing pack for a project."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f"Site Briefing: {project_name[:40]}")
    pdf.add_page()
    
    # 1. Organisation Overview
    pdf.chapter_title("1. Organisation Overview", level=1)
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Organisation: {org_name}\nProject/Stream: {project_name}")
    
    # Systems Landscape
    pdf.chapter_title("Systems Landscape", level=2)
    if systems_landscape:
        pdf.chapter_body(systems_landscape)
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No systems landscape information recorded yet.")
    pdf.ln(5)
        
    # 2. Foundational Readiness Checklist
    pdf.chapter_title("2. Foundational Readiness Status", level=1)
    if checklist_data:
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 9)
        pdf.set_fill_color(220, 220, 220)
        pdf.cell(115, 7, "Readiness Item", 1, 0, 'L', fill=True)
        pdf.cell(30, 7, "Status", 1, 0, 'C', fill=True)
        pdf.cell(35, 7, "Owner", 1, 1, 'C', fill=True)
        
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
        from core.constants import FOUNDATIONAL_READINESS_CHECKLIST
        frg_descriptions = {str(k): v for k, v in FOUNDATIONAL_READINESS_CHECKLIST}
        
        for item in checklist_data:
            # NHS Jobs or FRG Checklist schema
            task_id = item.get('Task ID') or item.get('criteria_name') or ''
            task_desc = item.get('Task Description') or frg_descriptions.get(str(task_id)) or item.get('criteria_name') or ''
            status = item.get('Status') or item.get('status') or 'Grey'
            owner = item.get('Owner') or item.get('verified_by') or 'Unassigned'
            
            display_text = f"{task_id}: {task_desc}"[:75]
            pdf.cell(115, 6, display_text, 1, 0, 'L')
            
            # Colour coding
            if status in ["Green", "Completed", "Complete"]:
                pdf.set_fill_color(204, 255, 204) # Light green
            elif status in ["Amber", "In Progress"]:
                pdf.set_fill_color(255, 255, 224) # Light yellow
            elif status in ["Red", "Not Started", "Blocked"]:
                pdf.set_fill_color(255, 204, 203) # Light red
            else:
                pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240)
            
            pdf.cell(30, 6, str(status), 1, 0, 'C', fill=True)
            pdf.cell(35, 6, str(owner)[:20], 1, 1, 'C')
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No checklist items found.")
    pdf.ln(5)

    # 3. Open Actions & Tasks
    pdf.chapter_title("3. Open Actions & Tasks", level=1)
    if not df_actions.empty:
        df_display = df_actions[['task', 'assigned_to', 'due_date']].head(20)
        page_width = pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin
        col_widths = [page_width * 0.55, page_width * 0.25, page_width * 0.20]
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 9)
        pdf.set_fill_color(220, 220, 220)
        headers = ["Task", "Assigned To", "Due Date"]
        for j, h in enumerate(headers):
            pdf.cell(col_widths[j], 7, h, 1, 0, 'L', fill=True)
        pdf.ln()
        
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
        for _, row in df_display.iterrows():
            pdf.cell(col_widths[0], 6, str(row['task'])[:55], 1)
            pdf.cell(col_widths[1], 6, str(row['assigned_to'])[:25], 1)
            pdf.cell(col_widths[2], 6, str(row['due_date'])[:15], 1, 1)
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No open actions.")
    pdf.ln(5)

    # 4. Active Risks
    pdf.chapter_title("4. Active Risks", level=1)
    if not df_risks.empty:
        font_family = pdf._get_font_family()
        for _, row in df_risks.iterrows():
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 9)
            pdf.write(5, f"[{row['impact']}] ")
            pdf.set_font(font_family, '', 9)
            pdf.write(5, str(row['description']))
            pdf.ln()
            if row.get('mitigation'):
                pdf.set_font(font_family, 'I', 8)
                pdf.write(4, f"Mitigation: {row['mitigation']}")
                pdf.ln()
            pdf.ln(2)
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No active risks.")
    pdf.ln(5)

    # 5. Key Stakeholders & ADKAR Status
    pdf.chapter_title("5. Key Stakeholders & ADKAR Status", level=1)
    if not df_stakeholders.empty:
        page_width = pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin
        col_widths = [page_width * 0.40, page_width * 0.35, page_width * 0.25]
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 9)
        pdf.set_fill_color(220, 220, 220)
        headers = ["Stakeholder Name", "Stance / Role", "Influence / Interest"]
        for j, h in enumerate(headers):
            pdf.cell(col_widths[j], 7, h, 1, 0, 'L', fill=True)
        pdf.ln()
        
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
        for _, row in df_stakeholders.iterrows():
            pdf.cell(col_widths[0], 6, str(row.get('name'))[:30], 1)
            pdf.cell(col_widths[1], 6, str(row.get('current_stance', 'N/A'))[:25], 1)
            influence_interest = f"{row.get('influence', 'N/A')} / {row.get('interest', 'N/A')}"
            pdf.cell(col_widths[2], 6, influence_interest, 1, 1)
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No stakeholder data recorded.")
    pdf.ln(5)

    # 6. Recent Meeting Context
    pdf.chapter_title("6. Recent Meeting Context", level=1)
    if not df_meetings.empty:
        for _, row in df_meetings.iterrows():
            pdf.chapter_title(f"Meeting on {row['date']}", level=2)
            if row.get('summary'):
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(f"**Executive Summary:** {row['summary']}")
            if row.get('thematic'):
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(f"**Thematic Discussion:** {row['thematic']}")
            if row.get('decisions'):
                pdf.markdown_to_pdf(f"**Key Decisions:** {row['decisions']}")
            pdf.ln(2)
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No recent meetings recorded.")

    return bytes(pdf.output())


@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def generate_board_assurance_pack_pdf(project_id: int) -> bytes:
    from core.database_utils import query, fetch_one
    
    # Fetch project details
    p_row = fetch_one("""
        SELECT p.name, p.status, p.rag_status, p.rag_narrative, p.due_date, o.name as org_name, p.checklist_data, p.platform_association 
        FROM projects p 
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id 
        WHERE p.id = ? AND p.is_deleted = 0
    """, (project_id,))
    if not p_row:
        return b""
    
    project_name, phase, rag_status, rag_narrative, due_date, org_name, checklist_data_json, platform_association = p_row

    # Create ReportPDF
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f"Board Assurance Pack: {org_name} - {project_name}")
    pdf.add_page()
    
    # 1. Project Overview
    pdf.chapter_title("1. Project Summary Overview", level=1)
    pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 10)
    pdf.set_text_color(0, 0, 0)
    pdf.cell(50, 7, "Organisation:", 0, 0)
    pdf.cell(0, 7, str(org_name), 0, 1)
    pdf.cell(50, 7, "Project Stream:", 0, 0)
    pdf.cell(0, 7, str(project_name), 0, 1)
    pdf.cell(50, 7, "Platform Association:", 0, 0)
    pdf.cell(0, 7, str(platform_association or "None"), 0, 1)
    pdf.cell(50, 7, "Current Phase:", 0, 0)
    pdf.cell(0, 7, str(phase), 0, 1)
    pdf.cell(50, 7, "Planned Go-Live Date:", 0, 0)
    pdf.cell(0, 7, str(due_date or "N/A"), 0, 1)
    pdf.cell(50, 7, "RAG Status:", 0, 0)
    pdf.cell(0, 7, str(rag_status), 0, 1)
    pdf.ln(5)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 5, f"RAG Narrative: {rag_narrative or 'No narrative provided.'}")
    pdf.ln(10)
    
    # 2. Go/No-Go Gate Checklist Status
    pdf.chapter_title("2. Go/No-Go Governance Gates", level=1)
    df_signoffs = query("SELECT gate_name, status, signed_by, signed_date FROM gate_signoffs WHERE project_id = ?", (project_id,))
    gates = [
        "Gate 1: Scoping",
        "Gate 2: Cleansing",
        "Gate 3: Data Quality",
        "Gate 4: Business Change",
        "Gate 5: Go/No-Go Approval"
    ]
    gate_data = []
    for g in gates:
        signed_by = "N/A"
        signed_date = "N/A"
        status = "Pending"
        if not df_signoffs.empty:
            match = df_signoffs[df_signoffs['gate_name'] == g]
            if not match.empty:
                status = match.iloc[0]['status']
                signed_by = match.iloc[0]['signed_by'] or "N/A"
                signed_date = match.iloc[0]['signed_date'] or "N/A"
        gate_data.append({
            "Gate": g,
            "Status": status,
            "Signed By": signed_by,
            "Signed Date": signed_date
        })
    df_gates = pd.DataFrame(gate_data)
    pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_gates, [55, 30, 45, 50])
    
    # 3. Active Risks
    pdf.chapter_title("3. Active High/Critical Risks", level=1)
    df_risks = query("""
        SELECT category, description, impact, likelihood, owner 
        FROM risks 
        WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 'Open' 
        AND impact IN ('High', 'Critical')
    """, (project_id,))
    if df_risks.empty:
        pdf.chapter_body("No active high/critical risks logged.")
    else:
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_risks[['category', 'impact', 'likelihood', 'owner']], [40, 30, 30, 80])
        for _, row in df_risks.iterrows():
            pdf.chapter_body(f"- [{row['category']} - {row['impact']}] {row['description']} (Owner: {row['owner']})")
    pdf.ln(5)

    # 4. Open Milestones / Tasks
    pdf.chapter_title("4. Open Data & Cutover Actions", level=1)
    df_actions = query("""
        SELECT task, assigned_to, due_date, status 
        FROM actions 
        WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 AND status != 'Closed'
        ORDER BY due_date ASC
    """, (project_id,))
    if df_actions.empty:
        pdf.chapter_body("No open tasks logged.")
    else:
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_actions, [90, 40, 30, 20])
    pdf.ln(5)

    # 5. Benefits & Benefit Owners
    pdf.chapter_title("5. Benefits Realisation & Ownership", level=1)
    df_benefits = query("""
        SELECT name AS "Benefit Name", target_value AS "Target Value", owner AS "Owner", metric AS "Metric"
        FROM benefits 
        WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0
    """, (project_id,))
    if df_benefits.empty:
        pdf.chapter_body("No benefits or outcomes mapped to this project stream.")
    else:
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_benefits, [80, 30, 40, 30])

    return bytes(pdf.output())


def generate_icb_executive_pdf(region_name: str, df_region_projects: pd.DataFrame, df_region_risks: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    """Generates a structured Integrated Care Board (ICB) Regional executive progress briefing PDF."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title=f"ICB Executive Briefing: {region_name}")
    pdf.add_page()
    
    # Title Page/Header
    pdf.chapter_title(f"ICB Regional Executive Briefing: {region_name}", level=1)
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Report Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    pdf.chapter_body("Prepared for Regional Directors and Integrated Care Board (ICB) Governance review.")
    pdf.ln(5)
    
    # 1. Regional Rollout Status Summary
    pdf.chapter_title("1. Regional Rollout Status Summary", level=1)
    if df_region_projects.empty:
        pdf.chapter_body("No projects recorded in this region.")
    else:
        df_sub = df_region_projects[['org_name', 'project_name', 'phase', 'cohort', 'rag_status']].copy()
        df_sub.columns = ["Organisation", "Project Stream", "Phase", "Cohort", "RAG"]
        page_width = pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin
        col_widths = [page_width * 0.35, page_width * 0.25, page_width * 0.15, page_width * 0.15, page_width * 0.10]
        
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 9)
        pdf.set_fill_color(220, 220, 220)
        for i, col in enumerate(df_sub.columns):
            pdf.cell(col_widths[i], 7, col, 1, 0, 'L', fill=True)
        pdf.ln()
        
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
        for _, row in df_sub.iterrows():
            pdf.cell(col_widths[0], 6, str(row["Organisation"])[:30], 1)
            pdf.cell(col_widths[1], 6, str(row["Project Stream"])[:20], 1)
            pdf.cell(col_widths[2], 6, str(row["Phase"])[:15], 1)
            pdf.cell(col_widths[3], 6, str(row["Cohort"])[:15], 1)
            
            rag = row["RAG"]
            if rag == "Green":
                pdf.set_fill_color(204, 255, 204)
            elif rag == "Amber":
                pdf.set_fill_color(255, 255, 224)
            elif rag == "Red":
                pdf.set_fill_color(255, 204, 203)
            else:
                pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240)
            pdf.cell(col_widths[4], 6, str(rag), 1, 1, 'C', fill=True)
            
    pdf.ln(5)
    
    # 2. Key Regional Risks & Issues
    pdf.chapter_title("2. Critical Regional Risks & Mitigation Plans", level=1)
    if df_region_risks.empty:
        pdf.chapter_body("No high or critical-impact risks logged across these regional projects.")
    else:
        df_risk_sub = df_region_risks[['org_name', 'description', 'impact', 'mitigation']].copy()
        df_risk_sub.columns = ["Organisation", "Risk Description", "Impact", "Mitigation Notes"]
        page_width = pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin
        r_col_widths = [page_width * 0.25, page_width * 0.35, page_width * 0.15, page_width * 0.25]
        
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 9)
        pdf.set_fill_color(220, 220, 220)
        for i, col in enumerate(df_risk_sub.columns):
            pdf.cell(r_col_widths[i], 7, col, 1, 0, 'L', fill=True)
        pdf.ln()
        
        pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
        for _, row in df_risk_sub.iterrows():
            pdf.cell(r_col_widths[0], 6, str(row["Organisation"])[:25], 1)
            pdf.cell(r_col_widths[1], 6, str(row["Risk Description"])[:35], 1)
            
            imp = row["Impact"]
            if imp == "Critical":
                pdf.set_fill_color(255, 204, 203)
                pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), 'B', 8)
            else:
                pdf.set_fill_color(255, 255, 224)
                pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
            pdf.cell(r_col_widths[2], 6, str(imp), 1, 0, 'C', fill=True)
            
            pdf.set_font(pdf._get_font_family(), '', 8)
            pdf.cell(r_col_widths[3], 6, str(row["Mitigation Notes"])[:25] if row["Mitigation Notes"] else "No mitigation plan.", 1, 1)
            
    return bytes(pdf.output())

def generate_cohort_wave_progress_pdf(cohort_summary: pd.DataFrame, project_details: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    """Generates a PDF report for Cohort Wave Progress."""
    pdf = ReportPDF(title="Cohort & Wave Progress Report")
    pdf.add_page()
    font_family = pdf._get_font_family()
    
    pdf.chapter_title("Cohort Wave Progress Summary", level=1)
    pdf.chapter_body(f"Report Date: {datetime.now().strftime('%d %B %Y')}")
    pdf.ln(5)
    
    pdf.chapter_title("1. Cohort Aggregates", level=2)
    if not cohort_summary.empty:
        # Col widths must sum up to width of page (A4 width is 210mm minus margins = 180mm)
        # Col widths: Cohort (30), Total (25), Live (25), Avg Read (30), Risks (25), Forecast (45) => 180mm
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(cohort_summary, col_widths=[30, 25, 25, 30, 25, 45])
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No cohort aggregates available.")
    
    pdf.ln(10)
    pdf.chapter_title("2. Project-Level Status Breakdown", level=2)
    if not project_details.empty:
        # Col widths: Trust (45), Stream (35), Cohort (25), Phase (30), RAG (20), Readiness (25) => 180mm
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(project_details, col_widths=[45, 35, 25, 30, 20, 25])
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No project details available.")
        
    return bytes(pdf.output())
