DEFAULT_REPORT_COLUMNS = {
    "Projects": ["Organisation", "Project Stream", "Phase", "RAG Status"],
    "Actions": ["Project Stream", "Action Title", "Status", "Owner/Assigned To", "Due Date", "Priority"],
    "Risks": ["Project Stream", "Risk Title", "Status", "Owner", "Impact", "Likelihood"],
    "Benefits": ["Project Stream", "Benefit Title", "Owner", "Target Value", "Current Value", "RAG Status"],
    "Expenses": ["Project Stream", "Amount", "Category", "Expense Date", "Description"]
}

def generate_report_from_config(config: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[pd.DataFrame, Optional[alt.Chart], str]:
    """
    Generates a report DataFrame and an Altair chart (if applicable) from a report configuration dictionary.
    """
    report_type = config['report_type']
    filters = config['filters']
    visualization_type = config['visualization_type']
    master_filter = config['master_filter']
    params = list(config['params'])
    selected_cols = config.get('selected_columns')
    if not selected_cols:
        selected_cols = DEFAULT_REPORT_COLUMNS.get(report_type, [])

    df_report: pd.DataFrame = pd.DataFrame()
    report_title = f"Custom Report: {report_type}"
    chart = None
    base_join = " JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region "

    if report_type == "Projects":
        select_clause_terms = []
        for col in selected_cols:
            if col in REPORT_COLUMNS["Projects"]:
                select_clause_terms.append(REPORT_COLUMNS["Projects"][col])
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if "p.status AS [Phase]" not in select_clause_terms and "p.status AS [status]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("p.status AS [status]")
            if "p.rag_status AS [RAG Status]" not in select_clause_terms and "p.rag_status AS [rag_status]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("p.rag_status AS [rag_status]")
        select_clause = ", ".join(select_clause_terms) if select_clause_terms else "o.name as Organisation, p.name as Project, p.status, p.rag_status"
        
        sql = f"SELECT {select_clause} FROM projects p {base_join} WHERE {master_filter}"
        if filters.get('status'):
            sql += f" AND p.status IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['status']))})"
            params.extend(filters['status'])
        if filters.get('rag_status'):
            sql += f" AND p.rag_status IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['rag_status']))})"
            params.extend(filters['rag_status'])
        df_report = query(sql, tuple(params))
        report_title = "Project Status Report"
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if 'status' not in df_report.columns and 'Phase' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['status'] = df_report['Phase']
            if 'rag_status' not in df_report.columns and 'RAG Status' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['rag_status'] = df_report['RAG Status']
            chart = alt.Chart(df_report).mark_bar().encode(
                x=alt.X('count():Q', title="Number of Projects"),
                y=alt.Y('status:N', sort='-x', title="Status"),
                color=alt.Color('rag_status:N', scale=alt.Scale(domain=["Green", "Amber", "Red"], range=["#00703c", "#ffdd00", "#d4351c"]))
            ).properties(title=f"{report_type} by Status and RAG")

    elif report_type == "Actions":
        select_clause_terms = []
        for col in selected_cols:
            if col in REPORT_COLUMNS["Actions"]:
                select_clause_terms.append(REPORT_COLUMNS["Actions"][col])
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if "a.assigned_to AS [Owner/Assigned To]" not in select_clause_terms and "a.assigned_to AS [assigned_to]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("a.assigned_to AS [assigned_to]")
            if "a.status AS [Status]" not in select_clause_terms and "a.status AS [status]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("a.status AS [status]")
        elif visualization_type == "Line Chart":
            if "a.due_date AS [Due Date]" not in select_clause_terms and "a.due_date AS [due_date]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("a.due_date AS [due_date]")

        select_clause = ", ".join(select_clause_terms) if select_clause_terms else "a.*, p.name as project_name"
        sql = f"SELECT {select_clause} FROM actions a JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id {base_join} WHERE {master_filter}"
        if filters.get('status'):
            sql += f" AND a.status IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['status']))})"
            params.extend(filters['status'])
        if filters.get('owner'):
            sql += f" AND a.assigned_to IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['owner']))})"
            params.extend(filters['owner'])
        if filters.get('due_date_range') and len(filters['due_date_range']) == 2:
            sql += " AND a.due_date BETWEEN ? AND ?"
            params.extend([str(d) for d in filters['due_date_range']])
        df_report = query(sql, tuple(params))
        report_title = "Action Status Report"
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if 'assigned_to' not in df_report.columns and 'Owner/Assigned To' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['assigned_to'] = df_report['Owner/Assigned To']
            if 'status' not in df_report.columns and 'Status' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['status'] = df_report['Status']
            chart = alt.Chart(df_report).mark_bar().encode(
                x=alt.X('count():Q', title="Number of Actions"),
                y=alt.Y('assigned_to:N', sort='-x', title="Owner"),
                color=alt.Color('status:N')
            ).properties(title=f"{report_type} by Owner and Status")
        elif visualization_type == "Line Chart":
            if 'due_date' not in df_report.columns and 'Due Date' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['due_date'] = df_report['Due Date']
            if 'due_date' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['due_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_report['due_date'])
                df_daily = df_report.groupby(df_report['due_date'].dt.date).size().reset_index(name='count')
                chart = alt.Chart(df_daily).mark_line(point=True).encode(
                    x=alt.X('due_date:T', title="Date"),
                    y=alt.Y('count:Q', title="Number of Actions Due")
                ).properties(title="Actions Due Over Time")

    elif report_type == "Risks":
        select_clause_terms = []
        for col in selected_cols:
            if col in REPORT_COLUMNS["Risks"]:
                select_clause_terms.append(REPORT_COLUMNS["Risks"][col])
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if "r.impact AS [Impact]" not in select_clause_terms and "r.impact AS [impact]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("r.impact AS [impact]")
            if "r.status AS [Status]" not in select_clause_terms and "r.status AS [status]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("r.status AS [status]")
        select_clause = ", ".join(select_clause_terms) if select_clause_terms else "r.*, p.name as project_name"
        sql = f"SELECT {select_clause} FROM risks r JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.id {base_join} WHERE {master_filter}"
        if filters.get('status'):
            sql += f" AND r.status IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['status']))})"
            params.extend(filters['status'])
        if filters.get('impact'):
            sql += f" AND r.impact IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['impact']))})"
            params.extend(filters['impact'])
        if filters.get('likelihood'):
            sql += f" AND r.likelihood IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['likelihood']))})"
            params.extend(filters['likelihood'])
        if filters.get('owner'):
            sql += f" AND r.owner IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['owner']))})"
            params.extend(filters['owner'])
        df_report = query(sql, tuple(params))
        report_title = "Risk Analysis Report"
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if 'impact' not in df_report.columns and 'Impact' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['impact'] = df_report['Impact']
            if 'status' not in df_report.columns and 'Status' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['status'] = df_report['Status']
            chart = alt.Chart(df_report).mark_bar().encode(
                x=alt.X('count():Q', title="Number of Risks"),
                y=alt.Y('impact:N', sort=get_config('RISK'), title="Impact"),
                color=alt.Color('status:N')
            ).properties(title=f"{report_type} by Impact and Status")

    elif report_type == "Benefits":
        select_clause_terms = []
        for col in selected_cols:
            if col in REPORT_COLUMNS["Benefits"]:
                select_clause_terms.append(REPORT_COLUMNS["Benefits"][col])
        select_clause = ", ".join(select_clause_terms) if select_clause_terms else "b.*, p.name as project_name"
        sql = f"SELECT {select_clause} FROM benefits b JOIN projects p ON b.project_id = p.id {base_join} WHERE {master_filter}"
        if filters.get('owner'):
            sql += f" AND b.owner IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['owner']))})"
            params.extend(filters['owner'])
        df_report = query(sql, tuple(params))
        report_title = "Benefit Realisation Report"

    elif report_type == "Expenses":
        select_clause_terms = []
        for col in selected_cols:
            if col in REPORT_COLUMNS["Expenses"]:
                select_clause_terms.append(REPORT_COLUMNS["Expenses"][col])
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if "e.amount AS [Amount]" not in select_clause_terms and "e.amount AS [amount]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("e.amount AS [amount]")
            if "e.category AS [Category]" not in select_clause_terms and "e.category AS [category]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("e.category AS [category]")
        elif visualization_type == "Line Chart":
            if "e.expense_date AS [Expense Date]" not in select_clause_terms and "e.expense_date AS [expense_date]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("e.expense_date AS [expense_date]")
            if "e.amount AS [Amount]" not in select_clause_terms and "e.amount AS [amount]" not in select_clause_terms:
                select_clause_terms.append("e.amount AS [amount]")
        select_clause = ", ".join(select_clause_terms) if select_clause_terms else "e.*, p.name as project_name"
        sql = f"SELECT {select_clause} FROM expenses e JOIN projects p ON e.project_id = p.id {base_join} WHERE {master_filter}"
        if filters.get('category'):
            sql += f" AND e.category IN ({','.join(['?']*len(filters['category']))})"
            params.extend(filters['category'])
        if filters.get('expense_date_range') and len(filters['expense_date_range']) == 2:
            sql += " AND e.expense_date BETWEEN ? AND ?"
            params.extend([str(d) for d in filters['expense_date_range']])
        df_report = query(sql, tuple(params))
        report_title = "Expense Analysis Report"
        if visualization_type == "Bar Chart":
            if 'category' not in df_report.columns and 'Category' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['category'] = df_report['Category']
            if 'amount' not in df_report.columns and 'Amount' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['amount'] = df_report['Amount']
            chart = alt.Chart(df_report).mark_bar().encode(
                x=alt.X('sum(amount):Q', title="Total Amount (£)"),
                y=alt.Y('category:N', sort='-x', title="Category"),
            ).properties(title=f"{report_type} by Category")
        elif visualization_type == "Line Chart":
            if 'expense_date' not in df_report.columns and 'Expense Date' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['expense_date'] = df_report['Expense Date']
            if 'amount' not in df_report.columns and 'Amount' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['amount'] = df_report['Amount']
            if 'expense_date' in df_report.columns:
                df_report['expense_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_report['expense_date'])
                df_daily = df_report.groupby(df_report['expense_date'].dt.date)['amount'].sum().reset_index()
                chart = alt.Chart(df_daily).mark_line(point=True).encode(
                    x=alt.X('expense_date:T', title="Date"),
                    y=alt.Y('amount:Q', title="Total Expenses (£)")
                ).properties(title="Expenses Over Time")

    # Filter df_report to show only the selected columns in the user's order
    display_cols = []
    for col in selected_cols:
        if col in df_report.columns:
            display_cols.append(col)
    if display_cols and not df_report.empty:
        df_report = df_report[display_cols]

    return df_report, chart, report_title

@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def get_decision_sandbox_context(project_id: int, decision_query: str) -> Tuple[str, Optional[pd.DataFrame]]:
    """
    Builds a detailed context string specifically for the Decision Sandbox feature,
    focusing on dependencies, resources, and financials.
    Also returns a DataFrame of tasks for charting.
    """
    # 1. Keyword extraction from the decision query
    try:
        # This uses generate_ai_response and KEYWORD_EXTRACTION_PROMPT from the file's scope
        keywords_str = generate_ai_response(KEYWORD_EXTRACTION_PROMPT.format(user_query=decision_query), temperature=0.0)
        keywords = [k.strip() for k in keywords_str.split(',') if k.strip()]
    except Exception:
        keywords = []

    context_parts = []
    df_for_chart = pd.DataFrame()

    # 2. Fetch relevant tasks and their dependencies
    if keywords:
        task_placeholders = " OR ".join(["task LIKE ?" for _ in keywords])
        task_params = [f"%{k}%" for k in keywords]
        
        # Find the primary task(s) mentioned
        df_tasks = query(f"""
            SELECT id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, depends_on_id 
            FROM actions 
            WHERE project_id=? AND status!='Closed' AND is_deleted=0 AND ({task_placeholders})
        """, (project_id, *task_params))
        
        if not df_tasks.empty:
            context_parts.append("--- RELEVANT TASKS ---")
            context_parts.append(df_tasks[['task', 'assigned_to', 'due_date']].to_string(index=False))
            
            # Find tasks that depend on the primary task(s)
            dependent_task_ids = df_tasks['id'].tolist()
            df_dependents = pd.DataFrame()
            if dependent_task_ids:
                id_placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(dependent_task_ids))
                df_dependents = query(f"""
                    SELECT id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, depends_on_id
                    FROM actions 
                    WHERE depends_on_id IN ({id_placeholders}) AND is_deleted=0
                """, tuple(dependent_task_ids))
                if not df_dependents.empty:
                    context_parts.append("\n--- TASKS DEPENDENT ON THE ABOVE ---")
                    context_parts.append(df_dependents[['task', 'assigned_to', 'due_date']].to_string(index=False))
            
            # Combine for charting
            df_for_chart = pd.concat([df_tasks, df_dependents], ignore_index=True)
    
    # 3. Fetch relevant risks
    if keywords:
        risk_placeholders = " OR ".join(["description LIKE ?" for _ in keywords])
        risk_params = [f"%{k}%" for k in keywords]
        df_risks = query(f"SELECT impact, description, mitigation FROM risks WHERE project_id=? AND status='Open' AND is_deleted=0 AND ({risk_placeholders})", (project_id, *risk_params))
        if not df_risks.empty:
            context_parts.append("\n--- RELEVANT RISKS ---")
            context_parts.append(df_risks.to_string(index=False))

    # 4. Fetch budget overview
    df_budget = query("SELECT budget_name, total_budget FROM budgets WHERE project_id=? AND is_deleted=0", (project_id,))
    if not df_budget.empty:
        total_budget = df_budget['total_budget'].sum()
        df_expenses = query("SELECT SUM(amount) FROM expenses WHERE project_id=? AND is_deleted=0", (project_id,))
        total_spent = df_expenses.iloc[0,0] if not df_expenses.empty and pd.notna(df_expenses.iloc[0,0]) else 0
        context_parts.append("\n--- FINANCIAL OVERVIEW ---")
        context_parts.append(f"Total Project Budget: £{total_budget:,.2f}")
        context_parts.append(f"Total Spent to Date: £{total_spent:,.2f}")

    # 5. Fetch resource overview
    df_resources = query("""
        SELECT rt.name, ra.allocation_pct
        FROM resource_allocations ra
        JOIN rit_team rt ON ra.user_id = rt.id
        WHERE ra.project_id = ? AND ra.is_deleted = 0
    """, (project_id,))
    if not df_resources.empty:
        context_parts.append("\n--- CURRENT RESOURCE ALLOCATION ---")
        context_parts.append(df_resources.to_string(index=False))

    context_str = "\n".join(context_parts)
    if not context_parts:
        context_str = "No specific project data found for the query. Provide a general analysis."

    return context_str, df_for_chart if not df_for_chart.empty else None

def check_baseline_gates(project_id: int) -> Tuple[bool, List[str]]:
    """
    Validates if all baseline gates (Gate 1: Scoping, Gate 2: Cleansing, Gate 3: Data Quality)
    are signed off (status = 'Cleared').
    Gate 3 can be dynamically considered cleared if the latest data quality score is >= 90.0%.
    
    Returns (True, []) if all baseline gates are cleared.
    Otherwise returns (False, list_of_uncleared_gates).
    """
    signoffs_df = query(
        "SELECT gate_name, status FROM gate_signoffs WHERE project_id = ?",
        (project_id,)
    )
    
    signoffs_map = {}
    if not signoffs_df.empty:
        signoffs_map = dict(zip(signoffs_df['gate_name'], signoffs_df['status']))
        
    uncleared = []
    
    # Check Gate 1
    if signoffs_map.get("Gate 1: Scoping") != "Cleared":
        uncleared.append("Gate 1: Scoping")
        
    # Check Gate 2
    if signoffs_map.get("Gate 2: Cleansing") != "Cleared":
        uncleared.append("Gate 2: Cleansing")
        
    # Check Gate 3
    if signoffs_map.get("Gate 3: Data Quality") != "Cleared":
        score_df = query(
            "SELECT score FROM data_quality_history WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1",
            (project_id,)
        )
        score = float(score_df['score'].iloc[0]) if not score_df.empty else 85.0
        if score < 90.0:
            uncleared.append("Gate 3: Data Quality")
            
    if uncleared:
        return False, uncleared
    return True, []

@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def get_go_nogo_data(project_id: int, checklist_json: str, platform_association: Optional[str]):
    """Fetches all data points for the Go/No-Go dashboard."""
    
    # a. Data Quality Score (from last readiness assessment)
    latest_score_df = query(
        "SELECT score FROM data_quality_history WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1", 
        (project_id,)
    )
    data_quality_score = float(latest_score_df['score'].iloc[0]) if not latest_score_df.empty else 85.0
    
    # b. Open Data-Related Risks
    data_risks_df = query("""
        SELECT description, impact, mitigation 
        FROM risks 
        WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'Open' AND is_deleted = 0
        AND (category = 'Data Migration' OR description LIKE '%data%')
    """, (project_id,))
    
    # c. Open Data-Related Tasks
    data_tasks_df = query("""
        SELECT task, assigned_to, due_date 
        FROM actions 
        WHERE project_id = ? AND status != 'Closed' AND is_deleted = 0
        AND (task LIKE '%data%' OR task LIKE '%mapping%' OR task LIKE '%cleanse%')
    """, (project_id,))
    
    # d. Foundational Readiness Checklist Status for data items
    data_readiness_items = []
    if platform_association == 'NHS Jobs':
        # Fetch from new readiness_criteria table
        df_readiness_criteria = query("SELECT criteria_name, status, verified_by FROM readiness_criteria WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (project_id,))
        if not df_readiness_criteria.empty:
            data_readiness_items = df_readiness_criteria.to_dict('records')
    else:
        # Fallback to existing checklist_data logic
        data_related_frg_ids = ['2', '3'] # IDs from core.constants.py
        if checklist_json:
            try:
                checklist_state = json.loads(checklist_json)
                for item in checklist_state:
                    if item.get('Task ID') in data_related_frg_ids:
                        data_readiness_items.append(item)
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                pass # Ignore if data is bad

    return data_quality_score, data_risks_df, data_tasks_df, data_readiness_items

def create_project_from_template(org_id: int, name: str, template_id: Optional[int] = None) -> int:
    """Creates a new project stream for an organisation and optionally applies a project template."""
    phases = get_config('PHASE')
    status = phases[0] if phases else 'Not Started'
    
    new_pid = execute(
        "INSERT INTO projects (org_id, name, status, is_deleted, ai_consent_given) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0, 0)",
        (org_id, name, status),
        return_lastrowid=True
    )
    
    try:
        from core.state import get_app_state
        app_state = get_app_state()
        user = app_state.user.current_user or "System"
        role = app_state.user.current_user_role or "System"
    except Exception:
        user, role = "System", "System"
        
    log_audit_event("CREATE", "Project", user, role, new_pid, details={"name": name, "org_id": org_id, "template_id": template_id, "source": "iCal Integration Helper"})
    
    if template_id and template_id > 0:
        tpl_platform = fetch_one("SELECT platform_association FROM project_templates WHERE id = ?", (template_id,))
        if tpl_platform and tpl_platform[0]:
            execute("UPDATE projects SET platform_association = ? WHERE id = ?", (tpl_platform[0], new_pid))
            
        df_template_tasks = query("SELECT id, task, assigned_to_role, due_offset_days, depends_on_template_task_id, project_phase, task_group FROM template_tasks WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
        task_id_map = {}
        for _, t_task in df_template_tasks.iterrows():
            assigned_to = t_task['assigned_to_role'] 
            due_date = (datetime.now().date() + timedelta(days=t_task['due_offset_days'])).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            new_task_id = execute(
                "INSERT INTO actions (project_id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, status, rag_status, project_phase, task_group) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (new_pid, t_task['task'], assigned_to, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), due_date, "Open", "Grey", t_task['project_phase'], t_task['task_group']),
                return_lastrowid=True
            )
            task_id_map[t_task['id']] = new_task_id
        
        for _, t_task in df_template_tasks.iterrows():
            if t_task['depends_on_template_task_id'] and t_task['depends_on_template_task_id'] in task_id_map:
                execute("UPDATE actions SET depends_on_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (task_id_map[t_task['depends_on_template_task_id']], task_id_map[t_task['id']]))
                
        df_template_risks = query("SELECT description, impact, likelihood, mitigation, owner_role FROM template_risks WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
        for _, t_risk in df_template_risks.iterrows():
            owner = t_risk['owner_role'] 
            execute(
                "INSERT INTO risks (project_id, description, impact, likelihood, mitigation, owner, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (new_pid, t_risk['description'], t_risk['impact'], t_risk['likelihood'], t_risk['mitigation'], owner, "Open")
            )
            
        df_template_checklist = query("SELECT item_description, category FROM template_checklist_items WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
        if not df_template_checklist.empty:
            checklist_items_to_save = []
            for i, item in df_template_checklist.iterrows():
                checklist_items_to_save.append({
                    "Task ID": f"T{i+1}",
                    "FRG Activity": item['item_description'],
                    "Category": item['category'],
                    "Action": "", 
                    "Status": "Grey", 
                    "Owner": "", 
                    "Due date": None, 
                    "Commentary": ""
                })
            checklist_json = json.dumps(checklist_items_to_save)
            execute("UPDATE projects SET checklist_data = ? WHERE id = ?", (checklist_json, new_pid))
            
        df_template_cfs = query("SELECT field_id, field_value FROM template_custom_field_values WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
        if not df_template_cfs.empty:
            template_cf_values = {row['field_id']: row['field_value'] for _, row in df_template_cfs.iterrows()}
            save_custom_field_values('project', new_pid, template_cf_values)
            
    return new_pid

@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def generate_mss_excel_export(project_id: int) -> bytes:
    """Generates an Excel spreadsheet for the MSS Rollout Tracker tasks of a project."""
    from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
    from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
    from openpyxl.worksheet.datavalidation import DataValidation
    from openpyxl.formatting.rule import CellIsRule

    df_mss = query(
        """SELECT id as "Task ID", project_phase as "Phase", task_group as "Task Group", 
                  task as "Task", status as "Status", rag_status as "RAG Status", 
                  assigned_to as "Owner", due_date as "Due Date", latest_update as "Latest Progress Update"
           FROM actions 
           WHERE project_id = ? AND project_phase IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0
           ORDER BY id ASC""",
        (project_id,)
    )
    
    # Process dates to YYYY-MM-DD string for user-friendly viewing/editing in Excel
    if not df_mss.empty:
        df_mss['Due Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_mss['Due Date'], errors='coerce').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d').fillna('')
        
    # Get valid statuses dynamically
    status_rows = fetch_all("SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE category = 'TASK_STATUS'")
    db_statuses = [r[0] for r in status_rows] if status_rows else ["Open", "In Progress", "Blocked", "In Review", "Closed"]
    valid_statuses = sorted(list(set(db_statuses + ["Completed", "Withdrawn"])))
    valid_rags = ["Green", "Amber", "Red", "Grey"]
    
    # Create lookup options DataFrame
    df_lookup = pd.DataFrame({
        "Status Options": pd.Series(valid_statuses),
        "RAG Options": pd.Series(valid_rags)
    })
    
    output = io.BytesIO()
    with pd.ExcelWriter(output, engine='openpyxl') as writer:
        df_mss.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Rollout Tracker', index=False)
        
        # Add instructions tab to help users maintain format consistency
        inst_df = pd.DataFrame({
            "Field": [
                "Task ID", 
                "Phase", 
                "Task Group", 
                "Task", 
                "Status", 
                "RAG Status", 
                "Owner", 
                "Due Date", 
                "Latest Progress Update"
            ],
            "Description": [
                "Unique identifier of the task. Do NOT change this value for existing tasks.",
                "The rollout phase (e.g., Planning and Preparation, Rollout - PILOT). Used to group tasks.",
                "The category or focus area (e.g., Scope, Communication Plan). Used to group tasks.",
                "The description of the rollout activity.",
                "Current task status.",
                "Current RAG health score.",
                "Name of the team member assigned to this task (should match a name in RIT Team directory).",
                "Task deadline. Use format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-30).",
                "Latest progress notes or updates."
            ],
            "Format/Constraint": [
                "Leave empty for new custom tasks. Do not modify existing IDs.",
                "Required text (max 100 chars)",
                "Required text (max 100 chars)",
                "Required text (max 255 chars)",
                "Select from dropdown options",
                "Select from dropdown options",
                "Text matching a team member, or blank if unassigned",
                "Date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD",
                "Free text notes"
            ]
        })
        inst_df.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Instructions', index=False)
        df_lookup.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='LookupLists', index=False)
        
        # Access worksheets to apply styles
        ws_tracker = writer.sheets['Rollout Tracker']
        ws_instructions = writer.sheets['Instructions']
        ws_lookup = writer.sheets['LookupLists']
        
        # Hide lookup Lists sheet to keep it clean
        ws_lookup.sheet_state = 'hidden'
        
        # Define premium design styles (Segoe UI font family and NHS Blue branding)
        font_title = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=11, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
        font_body = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, color="000000")
        font_body_bold = Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, bold=True, color="000000")
        
        fill_header = PatternFill(start_color="005EB8", end_color="005EB8", fill_type="solid")  # NHS Blue
        fill_zebra = PatternFill(start_color="F4F8FC", end_color="F4F8FC", fill_type="solid")   # Very light blue-grey
        fill_white = PatternFill(start_color="FFFFFF", end_color="FFFFFF", fill_type="solid")
        
        # Soft RAG statuses matches
        rag_styles = {
            "green": {
                "fill": PatternFill(start_color="D4EDDA", end_color="D4EDDA", fill_type="solid"),
                "font": Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, bold=True, color="155724")
            },
            "amber": {
                "fill": PatternFill(start_color="FFF3CD", end_color="FFF3CD", fill_type="solid"),
                "font": Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, bold=True, color="856404")
            },
            "red": {
                "fill": PatternFill(start_color="F8D7DA", end_color="F8D7DA", fill_type="solid"),
                "font": Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, bold=True, color="721C24")
            },
            "grey": {
                "fill": PatternFill(start_color="E2E3E5", end_color="E2E3E5", fill_type="solid"),
                "font": Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, bold=True, color="383D41")
            },
            "gray": {
                "fill": PatternFill(start_color="E2E3E5", end_color="E2E3E5", fill_type="solid"),
                "font": Font(name="Segoe UI", size=10, bold=True, color="383D41")
            }
        }
        
        border_thin = Border(
            left=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9'),
            right=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9'),
            top=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9'),
            bottom=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9')
        )
        
        # --- Format MSS Rollout Tracker Sheet ---
        # Ensure grid lines are visible
        try:
            ws_tracker.sheet_view.showGridLines = True
        except Exception:
            try:
                ws_tracker.views.sheetView[0].showGridLines = True
            except Exception:
                pass
                
        # Freeze header row
        ws_tracker.freeze_panes = 'A2'
        
        # Style Header
        ws_tracker.row_dimensions[1].height = 28
        for col_idx in range(1, len(df_mss.columns) + 1):
            cell = ws_tracker.cell(row=1, column=col_idx)
            cell.font = font_title
            cell.fill = fill_header
            cell.border = border_thin
            if col_idx in [1, 5, 6, 8]:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
            else:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
                
        # Style Data Rows (Background fills are zebra/white; colored dynamically by Excel Conditional Formatting)
        for row_idx in range(2, ws_tracker.max_row + 1):
            ws_tracker.row_dimensions[row_idx].height = 22
            is_zebra = (row_idx % 2 == 1)
            row_fill = fill_zebra if is_zebra else fill_white
                    
            for col_idx in range(1, len(df_mss.columns) + 1):
                cell = ws_tracker.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx)
                cell.font = font_body
                cell.border = border_thin
                cell.fill = row_fill
                if col_idx == 1:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
                elif col_idx == 5:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
                elif col_idx == 6:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
                elif col_idx == 8:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
                elif col_idx in [4, 9]:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
                else:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
                    
        col_widths = {1: 10, 2: 25, 3: 22, 4: 45, 5: 15, 6: 15, 7: 18, 8: 14, 9: 50}
        for col_idx, width in col_widths.items():
            col_letter = get_column_letter(col_idx)
            ws_tracker.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = width
            
        # Add drop-down data validation for Status and RAG Status columns
        try:
            # 1. RAG validation dropdown (pointing to range on LookupLists sheet with =)
            dv_rag = DataValidation(
                type="list", 
                formula1=f"=LookupLists!$B$2:$B${len(valid_rags) + 1}", 
                allow_blank=True,
                showErrorMessage=True,
                showInputMessage=True,
                error="Please select a RAG status from the dropdown list (Green, Amber, Red, Grey).",
                errorTitle="Invalid RAG Status",
                prompt="Select a RAG Status",
                promptTitle="RAG Status"
            )
            ws_tracker.add_data_validation(dv_rag)
            dv_rag.add("F2:F1000")
            
            # 2. Status validation dropdown (pointing to range on LookupLists sheet with =)
            status_formula = f"=LookupLists!$A$2:$A${len(valid_statuses) + 1}"
            dv_status = DataValidation(
                type="list", 
                formula1=status_formula, 
                allow_blank=True,
                showErrorMessage=True,
                showInputMessage=True,
                error="Please select a status from the dropdown list.",
                errorTitle="Invalid Status",
                prompt="Select a Status",
                promptTitle="Status"
            )
            ws_tracker.add_data_validation(dv_status)
            dv_status.add("E2:E1000")
        except Exception:
            pass
            
        # Add dynamic conditional formatting for RAG Status column (F2:F1000)
        try:
            rag_rules_to_add = [
                ("Green", rag_styles["green"]["fill"], rag_styles["green"]["font"]),
                ("green", rag_styles["green"]["fill"], rag_styles["green"]["font"]),
                ("Amber", rag_styles["amber"]["fill"], rag_styles["amber"]["font"]),
                ("amber", rag_styles["amber"]["fill"], rag_styles["amber"]["font"]),
                ("Red", rag_styles["red"]["fill"], rag_styles["red"]["font"]),
                ("red", rag_styles["red"]["fill"], rag_styles["red"]["font"]),
                ("Grey", rag_styles["grey"]["fill"], rag_styles["grey"]["font"]),
                ("grey", rag_styles["grey"]["fill"], rag_styles["grey"]["font"]),
                ("Gray", rag_styles["gray"]["fill"], rag_styles["gray"]["font"]),
                ("gray", rag_styles["gray"]["fill"], rag_styles["gray"]["font"]),
            ]
            for val, fill, font in rag_rules_to_add:
                rule = CellIsRule(operator='equal', formula=[f'"{val}"'], stopIfTrue=True, fill=fill, font=font)
                ws_tracker.conditional_formatting.add("F2:F1000", rule)
        except Exception:
            pass

        # --- Format Instructions Sheet ---
        ws_instructions.row_dimensions[1].height = 28
        for col_idx in range(1, len(inst_df.columns) + 1):
            cell = ws_instructions.cell(row=1, column=col_idx)
            cell.font = font_title
            cell.fill = PatternFill(start_color="002F6C", end_color="002F6C", fill_type="solid")
            cell.border = border_thin
            cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
            
        for row_idx in range(2, ws_instructions.max_row + 1):
            ws_instructions.row_dimensions[row_idx].height = 22
            is_zebra = (row_idx % 2 == 1)
            row_fill = fill_zebra if is_zebra else fill_white
            for col_idx in range(1, len(inst_df.columns) + 1):
                cell = ws_instructions.cell(row=row_idx, column=col_idx)
                cell.font = font_body
                if col_idx == 1:
                    cell.font = font_body_bold
                cell.border = border_thin
                cell.fill = row_fill
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
                
        ws_instructions.column_dimensions['A'].width = 25
        ws_instructions.column_dimensions['B'].width = 50
        ws_instructions.column_dimensions['C'].width = 45
        
    return output.getvalue()


def check_excel_owners(project_id: int, file_stream) -> List[str]:
    """
    Reads the Excel file and returns a list of owner names that are not
    currently in the valid owner directory (RIT team + project contacts).
    """
    try:
        try:
            file_stream.seek(0)
        except Exception:
            pass
        xl = pd.ExcelFile(file_stream)
        if 'Rollout Tracker' in xl.sheet_names:
            sheet_name = 'Rollout Tracker'
        elif 'MSS Rollout Tracker' in xl.sheet_names:
            sheet_name = 'MSS Rollout Tracker'
        else:
            sheet_name = xl.sheet_names[0]
        df = pd.read_excel(file_stream, sheet_name=sheet_name)
    except Exception:
        return []
    finally:
        try:
            file_stream.seek(0)
        except Exception:
            pass
        
    if 'Owner' not in df.columns:
        return []
        
    # Get unique owners from excel
    excel_owners = {str(o).strip() for o in df['Owner'].dropna().unique() if str(o).strip() != ""}
    if not excel_owners:
        return []
        
    # Get current valid owners
    rit_users_raw = fetch_all("SELECT name FROM rit_team ORDER BY name")
    project_contacts_raw = fetch_all(
        """SELECT c.name FROM project_contacts pc 
           JOIN contacts c ON pc.contact_id = c.id 
           WHERE pc.project_id = ? AND c.is_deleted = 0""", 
        (project_id,)
    )
    all_valid_names = [r[0] for r in rit_users_raw] + [r[0] for r in project_contacts_raw]
    valid_users = {name.strip().lower() for name in all_valid_names}
    
    unknown = []
    for owner in excel_owners:
        if owner.lower() not in valid_users:
            unknown.append(owner)
            
    return sorted(unknown)


def import_mss_excel_tracker(project_id: int, file_stream, current_user: str, current_user_role: str, auto_create_owners: List[str] = None) -> Tuple[int, int, str]:
    """
    Parses and imports an Excel file to update or add tasks in the MSS Rollout Tracker.
    Returns (updated_count, inserted_count, error_message).
    """
    try:
        try:
            file_stream.seek(0)
        except Exception:
            pass
        xl = pd.ExcelFile(file_stream)
        if 'Rollout Tracker' in xl.sheet_names:
            sheet_name = 'Rollout Tracker'
        elif 'MSS Rollout Tracker' in xl.sheet_names:
            sheet_name = 'MSS Rollout Tracker'
        else:
            sheet_name = xl.sheet_names[0]
        df = pd.read_excel(file_stream, sheet_name=sheet_name)
    except Exception as e:
        return 0, 0, f"Failed to read sheet '{sheet_name}': {e}"
        
    required_cols = ['Task ID', 'Phase', 'Task Group', 'Task', 'Status', 'RAG Status', 'Owner', 'Due Date', 'Latest Progress Update']
    missing_cols = [col for col in required_cols if col not in df.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        return 0, 0, f"Missing required columns in sheet: {', '.join(missing_cols)}"
        
    # Auto-create selected unknown owners
    if auto_create_owners:
        org_id_row = fetch_one("SELECT org_id FROM projects WHERE id = ?", (project_id,))
        if org_id_row:
            org_id = org_id_row[0]
            for owner_name in auto_create_owners:
                owner_name = owner_name.strip()
                if not owner_name:
                    continue
                # Check if contact exists in the trust/org
                existing_contact = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM contacts WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (org_id, owner_name))
                if existing_contact:
                    contact_id = existing_contact[0]
                else:
                    contact_id = execute(
                        """INSERT INTO contacts (org_id, name, job_title, notes, is_deleted) 
                           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 0)""",
                        (org_id, owner_name, "Rollout Contact", "Auto-created from Excel Rollout Tracker sync"),
                        return_lastrowid=True
                    )
                # Check if associated in project_contacts
                existing_proj_contact = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM project_contacts WHERE project_id = ? AND contact_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (project_id, contact_id))
                if not existing_proj_contact:
                    execute(
                        "INSERT INTO project_contacts (project_id, contact_id, role_in_project, is_deleted) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0)",
                        (project_id, contact_id, "Rollout Owner")
                    )
                    log_audit_event("CREATE", "ProjectContact", current_user, current_user_role, contact_id, details={"message": f"Auto-created rollout contact {owner_name} during Excel sync."})

    # Get valid owners for comparison/standardization (RIT team + project contacts)
    rit_users_raw = fetch_all("SELECT name FROM rit_team ORDER BY name")
    project_contacts_raw = fetch_all(
        """SELECT c.name FROM project_contacts pc 
           JOIN contacts c ON pc.contact_id = c.id 
           WHERE pc.project_id = ? AND c.is_deleted = 0""", 
        (project_id,)
    )
    all_valid_names = [r[0] for r in rit_users_raw] + [r[0] for r in project_contacts_raw]
    valid_users = {name.strip().lower(): name.strip() for name in all_valid_names}
    
    # Get valid statuses
    status_rows = fetch_all("SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE category = 'TASK_STATUS'")
    db_statuses = [r[0] for r in status_rows] if status_rows else ["Open", "In Progress", "Blocked", "In Review", "Closed"]
    valid_statuses = set(db_statuses + ["Completed", "Withdrawn"])
    closed_statuses = set(get_config('CLOSED_STATUS') or ['Closed', 'Done', 'Cancelled', 'Completed'])
    
    updated_count = 0
    inserted_count = 0
    
    # Fetch valid task IDs for this project that belong to the MSS tracker
    mss_ids_df = query("SELECT id FROM actions WHERE project_id = ? AND project_phase IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0", (project_id,))
    valid_mss_ids = set(mss_ids_df['id'].tolist()) if not mss_ids_df.empty else set()
    
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        # Check Task Description
        task_desc = str(row['Task']).strip() if pd.notna(row['Task']) else ""
        if not task_desc:
            continue # Skip rows with no task description
            
        phase = str(row['Phase']).strip() if pd.notna(row['Phase']) else "Planning and Preparation"
        group = str(row['Task Group']).strip() if pd.notna(row['Task Group']) else "General"
        
        status_val = str(row['Status']).strip() if pd.notna(row['Status']) else "Open"
        # Standardize status casing
        matched_status = "Open"
        for s in valid_statuses:
            if s.lower() == status_val.lower():
                matched_status = s
                break
                
        rag_val = str(row['RAG Status']).strip() if pd.notna(row['RAG Status']) else "Grey"
        matched_rag = "Grey"
        for r in ["Green", "Amber", "Red", "Grey"]:
            if r.lower() == rag_val.lower():
                matched_rag = r
                break
                
        owner_val = str(row['Owner']).strip() if pd.notna(row['Owner']) else None
        if owner_val:
            owner_val = valid_users.get(owner_val.lower(), owner_val) # Standardize casing if matched
            
        due_val = None
        if pd.notna(row['Due Date']) and str(row['Due Date']).strip() != "":
            try:
                due_val = pd.to_datetime(row['Due Date']).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
            except Exception:
                pass
                
        latest_up = str(row['Latest Progress Update']).strip() if pd.notna(row['Latest Progress Update']) else ""
        up_text, up_blob = compress_text_if_needed(latest_up)
        
        # Determine date_completed
        is_complete = matched_status in closed_statuses
        date_completed = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if is_complete else None
        
        task_id_val = row['Task ID']
        
        # Check if ID is a valid existing task
        is_update = False
        if pd.notna(task_id_val):
            try:
                int_id = int(task_id_val)
                if int_id in valid_mss_ids:
                    is_update = True
            except ValueError:
                pass
                
        if is_update:
            # Update existing
            execute(
                """UPDATE actions 
                   SET project_phase = ?, 
                       task_group = ?, 
                       task = ?, 
                       status = ?, 
                       rag_status = ?, 
                       assigned_to = ?, 
                       due_date = ?, 
                       latest_update = ?, 
                       latest_update_blob = ?, 
                       date_completed = ?
                   WHERE id = ?""",
                (
                    phase,
                    group,
                    task_desc,
                    matched_status,
                    matched_rag,
                    owner_val,
                    due_val,
                    up_text,
                    up_blob,
                    date_completed,
                    int(task_id_val)
                )
            )
            updated_count += 1
        else:
            # Insert new custom task
            execute(
                """INSERT INTO actions (
                       project_id, task, project_phase, task_group, 
                       status, rag_status, assigned_to, due_date, 
                       latest_update, latest_update_blob, date_completed,
                       sla_status, is_deleted
                   ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'On Track', 0)""",
                (
                    project_id,
                    task_desc,
                    phase,
                    group,
                    matched_status,
                    matched_rag,
                    owner_val,
                    due_val,
                    up_text,
                    up_blob,
                    date_completed
                )
            )
            inserted_count += 1
            
    # Log audit event
    log_audit_event(
        "IMPORT_MSS_TRACKER", 
        "Project", 
        current_user, 
        current_user_role, 
        project_id, 
        details={"updated_count": updated_count, "inserted_count": inserted_count}
    )
    
    return updated_count, inserted_count, ""

def run_automatic_task_escalations(project_id: int):
    """
    Checks all open or in progress actions for the project.
    Escalates tasks if they are overdue by more than 3, 7, or 14 days.
    """
    # Query non-closed tasks
    df_actions = query("""
        SELECT id, task, due_date, status, escalation_level
        FROM actions
        WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Completed')
    """, (project_id,))
    
    if df_actions.empty:
        return
        
    today = datetime.now().date()
    
    for _, row in df_actions.iterrows():
        due_str = row['due_date']
        if not due_str:
            continue
        try:
            # Parse due date (standard formats: YYYY-MM-DD)
            due_date = datetime.strptime(str(due_str).strip(), "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        except Exception:
            continue
            
        if due_date >= today:
            continue
            
        days_overdue = (today - due_date).days
        
        new_level = 0
        if days_overdue > 14:
            new_level = 3
        elif days_overdue > 7:
            new_level = 2
        elif days_overdue > 3:
            new_level = 1
            
        current_level = int(row['escalation_level']) if pd.notna(row['escalation_level']) else 0
        
        if new_level > current_level:
            reason = f"Task is {days_overdue} days overdue (due date was {due_str})."
            execute("""
                UPDATE actions
                SET escalation_level = ?, date_escalated = ?, escalation_reason = ?
                WHERE id = ?
            """, (new_level, today.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), reason, int(row['id'])))
            log_audit_event(
                "AUTO_ESCALATION",
                "Action",
                "System",
                "System",
                int(row['id']),
                details={"new_level": new_level, "reason": reason}
            )

def get_ai_escalation_briefing(task_id: int) -> dict:
    """
    Generates a formal, role-tailored AI escalation briefing/draft message for a task.
    """
    row = fetch_one("""
        SELECT a.task, a.assigned_to, a.due_date, a.escalation_level, a.escalation_reason, 
               p.name as project_name, o.name as org_name
        FROM actions a
        JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        WHERE a.id = ?
    """, (task_id,))
    
    if not row:
        return {"subject": "Task Escalation", "message": "Task not found.", "recipient_role": "None"}
        
    task_name, owner, due_date, esc_level, esc_reason, project_name, org_name = row
    
    level_recipient_map = {
        1: ("Implementation Manager (IM)", "IM"),
        2: ("Implementation Lead (IL)", "IL"),
        3: ("Senior Implementation Lead (SIL)", "SIL")
    }
    
    role_name, role_code = level_recipient_map.get(esc_level, ("Implementation Specialist", "IM"))
    
    prompt = f"""You are an NHSBSA Transformation Lead drafting an escalation email.
    
    **Escalation Level:** {role_name}
    **Trust/Organisation:** {org_name}
    **Project Stream:** {project_name}
    **Task Name:** {task_name}
    **Task Owner:** {owner or 'Unassigned'}
    **Due Date:** {due_date or 'N/A'}
    **Escalation Reason:** {esc_reason or 'Task is overdue.'}
    
    Guidelines:
    - Write a highly professional email message suitable for an NHS transformation rollout.
    - Tailor the tone to the recipient level ({role_name}):
      - Level 1 (IM): Ask for a status update, highlight the bottleneck, and offer operational support.
      - Level 2 (IL): Explain that local interventions have not resolved the delay and request leadership alignment/re-prioritization.
      - Level 3 (SIL): Formal notice of critical milestone risk. Request direct intervention or a senior mitigation meeting.
    - Keep it concise, clear, and actionable. Include placeholders for names like [Recipient Name] and [Your Name].
    
    Output the result in the following JSON format:
    {{
        "subject": "<Subject Line>",
        "message": "<Full Email Body, using \\n for newlines>"
    }}
    """
    
    try:
        response = generate_ai_response(prompt, temperature=0.3, bypass_cache=True)
        clean_res = response.strip()
        if clean_res.startswith("```json"):
            clean_res = clean_res[7:]
        if clean_res.endswith("```"):
            clean_res = clean_res[:-3]
        clean_res = clean_res.strip()
        
        parsed = json.loads(clean_res)
        return {
            "subject": parsed.get("subject", f"Escalation: {task_name} - {org_name}"),
            "message": parsed.get("message", response),
            "recipient_role": role_name
        }
    except Exception:
        subject = f"ACTION REQUIRED: Escalation of Task '{task_name}' - {org_name}"
        message = f"Dear {role_name},\n\nThis is an automated escalation for the following task under the {project_name} stream:\n\n- Task: {task_name}\n- Owner: {owner}\n- Due Date: {due_date}\n- Issue: {esc_reason}\n\nPlease review and follow up with the owner to resolve this delay.\n\nBest regards,\nTransformation Team"
        return {
            "subject": subject,
            "message": message,
            "recipient_role": role_name
        }

def diagnose_blocked_task_ai(task_id: int) -> str:
    """
    Calls the AI to analyze a blocked task and suggest mitigations and risk definitions.
    """
    row = fetch_one("""
        SELECT a.task, a.assigned_to, a.latest_update, p.name as project_name, o.name as org_name
        FROM actions a
        JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        WHERE a.id = ?
    """, (task_id,))
    
    if not row:
        return "Task not found."
        
    task_name, owner, latest_update, project_name, org_name = row
    
    prompt = f"""You are an NHS BSA Change Management Advisor.
    Analyze this blocked task in the People Portal (Future NHS Workforce Solution) rollout:
    - **Trust:** {org_name}
    - **Project Stream:** {project_name}
    - **Task Description:** {task_name}
    - **Task Owner:** {owner or 'Unassigned'}
    - **Latest Commentary/Blocker Notes:** {latest_update or 'No commentary logged.'}
    
    Please provide:
    1. A diagnostics summary of the likely operational or change-management bottleneck (e.g. system integration delay, staff capacity, data quality).
    2. 2-3 specific, actionable recommendation steps to unblock the task.
    3. A structured Risk definition for the risk register:
       - **Risk Title:** Short summary of the risk.
       - **Likelihood (1-5):** Recommended score.
       - **Impact (1-5):** Recommended score.
       - **Mitigation Action:** Short sentence.
    
    Keep the response in clean, professional markdown format.
    """
    
    try:
        response = generate_ai_response(prompt, temperature=0.2, bypass_cache=True)
        return response
    except Exception as e:
        return f"AI diagnostics failed: {e}"

def sync_calendar_from_url(url: str, default_project_id: int, user_name: str, sync_days: int = 14) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """
    Fetches the iCal feed from url, parses events for the next sync_days,
    and inserts new meetings into the database, avoiding duplicates.
    Returns a tuple (imported_count, status_message).
    """
    import requests
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta
    
    start_date = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=7) # Sync from 7 days ago to catch recent changes/past events
    end_date = datetime.now() + timedelta(days=sync_days)
    
    try:
        response = requests.get(url, timeout=15)
        if response.status_code != 200:
            return 0, f"Failed to download calendar: HTTP {response.status_code}"
        
        content = response.text
        if not content or "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" not in content:
            return 0, "Invalid calendar data. Please ensure it is a valid ICS link."
            
        df = parse_ical_content(content, start_date, end_date)
        if df.empty:
            return 0, "No meetings found in the calendar feed for the sync range."
            
        imported_count = 0
        from core.database_utils import fetch_one, execute, log_audit_event
        
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            title = row['title']
            m_date = row['start_time'].date().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
            start_time_iso = row['start_time'].isoformat()
            end_time_iso = row['end_time'].isoformat()
            teams_url = row.get('teams_url') or ''
            
            # Check for duplicate:
            # 1. Same project, title, and start time
            duplicate = fetch_one(
                "SELECT id FROM meetings WHERE project_id = ? AND title = ? AND start_time = ? AND is_deleted = 0",
                (default_project_id, title, start_time_iso)
            )
            if duplicate:
                continue
                
            # 2. Same teams url, date, and start time
            if teams_url:
                duplicate_teams = fetch_one(
                    "SELECT id FROM meetings WHERE teams_url = ? AND date = ? AND start_time = ? AND is_deleted = 0",
                    (teams_url, m_date, start_time_iso)
                )
                if duplicate_teams:
                    continue
            
            execute(
                """INSERT INTO meetings (project_id, title, date, attendees, summary, document_type, location, organizer, teams_url, start_time, end_time) 
                   VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                (
                    default_project_id,
                    title,
                    m_date,
                    row.get('attendees', ''),
                    row.get('summary', ''),
                    "M365 Subscription Sync",
                    row.get('location', ''),
                    row.get('organizer', ''),
                    teams_url,
                    start_time_iso,
                    end_time_iso
                )
            )
            imported_count += 1
            
        if imported_count > 0:
            log_audit_event(
                "CREATE", "Meeting", user_name, "Advisor", None,
                details={"count": imported_count, "source": "M365 Subscription Sync", "project_id": default_project_id}
            )
            
        return imported_count, "Success"
        
    except Exception as e:
        return 0, f"Error during calendar sync: {str(e)}"

def compile_group_tag_summaries(project_id: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Compiles aggregation summaries for stakeholders in a project, grouped by group_tag.
    Handles multi-group selection arrays stored in the group_tag column.
    """
    # Fetch active stakeholders
    df_sh = query("""
        SELECT s.id, s.health_score, s.current_stance, s.group_tag,
               s.adkar_awareness, s.adkar_desire, s.adkar_knowledge, s.adkar_ability, s.adkar_reinforcement,
               c.name, c.job_title
        FROM stakeholders s
        JOIN contacts c ON s.contact_id = c.id
        WHERE s.project_id = ? AND s.is_deleted = 0
    """, (project_id,))
    
    if df_sh.empty:
        return []
        
    group_data = {}
    
    for _, row in df_sh.iterrows():
        g_val = row['group_tag']
        tags = []
        if g_val:
            try:
                parsed = json.loads(g_val)
                if isinstance(parsed, list):
                    tags = [str(t).strip() for t in parsed if t]
                else:
                    tags = [str(parsed).strip()]
            except Exception:
                # fallback to comma-separated
                tags = [t.strip() for t in str(g_val).split(',') if t.strip()]
        
        if not tags:
            tags = ['Unassigned']
            
        for tag in tags:
            if tag not in group_data:
                group_data[tag] = {
                    "group_tag": tag,
                    "count": 0,
                    "health_scores": [],
                    "stances": {"Advocate": 0, "Supporter": 0, "Neutral": 0, "Blocker": 0},
                    "adkar_awareness": [],
                    "adkar_desire": [],
                    "adkar_knowledge": [],
                    "adkar_ability": [],
                    "adkar_reinforcement": [],
                    "members": []
                }
                
            gd = group_data[tag]
            gd["count"] += 1
            if row['health_score'] is not None:
                gd["health_scores"].append(row['health_score'])
            stance = row['current_stance'] or 'Neutral'
            if stance in gd["stances"]:
                gd["stances"][stance] += 1
            else:
                gd["stances"]["Neutral"] += 1
                
            if row['adkar_awareness'] is not None: gd["adkar_awareness"].append(row['adkar_awareness'])
            if row['adkar_desire'] is not None: gd["adkar_desire"].append(row['adkar_desire'])
            if row['adkar_knowledge'] is not None: gd["adkar_knowledge"].append(row['adkar_knowledge'])
            if row['adkar_ability'] is not None: gd["adkar_ability"].append(row['adkar_ability'])
            if row['adkar_reinforcement'] is not None: gd["adkar_reinforcement"].append(row['adkar_reinforcement'])
            
            gd["members"].append({
                "id": row['id'],
                "name": row['name'],
                "job_title": row['job_title']
            })
            
    summaries = []
    for tag, gd in group_data.items():
        avg_health = sum(gd["health_scores"]) / len(gd["health_scores"]) if gd["health_scores"] else 0.0
        avg_aw = sum(gd["adkar_awareness"]) / len(gd["adkar_awareness"]) if gd["adkar_awareness"] else None
        avg_ds = sum(gd["adkar_desire"]) / len(gd["adkar_desire"]) if gd["adkar_desire"] else None
        avg_kn = sum(gd["adkar_knowledge"]) / len(gd["adkar_knowledge"]) if gd["adkar_knowledge"] else None
        avg_ab = sum(gd["adkar_ability"]) / len(gd["adkar_ability"]) if gd["adkar_ability"] else None
        avg_rf = sum(gd["adkar_reinforcement"]) / len(gd["adkar_reinforcement"]) if gd["adkar_reinforcement"] else None
        
        summaries.append({
            "group_tag": tag,
            "count": gd["count"],
            "avg_health_score": round(avg_health, 1),
            "stances": gd["stances"],
            "avg_awareness": round(avg_aw, 2) if avg_aw is not None else None,
            "avg_desire": round(avg_ds, 2) if avg_ds is not None else None,
            "avg_knowledge": round(avg_kn, 2) if avg_kn is not None else None,
            "avg_ability": round(avg_ab, 2) if avg_ab is not None else None,
            "avg_reinforcement": round(avg_rf, 2) if avg_rf is not None else None,
            "members": gd["members"]
        })
        
    return summaries


def calculate_risk_weighted_sequence(project_id: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Calculates the risk-weighted sequence for cutover tasks in a project.
    Joins cutover tasks with open project risks associated with the same work packages or functional areas.
    """
    # Check and run auto-migration for cutover_tasks columns if they don't exist
    columns_query = query("PRAGMA table_info(cutover_tasks)")
    existing_cols = columns_query['name'].tolist() if not columns_query.empty else []
    if 'work_package_id' not in existing_cols:
        try:
            execute("ALTER TABLE cutover_tasks ADD COLUMN work_package_id INTEGER REFERENCES work_packages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL")
        except Exception:
            pass
    if 'functional_area' not in existing_cols:
        try:
            execute("ALTER TABLE cutover_tasks ADD COLUMN functional_area TEXT")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Fetch cutover tasks
    tasks = query("""
        SELECT id, project_id, task_name, hour_offset, responsible_role, status, notes, work_package_id, functional_area
        FROM cutover_tasks
        WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0
        ORDER BY hour_offset ASC, id ASC
    """, (project_id,))

    if tasks.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            'id', 'project_id', 'task_name', 'hour_offset', 'responsible_role',
            'status', 'notes', 'work_package_id', 'functional_area',
            'standard_index', 'hazard_coefficient', 'risk_weighted_sequence', 'associated_risks'
        ])

    # Assign 1-based standard ordinal index
    tasks['standard_index'] = range(1, len(tasks) + 1)

    # Fetch open risks for this project
    risks = query("""
        SELECT id, category, description, impact, likelihood, risk_score
        FROM risks
        WHERE project_id = ? AND status = 'Open' AND is_deleted = 0
    """, (project_id,))

    # Fetch risk-to-work-package mappings from database
    wp_risks = query("""
        SELECT DISTINCT rtl.risk_id, a.work_package_id
        FROM risk_task_links rtl
        JOIN actions a ON rtl.task_id = a.id
        WHERE a.project_id = ? AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.work_package_id IS NOT NULL
    """, (project_id,))

    # Fetch work package names
    work_packages_df = query("SELECT id, name FROM work_packages WHERE project_id = ?", (project_id,))
    wp_name_map = {}
    if not work_packages_df.empty:
        wp_name_map = dict(zip(work_packages_df['id'], work_packages_df['name']))

    # Create mapping of work_package_id -> set of risk_ids
    wp_to_risks = {}
    if not wp_risks.empty:
        for _, row in wp_risks.iterrows():
            wp_id = int(row['work_package_id'])
            r_id = int(row['risk_id'])
            if wp_id not in wp_to_risks:
                wp_to_risks[wp_id] = set()
            wp_to_risks[wp_id].add(r_id)

    # Risk impact factors map
    impact_factors = {
        'Critical': 2.5,
        'High': 2.0,
        'Medium': 1.2,
        'Low': 1.0
    }

    hazard_coefficients = []
    weighted_sequences = []
    associated_risks_list = []

    for _, task in tasks.iterrows():
        task_wp_id = task['work_package_id']
        task_fa = str(task['functional_area'] or '').strip().lower()
        task_name_lower = str(task['task_name'] or '').strip().lower()
        task_notes_lower = str(task['notes'] or '').strip().lower()

        # Find associated risks
        task_associated_risks = []
        task_risk_ids = set()

        if not risks.empty:
            for _, risk in risks.iterrows():
                risk_id = int(risk['id'])
                risk_cat = str(risk['category'] or '').strip().lower()
                risk_desc = str(risk['description'] or '').strip().lower()

                is_linked = False

                # 1. Match by functional area / category
                if task_fa and risk_cat and (task_fa == risk_cat or task_fa in risk_cat or risk_cat in task_fa):
                    is_linked = True

                # 2. Match by work_package_id linked to risk via risk_task_links
                if not is_linked and pd.notna(task_wp_id) and task_wp_id in wp_to_risks:
                    if risk_id in wp_to_risks[task_wp_id]:
                        is_linked = True

                # 3. Fallback: text matching between task notes/name and risk description/category/work package name
                if not is_linked:
                    if pd.notna(task_wp_id) and task_wp_id in wp_name_map:
                        wp_name = wp_name_map[task_wp_id].lower()
                        if wp_name and (wp_name in risk_desc or wp_name in risk_cat):
                            is_linked = True
                    if not is_linked and risk_cat and (risk_cat in task_name_lower or risk_cat in task_notes_lower):
                        is_linked = True

                if is_linked and risk_id not in task_risk_ids:
                    task_risk_ids.add(risk_id)
                    task_associated_risks.append({
                        'id': risk_id,
                        'category': risk['category'],
                        'description': risk['description'],
                        'impact': risk['impact'],
                        'likelihood': risk['likelihood'],
                        'risk_score': risk['risk_score']
                    })

        # Calculate hazard coefficient
        coeff = 1.0
        for r in task_associated_risks:
            r_impact = str(r['impact'] or '').strip().capitalize()
            factor = impact_factors.get(r_impact, 1.0)
            coeff *= factor

        coeff = round(coeff, 2)

        hazard_coefficients.append(coeff)
        weighted_sequences.append(round(task['standard_index'] * coeff, 2))
        associated_risks_list.append(task_associated_risks)

    tasks['hazard_coefficient'] = hazard_coefficients
    tasks['risk_weighted_sequence'] = weighted_sequences
    tasks['associated_risks'] = associated_risks_list

    return tasks

# core/validation_utils.py
import re
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from functools import lru_cache

@lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
def query_ods_spine_api(ods_code: str) -> bool:
    """Queries NHS Spine ORD API for ODS code validity. Returns True if valid, False if not."""
    url = f"https://directory.spineservices.nhs.uk/ORD/2-0-0/organisations/{ods_code}"
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, 
            headers={'Accept': 'application/json', 'User-Agent': 'NHS-People-Portal-Validator/1.0'}
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3.0) as response:
            if response.status == 200:
                return True
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        if e.code == 404:
            return False
        raise e
    except Exception as e:
        raise e
    return False

def validate_ods_code_with_spine(ods_code: str) -> bool:
    """Validates ODS code via NHS ORD Spine API, falling back to local list on failure."""
    v_str = str(ods_code).strip().upper()
    if not re.match(r"^[A-Z0-9]{3,5}$", v_str):
        return False
    valid_ods_fallback = {"RR8", "RGT", "RXA", "RCF", "RWY", "RCU", "RTH", "14F", "15N", "00M", "00N", "RGN", "RKB", "RJZ", "RTD", "RXR"}
    try:
        return query_ods_spine_api(v_str)
    except Exception:
        return v_str in valid_ods_fallback

import datetime
import logging
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional
import sys
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet, InvalidToken
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import rsa
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import serialization

# Configure logger
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class DecryptionError(Exception):
    """Custom exception raised when data decryption fails."""
    pass

def get_app_base_dir() -> Path:
    """Gets the base directory of the application, handling packaged executables."""
    if getattr(sys, 'frozen', False) and hasattr(sys, '_MEIPASS'):
        # Running in a PyInstaller bundle
        return Path(sys.executable).parent
    else:
        # Running as a normal script (inside core/, go up one level)
        return Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

def get_encryption_key() -> bytes:
    """Retrieves or generates a persistent AES encryption key for data at rest."""
    app_id = "NHS_People_Portal"
    key_name = "App_Encryption_Key"
    
    # 1. Attempt using OS-native Credential Store (Keyring)
    try:
        import keyring
        key_str = keyring.get_password(app_id, key_name)
        if key_str:
            logger.debug("Successfully retrieved encryption key from OS keyring.")
            return key_str.encode()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Failed to access OS keyring: {e}")

    # 2. Fallback: Check user's home directory (machine-bound)
    home_dir = Path.home()
    key_file = home_dir / '.nhs_app_key'
    
    if key_file.exists():
        try:
            with open(key_file, 'rb') as f:
                key = f.read()
            logger.info("Retrieved encryption key from user home directory fallback.")
            
            # Sync key back to keyring if it's now accessible
            try:
                import keyring
                keyring.set_password(app_id, key_name, key.decode())
            except Exception:
                pass
            return key
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to read key file from home directory: {e}")

    # 3. Fallback: Check application base directory
    base_dir = get_app_base_dir()
    fallback_key_file = base_dir / '.nhs_app_key'
    if fallback_key_file.exists():
        try:
            with open(fallback_key_file, 'rb') as f:
                key = f.read()
            logger.info("Retrieved encryption key from application base directory fallback.")
            
            # Sync key to home dir and keyring if possible
            try:
                with open(key_file, 'wb') as hf:
                    hf.write(key)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                import keyring
                keyring.set_password(app_id, key_name, key.decode())
            except Exception:
                pass
            return key
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to read key file from app directory: {e}")
            
    # 4. Create a new key if none exists
    logger.warning("No existing encryption key found. Generating a brand new key.")
    key = Fernet.generate_key()
    
    # Try saving to Keyring
    try:
        import keyring
        keyring.set_password(app_id, key_name, key.decode())
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Failed to persist new key to OS keyring: {e}")

    # Save to user home directory
    try:
        with open(key_file, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(key)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to write new key to home directory: {e}")
        # Last resort: Fallback to the application directory
        try:
            with open(fallback_key_file, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(key)
        except Exception as fe:
            logger.critical(f"Critical: Unable to persist encryption key anywhere! {fe}")
            
    return key

def encrypt_file(input_file_path: str, output_file_path: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
    """
    Encrypts a file using AES-128-CBC (Fernet).
    Writes to output_file_path if provided, otherwise encrypts in place.
    """
    key = get_encryption_key()
    f = Fernet(key)
    
    with open(input_file_path, 'rb') as file:
        file_data = file.read()
        
    encrypted_data = f.encrypt(file_data)
    target_path = output_file_path if output_file_path else input_file_path
    
    with open(target_path, 'wb') as file:
        file.write(encrypted_data)
    logger.debug(f"Successfully encrypted file: {input_file_path} -> {target_path}")

def decrypt_file(file_path: str) -> bytes:
    """Decrypts a file and returns the raw bytes. Raises DecryptionError if it fails."""
    key = get_encryption_key()
    f = Fernet(key)
    
    with open(file_path, 'rb') as file:
        encrypted_data = file.read()
    try:
        return f.decrypt(encrypted_data)
    except InvalidToken:
        logger.error(f"Decryption failed for file '{file_path}'. The file might be corrupted or the key has changed.")
        raise DecryptionError("Invalid or mismatched encryption key.")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Unexpected error while decrypting '{file_path}': {e}")
        raise DecryptionError(f"Decryption failed: {str(e)}")

def encrypt_data(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Encrypts raw bytes using AES-128-CBC (Fernet)."""
    key = get_encryption_key()
    f = Fernet(key)
    return f.encrypt(data)

def decrypt_data(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    """Decrypts raw bytes. Raises DecryptionError if it fails."""
    key = get_encryption_key()
    f = Fernet(key)
    try:
        return f.decrypt(data)
    except InvalidToken:
        logger.error("Data block decryption failed. Token is invalid or key mismatch.")
        raise DecryptionError("Invalid or mismatched encryption key.")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Unexpected error while decrypting data block: {e}")
        raise DecryptionError(f"Decryption failed: {str(e)}")

def generate_self_signed_cert() -> None:
    """Generates a self-signed certificate for securing data in transit (HTTPS)."""
    base_dir = get_app_base_dir()
    cert_file = base_dir / 'cert.pem'
    key_file = base_dir / 'key.pem'
    
    if cert_file.exists() and key_file.exists():
        return
        
    private_key = rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537, key_size=2048)
    
    subject = issuer = x509.Name([
        x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.ORGANIZATION_NAME, "NHS Local App"),
        x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME, "localhost"),
    ])
    
    cert = (
        x509.CertificateBuilder()
        .subject_name(subject)
        .issuer_name(issuer)
        .public_key(private_key.public_key())
        .serial_number(x509.random_serial_number())
        .not_valid_before(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc))
        .not_valid_after(datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(days=365))
        .add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.DNSName("localhost")]), critical=False)
        .sign(private_key, hashes.SHA256())
    )
    
    with open(key_file, "wb") as f:
        f.write(private_key.private_bytes(
            encoding=serialization.Encoding.PEM,
            format=serialization.PrivateFormat.TraditionalOpenSSL,
            encryption_algorithm=serialization.NoEncryption()
        ))
        
    with open(cert_file, "wb") as f:
        f.write(cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM))
    logger.info(f"Generated new self-signed certificate and key at {base_dir}")

def get_safe_filename(title: str, file_path: str) -> str:
    """Isolates extension from file_path, sanitizes title to make it a safe filesystem string (alphanumeric, underscores, no special characters), and returns the filename."""
    import re
    import os
    _, ext = os.path.splitext(file_path)
    # Strip extension from title if title already ends with it
    if title.lower().endswith(ext.lower()) and ext:
        title = title[:-len(ext)]
    # Replace spaces/dashes with underscores
    title_processed = title.replace(' ', '_').replace('-', '_')
    # Clean non-alphanumeric, non-underscore characters
    sanitized = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_]', '', title_processed)
    # Clean multiple underscores
    sanitized = re.sub(r'_+', '_', sanitized).strip('_')
    if not sanitized:
        sanitized = "attachment"
    return f"{sanitized}{ext}"
