                                    ))

                            if f"{key_prefix}_man_thread_msgs" in st.session_state:
                                del st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_man_thread_msgs"]
                            log_audit_event("CREATE", "Email", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "Unknown", None, details={"subject": e_subject, "project_count": len(selected_project_ids), "source": "Manual Log Split"})
                            st.toast(f"Email logged against {len(selected_project_ids)} project(s).")
                            st.rerun()

                    else:
                        # Legacy single email
                        if not e_body:
                            st.error("Email Body is required.")
                        else:
                            e_body_text, e_body_blob = compress_text_if_needed(e_body)
                            sentiment = analyze_sentiment(str(e_body))["polarity"]
                            thread_group_id = str(uuid.uuid4())

                            for proj_id in selected_project_ids:
                                if sentiment < -0.4:
                                    execute("UPDATE projects SET sentiment_alert_flag = 1 WHERE id = ?", (proj_id,))
                                    log_audit_event("SENTIMENT_ALERT", "Project", "System", "System", proj_id, details={"source": "Email Log Manual", "sentiment": sentiment, "subject": e_subject})
                                
                                new_email_id = execute(
                                    """INSERT INTO emails (project_id, email_from, email_to, cc, subject, body, date_sent, sentiment_score, influence_level, thread_group_id, body_blob, affected_trusts)
                                       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                                    (proj_id, from_str, to_str, cc_str, e_subject, e_body_text, str(e_date), sentiment, influence, thread_group_id, e_body_blob, affected_trusts_json),
                                    return_lastrowid=True
                                )
                                
                                if e_attachments:
                                    attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                                    attachment_records = []
                                    for uploaded_file in e_attachments:
                                        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
                                        safe_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_file.name if c.isalnum() or c in " ._-")
                                        save_path = attachments_dir / f"email_{new_email_id}_{timestamp}_{safe_name}"
                                        with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                                            f.write(uploaded_file.getvalue())
                                        encrypt_file(str(save_path))
                                        
                                        attachment_records.append((
                                            new_email_id, str(save_path), uploaded_file.name, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                                        ))
                                    if attachment_records:
                                        execute_many("INSERT INTO email_attachments (email_id, file_path, file_name, upload_timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", attachment_records)

                            log_audit_event("CREATE", "Email", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "Unknown", None, details={"subject": e_subject, "project_count": len(selected_project_ids), "source": "Manual Log"})
                            st.toast(f"Email logged against {len(selected_project_ids)} project(s).")
                            st.rerun()

def render_add_organisation_form(sub_regions: List[str], key_prefix: str = "modal_add_org"):
    app_state = get_app_state()
    current_user = app_state.user.current_user or "System"
    current_user_role = app_state.user.current_user_role or "System"

    with st.form("org_creation_modal_form", clear_on_submit=True):
        st.subheader("Add New Trust / Organisation")
        n = st.text_input("Organisation Name")
        r = st.selectbox("Sub-Region", sub_regions)
        g = st.text_input("Organisation Group / Collaborative (Optional)", help="e.g., Humber Health Partnership")

        st.markdown("**Address**")
        add_c1, add_c2 = st.columns(2)
        addr1 = add_c1.text_input("Address Line 1")
        addr2 = add_c2.text_input("Address Line 2")
        city = add_c1.text_input("City")
        county = add_c2.text_input("County")
        postcode = add_c1.text_input("Postcode")

        org_cfs = get_custom_fields('org')
        cf_inputs = {}
        if org_cfs:
            st.markdown("**Custom Fields**")
            for i in range(0, len(org_cfs), 2):
                cols = st.columns(2)
                for j, cf in enumerate(org_cfs[i:i+2]):
                    if cf['field_type'] == 'Text':
                        cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].text_input(cf['field_name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")
                    elif cf['field_type'] == 'Number':
                        cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].number_input(cf['field_name'], value=0.0, key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")
                    elif cf['field_type'] == 'Date':
                        cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].date_input(cf['field_name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")
                    elif cf['field_type'] == 'Boolean':
                        cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].checkbox(cf['field_name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")

        if st.form_submit_button("Add Trust", type="primary"):
            if n:
                new_org_id = execute("INSERT INTO orgs (name, region, org_group, last_updated, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, county, postcode) VALUES (?,?,?,'0',?,?,?,?,?)", (n, r, g, addr1, addr2, city, county, postcode), return_lastrowid=True)
                log_audit_event("CREATE", "Organisation", current_user, current_user_role, new_org_id, details={"name": n, "region": r, "org_group": g, "address_line_1": addr1, "city": city, "postcode": postcode})
                save_custom_field_values('org', new_org_id, cf_inputs)
                st.toast(f"Successfully added {n}!")
                st.cache_data.clear()
                st.rerun()
            else:
                st.error("Organisation Name is required.")

def render_add_project_stream_form(orgs_df: pd.DataFrame, ia_list: List[str], templates_dict: Dict[str, int], key_prefix: str = "modal_add_stream"):
    app_state = get_app_state()
    PHASES = get_config('PHASE')
    STREAM_OPTIONS = get_config('STREAM_TYPE')

    with st.form("stream_creation_modal_form", clear_on_submit=True):
        st.subheader("Add New Project Stream")
        
        if not orgs_df.empty:
            org_options = [""] + orgs_df['name'].tolist()
            org_display_map = {"": ""}
            for _, row in orgs_df.iterrows():
                name = row['name']
                group = row.get('org_group')
                if pd.notna(group) and str(group).strip() and str(group).lower() not in ('nan', 'none'):
                    org_display_map[name] = f"{name} ({group})"
                else:
                    org_display_map[name] = name
            o_name = st.selectbox("Parent Organisation", org_options, format_func=lambda x: org_display_map.get(x, x))
            secondary_o_names = st.multiselect("Secondary Organisations (Optional)", org_options, format_func=lambda x: org_display_map.get(x, x))
            selected_template_name = st.selectbox("Apply Project Template (Optional)", options=list(templates_dict.keys()), format_func=lambda x: x)
            p_due_date = st.date_input("Target Go-Live Date", value=None)
            sn = st.selectbox("Project Stream Type", STREAM_OPTIONS)
            ss = st.selectbox("Initial Status", PHASES)
            
            st.subheader("Resource Allocation")
            st.caption("Assign Implementation Advisors and their capacity allocation for this project.")
            ia_alloc_df = pd.DataFrame({'Assign': [False]*len(ia_list), 'Advisor': ia_list, 'Allocation (%)': [25]*len(ia_list)})
            edited_ia_allocs = st.data_editor(ia_alloc_df, hide_index=True, use_container_width=True, key="add_ia_alloc_modal")

            prj_cfs = get_custom_fields('project')
            prj_cf_inputs = {}
            if prj_cfs:
                st.markdown("**Custom Fields**")
                for i in range(0, len(prj_cfs), 2):
                    cols = st.columns(2)
                    for j, cf in enumerate(prj_cfs[i:i+2]):
                        if cf['field_type'] == 'Text':
                            prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].text_input(cf['field_name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")
                        elif cf['field_type'] == 'Number':
                            prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].number_input(cf['field_name'], value=0.0, key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")
                        elif cf['field_type'] == 'Date':
                            prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].date_input(cf['field_name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")
                        elif cf['field_type'] == 'Boolean':
                            prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = cols[j].checkbox(cf['field_name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_cf_{cf['id']}")

            st.divider()
            ai_consent = st.checkbox("Use of transcription and AI note taking has been confirmed as acceptable.", value=False, key="add_ai_consent_modal")
            sharepoint_link = st.text_input("SharePoint Site Link", placeholder="https://sharepoint.com/sites/...", key="add_sharepoint_link_modal")

            if st.form_submit_button("Add Stream", type="primary"):
                if sn and o_name:
                    primary_org_id = int(orgs_df[orgs_df['name'] == o_name]['id'].iloc[0])
                    
                    # Check for existing project
                    existing_project = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (primary_org_id, sn))
                    
                    if existing_project:
                        st.session_state['duplicate_project_info'] = {'sn': sn, 'o_name': o_name}
                        st.toast(f"A project stream of type '{sn}' already exists for '{o_name}'.", icon="⚠️")
                        st.rerun()
                    else:
                        secondary_org_ids = []
                        for sec_name in secondary_o_names:
                            if sec_name in orgs_df['name'].values:
                                sec_id = int(orgs_df[orgs_df['name'] == sec_name]['id'].iloc[0])
                                secondary_org_ids.append(sec_id)
                        
                        secondary_org_id = secondary_org_ids[0] if secondary_org_ids else None

                        save_sharepoint_link = sharepoint_link.strip()
                        if save_sharepoint_link and not (save_sharepoint_link.startswith("http://") or save_sharepoint_link.startswith("https://")):
                            save_sharepoint_link = "https://" + save_sharepoint_link

                        try:
                            with transaction():
                                new_pid = execute(
                                    "INSERT INTO projects (org_id, secondary_org_id, name, status, ai_consent_given, due_date, sharepoint_link) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                                    (primary_org_id, secondary_org_id, sn, ss, int(ai_consent), str(p_due_date) if p_due_date else None, save_sharepoint_link),
                                    return_lastrowid=True
                                )

                                for sec_id in secondary_org_ids:
                                    execute(
                                        "INSERT INTO project_secondary_orgs (project_id, org_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                                        (new_pid, sec_id)
                                    )

                                log_audit_event("CREATE", "Project", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", new_pid, details={"name": sn, "org_id": primary_org_id, "secondary_org_ids": secondary_org_ids, "ai_consent": ai_consent, "sharepoint_link": save_sharepoint_link})
                                save_custom_field_values('project', new_pid, prj_cf_inputs)
                                
                                update_project_phase(new_pid, ss)
                                
                                today = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                                for _, alloc_row in edited_ia_allocs.iterrows():
                                    if alloc_row['Assign']:
                                        user_id_row = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM rit_team WHERE name = ?", (alloc_row['Advisor'],))
                                        if user_id_row:
                                            execute("INSERT INTO resource_allocations (user_id, project_id, allocation_pct, start_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                                    (user_id_row[0], new_pid, alloc_row['Allocation (%)'], today))

                                # Apply template if selected
                                template_applied_msg = ""
                                if templates_dict[selected_template_name] != 0:
                                    template_id = templates_dict[selected_template_name]

                                    # Set project's platform association from the template
                                    tpl_platform = fetch_one("SELECT platform_association FROM project_templates WHERE id = ?", (template_id,))
                                    if tpl_platform and tpl_platform[0]:
                                        execute("UPDATE projects SET platform_association = ? WHERE id = ?", (tpl_platform[0], new_pid))

                                    # Add Template Tasks
                                    df_template_tasks = query("SELECT id, task, assigned_to_role, due_offset_days, depends_on_template_task_id, project_phase, task_group FROM template_tasks WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
                                    task_id_map = {}
                                    for _, t_task in df_template_tasks.iterrows():
                                        assigned_to = t_task['assigned_to_role'] 
                                        due_date = (datetime.now().date() + timedelta(days=t_task['due_offset_days'])).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                                        new_task_id = execute(
                                            "INSERT INTO actions (project_id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, status, rag_status, project_phase, task_group) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                            (new_pid, t_task['task'], assigned_to, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), due_date, "Open", "Grey", t_task['project_phase'], t_task['task_group']),
                                            return_lastrowid=True
                                        )
                                        task_id_map[t_task['id']] = new_task_id
                                    
                                    # Update dependencies after all tasks are created
                                    for _, t_task in df_template_tasks.iterrows():
                                        if t_task['depends_on_template_task_id'] and t_task['depends_on_template_task_id'] in task_id_map:
                                            execute("UPDATE actions SET depends_on_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (task_id_map[t_task['depends_on_template_task_id']], task_id_map[t_task['id']]))

                                    # Add Template Risks
                                    df_template_risks = query("SELECT description, impact, likelihood, mitigation, owner_role FROM template_risks WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
                                    for _, t_risk in df_template_risks.iterrows():
                                        owner = t_risk['owner_role'] 
                                        execute(
                                            "INSERT INTO risks (project_id, description, impact, likelihood, mitigation, owner, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                            (new_pid, t_risk['description'], t_risk['impact'], t_risk['likelihood'], t_risk['mitigation'], owner, "Open")
                                        )

                                    # Apply Template Checklist
                                    df_template_checklist = query("SELECT item_description, category FROM template_checklist_items WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
                                    if not df_template_checklist.empty:
                                        checklist_items_to_save = []
                                        for i, item in df_template_checklist.iterrows():
                                            checklist_items_to_save.append({
                                                "Task ID": f"T{i+1}",
                                                "FRG Activity": item['item_description'],
                                                "Category": item['category'],
                                                "Action": "", 
                                                "Status": "Grey", 
                                                "Owner": "", 
                                                "Due date": None, 
                                                "Commentary": ""
                                            })
                                        checklist_json = json.dumps(checklist_items_to_save)
                                        execute("UPDATE projects SET checklist_data = ? WHERE id = ?", (checklist_json, new_pid))

                                    # Apply Template Custom Fields
                                    df_template_cfs = query("SELECT field_id, field_value FROM template_custom_field_values WHERE template_id = ?", (template_id,))
                                    if not df_template_cfs.empty:
                                        template_cf_values = {row['field_id']: row['field_value'] for _, row in df_template_cfs.iterrows()}
                                        save_custom_field_values('project', new_pid, template_cf_values)
                                    template_applied_msg = f" and template '{selected_template_name}' applied"

                            st.toast(f"Project '{sn}' created for {o_name}{template_applied_msg}.")
                            st.cache_data.clear()
                            app_state.navigation.pending_org = o_name
                            app_state.navigation.pending_prj = sn
                            st.switch_page("pages/02_🔍_Project_Dashboard.py")
                        except ValueError as e:
                            st.error(str(e))
                else:
                    st.error("Project Stream Type and a Parent Organisation are required.")
        else:
            st.warning("Add an Organisation first.")

def render_add_team_member_form(rit_roles: List[str], master_regions: List[str], key_prefix: str = "modal_add_member"):
    from core.auth_utils import hash_password
    app_state = get_app_state()

    with st.form("rit_reg_modal_form", clear_on_submit=True):
        rn = st.text_input("Full Name")
        new_roles = st.multiselect("Assigned Roles", rit_roles)
        new_primary_role = st.selectbox("Primary Role", options=new_roles if new_roles else [], help="The main role for display and default permissions.")
        new_pass = st.text_input("Set Password", type="password")
        rs = st.text_input("Skills (comma-separated)", placeholder="e.g. EPR, Clinical, ITIL")
        rc = st.number_input("Max Capacity Score", min_value=1, value=15, help="Threshold for burnout warning.")
        new_cost = st.number_input("Cost per Hour (£)", min_value=0.0, value=50.0, step=5.0, format="%.2f")
        new_photo = st.file_uploader("Profile Photo (Optional)", type=["jpg", "jpeg", "png"])
        ass = st.multiselect("Coverage / Assignments", master_regions)
        
        if st.form_submit_button("Register Member", type="primary"):
            if rn and new_pass and new_roles:
                photo_path_to_save = None
                if new_photo:
                    attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                    safe_name = "".join(c for c in rn if c.isalnum() or c in " ._-").replace(" ", "_")
                    file_ext = os.path.splitext(new_photo.name)[1]
                    save_path = attachments_dir / f"profile_{safe_name}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M')}{file_ext}"
                    with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                        f.write(new_photo.getbuffer())
                    encrypt_file(str(save_path))
                    photo_path_to_save = str(save_path)

                final_primary_role = new_primary_role if new_primary_role else new_roles[0]
                pass_hash = hash_password(new_pass)
                new_user_id = execute("INSERT INTO rit_team (name, primary_role, skills, max_capacity, assignment_id, password_hash, photo_path, cost_per_hour) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                                      (rn, final_primary_role, rs, rc, ",".join(ass), pass_hash, photo_path_to_save, new_cost), return_lastrowid=True)
                
                roles_to_insert = [(new_user_id, role) for role in new_roles]
                execute_many("INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?)", roles_to_insert)

                log_audit_event("CREATE", "User", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", new_user_id, details={"name": rn, "roles": new_roles})
                st.toast(f"Registered {rn}!")
                st.rerun()
            else:
                st.error("Name, Password, and at least one Role are required.")

def render_add_stakeholder_form(project_id: int, key_prefix: str = "modal_add_stk"):
    app_state = get_app_state()
    # Fetch all contacts from the central directory who are not already stakeholders for this project
    contacts_df = query("""
        SELECT c.id, c.name, c.job_title, o.name as org_name
        FROM contacts c
        LEFT JOIN orgs o ON c.org_id = o.id
        WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT contact_id FROM stakeholders WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0)
        ORDER BY c.name
    """, (project_id,))
    
    if contacts_df.empty:
        st.info("No new directory contacts available to add. Create contacts in the 'Central Contacts Directory' first.")
    else:
        with st.form("add_stakeholder_modal_form", clear_on_submit=True):
            contact_map = {row['id']: f"{row['name']} ({row['job_title'] or 'No Title'} — {row['org_name'] or 'No Organisation'})" for _, row in contacts_df.iterrows()}
            contact_id = st.selectbox("Select Contact from Directory", options=list(contact_map.keys()), format_func=lambda x: contact_map[x])
            
            if st.form_submit_button("Add to Register", type="primary"):
                # Auto-associate contact to the project if not already linked
                existing_pc = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM project_contacts WHERE project_id = ? AND contact_id = ?", (project_id, contact_id))
                if not existing_pc:
                    execute("INSERT INTO project_contacts (project_id, contact_id, role_in_project) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", (project_id, contact_id, 'Stakeholder'))
                
                new_stakeholder_id = execute(
                    "INSERT INTO stakeholders (project_id, contact_id, influence, interest, current_stance) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (project_id, contact_id, 'Medium', 'Medium', 'Neutral'),
                    return_lastrowid=True
                )
                log_audit_event("CREATE", "Stakeholder", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", new_stakeholder_id, details={"contact_id": contact_id, "project_id": project_id})
                st.toast("Stakeholder added to register.")
                st.rerun()

def render_add_engagement_form(stakeholder_id: int, stakeholder_name: str, key_prefix: str = "modal_add_eng"):
    app_state = get_app_state()
    with st.form("add_engagement_modal_form", clear_on_submit=True):
        st.write(f"**Log new engagement for {stakeholder_name}**")
        c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
        eng_date = c1.date_input("Engagement Date")
        # --- Item 21: Enhanced channel options ---
        eng_channel = c2.selectbox("Channel Type", ["Teams Call", "Teams Chat", "Email", "Phone Call", "In Person Meeting", "Workshop", "Other"])
        eng_notes = st.text_area("Notes / Summary of Interaction")

        # --- Item 21: Meeting Outcome & Follow-Up ---
        oc1, oc2 = st.columns(2)
        meeting_outcome = oc1.selectbox("Meeting Outcome", ["Positive", "Neutral", "Negative", "Action Required"])
        follow_up_required = oc2.checkbox("Follow-Up Required?", value=False)

        follow_up_due_date = None
        if follow_up_required:
            follow_up_due_date = st.date_input("Follow-Up Due Date", value=datetime.now().date() + timedelta(days=7))

        if st.form_submit_button("Log Engagement", type="primary"):
            if eng_notes:
                new_log_id = execute(
                    "INSERT INTO engagement_log (stakeholder_id, engagement_date, channel, channel_type, meeting_outcome, follow_up_required, follow_up_due_date, notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (stakeholder_id, str(eng_date), eng_channel, eng_channel, meeting_outcome,
                     1 if follow_up_required else 0,
                     str(follow_up_due_date) if follow_up_due_date else None,
                     eng_notes),
                    return_lastrowid=True
                )
                log_audit_event("CREATE", "EngagementLog", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", new_log_id, details={"stakeholder_id": stakeholder_id, "outcome": meeting_outcome})
                st.toast("Engagement logged successfully.")
                st.rerun()
            else:
                st.error("Notes are required.")

def render_add_issue_form(project_id: int, issue_priorities: List[str], key_prefix: str = "modal_add_issue"):
    app_state = get_app_state()
    current_user = app_state.user.current_user or "System"
    current_user_role = app_state.user.current_user_role or "System"

    description_input_key = f"{key_prefix}_issue_desc"
    suggested_solutions_key = f"{key_prefix}_suggested_solutions"
    
    if suggested_solutions_key not in st.session_state:
        st.session_state[suggested_solutions_key] = []

    def find_relevant_solutions_click():
        issue_desc = st.session_state.get(description_input_key, "")
        if len(issue_desc) > 10:
            try:
                from core.ai_utils import find_historical_solutions
                hits = find_historical_solutions(issue_desc, n_results=3)
                st.session_state[suggested_solutions_key] = hits
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Error finding historical solutions: {e}")
                st.session_state[suggested_solutions_key] = []
        else:
            st.session_state[suggested_solutions_key] = []

    with st.form("new_issue_modal_form", clear_on_submit=True):
        st.subheader("Log a New Issue")
        
        if st.session_state.get(suggested_solutions_key):
            with st.container(border=True):
                st.info("💡 **AI Suggestion: Matching Historical Solutions**")
                import re
                for idx, hit in enumerate(st.session_state[suggested_solutions_key]):
                    meta = hit['metadata']
                    hist_desc = meta.get('description') or hit['document']
                    resolution = meta.get('resolution') or "No solution recorded."
                    distance = hit.get('distance', 1.0)
                    similarity = 1.0 - (distance / 2.0)
                    confidence = max(0, min(100, int(similarity * 100)))
                    
                    with st.expander(f"**Historical Issue: {hist_desc[:80]}...** (Match: {confidence}%)"):
                        st.markdown(f"**Description:**\n{hist_desc}")
                        st.markdown(f"**Historical Solution (Resolution):**\n{resolution}")
                st.caption("Review these past solutions from completed streams to guide your resolution.")
            st.divider()

        issue_desc = st.text_area("Issue Description", key=description_input_key, help="Enter issue details and click 'Find Historical Solutions' for AI suggestions.")
        
        col_suggest, _ = st.columns([0.5, 0.5])
        if col_suggest.form_submit_button("💡 Find Historical Solutions", type="secondary", use_container_width=True):
            find_relevant_solutions_click()
            st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
            st.rerun()

        i_c1, i_c2, i_c3 = st.columns(3)
        issue_raised_by = i_c1.text_input("Raised By", value=current_user)
        issue_owner = i_c2.text_input("Owner")
        issue_priority = i_c3.selectbox("Priority", issue_priorities)

        if st.form_submit_button("Log Issue", type="primary"):
            real_desc = st.session_state.get(description_input_key, "")
            if real_desc:
                new_issue_id = execute(
                    "INSERT INTO issues (project_id, description, date_raised, raised_by, owner, priority, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (project_id, real_desc, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), issue_raised_by, issue_owner, issue_priority, "Open"),
                    return_lastrowid=True
                )
                log_audit_event("CREATE", "Issue", current_user, current_user_role, new_issue_id, details={"description": real_desc, "project_id": project_id})
                
                try:
                    from core.ai_utils import find_related_items_for_issue
                    ai_comment = find_related_items_for_issue(real_desc, project_id, new_issue_id)
                    if ai_comment:
                        execute("INSERT INTO comments (parent_id, parent_type, author, comment_text, timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                (new_issue_id, 'issue', 'AI Assistant', ai_comment, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")))
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"AI Triage Failed: {e}")

                st.session_state[suggested_solutions_key] = []
                st.session_state[description_input_key] = ""
                st.toast("Issue logged successfully!")
                st.rerun()
            else:
                st.error("Issue Description is required.")

def render_manage_contact_form(contact: Dict[str, Any], additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing a contact."""
    app_state = get_app_state()
    st.write(f"**Edit Contact: {contact['name']}**")
    c_key_id = contact['id']
    current_user = app_state.user.current_user or 'Unknown'
    current_user_role = app_state.user.current_user_role or 'Unknown'

    can_edit, reason = user_can("edit_contact")

    # Fetch all orgs for the dropdown
    df_orgs = query("SELECT id, name FROM orgs WHERE is_deleted=0 ORDER BY name")
    org_map = dict(zip(df_orgs['id'], df_orgs['name']))
    org_ids = list(org_map.keys())
    
    try:
        current_org_index = org_ids.index(contact['org_id'])
    except (ValueError, KeyError):
        current_org_index = 0

    edit_org_id = st.selectbox("Organisation", options=org_ids, format_func=lambda x: org_map.get(x, "Unknown"), index=current_org_index, key=f"{key_prefix}_org_{c_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit)

    c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
    edit_name = c1.text_input("Full Name", value=contact.get('name', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_name_{c_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit)
    edit_title = c2.text_input("Job Title", value=contact.get('job_title', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_title_{c_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit)

    c3, c4 = st.columns(2)
    edit_email = c3.text_input("Email Address", value=contact.get('email', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_email_{c_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit)
    edit_phone = c4.text_input("Phone Number", value=contact.get('phone', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_phone_{c_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit)

    edit_notes = st.text_area("Notes", value=contact.get('notes', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_notes_{c_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit)

    if st.button("💾 Save Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_contact_{c_key_id}", type="primary", use_container_width=True, disabled=not can_edit):
        execute(
            "UPDATE contacts SET org_id=?, name=?, job_title=?, email=?, phone=?, notes=? WHERE id=?",
            (edit_org_id, edit_name, edit_title, edit_email, edit_phone, edit_notes, c_key_id)
        )
        log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Contact", current_user, current_user_role, c_key_id, details={"name": edit_name})

        st.rerun()

    can_delete, _ = user_can("delete_contact")
    if can_delete:
        st.write("")
        if st.button("🗑️ Delete Contact Completely", key=f"{key_prefix}_delete_contact_{c_key_id}", type="secondary", use_container_width=True):
            execute("UPDATE contacts SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (c_key_id,))
            execute("DELETE FROM project_contacts WHERE contact_id=?", (c_key_id,))
            log_audit_event("DELETE", "Contact", current_user, current_user_role, c_key_id, details={"name": contact.get('name')})
            st.toast(f"Contact '{contact.get('name')}' deleted completely.")
            st.rerun()

def render_log_risk_form(project_id: int, key_prefix: str, current_user: str, current_user_role: str, selected_prj: str, selected_org: str, current_org_id: Optional[int]):
    """Renders a form to log a new risk, for use on multiple pages."""
    
    RISK_IMPACTS = get_config('RISK')
    RISK_CATEGORIES = get_config('RISK_CATEGORY')
    RISK_LIKELIHOODS = get_config('RISK_LIKELIHOOD')
    RISK_STATUSES = get_config('RISK_STATUS')
    if not RISK_STATUSES: # Fallback if not configured yet
        RISK_STATUSES = ["Open", "Resolved", "Closed"]

    session_state_key = f"suggested_lessons_{key_prefix}"
    suggested_issues_key = f"suggested_issues_{key_prefix}"
    description_input_key = f"new_risk_description_input_{key_prefix}"

    can_add, reason = user_can("add_risk")
    if can_add:
        if session_state_key not in st.session_state:
            st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
        if suggested_issues_key not in st.session_state:
            st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = []

        def find_relevant_lessons():
            risk_desc = st.session_state.get(description_input_key, "")
            if len(risk_desc) > 20:
                try:
                    lessons_collection = sync_lessons_to_vector_store(project_id)
                    if lessons_collection and lessons_collection.count() > 0:
                        results = lessons_collection.query(query_texts=[risk_desc], n_results=2)
                        if results and results['documents'] and results['documents'][0]:
                            st.session_state[session_state_key] = results['documents'][0]
                        else:
                            st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
                    else:
                        st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Error finding relevant lessons: {e}")
                    st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
            else:
                st.session_state[session_state_key] = []

        def find_relevant_issues_click():
            risk_desc = st.session_state.get(description_input_key, "")
            if len(risk_desc) > 20:
                try:
                    hits = find_relevant_issues(risk_desc, n_results=3)
                    st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = hits
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Error finding relevant issues: {e}")
                    st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = []
            else:
                st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = []

        with st.form(f"a_rsk_capture_{key_prefix}", clear_on_submit=True):
            st.subheader("Log New Risk")
            rd = st.text_area("Risk Description", key=description_input_key, help="Enter risk description and click 'Suggest Lessons' or 'Suggest Mitigations' for AI insights.")

            if st.session_state.get(session_state_key):
                with st.container(border=True):
                    st.info("💡 **AI Suggestion: Relevant Lessons Learned**")
                    for lesson_text in st.session_state[session_state_key]:
                        title_match = re.search(r"Lesson Title: (.*?)\n", lesson_text)
                        title = title_match.group(1) if title_match else "Suggested Lesson"
                        with st.expander(f"**{title}**"):
                            st.markdown(lesson_text)
                    st.caption("Consider these past experiences when refining your mitigation plan.")
                st.divider()

            if st.session_state.get(suggested_issues_key):
                with st.container(border=True):
                    st.info("💡 **AI Suggestion: Proven Mitigations from Historical Issues**")
                    for idx, hit in enumerate(st.session_state[suggested_issues_key]):
                        meta = hit['metadata']
                        issue_desc = meta.get('description') or hit['document']
                        resolution = meta.get('resolution') or "No resolution recorded."
                        distance = hit.get('distance', 1.0)
                        similarity = 1.0 - (distance / 2.0)
                        confidence = max(0, min(100, int(similarity * 100)))
                        
                        with st.expander(f"**Issue: {issue_desc[:80]}...** (Match: {confidence}%)"):
                            st.markdown(f"**Full Issue Description:**\n{issue_desc}")
                            st.markdown(f"**Proven Mitigation (Resolution):**\n{resolution}")
                            
                            if st.form_submit_button(f"📋 Copy Mitigation to Plan (Suggestion #{idx+1})", key=f"apply_issue_mit_{idx}_{key_prefix}"):
                                st.session_state[f"mitigation_{key_prefix}"] = resolution
                                st.rerun()
                    st.caption("Review these historical issues and copy a proven mitigation to your plan.")
                st.divider()

            col_btn1, col_btn2 = st.columns(2)
            if col_btn1.form_submit_button("💡 Suggest Lessons", type="secondary", use_container_width=True):
                find_relevant_lessons()
            if col_btn2.form_submit_button("💡 Suggest Mitigations from Issues", type="secondary", use_container_width=True):
                find_relevant_issues_click()

            rc1, rc2, rc3 = st.columns(3)
            ri = rc1.selectbox("Impact", RISK_IMPACTS, key=f"impact_{key_prefix}")
            rl = rc2.selectbox("Likelihood", RISK_LIKELIHOODS, key=f"likelihood_{key_prefix}")
            rc = rc3.selectbox("Category", RISK_CATEGORIES, key=f"category_{key_prefix}")
            ro = st.text_input("Owner", key=f"owner_{key_prefix}")
            rm = st.text_area("Mitigation Plan", help="You can use Markdown for formatting (e.g., **bold**, _italic_).", key=f"mitigation_{key_prefix}")
            
            if st.form_submit_button("Log Risk"):
                if rd:
                    score = calculate_risk_score(ri, rl)
                    new_risk_id = execute("INSERT INTO risks (project_id, category, impact, likelihood, risk_score, description, mitigation, owner, status, date_raised) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", 
                                              (project_id, rc, ri, rl, score, rd, rm, ro, "Open", datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")), return_lastrowid=True)
                    log_audit_event("CREATE", "Risk", current_user, current_user_role, new_risk_id, details={"description": rd, "project_id": project_id})
                    execute("INSERT INTO risk_history (risk_id, update_date, update_text) VALUES (?,?,?)", 
                            (new_risk_id, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "Risk originally logged."))

                    if ri == 'Critical':
                        create_notifications_for_event(
                            event_type='NEW_CRITICAL_RISK', project_id=project_id,
                            message=f"New Critical Risk on '{selected_prj}': {rd[:50]}...",
                            link=f"pages/07_⚠️_Risk_Log.py")
                        webhook_payload = {
                            "event_type": "CRITICAL_RISK_LOGGED",
                            "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat(),
                            "project_id": project_id,
                            "project_name": selected_prj,
                            "org_name": selected_org,
                            "risk_id": new_risk_id,
                            "risk_description": rd,
                            "risk_owner": ro
                        }
                        trigger_webhooks("CRITICAL_RISK_LOGGED", webhook_payload)
                    
                    if current_org_id:
                        update_timestamp(current_org_id)
                    st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
                    st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = []
                    if f"mitigation_{key_prefix}" in st.session_state:
                        st.session_state[f"mitigation_{key_prefix}"] = ""
                    # The form submission will trigger a page rerun, closing the dialog.
    else:
        st.info(reason)

def render_manage_task_form(task: Dict[str, Any], all_tasks_in_project_df: pd.DataFrame, key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing a task to avoid code duplication."""
    st.write(f"**Edit Task**")
    t_key_id = task['id']

    TASK_STATUSES = get_config('TASK_STATUS')
    CLOSED_STATUSES = get_config('TASK_STATUS_CLOSED')
    if not CLOSED_STATUSES:
        CLOSED_STATUSES = ["Closed", "Done", "Cancelled"]

    FRG_ACTIVITIES = get_config('FRG_ACTIVITY')
    frg_idx = FRG_ACTIVITIES.index(task.get('frg_activity')) if task.get('frg_activity') in FRG_ACTIVITIES else -1
    c_grp1, c_grp2 = st.columns(2)
    new_frg = c_grp1.selectbox("FRG Activity", FRG_ACTIVITIES, index=frg_idx, key=f"{key_prefix}_frg_{t_key_id}")
    new_task_group = c_grp2.text_input("Work Package / Task Group", value=task.get('task_group') or "", key=f"{key_prefix}_task_group_{t_key_id}")

    new_task_name = st.text_input("Action", value=task.get('task'), key=f"{key_prefix}_name_{t_key_id}")
    
    all_users = [""] + [r[0] for r in fetch_all("SELECT name FROM rit_team ORDER BY name")]
    current_owners = [owner.strip() for owner in str(task.get('Owner') or '').split(',') if owner.strip()]
    new_owners = st.multiselect("Owners", options=all_users, default=current_owners, key=f"{key_prefix}_owner_{t_key_id}")

    c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
    current_start_val: Any = task.get('start_date')
    if isinstance(current_start_val, str):
        try:
            current_start_val = datetime.strptime(current_start_val, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        except ValueError:
            current_start_val = None
    safe_start_date_val = current_start_val if pd.notnull(current_start_val) else datetime.now().date()
    new_start_date = c1.date_input("Start Date", value=safe_start_date_val, key=f"{key_prefix}_start_{t_key_id}")

    current_due_val: Any = task.get('due_date')
    safe_due_date_val = current_due_val if pd.notnull(current_due_val) else datetime.now().date()
    new_due_date = c2.date_input("Due Date", value=safe_due_date_val, key=f"{key_prefix}_due_{t_key_id}")

    rag_status_options = {'Grey': 'Not Yet Started', 'Green': 'On Track', 'Amber': 'At Risk', 'Red': 'Delayed'}
    current_rag = task.get('rag_status', 'Grey')
    rag_idx = list(rag_status_options.keys()).index(current_rag) if current_rag in rag_status_options else 0 # Green is now 'On Track'
    new_rag = st.selectbox("Status", options=list(rag_status_options.keys()), format_func=lambda x: rag_status_options[x], index=rag_idx, key=f"{key_prefix}_rag_{t_key_id}")
    
    new_update = st.text_area("Commentary", value=task.get('latest_update') or "", key=f"{key_prefix}_update_{t_key_id}", help="You can use Markdown for formatting (e.g., **bold**, _italic_).")

    st.divider()
    st.write("**Dependencies & Sub-Tasks**")

    dependency_options_df = cast(pd.DataFrame, all_tasks_in_project_df[all_tasks_in_project_df['id'] != t_key_id])
    dep_opts_dict: Dict[int, str] = dict(zip(dependency_options_df['id'], dependency_options_df['task']))
    dep_opts_dict[0] = "None"
    
    current_dep_id = task.get('depends_on_id') or 0
    if pd.notnull(current_dep_id):
        current_dep_id = int(current_dep_id)
    else:
        current_dep_id = 0

    dep_ids: List[int] = list(dep_opts_dict.keys())
    dep_index = dep_ids.index(current_dep_id) if current_dep_id in dep_ids else 0

    def format_dep(x: Any) -> str:
        return str(dep_opts_dict.get(x, "Invalid Dependency"))

    new_dependency: int = st.selectbox(
        "Depends On (Blocks this task)", options=dep_ids,
        format_func=format_dep, index=dep_index, key=f"{key_prefix}_dep_{t_key_id}"
    )

    if st.button("➕ Add Sub-task", key=f"{key_prefix}_add_sub_{t_key_id}", use_container_width=True):
        st.session_state['adding_subtask_to'] = t_key_id
        st.rerun()

    is_recurring = False
    recur_freq = None
    if not task.get('original_task_id'):
        st.divider()
        st.write("**Recurring Task**")
        is_recurring = st.checkbox("Make this task recurring", value=bool(task.get('is_recurring')), key=f"{key_prefix}_recur_{t_key_id}")
        if is_recurring:
            freq_options = ["Daily", "Weekly", "Monthly"]
            current_freq = task.get('recurring_frequency')
            freq_index = freq_options.index(current_freq) if current_freq in freq_options else 1
            recur_freq = st.selectbox("Frequency", freq_options, index=freq_index, key=f"{key_prefix}_freq_{t_key_id}")

    st.divider()
    current_status = task.get('status', 'Open')
    status_index = TASK_STATUSES.index(current_status) if current_status in TASK_STATUSES else 0
    new_status = st.selectbox("Status", TASK_STATUSES, index=status_index, key=f"{key_prefix}_status_{t_key_id}")

    # --- NEW: AI Blocker Diagnostics ---
    if new_status == 'Blocked':
        st.divider()
        st.write("**🤖 AI Blocker Diagnostics**")
        
        diag_key = f"diag_text_{t_key_id}"
        run_diag = st.button("🔍 Run AI Diagnostics Checkup", key=f"run_diag_{t_key_id}", use_container_width=True)
        if run_diag:
            # Save the current state of task details first so AI has the latest commentary/name/group
            dep_id_to_save = new_dependency if new_dependency != 0 else None
            legacy_owner_str = ", ".join(new_owners)
            execute("""UPDATE actions SET task=?, assigned_to=?, start_date=?, due_date=?, latest_update=?, depends_on_id=?, status=?, frg_activity=?, rag_status=?, task_group=? WHERE id=?""",
                    (new_task_name, legacy_owner_str, str(new_start_date), str(new_due_date), new_update, dep_id_to_save, new_status, new_frg, new_rag, new_task_group, t_key_id))
            
            with st.spinner("Analyzing blockers using AI..."):
                from core.logic import diagnose_blocked_task_ai
                diag_markdown = diagnose_blocked_task_ai(t_key_id)
                st.session_state[diag_key] = diag_markdown
        
        if st.session_state.get(diag_key):
            st.info("### AI Blocker Diagnostics Report")
            st.markdown(st.session_state[diag_key])
            
            # Local parser helper
            def parse_diagnostics_to_risk(diag_text: str) -> dict:
                risk_data = {
                    "description": f"Risk related to blocked task: {new_task_name}",
                    "impact": "Medium",
                    "likelihood": "3 - Possible",
                    "mitigation": "Review AI unblocking recommendations.",
                    "category": "Operational"
                }
                
                title_match = re.search(r"-\s*\*\*Risk Title:\*\*\s*(.*)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if not title_match:
                    title_match = re.search(r"\*\*Risk Title:\*\*\s*(.*)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if title_match:
                    risk_data["description"] = title_match.group(1).strip()
                    
                lh_match = re.search(r"-\s*\*\*Likelihood.*?\*\*:\s*(\d|\w+)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if not lh_match:
                    lh_match = re.search(r"\*\*Likelihood.*?\*\*:\s*(\d|\w+)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if lh_match:
                    val = lh_match.group(1).strip().lower()
                    if '1' in val or 'rare' in val:
                        risk_data["likelihood"] = "1 - Rare"
                    elif '2' in val or 'unlik' in val:
                        risk_data["likelihood"] = "2 - Unlikely"
                    elif '3' in val or 'poss' in val:
                        risk_data["likelihood"] = "3 - Possible"
                    elif '4' in val or 'like' in val:
                        risk_data["likelihood"] = "4 - Likely"
                    elif '5' in val or 'cert' in val:
                        risk_data["likelihood"] = "5 - Almost Certain"
                        
                imp_match = re.search(r"-\s*\*\*Impact.*?\*\*:\s*(\d|\w+)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if not imp_match:
                    imp_match = re.search(r"\*\*Impact.*?\*\*:\s*(\d|\w+)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if imp_match:
                    val = imp_match.group(1).strip().lower()
                    if 'crit' in val or '5' in val:
                        risk_data["impact"] = "Critical"
                    elif 'high' in val or '4' in val:
                        risk_data["impact"] = "High"
                    elif 'med' in val or '3' in val:
                        risk_data["impact"] = "Medium"
                    elif 'low' in val or '1' in val or '2' in val:
                        risk_data["impact"] = "Low"
                        
                mit_match = re.search(r"-\s*\*\*Mitigation.*?\*\*:\s*(.*)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if not mit_match:
                    mit_match = re.search(r"\*\*Mitigation.*?\*\*:\s*(.*)", diag_text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if mit_match:
                    risk_data["mitigation"] = mit_match.group(1).strip()
                    
                return risk_data

            parsed_risk = parse_diagnostics_to_risk(st.session_state[diag_key])
            
            st.markdown("#### Log Blocker as a Risk")
            with st.container(border=True):
                risk_desc = st.text_input("Risk Title / Description", value=parsed_risk["description"], key=f"diag_risk_desc_{t_key_id}")
                
                c_imp, c_lik, c_cat = st.columns(3)
                
                RISK_IMPACTS = get_config('RISK')
                RISK_LIKELIHOODS = get_config('RISK_LIKELIHOOD')
                RISK_CATEGORIES = get_config('RISK_CATEGORY')
                
                imp_idx = RISK_IMPACTS.index(parsed_risk["impact"]) if parsed_risk["impact"] in RISK_IMPACTS else 0
                lik_idx = RISK_LIKELIHOODS.index(parsed_risk["likelihood"]) if parsed_risk["likelihood"] in RISK_LIKELIHOODS else 0
                cat_idx = RISK_CATEGORIES.index(parsed_risk["category"]) if parsed_risk["category"] in RISK_CATEGORIES else 0
                
                selected_imp = c_imp.selectbox("Impact Level", RISK_IMPACTS, index=imp_idx, key=f"diag_risk_imp_{t_key_id}")
                selected_lik = c_lik.selectbox("Likelihood", RISK_LIKELIHOODS, index=lik_idx, key=f"diag_risk_lik_{t_key_id}")
                selected_cat = c_cat.selectbox("Category", RISK_CATEGORIES, index=cat_idx, key=f"diag_risk_cat_{t_key_id}")
                
                risk_mit = st.text_area("Mitigation Action", value=parsed_risk["mitigation"], key=f"diag_risk_mit_{t_key_id}")
                
                if st.button("🛡️ Auto-Log to Risk Register", key=f"diag_log_risk_btn_{t_key_id}", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
                    score = calculate_risk_score(selected_imp, selected_lik)
                    current_user = st.session_state.get('current_user', 'System')
                    current_user_role = st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'System')
                    
                    new_risk_id = execute("""
                        INSERT INTO risks (project_id, category, impact, likelihood, risk_score, description, mitigation, owner, status, date_raised)
                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """, (task['project_id'], selected_cat, selected_imp, selected_lik, score, risk_desc, risk_mit, (task.get('Owner') or current_user), "Open", datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")), return_lastrowid=True)
                    
                    log_audit_event("CREATE", "Risk", current_user, current_user_role, new_risk_id, details={"description": risk_desc, "project_id": task['project_id']})
                    
                    execute("INSERT INTO risk_history (risk_id, update_date, update_text) VALUES (?,?,?)", 
                            (new_risk_id, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "Risk logged automatically from blocked task diagnostics."))
                    
                    if selected_imp == 'Critical':
                        create_notifications_for_event(
                            event_type='NEW_CRITICAL_RISK', project_id=task['project_id'],
                            message=f"New Critical Risk logged via Blocker diagnostics: {risk_desc[:50]}...",
                            link="pages/07_⚠️_Risk_Log.py"
                        )
                    
                    st.toast("Risk successfully logged to Risk Register!", icon="🛡️")
                    del st.session_state[diag_key]
                    st.rerun()

    if st.button("💾 Save Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_{t_key_id}", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
        can_save = True
        if new_status in CLOSED_STATUSES and task.get('status') not in CLOSED_STATUSES:
            blocked_by = all_tasks_in_project_df[all_tasks_in_project_df['id'] == task.get('depends_on_id')]
            if not blocked_by.empty and str(blocked_by.iloc[0]['status']) not in CLOSED_STATUSES:
                st.error(f"Cannot close: Task depends on '{blocked_by.iloc[0]['task']}' which is not complete.")
                can_save = False

        if can_save:
            # Ensure current_due_val is a date object for subtraction
            parsed_current_due_val = None
            if pd.notnull(task.get('due_date')) and isinstance(task.get('due_date'), str):
                try: parsed_current_due_val = datetime.strptime(task['due_date'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
                except ValueError: pass
            days_shifted = (new_due_date - parsed_current_due_val).days if parsed_current_due_val and new_due_date else 0
            next_occurrence = task.get('next_occurrence_date')
            if is_recurring and not bool(task.get('is_recurring')): next_occurrence = str(new_due_date)
            date_completed = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if new_status in CLOSED_STATUSES else None
            if key_prefix == "modal":
                if 'modal_edit_entity' in st.session_state:
                    del st.session_state.modal_edit_entity
            
            # --- NEW: Sync multi-user assignments ---
            current_assignments_df = query("SELECT rt.name FROM action_assignments aa JOIN rit_team rt ON aa.user_id = rt.id WHERE aa.action_id = ?", (t_key_id,))
            current_assigned_names = current_assignments_df['name'].tolist() if not current_assignments_df.empty else []

            owners_to_add = [name for name in new_owners if name and name not in current_assigned_names]
            owners_to_remove = [name for name in current_assigned_names if name not in new_owners]

            if owners_to_add:
                user_ids_to_add_df = query(f"SELECT id FROM rit_team WHERE name IN ({','.join(['?']*len(owners_to_add))})", tuple(owners_to_add))
                if not user_ids_to_add_df.empty:
                    execute_many("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO action_assignments (action_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)", [(t_key_id, user_id) for user_id in user_ids_to_add_df['id']])

            if owners_to_remove:
                user_ids_to_remove_df = query(f"SELECT id FROM rit_team WHERE name IN ({','.join(['?']*len(owners_to_remove))})", tuple(owners_to_remove))
                if not user_ids_to_remove_df.empty:
                    placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(user_ids_to_remove_df['id']))
                    execute(f"DELETE FROM action_assignments WHERE action_id = ? AND user_id IN ({placeholders})", (t_key_id, *user_ids_to_remove_df['id']))
            
            legacy_owner_str = ", ".join(new_owners)
            sentiment_score = None
            if new_update:
                sentiment_score = analyze_sentiment(new_update)['polarity']
            dep_id_to_save = new_dependency if new_dependency != 0 else None

            execute("""UPDATE actions SET task=?, assigned_to=?, start_date=?, due_date=?, latest_update=?, depends_on_id=?, is_recurring=?, recurring_frequency=?, next_occurrence_date=?, status=?, date_completed=?, frg_activity=?, rag_status=?, sentiment_score=?, task_group=? WHERE id=?""",(new_task_name, legacy_owner_str, str(new_start_date), str(new_due_date), new_update, dep_id_to_save, int(is_recurring), recur_freq, next_occurrence, new_status, date_completed, new_frg, new_rag, sentiment_score, new_task_group, t_key_id))
            
            if days_shifted != 0:
                affected = cascade_task_delay(t_key_id, days_shifted)
                if affected > 0: st.toast(f"🔄 Cascaded {days_shifted} day shift to {affected} dependent task(s)!", icon="🌊")

            st.rerun()
    
    comment_df = query("SELECT author, timestamp, comment_text FROM comments WHERE parent_id=? AND parent_type='action' ORDER BY timestamp ASC", (task['id'],))
    if not comment_df.empty:
        for _, c in comment_df.iterrows():
            st.caption(f"**{c['author']}** ({c['timestamp']}):")
            st.markdown(c['comment_text'])
    else:
        st.caption("No comments yet.")
    
    new_comment = st.text_area("Add a comment:", key=f"{key_prefix}_new_comment_{task['id']}", label_visibility="collapsed", placeholder="Type your comment...", help="Use Markdown for formatting (e.g., **bold**, _italic_).")
    if st.button("Post Comment", key=f"{key_prefix}_post_comment_{task['id']}", use_container_width=True):
        if new_comment:
            current_user = st.session_state.get('current_user', 'Unknown')
            sentiment_score = analyze_sentiment(new_comment)['polarity']
            execute("INSERT INTO comments (parent_id, parent_type, author, comment_text, timestamp, sentiment_score) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (task['id'], 'action', current_user, new_comment, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), sentiment_score))
            
            # --- NEW: @mention Notifications ---
            all_users = query("SELECT name FROM rit_team")['name'].tolist()
            for user in all_users:
                if f"@{user}" in new_comment and user != current_user:
                    create_notifications_for_event(event_type='USER_MENTION', message=f"{current_user} mentioned you on a task.", link="pages/06_📋_Task_List.py", direct_user=user)

            st.rerun()

    st.divider()
    can_delete, reason = user_can("delete_action", project_id=task['project_id'])
    if st.button("🗑️ Delete Action", key=f"{key_prefix}_del_act_{task['id']}", use_container_width=True, disabled=not can_delete, help=reason if not can_delete else "Delete this action permanently."):
        execute("UPDATE actions SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (task['id'],))
        
        st.rerun()

def render_manage_risk_form(risk: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing a risk to avoid code duplication."""
    st.markdown("### Edit Risk Intelligence")
    
    RISK_IMPACTS = get_config('RISK')
    RISK_CATEGORIES = get_config('RISK_CATEGORY')
    RISK_LIKELIHOODS = get_config('RISK_LIKELIHOOD')
    RISK_STATUSES = get_config('RISK_STATUS')
    if not RISK_STATUSES: # Fallback if not configured yet
        RISK_STATUSES = ["Open", "Resolved", "Closed"]

    
    can_edit_risk, reason = user_can("edit_risk", owner=risk.get('owner'))

    description_text = decompress_text_if_needed(risk.get('description'), risk.get('description_blob'))
    mitigation_text = decompress_text_if_needed(risk.get('mitigation'), risk.get('mitigation_blob'))
    contingency_text = decompress_text_if_needed(risk.get('contingency_plan'), risk.get('contingency_plan_blob'))

    new_cat = st.selectbox("Category", RISK_CATEGORIES, index=RISK_CATEGORIES.index(risk.get('category')) if risk.get('category') in RISK_CATEGORIES else 0, key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_cat_{risk['id']}", disabled=not can_edit_risk)
    new_desc = st.text_area("Description", value=description_text, key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_desc_{risk['id']}", help="Use Markdown for formatting.", disabled=not can_edit_risk)
    
    # --- Context-Aware Lessons Recommender ---
    session_state_key = f"suggested_lessons_edit_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"
    if session_state_key not in st.session_state:
        st.session_state[session_state_key] = []

    def find_relevant_lessons_edit():
        import re
        risk_desc = new_desc
        if len(risk_desc) > 20:
            try:
                lessons_collection = sync_lessons_to_vector_store(risk['project_id'])
                if lessons_collection and lessons_collection.count() > 0:
                    results = lessons_collection.query(query_texts=[risk_desc], n_results=2)
                    if results and results['documents'] and results['documents'][0]:
                        st.session_state[session_state_key] = results['documents'][0]
                    else:
                        st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
                else:
                    st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Error finding relevant lessons: {e}")
                st.session_state[session_state_key] = []
        else:
            st.session_state[session_state_key] = []

    # --- Context-Aware Issues Recommender ---
    suggested_issues_key = f"suggested_issues_edit_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"
    if suggested_issues_key not in st.session_state:
        st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = []

    def find_relevant_issues_edit():
        risk_desc = new_desc
        if len(risk_desc) > 20:
            try:
                hits = find_relevant_issues(risk_desc, n_results=3)
                st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = hits
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Error finding relevant issues: {e}")
                st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = []
        else:
            st.session_state[suggested_issues_key] = []

    if st.session_state.get(session_state_key):
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.info("💡 **AI Suggestion: Relevant Lessons Learned**")
            import re
            for lesson_text in st.session_state[session_state_key]:
                title_match = re.search(r"Lesson Title: (.*?)\n", lesson_text)
                title = title_match.group(1) if title_match else "Suggested Lesson"
                with st.expander(f"**{title}**"):
                    st.markdown(lesson_text)
            st.caption("Consider these past experiences when refining your mitigation plan.")
        st.divider()

    if st.session_state.get(suggested_issues_key):
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.info("💡 **AI Suggestion: Proven Mitigations from Historical Issues**")
            for idx, hit in enumerate(st.session_state[suggested_issues_key]):
                meta = hit['metadata']
                issue_desc = meta.get('description') or hit['document']
                resolution = meta.get('resolution') or "No resolution recorded."
                distance = hit.get('distance', 1.0)
                similarity = 1.0 - (distance / 2.0)
                confidence = max(0, min(100, int(similarity * 100)))
                
                with st.expander(f"**Issue: {issue_desc[:80]}...** (Match: {confidence}%)"):
                    st.markdown(f"**Full Issue Description:**\n{issue_desc}")
                    st.markdown(f"**Proven Mitigation (Resolution):**\n{resolution}")
                    
                    if st.button(f"📋 Copy Mitigation to Plan (Suggestion #{idx+1})", key=f"apply_issue_mit_edit_{idx}_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"):
                        st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_nr_mit_{risk['id']}"] = resolution
                        st.rerun()
            st.caption("Review these historical issues and copy a proven mitigation to your plan.")
        st.divider()

    col_btn_edit1, col_btn_edit2 = st.columns(2)
    if col_btn_edit1.button("💡 Suggest Lessons from Past Rollouts", key=f"{key_prefix}_suggest_lessons_btn_{risk['id']}", use_container_width=True):
        find_relevant_lessons_edit()
        st.rerun()
    if col_btn_edit2.button("💡 Suggest Mitigations from Issues", key=f"{key_prefix}_suggest_issues_btn_{risk['id']}", use_container_width=True):
        find_relevant_issues_edit()
        st.rerun()

    # --- AI MITIGATION STRATEGIST ---
    st.write("**Mitigation Plan**")
    mit_col1, mit_col2 = st.columns([0.7, 0.3])
    
    if mit_col2.button("🤖 Auto-Draft", key=f"{key_prefix}_ai_mit_{risk['id']}", help="Draft using Llama 3", use_container_width=True, disabled=not can_edit_risk):
        with st.spinner("AI is strategizing..."):
            user_prompt = MITIGATION_STRATEGIST_USER_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(impact=risk['impact'], new_desc=new_desc)
            try:
                res = generate_ai_response(prompt=user_prompt, system_prompt=MITIGATION_STRATEGIST_SYSTEM_PROMPT, temperature=0.2)
                ai_plan = json.loads(res)
                parsed_mitigation_plan = ai_plan.get("mitigation_plan", "")
                parsed_suggested_actions = ai_plan.get("suggested_actions", [])
                st.session_state[f"draft_actions_df_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"] = pd.DataFrame(parsed_suggested_actions)
                st.session_state[f"draft_mit_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"] = parsed_mitigation_plan
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(str(e))
                
    display_mit = st.session_state.get(f"draft_mit_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}", mitigation_text)
    new_mit = mit_col1.text_area("Mitigation Plan", value=display_mit, key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_mit_{risk['id']}", label_visibility="collapsed", help="Use Markdown for formatting.", disabled=not can_edit_risk)

    # --- Suggested Actions Section ---
    if f"draft_actions_df_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}" in st.session_state and not st.session_state[f"draft_actions_df_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"].empty:
        st.divider()
        st.write("**AI Suggested Actions (Review & Commit)**")
        
        df_suggested_actions = st.session_state[f"draft_actions_df_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"]
        if not df_suggested_actions.empty:
            df_suggested_actions['Import'] = True # Default to import
            
            edited_suggested_actions = st.data_editor(
                df_suggested_actions,
                column_config={
                    "Import": st.column_config.CheckboxColumn("Import?"),
                    "Task Description": st.column_config.TextColumn("Task Description", width="large"),
                    "Assigned To": st.column_config.TextColumn("Assigned To"),
                    "Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD)": st.column_config.DateColumn("Due Date", format="YYYY-MM-DD")
                },
                hide_index=True,
                use_container_width=True,
                key=f"{key_prefix}_ai_suggested_actions_{risk['id']}"
            )
                
            if st.button("➕ Commit Suggested Actions", key=f"{key_prefix}_commit_ai_actions_{risk['id']}", use_container_width=True, type="secondary"):
                new_actions_count = 0
                for action_row in edited_suggested_actions.to_dict('records'):
                    if action_row['Import']:
                        try:
                            due_date_str = action_row['Due Date (YYYY-MM-DD)']
                            if isinstance(due_date_str, (datetime, pd.Timestamp)):
                                clean_due = due_date_str.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                            else:
                                clean_due = dparser.parse(str(due_date_str), fuzzy=True, default=datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                        except (dparser.ParserError, TypeError):
                            clean_due = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                        
                        execute("INSERT INTO actions (project_id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, status, latest_update) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                                (risk['project_id'], action_row['Task Description'], action_row['Assigned To'], datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), clean_due, "Open", f"AI Suggested Mitigation for Risk ID {risk['id']}"))
                        new_actions_count += 1
                
                if new_actions_count > 0:
                    st.toast(f"Committed {new_actions_count} AI-suggested actions!")
                    del st.session_state[f"draft_actions_df_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"]
                    if f"draft_mit_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}" in st.session_state:
                        del st.session_state[f"draft_mit_{key_prefix}_{risk['id']}"]
                    st.rerun()
                else:
                    st.info("No actions selected for import.")

    c_imp, c_lik = st.columns(2)
    new_imp = c_imp.selectbox("Impact Level", RISK_IMPACTS, index=RISK_IMPACTS.index(risk['impact']) if risk['impact'] in RISK_IMPACTS else 0, key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_imp_{risk['id']}", disabled=not can_edit_risk)
    new_lik = c_lik.selectbox("Likelihood", RISK_LIKELIHOODS, index=RISK_LIKELIHOODS.index(risk.get('likelihood')) if risk.get('likelihood') in RISK_LIKELIHOODS else 2, key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_lik_{risk['id']}", disabled=not can_edit_risk)
    
    new_cp = st.text_area("Contingency Plan", value=contingency_text, key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_cp_{risk['id']}", help="Use Markdown for formatting.", disabled=not can_edit_risk)
    current_risk_status = risk.get('status', 'Open') # Default to 'Open' if status is missing
    # Ensure current_risk_status is in RISK_STATUSES, otherwise default to 'Open' or the first available status
    if current_risk_status not in RISK_STATUSES:
        current_risk_status = "Open" if "Open" in RISK_STATUSES else RISK_STATUSES[0] if RISK_STATUSES else "Open"
    risk_status_index = RISK_STATUSES.index(current_risk_status)
    new_risk_status = st.selectbox("Risk Status", RISK_STATUSES, index=risk_status_index, key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_status_{risk['id']}", disabled=not can_edit_risk) # Use RISK_STATUSES
    if st.button("💾 Save Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_save_{risk['id']}", use_container_width=True, type="primary", disabled=not can_edit_risk, help=reason if not can_edit_risk else "Save changes to this risk."):
        new_score = calculate_risk_score(new_imp, new_lik)
        
        changes: List[str] = []
        if new_imp != risk.get('impact'): changes.append(f"Impact changed to {new_imp}")
        if new_lik != risk.get('likelihood'): changes.append(f"Likelihood changed to {new_lik}")
        if new_mit != mitigation_text: changes.append("Mitigation updated")
        if new_cp != contingency_text: changes.append("Contingency plan updated")
        if new_risk_status != risk.get('status'): changes.append(f"Status changed to {new_risk_status}")

        combined_text = f"{new_desc} {new_mit} {new_cp}"
        sentiment_score = analyze_sentiment(combined_text)['polarity']

        # Compress text fields before updating
        new_desc_text, new_desc_blob = compress_text_if_needed(new_desc)
        new_mit_text, new_mit_blob = compress_text_if_needed(new_mit)
        new_cp_text, new_cp_blob = compress_text_if_needed(new_cp)

        execute("UPDATE risks SET category=?, description=?, mitigation=?, contingency_plan=?, impact=?, likelihood=?, risk_score=?, sentiment_score=?, status=?, description_blob=?, mitigation_blob=?, contingency_plan_blob=? WHERE id=?",
                  (new_cat, new_desc_text, new_mit_text, new_cp_text, new_imp, new_lik, new_score, sentiment_score, new_risk_status, new_desc_blob, new_mit_blob, new_cp_blob, risk['id']))
                  
        if changes:
            execute("INSERT INTO risk_history (risk_id, update_date, update_text) VALUES (?,?,?)", 
                    (risk['id'], datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "; ".join(changes)))
                    
        # Clear modal state on save
        if key_prefix == "modal":
            if 'modal_edit_entity' in st.session_state:
                del st.session_state.modal_edit_entity
        st.toast(f"Risk updated!")
        st.rerun()

    st.divider()
    
    st.markdown("##### 💬 Discussion Thread")
    comment_df = query("SELECT author, timestamp, comment_text FROM comments WHERE parent_id=? AND parent_type='risk' ORDER BY timestamp ASC", (risk['id'],))
    if not comment_df.empty:
        for _, c in comment_df.iterrows():
            st.caption(f"**{c['author']}** ({c['timestamp']}):")
            st.markdown(c['comment_text'])
    else:
        st.caption("No comments yet.")
    
    new_comment = st.text_area("Add a comment:", key=f"{key_prefix}_new_comment_{risk['id']}", label_visibility="collapsed", placeholder="Type your comment...", help="Use Markdown for formatting (e.g., **bold**, _italic_).")
    if st.button("Post Comment", key=f"{key_prefix}_post_comment_{risk['id']}", use_container_width=True):
        if new_comment:
            current_user = st.session_state.get('current_user', 'Unknown')
            sentiment_score = analyze_sentiment(new_comment)['polarity']
            execute("INSERT INTO comments (parent_id, parent_type, author, comment_text, timestamp, sentiment_score) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (risk['id'], 'risk', current_user, new_comment, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), sentiment_score))
            
            all_users = query("SELECT name FROM rit_team")['name'].tolist()
            for user in all_users:
                if f"@{user}" in new_comment and user != current_user:
                    create_notifications_for_event(event_type='USER_MENTION', message=f"{current_user} mentioned you on a risk.", link="pages/07_⚠️_Risk_Log.py", direct_user=user)

            st.rerun()

    with st.expander("🕰️ Risk History & Audit Log"):
        risk_history_df = query("SELECT update_date, update_text FROM risk_history WHERE risk_id = ? ORDER BY update_date DESC", (risk['id'],))
        if not risk_history_df.empty:
            for _, h in risk_history_df.iterrows():
                st.caption(f"**{h['update_date']}**: {h['update_text']}")
        else:
            st.caption("No history recorded yet.")
    
    st.divider() 
    can_delete, reason = user_can("delete_risk", project_id=risk['project_id'])
    if st.button("🗑️ Delete Risk", key=f"{key_prefix}_nr_del_{risk['id']}", use_container_width=True, disabled=not can_delete, help=reason if not can_delete else "Delete this risk permanently."):
        execute("UPDATE risks SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (risk['id'],))
        st.toast("Risk removed.")
        st.rerun()

def render_manage_meeting_form(meeting: Dict[str, Any], additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing a meeting minute."""
    st.write(f"**Edit Meeting Minute**")
    m_key_id = meeting['id']
    pid = meeting['project_id']
    current_user = st.session_state.get('current_user', 'Unknown')
    current_user_role = st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown')

    all_attendees_options = additional_data.get("all_attendees_options", [])
    all_other_projects_df = additional_data.get("all_other_projects_df", pd.DataFrame())

    can_edit_meeting, reason = user_can("edit_meeting")
    
    u_title = st.text_input("Meeting Title", value=meeting.get('title', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_title_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    date_col, start_col, end_col = st.columns(3)
    try:
        curr_date = pd.to_datetime(meeting.get('date')).date() if pd.notna(meeting.get('date')) else None
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        curr_date = None
    u_date = date_col.date_input("Date", value=curr_date, key=f"{key_prefix}_dt_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)

    try:
        start_time_val = dparser.parse(str(meeting.get('start_time'))).time() if pd.notna(meeting.get('start_time')) else None
        end_time_val = dparser.parse(str(meeting.get('end_time'))).time() if pd.notna(meeting.get('end_time')) else None
    except (ValueError, TypeError, dparser.ParserError):
        start_time_val = None
        end_time_val = None

    u_start_time = start_col.time_input("Start Time", value=start_time_val, key=f"{key_prefix}_start_time_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    u_end_time = end_col.time_input("End Time", value=end_time_val, key=f"{key_prefix}_end_time_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)


    all_saved_attendees = [name.strip() for name in str(meeting.get('attendees', '')).split(',')] if pd.notna(meeting.get('attendees')) and meeting.get('attendees') else []
    known_attendees_default = [name for name in all_saved_attendees if name in all_attendees_options]
    other_attendees_default = [name for name in all_saved_attendees if name not in all_attendees_options]
    other_attendees_str = ", ".join(other_attendees_default)
    options_with_current = sorted(list(set(all_attendees_options + known_attendees_default)))

    st.write("**Attendees**")
    selected_edit_attendees = st.multiselect(
        "Attendees (from Directory)",
        options=options_with_current,
        default=known_attendees_default,
        key=f"{key_prefix}_attendees_dir_{m_key_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_meeting
    )
    u_other_att = st.text_input("Other Attendees (comma-separated)", value=other_attendees_str, key=f"{key_prefix}_other_at_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
