    final_attendees_list_edit = selected_edit_attendees
    if u_other_att:
        final_attendees_list_edit.extend([name.strip() for name in u_other_att.split(',') if name.strip()])
    u_att = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_attendees_list_edit))))

    st.divider()
    st.markdown("**Calendar Details**")
    cal_c1, cal_c2 = st.columns(2)
    u_location = cal_c1.text_input("Location", value=meeting.get('location', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_loc_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    u_organizer = cal_c2.text_input("Organizer", value=meeting.get('organizer', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_org_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    u_teams_url = st.text_input("Teams URL", value=meeting.get('teams_url', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_teams_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    st.divider()

    # --- FIX: Add missing text areas for meeting content ---
    u_sum = st.text_area("Executive Summary", value=decompress_text_if_needed(meeting.get('summary'), meeting.get('summary_blob')), key=f"{key_prefix}_sum_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    u_them = st.text_area("Thematic Discussion", value=decompress_text_if_needed(meeting.get('thematic'), meeting.get('thematic_blob')), key=f"{key_prefix}_them_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    u_dec = st.text_area("Decisions Made", value=decompress_text_if_needed(meeting.get('decisions'), meeting.get('decisions_blob')), key=f"{key_prefix}_dec_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    u_out = st.text_area("Strategic Outlook", value=decompress_text_if_needed(meeting.get('next_steps'), meeting.get('next_steps_blob')), key=f"{key_prefix}_out_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)


    u_consortium_notes_val = decompress_text_if_needed(meeting.get('consortium_notes'), meeting.get('consortium_notes_blob'))
    if additional_data.get("project_name") == "Foundational Readiness":
        u_consortium_notes = st.text_area("Consortium Notes", value=u_consortium_notes_val, key=f"{key_prefix}_cn_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)
    else:
        u_consortium_notes = u_consortium_notes_val

    # Add file uploader
    u_edit_files = st.file_uploader("Upload New Attachments", accept_multiple_files=True, key=f"{key_prefix}_edit_files_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_edit_meeting)

    if st.button("💾 Save Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_meeting_{m_key_id}", type="primary", disabled=not can_edit_meeting):
        previous_data_blob = json.dumps({k: (None if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and __import__('math').isnan(v)) else str(v)) for k, v in meeting.items()})

        date_to_save = str(u_date) if u_date else None
        start_datetime = datetime.combine(u_date, u_start_time).isoformat() if u_date and u_start_time else None # type: ignore
        end_datetime = datetime.combine(u_date, u_end_time).isoformat() if u_date and u_end_time else None # type: ignore

        # Compress text fields before updating
        u_sum_text, u_sum_blob = compress_text_if_needed(u_sum)
        u_them_text, u_them_blob = compress_text_if_needed(u_them)
        u_dec_text, u_dec_blob = compress_text_if_needed(u_dec)
        u_out_text, u_out_blob = compress_text_if_needed(u_out)
        u_consortium_notes_text, u_consortium_notes_blob = compress_text_if_needed(u_consortium_notes)

        execute("INSERT INTO meetings_history (meeting_id, edit_date, edited_by, previous_data) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (m_key_id, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), current_user, previous_data_blob))
        log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Meeting", current_user, current_user_role, m_key_id, details={"date": str(u_date)})
        execute("""UPDATE meetings SET title=?, date=?, attendees=?, summary=?, thematic=?, decisions=?, next_steps=?, consortium_notes=?, location=?, organizer=?, teams_url=?, start_time=?, end_time=?,
                   summary_blob=?, thematic_blob=?, decisions_blob=?, next_steps_blob=?, consortium_notes_blob=? WHERE id=?""",
                (u_title, date_to_save, u_att, u_sum_text, u_them_text, u_dec_text, u_out_text, u_consortium_notes_text, u_location, u_organizer, u_teams_url, start_datetime, end_datetime,
                 u_sum_blob, u_them_blob, u_dec_blob, u_out_blob, u_consortium_notes_blob, m_key_id))

        # Handle file uploads
        if u_edit_files:
            attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
            attachment_records = []
            for uploaded_file in u_edit_files:
                timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
                safe_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_file.name if c.isalnum() or c in " ._-")
                save_path = attachments_dir / f"{pid}_{timestamp}_{safe_name}"
                with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(uploaded_file.getbuffer())
                encrypt_file(str(save_path))
                attachment_records.append(( # type: ignore
                    m_key_id,
                    str(save_path),
                    uploaded_file.name,
                    datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                ))
            if attachment_records: # type: ignore
                execute_many("INSERT INTO meeting_attachments (meeting_id, file_path, file_name, upload_timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)", attachment_records)
                st.toast(f"Uploaded {len(attachment_records)} new file(s).")
        
        st.toast("Minute updated successfully!")
        st.rerun()

    st.divider()
    can_delete_meeting, reason = user_can("delete_meeting")
    if st.button("🗑️ Delete Minute", key=f"{key_prefix}_del_meeting_{m_key_id}", disabled=not can_delete_meeting):
        log_audit_event("SOFT_DELETE", "Meeting", current_user, current_user_role, m_key_id, details={"date": str(meeting['date'])})
        execute("UPDATE meetings SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (m_key_id,))
        st.rerun()

def render_manage_email_form(email_data: Dict[str, Any], additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing an email log."""
    import uuid
    from core.database_utils import get_attachments_dir
    from core.encryption_utils import encrypt_file
    from core.pdf_utils import generate_pdf_from_docx

    st.write(f"**Edit Email Log**")
    email_id = email_data['id']
    pid = email_data['project_id']
    current_user = st.session_state.get('current_user', 'Unknown')
    current_user_role = st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown')

    all_attendees_options = additional_data.get("all_attendees_options", [])
    
    can_edit_email, reason = user_can("edit_meeting") # Re-using permission

    edit_d1, edit_d2 = st.columns(2)
    try:
        curr_date_sent = pd.to_datetime(email_data.get('date')).date() if pd.notna(email_data.get('date')) else None
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        curr_date_sent = None
    u_date_sent = edit_d1.date_input("Date Sent", value=curr_date_sent, key=f"{key_prefix}_email_date_{email_id}", disabled=not can_edit_email)
    u_subject = edit_d2.text_input("Subject", value=email_data.get('title'), key=f"{key_prefix}_email_subj_{email_id}", disabled=not can_edit_email)

    with st.expander("Sender & Recipients"):
        u_from = render_contact_selector("From", f"{key_prefix}_email_from_{email_id}", all_attendees_options, email_data.get('email_from'), not can_edit_email)
        u_to = render_contact_selector("To", f"{key_prefix}_email_to_{email_id}", all_attendees_options, email_data.get('email_to'), not can_edit_email)
        u_cc = render_contact_selector("CC", f"{key_prefix}_email_cc_{email_id}", all_attendees_options, email_data.get('cc'), not can_edit_email)

    email_body_text_edit = decompress_text_if_needed(email_data.get('body'), email_data.get('body_blob'))
    u_body = st.text_area("Email Body", value=email_body_text_edit, height=200, key=f"{key_prefix}_email_body_{email_id}", disabled=not can_edit_email)

    st.divider()
    st.markdown("##### 🔗 Linked Projects")
    
    all_projects_df = query("SELECT p.id, o.name || ' - ' || p.name as full_name FROM projects p JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id WHERE p.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY o.name, p.name")
    project_map = dict(zip(all_projects_df['id'], all_projects_df['full_name']))
    project_options = list(project_map.keys())

    thread_group_id = email_data.get('thread_group_id')
    if thread_group_id:
        linked_projects_df = query("SELECT project_id FROM emails WHERE thread_group_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (thread_group_id,))
        default_project_ids = linked_projects_df['project_id'].tolist()
    else:
        default_project_ids = [pid]

    selected_project_ids = st.multiselect(
        "Select one or more projects to see this email in",
        options=project_options,
        format_func=lambda x: project_map.get(x, "Unknown Project"),
        default=default_project_ids,
        key=f"{key_prefix}_email_projects_{email_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_email
    )

    # Fetch current affected trusts
    curr_affected_raw = email_data.get('affected_trusts')
    default_trusts = []
    if curr_affected_raw:
        try:
            import json
            default_trusts = json.loads(curr_affected_raw)
            if not isinstance(default_trusts, list):
                default_trusts = []
        except Exception:
            pass

    df_orgs = query("SELECT name FROM orgs ORDER BY name")
    all_org_names = df_orgs['name'].tolist()

    selected_trusts = st.multiselect(
        "Select affected trusts",
        options=all_org_names,
        default=default_trusts,
        help="Select which NHS trusts/organisations are affected by this email interaction.",
        key=f"{key_prefix}_email_trusts_{email_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_email
    )

    st.divider()
    st.markdown("##### 🎯 Strategic Analysis")

    u_influence = st.select_slider(
        "Sender Influence",
        options=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
        value=int(email_data.get('influence_level') or 3),
        key=f"{key_prefix}_email_influence_{email_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_email
    )
    
    u_email_files = st.file_uploader(
        "Upload Attachments", 
        key=f"{key_prefix}_email_file_{email_id}", 
        disabled=not can_edit_email, 
        accept_multiple_files=True
    )

    if st.button("💾 Save Email Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_email_{email_id}", type="primary", disabled=not can_edit_email):
        original_project_ids = set(default_project_ids)
        new_project_ids = set(selected_project_ids)

        projects_to_add = new_project_ids - original_project_ids
        projects_to_remove = original_project_ids - new_project_ids

        # Ensure a thread_group_id exists
        thread_group_id = email_data.get('thread_group_id')
        if not thread_group_id:
            thread_group_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
            execute("UPDATE emails SET thread_group_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (thread_group_id, email_id))
        
        u_body_text, u_body_blob = compress_text_if_needed(u_body)
        new_sentiment = analyze_sentiment(u_body)['polarity'] if u_body != email_body_text_edit else email_data.get('sentiment_score', 0.0)
        date_to_save = str(u_date_sent) if u_date_sent else None
        import json
        affected_trusts_json = json.dumps(selected_trusts) if selected_trusts else None

        # Handle additions
        if projects_to_add:
            records_to_insert = []
            for project_id_to_add in projects_to_add:
                records_to_insert.append((
                    project_id_to_add, u_from, u_to, u_cc, u_subject, u_body_text, date_to_save, new_sentiment, u_influence, thread_group_id, u_body_blob, affected_trusts_json
                ))
            if records_to_insert:
                execute_many(
                    """INSERT INTO emails (project_id, email_from, email_to, cc, subject, body, date_sent, sentiment_score, influence_level, thread_group_id, body_blob, affected_trusts)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                    records_to_insert
                )

        # Handle removals
        if projects_to_remove:
            placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(projects_to_remove))
            execute(
                f"UPDATE emails SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE thread_group_id = ? AND project_id IN ({placeholders})",
                (thread_group_id, *list(projects_to_remove))
            )

        # Update all linked emails
        execute("""
            UPDATE emails SET
            date_sent=?, subject=?, email_from=?, email_to=?, cc=?, body=?, body_blob=?,
            influence_level=?, sentiment_score=?, affected_trusts=?
            WHERE thread_group_id=? AND is_deleted = 0
        """, (
            date_to_save, u_subject, u_from, u_to, u_cc, u_body_text, u_body_blob,
            u_influence, new_sentiment, affected_trusts_json, thread_group_id
        ))

        # Handle file upload on edit
        if u_email_files:
            attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
            attachment_records = []
            for uploaded_file in u_email_files:
                timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
                safe_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_file.name if c.isalnum() or c in " ._-")
                save_path = attachments_dir / f"email_{email_id}_{timestamp}_{safe_name}"
                with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(uploaded_file.getbuffer())
                encrypt_file(str(save_path))

                pdf_path_to_save = None
                if uploaded_file.name.lower().endswith('.docx'):
                    try:
                        pdf_bytes = generate_pdf_from_docx(str(save_path))
                        pdf_save_path = save_path.with_suffix('.pdf')
                        with open(pdf_save_path, "wb") as f:
                            f.write(pdf_bytes)
                        encrypt_file(str(pdf_save_path))
                        pdf_path_to_save = str(pdf_save_path)
                    except Exception as e:
                        st.warning(f"Could not generate PDF version of document: {e}")

                attachment_records.append((email_id, str(save_path), uploaded_file.name, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), pdf_path_to_save))
            
            if attachment_records:
                execute_many("INSERT INTO email_attachments (email_id, file_path, file_name, upload_timestamp, pdf_file_path) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", attachment_records)

        log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Email", current_user, current_user_role, email_id, details={"subject": u_subject, "linked_projects": list(new_project_ids)})
        st.toast("Email log updated across all linked projects!")
        st.rerun()

    st.divider()
    can_delete_email, reason = user_can("delete_meeting") # Re-using permission
    if st.button("🗑️ Delete Email Log", key=f"{key_prefix}_del_email_{email_id}", disabled=not can_delete_email):
        log_audit_event("SOFT_DELETE", "Email", current_user, current_user_role, email_id, details={"subject": email_data.get('title')})
        execute("UPDATE emails SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (email_id,))
        st.rerun()

def render_manage_email_reply_form(reply_data: Dict[str, Any], additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing an email thread reply."""
    from core.database_utils import get_attachments_dir
    from core.encryption_utils import encrypt_file, decrypt_file
    import os

    st.write(f"**Edit Email Reply**")
    reply_id = reply_data.get('id')
    email_id = reply_data.get('email_id')
    if reply_id and not email_id:
        email_id_row = fetch_one("SELECT email_id FROM email_thread WHERE id = ?", (reply_id,))
        email_id = email_id_row[0] if email_id_row else None
    
    can_edit_reply, reason = user_can("edit_meeting") # Re-using same edit permission

    all_attendees_options = additional_data.get("all_attendees_options", [])
    
    # Author input
    author_val = reply_data.get('author', 'Me')
    author_options = ["Me"] + all_attendees_options + ["Other (Outside Project)..."]
    
    if author_val == "Me":
        default_idx = 0
    elif author_val in all_attendees_options:
        default_idx = author_options.index(author_val)
    else:
        default_idx = len(author_options) - 1 # Other (Outside Project)...
    
    reply_author_input = st.selectbox(
        "Author of this reply", 
        author_options, 
        index=default_idx, 
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_author_sel_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )
    
    if reply_author_input == "Other (Outside Project)...":
        reply_author_name = st.text_input(
            "Sender Name", 
            value="" if author_val == "Me" or author_val in all_attendees_options else author_val, 
            key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_author_txt_{reply_id}",
            disabled=not can_edit_reply
        )
    else:
        reply_author_name = reply_author_input

    # Recipients (To and CC)
    to_val = reply_data.get('to_recipients') or ""
    parsed_to_list = [p.strip() for p in to_val.split(',') if p.strip()]
    
    cc_val = reply_data.get('cc_recipients') or ""
    parsed_cc_list = [p.strip() for p in cc_val.split(',') if p.strip()]

    default_to_list = [p for p in parsed_to_list if p in all_attendees_options]
    default_other_to_list = [p for p in parsed_to_list if p not in all_attendees_options]
    default_other_to = ", ".join(default_other_to_list)

    default_cc_list = [p for p in parsed_cc_list if p in all_attendees_options]
    default_other_cc_list = [p for p in parsed_cc_list if p not in all_attendees_options]
    default_other_cc = ", ".join(default_other_cc_list)

    reply_to_list = st.multiselect(
        "To (Project Contacts)", 
        options=all_attendees_options, 
        default=default_to_list,
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_to_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )

    reply_other_to = st.text_input(
        "To (Other / External)",
        value=default_other_to,
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_other_to_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )
    
    reply_cc_list = st.multiselect(
        "CC (Project Contacts)", 
        options=all_attendees_options, 
        default=default_cc_list,
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_cc_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )

    reply_other_cc = st.text_input(
        "CC (Other / External)",
        value=default_other_cc,
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_other_cc_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )

    # Date of reply
    reply_date_col, reply_time_col = st.columns(2)
    try:
        parsed_dt = pd.to_datetime(reply_data.get('date')) if pd.notna(reply_data.get('date')) else datetime.now()
        curr_reply_date = parsed_dt.date()
        curr_reply_time = parsed_dt.time()
    except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        curr_reply_date = datetime.now().date()
        curr_reply_time = datetime.now().time()

    reply_date = reply_date_col.date_input(
        "Date of Reply", 
        value=curr_reply_date, 
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_date_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )
    reply_time = reply_time_col.time_input(
        "Time of Reply",
        value=curr_reply_time,
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_time_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )

    # Reply Body
    reply_body_text_edit = decompress_text_if_needed(reply_data.get('body'), reply_data.get('body_blob'))
    reply_body = st.text_area(
        "Reply Body", 
        value=reply_body_text_edit, 
        height=150, 
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_body_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )

    curr_affected_raw = reply_data.get('affected_trusts')
    default_trusts = []
    if curr_affected_raw:
        try:
            import json
            default_trusts = json.loads(curr_affected_raw)
            if not isinstance(default_trusts, list):
                default_trusts = []
        except Exception:
            pass

    df_orgs = query("SELECT name FROM orgs ORDER BY name")
    all_org_names = df_orgs['name'].tolist()

    selected_trusts = st.multiselect(
        "Select affected trusts",
        options=all_org_names,
        default=default_trusts,
        help="Select which NHS trusts/organisations are affected by this email reply.",
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_trusts_{reply_id}",
        disabled=not can_edit_reply
    )

    # Attachments list & delete
    reply_attachments = query("SELECT * FROM generic_attachments WHERE entity_type = 'email_thread' AND entity_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (reply_id,))
    if not reply_attachments.empty:
        st.write("**Existing Attachments**")
        for _, att_row in reply_attachments.iterrows():
            c_att, c_del_att = st.columns([0.8, 0.2])
            with c_att:
                if att_row.get('file_path') and os.path.exists(att_row['file_path']):
                    st.download_button(
                        f"📎 {att_row['original_filename']}", 
                        data=decrypt_file(att_row['file_path']), 
                        file_name=att_row['original_filename'], 
                        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_dl_att_{att_row['id']}", 
                        use_container_width=True
                    )
            with c_del_att:
                if user_can("delete_attachment"):
                    if st.button("🗑️", key=f"{key_prefix}_del_reply_att_btn_{att_row['id']}", help="Delete attachment"):
                        execute("UPDATE generic_attachments SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (att_row['id'],))
                        log_audit_event("SOFT_DELETE", "GenericAttachment", st.session_state.get('current_user', 'System'), st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown'), att_row['id'], details={"file_name": att_row['original_filename'], "entity_type": "email_thread", "entity_id": reply_id})
                        st.success(f"Attachment {att_row['original_filename']} deleted.")
                        st.rerun()

    # File Upload for new attachments
    reply_uploaded_files = st.file_uploader(
        "Upload Attachments", 
        key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_uploader_{reply_id}", 
        disabled=not can_edit_reply, 
        accept_multiple_files=True
    )

    c_save, c_del = st.columns([0.5, 0.5])
    with c_save:
        if st.button("💾 Save Reply Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_reply_{reply_id}", type="primary", disabled=not can_edit_reply):
            if reply_body and reply_author_name:
                reply_body_text, reply_body_blob = compress_text_if_needed(reply_body)
                reply_sentiment = analyze_sentiment(reply_body)['polarity'] if reply_body != reply_body_text_edit else reply_data.get('sentiment_score', 0.0)

                final_to_list = reply_to_list + ([reply_other_to.strip()] if reply_other_to.strip() else [])
                final_cc_list = reply_cc_list + ([reply_other_cc.strip()] if reply_other_cc.strip() else [])
                final_to_str = ", ".join(final_to_list)
                final_cc_str = ", ".join(final_cc_list)

                # Combine date and time
                reply_datetime = datetime.combine(reply_date, reply_time)
                reply_datetime_str = reply_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                import json
                affected_trusts_json = json.dumps(selected_trusts) if selected_trusts else None

                execute("""
                    UPDATE email_thread SET
                    author=?, date=?, body=?, body_blob=?, to_recipients=?, cc_recipients=?, sentiment_score=?, affected_trusts=?
                    WHERE id=?
                """, (
                    reply_author_name, reply_datetime_str, reply_body_text, reply_body_blob,
                    final_to_str, final_cc_str, reply_sentiment, affected_trusts_json, reply_id
                ))

                # Handle new files
                if reply_uploaded_files:
                    attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                    attachment_records = []
                    app_state = get_app_state()
                    user_id = app_state.user.current_user_id
                    current_time = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

                    for uploaded_file in reply_uploaded_files:
                        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
                        safe_original_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_file.name if c.isalnum() or c in ('.', '_')).rstrip()
                        unique_filename = f"attachment_reply_{reply_id}_{timestamp}_{safe_original_name}"
                        file_path = attachments_dir / unique_filename

                        with open(file_path, "wb") as f:
                            f.write(uploaded_file.getvalue())
                        encrypt_file(str(file_path))

                        attachment_records.append((
                            'email_thread',
                            reply_id,
                            str(file_path),
                            uploaded_file.name,
                            user_id,
                            current_time
                        ))
                    
                    if attachment_records:
                        execute_many(
                            """INSERT INTO generic_attachments (entity_type, entity_id, file_path, original_filename, uploaded_by_id, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                            attachment_records
                        )

                log_audit_event("UPDATE", "EmailReply", st.session_state.get('current_user', 'System'), st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown'), reply_id, details={"email_id": email_id})
                st.success("Reply updated successfully!")
                st.rerun()

    with c_del:
        if st.button("🗑️ Delete Reply", key=f"{key_prefix}_delete_reply_{reply_id}", type="secondary", disabled=not can_edit_reply):
            execute("UPDATE email_thread SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (reply_id,))
            log_audit_event("SOFT_DELETE", "EmailReply", st.session_state.get('current_user', 'System'), st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown'), reply_id, details={"email_id": email_id})
            st.warning("Reply deleted.")
            st.rerun()

def extract_only_new_reply(body_text: str) -> str:
    """Extracts only the latest reply from an email body, removing the previous thread/history."""
    if not body_text:
        return ""
    
    # Common delimiters to split on (as patterns)
    delimiters = [
        r"(?i)-+\s*original\s*message\s*-+",
        r"________________________________+",
        r"(?i)^\s*from:\s+.*",
        r"(?i)^\s*on\s+.*\s+wrote:",
        r"(?i)^\s*on\s+.*\s+write:",
        r"(?i)^\s*sent\s+from\s+my\s+iphone",
        r"(?i)^\s*sent\s+from\s+my\s+ipad",
        r"(?i)^\s*sent\s+from\s+outlook",
        r"(?i)^\s*sent\s+from\s+mail"
    ]
    
    lines = body_text.splitlines()
    cleaned_lines = []
    
    for line in lines:
        matched = False
        for pattern in delimiters:
            if re.search(pattern, line):
                matched = True
                break
        if matched:
            break
        
        # Stop if we hit a blockquote indicator (line starting with >)
        if line.strip().startswith('>'):
            break
            
        cleaned_lines.append(line)
        
    return "\n".join(cleaned_lines).strip()

def render_add_email_reply_form(email_id: int, additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for adding a reply to an email thread."""
    from core.database_utils import get_attachments_dir
    from core.encryption_utils import encrypt_file
    import os
    import uuid
    import extract_msg  # type: ignore
    import email
    from email import policy
    import dateutil.parser as parser

    st.write(f"**Add Reply to Thread**")

    # Fetch parent email's affected trusts to use as default
    parent_email_row = fetch_one("SELECT affected_trusts FROM emails WHERE id = ?", (email_id,))
    parent_trusts = []
    if parent_email_row and parent_email_row[0]:
        try:
            import json
            parent_trusts = json.loads(parent_email_row[0])
            if not isinstance(parent_trusts, list):
                parent_trusts = []
        except Exception:
            pass

    df_orgs = query("SELECT name FROM orgs ORDER BY name")
    all_org_names = df_orgs['name'].tolist()
    
    can_add_reply, reason = user_can("edit_meeting") # Re-using same edit permission

    if not can_add_reply:
        st.warning(reason)
        return

    all_attendees_options = additional_data.get("all_attendees_options", [])

    tab_import, tab_manual = st.tabs(["📤 Import Outlook File", "✍️ Manually Log Reply"])

    with tab_import:
        uploaded_email = st.file_uploader("Drop Outlook (.msg or .eml) file here to parse reply details", type=["msg", "eml"], key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_uploader_{email_id}")
        if uploaded_email:
            e_body = ""
            e_from = ""
            e_to = ""
            e_cc = ""
            e_date = datetime.now()
            internal_attachments = []

            try:
                if uploaded_email.name.endswith('.msg'):
                    msg = extract_msg.Message(uploaded_email)
                    e_body = msg.body
                    e_from = msg.sender
                    if hasattr(msg, 'attachments') and msg.attachments:
                        for attachment in msg.attachments:
                            if hasattr(attachment, 'data') and attachment.longFilename:
                                internal_attachments.append({'filename': attachment.longFilename, 'data': attachment.data})
                    e_to = msg.to
                    e_cc = msg.cc
                    try:
                        e_date = parser.parse(str(msg.date), default=datetime.now())
                    except Exception:
                        e_date = datetime.now()
                else:
                    bytes_data = uploaded_email.read()
                    msg = email.message_from_bytes(bytes_data, policy=policy.default)
                    e_from = msg['from']
                    e_to = msg['to']
                    e_cc = msg.get('cc', '')
                    try:
                        raw_date = msg.get('date')
                        e_date = parser.parse(str(raw_date), default=datetime.now())
                    except Exception:
                        e_date = datetime.now()

                    if msg.is_multipart():
                        for part in msg.walk():
                            if part.get_content_type() == "text/plain":
                                if e_body == "":
                                    e_body = part.get_payload(decode=True).decode(errors="replace")
                            elif part.get_content_maintype() != 'multipart' and part.get('Content-Disposition') is not None:
                                filename = part.get_filename()
                                if filename:
                                    internal_attachments.append({'filename': filename, 'data': part.get_payload(decode=True)})
                    else:
                        e_body = msg.get_payload(decode=True).decode(errors="replace")

                # --- Thread splitting logic ---
                import hashlib
                try:
                    file_bytes = uploaded_email.getvalue()
                    file_hash = hashlib.sha256(file_bytes).hexdigest()
                except Exception:
                    file_hash = uploaded_email.name + str(uploaded_email.size)

                if st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_file_hash_{email_id}") != file_hash:
                    st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_reply_file_hash_{email_id}"] = file_hash
                    st.session_state.pop(f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}", None)

                if f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}" not in st.session_state:
                    from core.ai_utils import split_email_thread
                    thread_messages = split_email_thread(e_body) if e_body else []
                    t_msgs = []
                    if thread_messages:
                        for tm in thread_messages:
                            t_msgs.append({
                                "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                                "from": tm.get("from", ""),
                                "to": tm.get("to", ""),
                                "cc": tm.get("cc", ""),
                                "date": tm.get("date", e_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")),
                                "body": tm.get("body", "")
                            })
                    else:
                        t_msgs.append({
                            "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                            "from": e_from,
                            "to": e_to,
                            "cc": e_cc,
                            "date": e_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                            "body": e_body or ""
                        })
                    st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}"] = t_msgs

                msgs = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}", [])
                split_thread = st.checkbox(
                    "Split thread into individual messages (recommended)",
                    value=len(msgs) > 1,
                    key=f"{key_prefix}_split_thread_toggle_{email_id}"
                )

                # ── SPLIT MODE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
                if split_thread:
                    with st.form(f"{key_prefix}_reply_import_form_{email_id}_split"):
                        st.markdown("**Edit messages to import** *(oldest first)*")
                        
                        for i, msg in enumerate(msgs):
                            role_label = f"Reply Message {i+1}"
                            with st.container(border=True):
                                st.markdown(f"**{role_label}**")
                                
                                try:
                                    dt = parser.parse(msg.get("date", ""))
                                except Exception:
                                    dt = datetime.now()
                                    
                                col1, col2 = st.columns(2)
                                msg_d = col1.date_input(f"Date", value=dt.date(), format="DD/MM/YYYY", key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_d")
                                msg_t = col2.time_input(f"Time", value=dt.time(), key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_t")
                                
                                # Contact selectors for From, To, CC
                                msg_from = render_contact_selector("From", f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_from", all_attendees_options, default_value=msg.get("from", ""))
                                msg_to = render_contact_selector("To", f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_to", all_attendees_options, default_value=msg.get("to", ""))
                                msg_cc = render_contact_selector("CC", f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_cc", all_attendees_options, default_value=msg.get("cc", ""))
                                
                                # Quick Contact Actions
                                st.caption("⚡ **Quick Contact Actions:**")
                                c_act1, c_act2, c_act3, c_act4, c_act5 = st.columns(5)
                                msg_key_pfx = f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}"
                                
                                if c_act1.form_submit_button("🔄 Swap From/To", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_swap", use_container_width=True):
                                    handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "swap_from_to")
                                    st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                                    st.rerun()
                                if c_act2.form_submit_button("➡️ From to To", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_f_to_t", use_container_width=True):
                                    handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_from_to")
                                    st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                                    st.rerun()
                                if c_act3.form_submit_button("➡️ To to From", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_t_to_f", use_container_width=True):
                                    handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_to_from")
                                    st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                                    st.rerun()
                                if c_act4.form_submit_button("➡️ To to CC", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_t_to_cc", use_container_width=True):
                                    handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_to_cc")
                                    st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                                    st.rerun()
                                if c_act5.form_submit_button("➡️ CC to To", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_cc_to_t", use_container_width=True):
                                    handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_cc_to_to")
                                    st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                                    st.rerun()
                                
                                msg_body = st.text_area(f"Body", value=msg.get("body", ""), height=120, key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_body")
                                
                                if len(msgs) > 1:
                                    if st.form_submit_button(f"🗑️ Delete Message {i+1}", key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_del_{msg['id']}"):
                                        st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}"] = [m for m in msgs if m['id'] != msg['id']]
                                        for suffix in ['from_multiselect', 'from_other', 'date_d', 'date_t', 'to_multiselect', 'to_other', 'cc_multiselect', 'cc_other', 'body']:
                                            st.session_state.pop(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_{suffix}", None)
                                        st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                                        st.rerun()

                        if st.form_submit_button("➕ Add Message / Reply"):
                            msgs = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}", [])
                            last_msg = msgs[-1] if msgs else None
                            
                            new_from = ""
                            new_to = ""
                            new_cc = ""
                            new_date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                            
                            if last_msg:
                                from_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_from_multiselect", [])
                                from_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_from_other", "")
                                final_from_list = list(from_sel)
                                if from_oth:
                                    final_from_list.extend([name.strip() for name in from_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                                last_from = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_from_list))))

                                cc_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_cc_multiselect", [])
                                cc_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_cc_other", "")
                                final_cc_list = list(cc_sel)
                                if cc_oth:
                                    final_cc_list.extend([name.strip() for name in cc_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                                last_cc = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_cc_list))))

                                date_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_date_d")
                                time_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_date_t")
                                if date_val and time_val:
                                    new_date_str = datetime.combine(date_val, time_val).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                                
                                new_to = last_from
                                new_cc = last_cc

                            st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}"].append({
                                "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                                "from": new_from,
                                "to": new_to,
                                "cc": new_cc,
                                "date": new_date_str,
                                "body": ""
                            })
                            st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                            st.rerun()

                        selected_trusts = st.multiselect(
                            "Select affected trusts",
                            options=all_org_names,
                            default=parent_trusts,
                            help="Select NHS trusts/organisations affected by this reply thread.",
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_reply_import_split_trusts_{email_id}"
                        )

                        if st.form_submit_button("💾 Import Messages", type="primary", disabled=not can_add_reply):
                            # Reconstruct from keys
                            updated_replies = []
                            for msg in st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}", []):
                                # Combine From
                                from_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_from_multiselect", [])
                                from_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_from_other", "")
                                final_from_list = list(from_sel)
                                if from_oth:
                                    final_from_list.extend([name.strip() for name in from_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                                final_from = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_from_list))))

                                # Combine To
                                to_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_to_multiselect", [])
                                to_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_to_other", "")
                                final_to_list = list(to_sel)
                                if to_oth:
                                    final_to_list.extend([name.strip() for name in to_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                                final_to = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_to_list))))

                                # Combine CC
                                cc_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_cc_multiselect", [])
                                cc_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_cc_other", "")
                                final_cc_list = list(cc_sel)
                                if cc_oth:
                                    final_cc_list.extend([name.strip() for name in cc_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                                final_cc = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_cc_list))))

                                # Combine Date and Time
                                date_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_d")
                                time_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_t")
                                if date_val and time_val:
                                    msg_datetime = datetime.combine(date_val, time_val)
                                    msg_date_str = msg_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                                else:
                                    msg_date_str = msg.get("date", "")

                                updated_replies.append({
                                    "from": final_from,
                                    "to": final_to,
                                    "cc": final_cc,
                                    "date": msg_date_str,
                                    "body": st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_body", msg.get("body", ""))
                                })
                                
                            attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                            app_state = get_app_state()
                            user_id = app_state.user.current_user_id
                            current_time = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                            last_reply_id = None
                            import json
                            affected_trusts_json = json.dumps(selected_trusts) if selected_trusts else None
                            
                            for reply in updated_replies:
                                reply_body = reply.get('body', '')
                                reply_body_text, reply_body_blob = compress_text_if_needed(reply_body)
                                reply_sentiment = analyze_sentiment(reply_body)['polarity']
                                
                                last_reply_id = execute("""
                                    INSERT INTO email_thread (email_id, author, date, body, to_recipients, cc_recipients, sentiment_score, body_blob, affected_trusts)
                                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                                """, (
                                    email_id, reply.get('from', 'Unknown'), str(reply.get('date', '')), reply_body_text,
                                    reply.get('to', ''), reply.get('cc', ''), reply_sentiment, reply_body_blob, affected_trusts_json
                                ), return_lastrowid=True)
                                
                                log_audit_event("CREATE", "EmailReply", st.session_state.get('current_user', 'System'), st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown'), last_reply_id, details={"email_id": email_id, "source": "ThreadSplitManual"})
                                
                            # Attach the uploaded email file + internal attachments to the last inserted reply
                            if last_reply_id:
                                attachment_records = []
                                timestamp_up = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
                                safe_up_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_email.name if c.isalnum() or c in ('.', '_')).rstrip()
                                up_file_path = attachments_dir / f"attachment_reply_{last_reply_id}_{timestamp_up}_{safe_up_name}"
                                with open(up_file_path, "wb") as f:
                                    f.write(uploaded_email.getvalue())
                                encrypt_file(str(up_file_path))
                                attachment_records.append(('email_thread', last_reply_id, str(up_file_path), uploaded_email.name, user_id, current_time))
                                
                                for attachment in internal_attachments:
                                    timestamp_int = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
                                    safe_int_name = "".join(c for c in attachment['filename'] if c.isalnum() or c in ('.', '_')).rstrip()
                                    int_file_path = attachments_dir / f"attachment_reply_{last_reply_id}_{timestamp_int}_{safe_int_name}"
                                    with open(int_file_path, "wb") as f:
                                        f.write(attachment['data'])
                                    encrypt_file(str(int_file_path))
                                    attachment_records.append(('email_thread', last_reply_id, str(int_file_path), attachment['filename'], user_id, current_time))
                                    
                                if attachment_records:
                                    execute_many(
                                        """INSERT INTO generic_attachments (entity_type, entity_id, file_path, original_filename, uploaded_by_id, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                                        attachment_records
                                    )
                            
                            if f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}" in st.session_state:
                                del st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_reply_thread_msgs_{email_id}"]
                                
                            st.success(f"✅ {len(updated_replies)} message(s) imported successfully!")
                            st.rerun()

                # ── SINGLE REPLY MODE (no thread / split disabled) ─────────
                else:
                    is_thread = len(msgs) > 1
                    e_body_single = msgs[-1].get("body", "") if (is_thread and msgs) else extract_only_new_reply(e_body)
                    sentiment_data = analyze_sentiment(str(e_body_single or ""))
                    sentiment = sentiment_data["polarity"]
                    vibe = "Supportive / Positive" if sentiment > 0.1 else "Hostile / Concerning" if sentiment < -0.1 else "Neutral / Matter-of-fact"
                    st.markdown(f"**Detected Tone:** {vibe} (Polarity: {round(sentiment, 2)})")

                    with st.form(f"{key_prefix}_reply_import_form_{email_id}"):
                        from email.utils import getaddresses
                        def clean_recipients(recipient_str):
                            return [name for name, email in getaddresses([str(recipient_str)]) if name and '@' not in name]

                        parsed_from_list = clean_recipients(e_from)
                        parsed_to_list = clean_recipients(e_to)
                        parsed_cc_list = clean_recipients(e_cc)

                        author_options = ["Me"] + all_attendees_options + ["Other (Outside Project)..."]
                        parsed_from_name = parsed_from_list[0] if parsed_from_list else ""
                        default_author_index = all_attendees_options.index(parsed_from_name) + 1 if parsed_from_name in all_attendees_options else (len(author_options) - 1 if parsed_from_name else 0)

                        reply_author_input = st.selectbox(
                            "Author of this reply",
                            author_options,
                            index=default_author_index,
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_author_sel_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )
                        if reply_author_input == "Other (Outside Project)...":
                            reply_author_name = st.text_input(
                                "Sender Name",
                                value=parsed_from_name,
                                key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_author_txt_{email_id}",
                                disabled=not can_add_reply
                            )
                        else:
                            reply_author_name = reply_author_input

                        reply_to_list = st.multiselect(
                            "To (Project Contacts)",
                            options=all_attendees_options,
                            default=[p for p in parsed_to_list if p in all_attendees_options],
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_to_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )
                        other_to_vals = [p for p in parsed_to_list if p not in all_attendees_options]
                        reply_other_to = st.text_input(
                            "To (Other / External)",
                            value=", ".join(other_to_vals),
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_other_to_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )
                        reply_cc_list = st.multiselect(
                            "CC (Project Contacts)",
                            options=all_attendees_options,
                            default=[p for p in parsed_cc_list if p in all_attendees_options],
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_cc_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )
                        other_cc_vals = [p for p in parsed_cc_list if p not in all_attendees_options]
                        reply_other_cc = st.text_input(
                            "CC (Other / External)",
                            value=", ".join(other_cc_vals),
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_other_cc_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )
                        reply_date_col, reply_time_col = st.columns(2)
                        reply_date = reply_date_col.date_input(
                            "Date of Reply",
                            value=e_date.date(),
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_date_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )
                        reply_time = reply_time_col.time_input(
                            "Time of Reply",
                            value=e_date.time(),
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_time_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )
                        reply_body = st.text_area(
                            "Reply Body",
                            value=str(e_body_single or ""),
                            height=150,
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_body_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )

                        selected_trusts = st.multiselect(
                            "Select affected trusts",
                            options=all_org_names,
                            default=parent_trusts,
                            help="Select NHS trusts/organisations affected by this reply.",
                            key=f"{key_prefix}_imp_reply_trusts_{email_id}",
                            disabled=not can_add_reply
                        )

                        if st.form_submit_button("💾 Import Reply", type="primary", disabled=not can_add_reply):
                            if reply_body and reply_author_name:
                                reply_body_text, reply_body_blob = compress_text_if_needed(reply_body)
                                reply_sentiment = analyze_sentiment(reply_body)['polarity']
                                final_to_str = ", ".join(reply_to_list + ([reply_other_to.strip()] if reply_other_to.strip() else []))
                                final_cc_str = ", ".join(reply_cc_list + ([reply_other_cc.strip()] if reply_other_cc.strip() else []))

                                reply_datetime = datetime.combine(reply_date, reply_time)
                                reply_datetime_str = reply_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                                import json
                                affected_trusts_json = json.dumps(selected_trusts) if selected_trusts else None

                                new_reply_id = execute("""
                                    INSERT INTO email_thread (email_id, author, date, body, to_recipients, cc_recipients, sentiment_score, body_blob, affected_trusts)
                                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                                """, (
                                    email_id, reply_author_name, reply_datetime_str, reply_body_text,
                                    final_to_str, final_cc_str, reply_sentiment, reply_body_blob, affected_trusts_json
                                ), return_lastrowid=True)

                                attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                                attachment_records = []
                                app_state = get_app_state()
                                user_id = app_state.user.current_user_id
                                current_time = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

                                timestamp_up = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
                                safe_up_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_email.name if c.isalnum() or c in ('.', '_')).rstrip()
                                up_file_path = attachments_dir / f"attachment_reply_{new_reply_id}_{timestamp_up}_{safe_up_name}"
                                with open(up_file_path, "wb") as f:
                                    f.write(uploaded_email.getvalue())
                                encrypt_file(str(up_file_path))
                                attachment_records.append(('email_thread', new_reply_id, str(up_file_path), uploaded_email.name, user_id, current_time))

                                for attachment in internal_attachments:
                                    timestamp_int = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
                                    safe_int_name = "".join(c for c in attachment['filename'] if c.isalnum() or c in ('.', '_')).rstrip()
                                    int_file_path = attachments_dir / f"attachment_reply_{new_reply_id}_{timestamp_int}_{safe_int_name}"
                                    with open(int_file_path, "wb") as f:
                                        f.write(attachment['data'])
                                    encrypt_file(str(int_file_path))
                                    attachment_records.append(('email_thread', new_reply_id, str(int_file_path), attachment['filename'], user_id, current_time))

                                if attachment_records:
                            # duplicate if removed
                                    execute_many(
                                        """INSERT INTO generic_attachments (entity_type, entity_id, file_path, original_filename, uploaded_by_id, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                                        attachment_records
                                    )

                                log_audit_event("CREATE", "EmailReply", st.session_state.get('current_user', 'System'), st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown'), new_reply_id, details={"email_id": email_id, "source": "Import"})
                                st.success("Reply imported successfully!")
                                st.rerun()
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"Parsing error: {e}")

    with tab_manual:
        if f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}" not in st.session_state:
            st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}"] = [{
                "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                "from": "Me",
                "to": "",
                "cc": "",
                "date": datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "body": ""
            }]

        with st.form(f"{key_prefix}_reply_manual_form_{email_id}"):
            msgs = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}", [])
            for i, msg in enumerate(msgs):
                role_label = f"Reply Message {i+1}"
                with st.container(border=True):
                    st.markdown(f"**{role_label}**")
                    
                    try:
                        dt = parser.parse(msg.get("date", ""))
                    except Exception:
                        dt = datetime.now()
                        
                    col1, col2 = st.columns(2)
                    msg_d = col1.date_input(f"Date Sent", value=dt.date(), format="DD/MM/YYYY", key=f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_d")
                    msg_t = col2.time_input(f"Time Sent", value=dt.time(), key=f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_t")
                    
                    # Contact selectors for From, To, CC
                    msg_from = render_contact_selector("From", f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_from", all_attendees_options, default_value=msg.get("from", ""))
                    msg_to = render_contact_selector("To", f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_to", all_attendees_options, default_value=msg.get("to", ""))
                    msg_cc = render_contact_selector("CC", f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_cc", all_attendees_options, default_value=msg.get("cc", ""))
                    
                    # Quick Contact Actions
                    st.caption("⚡ **Quick Contact Actions:**")
                    c_act1, c_act2, c_act3, c_act4, c_act5 = st.columns(5)
                    msg_key_pfx = f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}"
                    
                    if c_act1.form_submit_button("🔄 Swap From/To", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_swap", use_container_width=True):
                        handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "swap_from_to")
                        st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                        st.rerun()
                    if c_act2.form_submit_button("➡️ From to To", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_f_to_t", use_container_width=True):
                        handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_from_to")
                        st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                        st.rerun()
                    if c_act3.form_submit_button("➡️ To to From", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_t_to_f", use_container_width=True):
                        handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_to_from")
                        st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                        st.rerun()
                    if c_act4.form_submit_button("➡️ To to CC", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_t_to_cc", use_container_width=True):
                        handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_to_cc")
                        st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                        st.rerun()
                    if c_act5.form_submit_button("➡️ CC to To", key=f"{msg_key_pfx}_cc_to_t", use_container_width=True):
                        handle_contact_transfer(msg_key_pfx, "move_cc_to_to")
                        st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                        st.rerun()
                    
                    msg_body = st.text_area(f"Body", value=msg.get("body", ""), height=120, key=f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_body")
                    
                    if len(msgs) > 1:
                        if st.form_submit_button(f"🗑️ Delete Message {i+1}", key=f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_del_{msg['id']}"):
                            st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}"] = [m for m in msgs if m['id'] != msg['id']]
                            for suffix in ['from_multiselect', 'from_other', 'date_d', 'date_t', 'to_multiselect', 'to_other', 'cc_multiselect', 'cc_other', 'body']:
                                st.session_state.pop(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_{suffix}", None)
                            st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                            st.rerun()

            if st.form_submit_button("➕ Add Message / Reply"):
                msgs = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}", [])
                last_msg = msgs[-1] if msgs else None
                
                new_from = ""
                new_to = ""
                new_cc = ""
                new_date_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                
                if last_msg:
                    from_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_from_multiselect", [])
                    from_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_from_other", "")
                    final_from_list = list(from_sel)
                    if from_oth:
                        final_from_list.extend([name.strip() for name in from_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                    last_from = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_from_list))))

                    cc_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_cc_multiselect", [])
                    cc_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_cc_other", "")
                    final_cc_list = list(cc_sel)
                    if cc_oth:
                        final_cc_list.extend([name.strip() for name in cc_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                    last_cc = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_cc_list))))

                    date_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_date_d")
                    time_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{last_msg['id']}_date_t")
                    if date_val and time_val:
                        new_date_str = datetime.combine(date_val, time_val).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    
                    new_to = last_from
                    new_cc = last_cc

                st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}"].append({
                    "id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                    "from": new_from,
                    "to": new_to,
                    "cc": new_cc,
                    "date": new_date_str,
                    "body": ""
                })
                st.session_state["keep_modal_open"] = True
                st.rerun()

            selected_trusts = st.multiselect(
                "Select affected trusts",
                options=all_org_names,
                default=parent_trusts,
                help="Select NHS trusts/organisations affected by this reply thread.",
                key=f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_trusts_{email_id}",
                disabled=not can_add_reply
            )

            reply_uploaded_files = st.file_uploader(
                "Upload Attachments", 
                key=f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_uploader_{email_id}", 
                disabled=not can_add_reply, 
                accept_multiple_files=True
            )

            if st.form_submit_button("💾 Save Reply Sequence", type="primary", disabled=not can_add_reply):
                # Reconstruct
                updated_replies = []
                for msg in st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}", []):
                    # Combine From
                    from_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_from_multiselect", [])
                    from_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_from_other", "")
                    final_from_list = list(from_sel)
                    if from_oth:
                        final_from_list.extend([name.strip() for name in from_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                    final_from = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_from_list))))

                    # Combine To
                    to_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_to_multiselect", [])
                    to_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_to_other", "")
                    final_to_list = list(to_sel)
                    if to_oth:
                        final_to_list.extend([name.strip() for name in to_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                    final_to = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_to_list))))

                    # Combine CC
                    cc_sel = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_cc_multiselect", [])
                    cc_oth = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_cc_other", "")
                    final_cc_list = list(cc_sel)
                    if cc_oth:
                        final_cc_list.extend([name.strip() for name in cc_oth.split(',') if name.strip()])
                    final_cc = ", ".join(sorted(list(set(final_cc_list))))

                    # Combine Date and Time
                    date_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_d")
                    time_val = st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_date_t")
                    if date_val and time_val:
                        msg_datetime = datetime.combine(date_val, time_val)
                        msg_date_str = msg_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    else:
                        msg_date_str = msg.get("date", "")

                    updated_replies.append({
                        "from": final_from,
                        "to": final_to,
                        "cc": final_cc,
                        "date": msg_date_str,
                        "body": st.session_state.get(f"{key_prefix}_man_reply_msg_{msg['id']}_body", msg.get("body", ""))
                    })
                
                # Validation: check if any reply is empty
                empty_replies = [r for r in updated_replies if not r.get("body", "").strip() or not r.get("from", "").strip()]
                if empty_replies:
                    st.error("All messages in the sequence must have a From and Body.")
                else:
                    last_reply_id = None
                    import json
                    affected_trusts_json = json.dumps(selected_trusts) if selected_trusts else None
                    for reply in updated_replies:
                        reply_body = reply.get('body', '')
                        reply_body_text, reply_body_blob = compress_text_if_needed(reply_body)
                        reply_sentiment = analyze_sentiment(reply_body)['polarity']
                        
                        last_reply_id = execute("""
                            INSERT INTO email_thread (email_id, author, date, body, to_recipients, cc_recipients, sentiment_score, body_blob, affected_trusts)
                            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                        """, (
                            email_id, reply.get('from', 'Unknown'), str(reply.get('date', '')), reply_body_text,
                            reply.get('to', ''), reply.get('cc', ''), reply_sentiment, reply_body_blob, affected_trusts_json
                        ), return_lastrowid=True)
                        
                        log_audit_event("CREATE", "EmailReply", st.session_state.get('current_user', 'System'), st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown'), last_reply_id, details={"email_id": email_id, "source": "ManualThreadSequence"})
                    
                    # Save attachments for the last inserted reply
                    if reply_uploaded_files and last_reply_id:
                        attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                        attachment_records = []
                        app_state = get_app_state()
                        user_id = app_state.user.current_user_id
                        current_time = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

                        for uploaded_file in reply_uploaded_files:
                            timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S%f")
                            safe_original_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_file.name if c.isalnum() or c in ('.', '_')).rstrip()
                            unique_filename = f"attachment_reply_{last_reply_id}_{timestamp}_{safe_original_name}"
                            save_path = attachments_dir / unique_filename
                            with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                                f.write(uploaded_file.getvalue())
                            encrypt_file(str(save_path))

                            attachment_records.append((
                                'email_thread', last_reply_id, str(save_path), uploaded_file.name, user_id, current_time
                            ))

                        if attachment_records:
                            execute_many(
                                """INSERT INTO generic_attachments (entity_type, entity_id, file_path, original_filename, uploaded_by_id, uploaded_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                                attachment_records
                            )
                    
                    if f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}" in st.session_state:
                        del st.session_state[f"{key_prefix}_manual_reply_msgs_{email_id}"]
                        
                    st.success("Reply sequence logged successfully!")
                    st.rerun()

def render_manage_organisation_form(org: Dict[str, Any], additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing an organisation."""
    st.write(f"**Edit Organisation: {org['name']}**")
    o_key_id = org['id']
    current_user = st.session_state.get('current_user', 'Unknown')
    current_user_role = st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown')
    
    SUB_REGIONS = additional_data.get("sub_region_options", [])
    
    edit_name = st.text_input("Name", value=org['name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_name_{o_key_id}")
    try:
        current_reg_index = SUB_REGIONS.index(org['region'])
    except ValueError:
        current_reg_index = 0
    edit_reg = st.selectbox("Region", SUB_REGIONS, index=current_reg_index, key=f"{key_prefix}_reg_{o_key_id}")
    edit_group = st.text_input("Organisation Group / Collaborative (Optional)", value=org.get('org_group', '') or '', key=f"{key_prefix}_group_{o_key_id}", help="e.g., Humber Health Partnership")

    st.markdown("**Address**")
    edit_addr1 = st.text_input("Address Line 1", value=org.get('address_line_1', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_addr1_{o_key_id}")
    edit_addr2 = st.text_input("Address Line 2", value=org.get('address_line_2', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_addr2_{o_key_id}")
    edit_city = st.text_input("City", value=org.get('city', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_city_{o_key_id}")
    edit_county = st.text_input("County", value=org.get('county', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_county_{o_key_id}")
    edit_postcode = st.text_input("Postcode", value=org.get('postcode', ''), key=f"{key_prefix}_postcode_{o_key_id}")
    
    is_internal = st.checkbox("Internal / Exclude from Digest", value=bool(org.get('exclude_digest', 0)), key=f"{key_prefix}_internal_{o_key_id}")
    
    if st.button("💾 Save Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_org_{o_key_id}", type="primary"):
        old_name = org['name']
        execute("UPDATE orgs SET name=?, region=?, org_group=?, exclude_digest=?, address_line_1=?, address_line_2=?, city=?, county=?, postcode=? WHERE id=?",
                (edit_name, edit_reg, edit_group, int(is_internal), edit_addr1, edit_addr2, edit_city, edit_county, edit_postcode, o_key_id))
        log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Organisation", current_user, current_user_role, o_key_id, details={"name": edit_name, "org_group": edit_group})
        
        # Sync selection filter and widget state if renaming
        app_state = get_app_state()
        if app_state.filters.global_org_filter == old_name:
            app_state.filters.global_org_filter = edit_name
            if "sidebar_org_filter_widget" in st.session_state:
                st.session_state["sidebar_org_filter_widget"] = edit_name
            if "quick_nav_org" in st.session_state:
                st.session_state["quick_nav_org"] = edit_name

        st.cache_data.clear()
        st.rerun()

    st.divider()
    can_delete_org, reason_delete = user_can("delete_organisation")
    
    # Check if there are active projects or contacts
    dep_projects_df = query("SELECT name FROM projects WHERE (org_id = ? OR secondary_org_id = ?) AND is_deleted = 0", (o_key_id, o_key_id))
    dep_contacts_df = query("SELECT name FROM contacts WHERE org_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (o_key_id,))
    
    has_dep_projects = not dep_projects_df.empty
    has_dep_contacts = not dep_contacts_df.empty
    
    if has_dep_projects:
        dep_proj_names = ", ".join(dep_projects_df['name'].tolist())
        st.warning(f"⚠️ Cannot delete organisation because it has active project streams: {dep_proj_names}. Delete or reassign these streams first.")
        confirm_delete = False
    elif has_dep_contacts:
        dep_contact_names = ", ".join(dep_contacts_df['name'].tolist())
        st.warning(f"⚠️ Cannot delete organisation because it has active contacts: {dep_contact_names}. Delete or reassign these contacts first.")
        confirm_delete = False
    else:
        st.warning(f"⚠️ **Warning**: You are preparing to delete the organisation **{org['name']}**. This will deactivate the organisation in all directory listings.")
        confirm_delete = st.checkbox(f"Confirm deletion of **{org['name']}**", key=f"{key_prefix}_confirm_del_org_{o_key_id}")

    if st.button("🗑️ Delete Organisation", key=f"{key_prefix}_del_org_{o_key_id}", use_container_width=True, type="secondary", disabled=not can_delete_org or has_dep_projects or has_dep_contacts or not confirm_delete, help=reason_delete if not can_delete_org else f"Soft delete {org['name']}."):
        execute("UPDATE orgs SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (o_key_id,))
        log_audit_event("SOFT_DELETE", "Organisation", current_user, current_user_role, o_key_id, details={"name": org['name']})
        
        # Clear filter selection if this organisation was selected
        app_state = get_app_state()
        if app_state.filters.global_org_filter == org['name']:
            app_state.filters.global_org_filter = "All Organisations"
            if "sidebar_org_filter_widget" in st.session_state:
                st.session_state["sidebar_org_filter_widget"] = "All Organisations"
            if "quick_nav_org" in st.session_state:
                st.session_state["quick_nav_org"] = "All Organisations"
                
        st.toast("Organisation deleted.")
        st.cache_data.clear()
        st.rerun()

def render_manage_project_stream_form(project: Dict[str, Any], additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing a project stream."""
    st.write(f"**Edit Project Stream: {project['name']}**")
    p_key_id = project['id']
    
    # Get options from additional_data
    PHASES = get_config('PHASE')
    STREAM_OPTIONS = get_config('STREAM_TYPE')
    df_o_data = additional_data.get("all_orgs_df", pd.DataFrame())
    ia_list = additional_data.get("all_ias", [])
    current_allocations = additional_data.get("current_allocations", [])

    org_id_to_name = dict(zip(df_o_data['id'], df_o_data['name']))
    org_name_list = df_o_data['name'].tolist()
    org_options_with_none = [""] + org_name_list

    org_display_map = {"": ""}
    for _, row in df_o_data.iterrows():
        name = row['name']
        group = row.get('org_group')
        if pd.notna(group) and str(group).strip() and str(group).lower() not in ('nan', 'none'):
            org_display_map[name] = f"{name} ({group})"
        else:
            org_display_map[name] = name

    current_primary_org_name = org_id_to_name.get(project['org_id'])
