    primary_org_index = org_name_list.index(current_primary_org_name) if current_primary_org_name in org_name_list else 0
    edit_primary_org_name = st.selectbox("Primary Organisation", org_name_list, index=primary_org_index, format_func=lambda x: org_display_map.get(x, x), key=f"{key_prefix}_pri_org_{p_key_id}")

    current_sec_org_ids = query("SELECT org_id FROM project_secondary_orgs WHERE project_id = ?", (p_key_id,))
    current_sec_org_names = []
    if not current_sec_org_ids.empty:
        current_sec_org_names = [org_id_to_name.get(oid) for oid in current_sec_org_ids['org_id'].tolist() if oid in org_id_to_name]
    else:
        if pd.notna(project.get('secondary_org_id')):
            old_sec_name = org_id_to_name.get(int(project['secondary_org_id']))
            if old_sec_name:
                current_sec_org_names = [old_sec_name]

    edit_secondary_org_names = st.multiselect(
        "Secondary Organisations (Optional)",
        org_name_list,
        default=[name for name in current_sec_org_names if name != edit_primary_org_name],
        format_func=lambda x: org_display_map.get(x, x),
        key=f"{key_prefix}_sec_orgs_{p_key_id}"
    )
    
    st.divider()
    st.markdown("**Platform Association**")
    plat_c1, plat_c2, plat_c3, plat_c4 = st.columns(4)
    edit_has_nhs_jobs = plat_c1.checkbox("NHS Jobs", value=bool(project.get('has_nhs_jobs', 0)), key=f"{key_prefix}_nhs_jobs_{p_key_id}")
    edit_has_esr = plat_c2.checkbox("ESR", value=bool(project.get('has_esr', 0)), key=f"{key_prefix}_esr_{p_key_id}")
    edit_has_pensions = plat_c3.checkbox("Pensions", value=bool(project.get('has_pensions', 0)), key=f"{key_prefix}_pensions_{p_key_id}")
    edit_has_hrss = plat_c4.checkbox("HR Shared Services", value=bool(project.get('has_hrss', 0)), key=f"{key_prefix}_hrss_{p_key_id}")
    st.divider()

    edit_p_stat = st.selectbox("Rollout Status", PHASES, index=PHASES.index(project['status']) if project['status'] in PHASES else 0, key=f"{key_prefix}_eps_{p_key_id}")
    edit_sharepoint_link = st.text_input("SharePoint Site Link", value=project.get('sharepoint_link', '') or '', key=f"{key_prefix}_sharepoint_link_{p_key_id}", placeholder="https://sharepoint.com/sites/...")

    # Fetch custom fields for project entity
    prj_cfs = additional_data.get("custom_fields_config", [])
    prj_cf_vals = additional_data.get("custom_fields_values", {})
    prj_cf_inputs = {}
    if prj_cfs:
        st.markdown("**Custom Fields**")
        for cf in prj_cfs:
            default_val = prj_cf_vals.get(cf['id'])
            if cf['field_type'] == 'Text':
                prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = st.text_input(cf['field_name'], value=default_val, key=f"edit_proj_cf_{cf['id']}_{p_key_id}")
            elif cf['field_type'] == 'Number':
                prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = st.number_input(cf['field_name'], value=float(default_val) if default_val else 0.0, key=f"edit_proj_cf_{cf['id']}_{p_key_id}")
            elif cf['field_type'] == 'Date':
                prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = st.date_input(cf['field_name'], value=pd.to_datetime(default_val).date() if default_val else None, key=f"edit_proj_cf_{cf['id']}_{p_key_id}")
            elif cf['field_type'] == 'Boolean':
                prj_cf_inputs[cf['id']] = st.checkbox(cf['field_name'], value=str(default_val).lower() == 'true', key=f"edit_proj_cf_{cf['id']}_{p_key_id}")
    
    if st.button("💾 Save Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_proj_{p_key_id}", type="primary"):
        primary_org_id = int(df_o_data[df_o_data['name'] == edit_primary_org_name]['id'].iloc[0])
        secondary_org_ids = []
        for name in edit_secondary_org_names:
            if name in df_o_data['name'].values:
                sec_id = int(df_o_data[df_o_data['name'] == name]['id'].iloc[0])
                secondary_org_ids.append(sec_id)
        
        secondary_org_id = secondary_org_ids[0] if secondary_org_ids else None
        
        save_sharepoint_link = edit_sharepoint_link.strip()
        if save_sharepoint_link and not (save_sharepoint_link.startswith("http://") or save_sharepoint_link.startswith("https://")):
            save_sharepoint_link = "https://" + save_sharepoint_link

        with transaction():
            execute("UPDATE projects SET org_id=?, secondary_org_id=?, status=?, has_nhs_jobs=?, has_esr=?, has_pensions=?, has_hrss=?, sharepoint_link=? WHERE id=?",
                    (primary_org_id, secondary_org_id, edit_p_stat,
                     int(edit_has_nhs_jobs), int(edit_has_esr), int(edit_has_pensions), int(edit_has_hrss),
                     save_sharepoint_link, p_key_id))
            
            execute("DELETE FROM project_secondary_orgs WHERE project_id = ?", (p_key_id,))
            for sec_id in secondary_org_ids:
                execute("INSERT INTO project_secondary_orgs (project_id, org_id) VALUES (?, ?)", (p_key_id, sec_id))
                
        st.cache_data.clear()
        st.rerun()

    st.divider()
    can_delete_project, reason_delete = user_can("delete_project")
    if st.button("🗑️ Delete Project Stream", key=f"{key_prefix}_del_proj_{p_key_id}", use_container_width=True, type="secondary", disabled=not can_delete_project, help=reason_delete if not can_delete_project else "Soft delete this project stream. It can be restored from System Maintenance."):
        execute("UPDATE projects SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (p_key_id,))
        log_audit_event("SOFT_DELETE", "Project", st.session_state.get('current_user', 'Unknown'), st.session_state.get('current_user_role', 'Unknown'), p_key_id, details={"name": project['name']})
        
        # Also soft delete associated resource allocations
        execute("UPDATE resource_allocations SET is_deleted=1 WHERE project_id=?", (p_key_id,))
        
        st.toast("Project stream deleted.")
        st.cache_data.clear()
        st.rerun()

def render_manage_team_member_form(member: Dict[str, Any], additional_data: Dict[str, Any], key_prefix: str):
    """Renders the form for managing a team member."""
    from core.auth_utils import hash_password
    from core.database_utils import get_attachments_dir, encrypt_file

    st.write(f"**Edit Team Member: {member['name']}**")
    m_key_id = member['id']
    
    assigned_roles = additional_data.get("assigned_roles", [])
    all_possible_roles = additional_data.get("all_possible_roles", [])
    MASTER_REGIONS = additional_data.get("master_regions", [])
    
    edit_name = st.text_input("Name", value=member['name'], key=f"{key_prefix}_name_{m_key_id}")
    edit_roles = st.multiselect("Assigned Roles", all_possible_roles, default=assigned_roles, key=f"{key_prefix}_roles_{m_key_id}")
    primary_role_options = edit_roles if edit_roles else []
    primary_role_index = primary_role_options.index(member['primary_role']) if member['primary_role'] in primary_role_options else 0
    edit_primary_role = st.selectbox("Primary Role", options=primary_role_options, index=primary_role_index, key=f"{key_prefix}_primary_role_{m_key_id}")
    
    raw_list = [a.strip() for a in str(member['assignment_id']).split(',')] if member['assignment_id'] else []
    current_ass = [val for val in raw_list if val in MASTER_REGIONS or val.isdigit()]
    edit_ass = st.multiselect("Coverage / Project IDs", MASTER_REGIONS, default=[v for v in current_ass if not v.isdigit()], key=f"{key_prefix}_ass_{m_key_id}")
    
    new_pass_reset = st.text_input("Reset Password (leave blank to keep unchanged)", type="password", key=f"{key_prefix}_pass_{m_key_id}")

    # --- PHOTO SECTION ---
    st.divider()
    st.markdown("**📸 Profile Photo**")
    current_photo_path = member.get('photo_path')
    
    col_photo, col_upload = st.columns([1, 2])
    with col_photo:
        # Show current photo or placeholder
        if current_photo_path and os.path.exists(str(current_photo_path)):
            try:
                from core.encryption_utils import decrypt_file as _decrypt
                import io as _io
                photo_bytes = _decrypt(str(current_photo_path))
                st.image(_io.BytesIO(photo_bytes), width=110, caption="Current photo")
            except Exception:
                st.markdown(
                    '<div style="width:110px;height:110px;line-height:110px;border-radius:50%;'
                    'background:#f0f4f5;text-align:center;font-size:36px;border:2px solid #d6d6d6;">👤</div>'
                    '<p style="font-size:0.8em;color:gray;margin-top:4px;">Could not load photo</p>',
                    unsafe_allow_html=True
                )
        else:
            st.markdown(
                '<div style="width:110px;height:110px;line-height:110px;border-radius:50%;'
                'background:#f0f4f5;text-align:center;font-size:36px;border:2px dashed #adb5bd;">👤</div>'
                '<p style="font-size:0.8em;color:gray;margin-top:4px;">No photo uploaded</p>',
                unsafe_allow_html=True
            )
    with col_upload:
        new_photo = st.file_uploader(
            "Upload / Replace Photo",
            type=["jpg", "jpeg", "png"],
            key=f"{key_prefix}_photo_{m_key_id}",
            help="Upload a new photo to replace the current one."
        )
        if new_photo:
            st.caption(f"✅ Ready to save: **{new_photo.name}**")

    st.divider()

    if st.button("💾 Save Changes", key=f"{key_prefix}_save_member_{m_key_id}", type="primary"):
        roles_to_add = [r for r in edit_roles if r not in assigned_roles]
        if roles_to_add: execute_many("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO user_roles (user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?)", [(m_key_id, r) for r in roles_to_add])
        roles_to_remove = [r for r in assigned_roles if r not in edit_roles]
        if roles_to_remove:
            for r in roles_to_remove: execute("DELETE FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = ? AND role = ?", (m_key_id, r))
        final_primary_role = edit_primary_role if edit_primary_role in edit_roles else (edit_roles[0] if edit_roles else None)

        # Handle photo replacement
        new_photo_path_to_save = current_photo_path  # default: keep existing
        if new_photo:
            try:
                attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                safe_name = "".join(c for c in edit_name if c.isalnum() or c in " ._-").replace(" ", "_")
                file_ext = os.path.splitext(new_photo.name)[1]
                save_path = attachments_dir / f"profile_{safe_name}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d%H%M')}{file_ext}"
                with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(new_photo.getbuffer())
                encrypt_file(str(save_path))
                new_photo_path_to_save = str(save_path)
                # Remove old encrypted photo file if it existed and is different
                if current_photo_path and current_photo_path != new_photo_path_to_save and os.path.exists(str(current_photo_path)):
                    try:
                        os.remove(str(current_photo_path))
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            except Exception as e:
                st.warning(f"⚠️ Photo could not be saved: {e}. Other changes will still be applied.")

        if new_pass_reset:
            pass_hash = hash_password(new_pass_reset)
            execute("UPDATE rit_team SET name=?, primary_role=?, assignment_id=?, password_hash=?, photo_path=? WHERE id=?",
                    (edit_name, final_primary_role, ",".join(edit_ass), pass_hash, new_photo_path_to_save, m_key_id))
        else:
            execute("UPDATE rit_team SET name=?, primary_role=?, assignment_id=?, photo_path=? WHERE id=?",
                    (edit_name, final_primary_role, ",".join(edit_ass), new_photo_path_to_save, m_key_id))

        st.rerun()

from packaging import version
import streamlit as st


def render_main_editor_modal():
    """
    Checks session state for a modal request, and renders
    the appropriate editing form inside an `st.dialog`.
    """
    if "modal_edit_entity" not in st.session_state:
        return

    entity_to_edit = st.session_state["modal_edit_entity"]
    if not entity_to_edit:
        return # Exit if the state was empty for some reason

    entity_type = entity_to_edit.get("type")
    entity_data = entity_to_edit.get("data")
    additional_data = entity_to_edit.get("additional_data", {})

    def _on_dismiss_editor():
        st.session_state.pop("modal_edit_entity", None)

    def render_form_contents():
        apply_modal_styling()

        if "pending_contact_transfer" in st.session_state:
            msg_key_pfx, action = st.session_state.pop("pending_contact_transfer")
            apply_contact_transfer_state(msg_key_pfx, action)

        # Override st.rerun temporarily inside the dialog context so it clears the state
        original_rerun = st.rerun
        def custom_rerun():
            if st.session_state.pop("keep_modal_open", False):
                original_rerun()
            else:
                st.session_state.pop("modal_edit_entity", None)
                original_rerun()
        st.rerun = custom_rerun

        try:
            if entity_type == 'task':
                render_manage_task_form(entity_data, additional_data.get('all_tasks_in_project_df'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == 'add_task':
                render_add_task_form(entity_data.get('project_id'), entity_data.get('project_name'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "risk":
                render_manage_risk_form(entity_data, "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_risk":
                render_add_risk_form(entity_data.get('project_id'), entity_data.get('selected_prj'), entity_data.get('selected_org'), entity_data.get('current_org_id'))
            elif entity_type == "meeting":
                render_manage_meeting_form(entity_data, additional_data, "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_meeting":
                render_add_meeting_form(entity_data.get('project_id'), additional_data.get('all_attendees_options'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_email":
                render_add_email_form(entity_data.get('project_id'), entity_data.get('project_name'), additional_data.get('all_attendees_options'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "email":
                render_manage_email_form(entity_data, additional_data, "modal")
            elif entity_type == "email_reply":
                render_manage_email_reply_form(entity_data, additional_data, "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_email_reply":
                render_add_email_reply_form(entity_data.get('email_id'), additional_data, "modal")
            elif entity_type == "organisation":
                render_manage_organisation_form(
                    entity_data, additional_data, "modal"
                )
            elif entity_type == "add_organisation":
                render_add_organisation_form(additional_data.get('sub_regions'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "project_stream":
                render_manage_project_stream_form(
                    entity_data, additional_data, "modal"
                )
            elif entity_type == "add_project_stream":
                render_add_project_stream_form(additional_data.get('all_orgs_df'), additional_data.get('all_ias'), additional_data.get('templates_dict'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "team_member":
                render_manage_team_member_form(
                    entity_data, additional_data, "modal"
                )
            elif entity_type == "add_team_member":
                render_add_team_member_form(additional_data.get('rit_roles'), additional_data.get('master_regions'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "contact":
                render_manage_contact_form(entity_data, additional_data, "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_contact":
                render_add_contact_form(additional_data.get('orgs_map'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_stakeholder":
                render_add_stakeholder_form(entity_data.get('project_id'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_engagement":
                render_add_engagement_form(entity_data.get('stakeholder_id'), entity_data.get('stakeholder_name'), "modal")
            elif entity_type == "add_issue":
                render_add_issue_form(entity_data.get('project_id'), additional_data.get('issue_priorities'), "modal")

            st.divider()
            if st.button("Cancel", key="modal_cancel_main", use_container_width=True):
                st.session_state.pop("modal_edit_entity", None)
                st.rerun()
        finally:
            st.rerun = original_rerun

    # --- ATTEMPT DIALOG (DECORATOR APPROACH) ---
    dialog_title = "Add New Action Item" if entity_type == "add_task" else \
                   "Log New Risk" if entity_type == "add_risk" else \
                   "Log Meeting Minutes" if entity_type == "add_meeting" else \
                   "Log Email" if entity_type == "add_email" else \
                   "Add New Trust / Organisation" if entity_type == "add_organisation" else \
                   "Add New Project Stream" if entity_type == "add_project_stream" else \
                   "Register New Team Member" if entity_type == "add_team_member" else \
                   "Add New Contact" if entity_type == "add_contact" else \
                   "Add Stakeholder to Register" if entity_type == "add_stakeholder" else \
                   "Log Engagement" if entity_type == "add_engagement" else \
                   "Log New Issue" if entity_type == "add_issue" else \
                   "Edit Email Log" if entity_type == "email" else \
                   "Add Reply to Thread" if entity_type == "add_email_reply" else \
                   f"Edit {entity_type.replace('_', ' ').title()}"

    try:
        @st.dialog(dialog_title, width="large", on_dismiss=_on_dismiss_editor)
        def trigger_dialog():
            render_form_contents()

        # Call the decorated function to actually pop it open
        trigger_dialog()

    # --- FALLBACK TO EXPANDER ON ERROR ---
    except (TypeError, AttributeError) as e:
        # If dialogs are not supported, pop immediately to avoid stuck state
        st.session_state.pop("modal_edit_entity", None)
        try:
            st_version = st.__version__
            if version.parse(st_version) < version.parse("1.37.0"):
                st.warning(
                    f"Your Streamlit version ({st_version}) is older and does not fully support stable dialogs. Please upgrade. Falling back to an expander.",
                    icon="⚠️",
                )
            else:
                st.error(
                    f"An unexpected error occurred with dialogs on Streamlit version {st_version}. Error: {e}. Falling back to an expander.",
                    icon="🚨",
                )
        except Exception:
            st.warning(
                "Your Streamlit version might not fully support dialogs. Falling back to an expander for editing.",
                icon="⚠️",
            )

        with st.expander(dialog_title, expanded=True):
            render_form_contents()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Offline My Day — IndexedDB Cache Widget (Item 12)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def render_indexeddb_offline_widget(
    briefing_json: str,
    user_name: str,
    is_offline: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Injects an IndexedDB-backed offline cache for the My Day briefing pack.

    Online path  — writes *briefing_json* into IndexedDB so it is available
                   without a network connection.
    Offline path — reads the cached record from IndexedDB and renders a
                   styled read-only briefing card directly in the browser.

    A compact status badge and optional Force-Sync button are rendered in the
    sidebar via a separate ``st.sidebar.components.html`` injection.

    Args:
        briefing_json: JSON string of the full briefing-pack payload
                       (produced by ``_serialise_briefing_pack`` in My Day).
        user_name:     Current authenticated user — used as the IndexedDB key.
        is_offline:    Set to True when the Python data fetch failed, signalling
                       that the browser should read from cache instead of write.
    """
    import streamlit.components.v1 as components

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. Main-area engine — zero-height, handles DB read/write + offline
    #    card injection.
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    _js_payload = briefing_json.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("`", "\\`")
    _mode = "offline" if is_offline else "online"

    main_html = f"""
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<style>
  /* Offline briefing card styles */
  #ppp-offline-root {{
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
    color: #0b0c0c;
    background: #f3f2f1;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }}
  .ppp-offline-banner {{
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    background: #d4351c;
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }}
  .ppp-stale-banner {{
    background: #f47738;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #fff;
  }}
  .ppp-section-title {{
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    border-bottom: 2px solid #005eb8;
    padding-bottom: 4px;
    margin: 14px 0 8px;
    color: #005eb8;
  }}
  .ppp-card {{
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    border-left: 4px solid #005eb8;
    font-size: 13px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }}
  .ppp-card.risk   {{ border-left-color: #d4351c; }}
  .ppp-card.task   {{ border-left-color: #f47738; }}
  .ppp-card.notif  {{ border-left-color: #4c2c92; }}
  .ppp-tag {{
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 1px 7px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    margin-right: 4px;
  }}
  .ppp-tag.overdue {{ background:#d4351c; color:#fff; }}
  .ppp-tag.soon    {{ background:#f47738; color:#fff; }}
  .ppp-tag.ontrack {{ background:#00703c; color:#fff; }}
  .ppp-empty       {{ color:#6f777b; font-style:italic; font-size:13px; }}
  #ppp-status-dot  {{ display:none; }}
</style>
</head>
<body style="margin:0;padding:0;background:transparent;">

<!-- Invisible sentinel — the offline card is injected here when offline -->
<div id="ppp-offline-root" style="display:none;"></div>

<script>
(function() {{
  const DB_NAME    = 'ppp_offline_cache';
  const DB_VERSION = 1;
  const STORE_NAME = 'briefing_packs';
  const USER_KEY   = {json.dumps(user_name)};
  const MODE       = '{_mode}';
  const STALE_MS   = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000; // 24 hours

  // ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function openDB() {{
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {{
      const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
      req.onupgradeneeded = e => {{
        const db = e.target.result;
        if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_NAME)) {{
          db.createObjectStore(STORE_NAME, {{ keyPath: 'user_name' }});
        }}
      }};
      req.onsuccess = e => resolve(e.target.result);
      req.onerror   = e => reject(e.target.error);
    }});
  }}

  function putRecord(db, record) {{
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {{
      const tx    = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req   = store.put(record);
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      req.onerror   = e => reject(e.target.error);
    }});
  }}

  function getRecord(db) {{
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {{
      const tx    = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readonly');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req   = store.get(USER_KEY);
      req.onsuccess = e => resolve(e.target.result || null);
      req.onerror   = e => reject(e.target.error);
    }});
  }}

  function deleteRecord(db) {{
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {{
      const tx    = db.transaction(STORE_NAME, 'readwrite');
      const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_NAME);
      const req   = store.delete(USER_KEY);
      req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
      req.onerror   = e => reject(e.target.error);
    }});
  }}

  // ── offline renderer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderOfflineCard(record) {{
    const root = document.getElementById('ppp-offline-root');
    if (!root) return;

    const cachedAt  = new Date(record.cached_at);
    const ageMs     = Date.now() - cachedAt.getTime();
    const isStale   = ageMs > STALE_MS;
    const dateLabel = cachedAt.toLocaleString('en-GB', {{
      weekday:'short', day:'numeric', month:'short',
      year:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'
    }});

    let html = `
      <div class="ppp-offline-banner">
        📴 Offline Mode — showing cached briefing pack
      </div>`;

    if (isStale) {{
      html += `<div class="ppp-stale-banner">⚠️ Data may be stale — cached on ${{dateLabel}}</div>`;
    }} else {{
      html += `<p style="font-size:12px;color:#505a5f;margin:0 0 10px;">
        Last synced: <strong>${{dateLabel}}</strong></p>`;
    }}

    // Meetings
    html += `<div class="ppp-section-title">🗓️ Meetings</div>`;
    const meetings = record.meetings || [];
    if (meetings.length === 0) {{
      html += `<p class="ppp-empty">No meetings cached.</p>`;
    }} else {{
      meetings.forEach(m => {{
        const title   = m.title || m.summary || 'Meeting';
        const start   = m.start_time ? new Date(m.start_time).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', {{hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}}) : '';
        const end     = m.end_time   ? new Date(m.end_time).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', {{hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}}) : '';
        const timeStr = (start && end) ? `${{start}} – ${{end}}` : (start || '');
        const org     = m.org_name || '';
        html += `<div class="ppp-card">
          <strong>${{title}}</strong>
          ${{timeStr ? `<span style="color:#505a5f;margin-left:8px;">${{timeStr}}</span>` : ''}}
          ${{org ? `<span style="color:#6f777b;font-size:12px;margin-left:6px;">(${{org}})</span>` : ''}}
        </div>`;
      }});
    }}

    // Tasks
    html += `<div class="ppp-section-title">✅ Tasks</div>`;
    const tasks = record.tasks || [];
    const urgentTasks = tasks.filter(t => t.due_date_status === 'Overdue' || t.due_date_status === 'Due Soon');
    if (urgentTasks.length === 0) {{
      html += `<p class="ppp-empty">No overdue or due-soon tasks cached.</p>`;
    }} else {{
      urgentTasks.forEach(t => {{
        const tagClass = t.due_date_status === 'Overdue' ? 'overdue' : 'soon';
        html += `<div class="ppp-card task">
          <span class="ppp-tag ${{tagClass}}">${{t.due_date_status || ''}}</span>
          <strong>${{t.task || ''}}</strong>
          <span style="color:#505a5f;font-size:12px;margin-left:6px;">Due: ${{t.due_date || 'N/A'}}</span>
          ${{t.org_name ? `<span style="color:#6f777b;font-size:12px;"> · ${{t.org_name}}</span>` : ''}}
        </div>`;
      }});
    }}

    // Risks
    html += `<div class="ppp-section-title">⚠️ Critical Risks</div>`;
    const risks = record.risks || [];
    if (risks.length === 0) {{
      html += `<p class="ppp-empty">No critical risks cached.</p>`;
    }} else {{
      risks.forEach(r => {{
        html += `<div class="ppp-card risk">
          <strong>${{r.description || 'Risk'}}</strong>
          ${{r.impact ? `<span style="color:#d4351c;font-size:12px;margin-left:6px;">[${{r.impact}}]</span>` : ''}}
          ${{r.org_name ? `<span style="color:#6f777b;font-size:12px;"> · ${{r.org_name}}</span>` : ''}}
        </div>`;
      }});
    }}

    // Notifications
    html += `<div class="ppp-section-title">🔔 Recent Notifications</div>`;
    const notifs = record.notifications || [];
    if (notifs.length === 0) {{
      html += `<p class="ppp-empty">No notifications cached.</p>`;
    }} else {{
      notifs.forEach(n => {{
        html += `<div class="ppp-card notif">${{n.message || ''}}</div>`;
      }});
    }}

    root.innerHTML = html;
    root.style.display = 'block';
    // Signal parent iframe to expand
    window.parent.postMessage({{type:'ppp_idb_offline_render', height: root.scrollHeight + 40}}, '*');
  }}

  // ── main flow ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  openDB().then(async db => {{

    if (MODE === 'online') {{
      // Write the fresh payload into IndexedDB
      try {{
        const payload = JSON.parse(`{_js_payload}`);
        const record  = {{
          user_name : USER_KEY,
          cached_at : new Date().toISOString(),
          meetings  : payload.meetings      || [],
          tasks     : payload.tasks         || [],
          risks     : payload.risks         || [],
          notifications: payload.notifications || [],
        }};
        await putRecord(db, record);
        // Report cached_at back to the sidebar status badge via postMessage
        window.parent.postMessage({{
          type      : 'ppp_idb_status',
          status    : 'cached',
          cached_at : record.cached_at,
          user_name : USER_KEY,
        }}, '*');
      }} catch(err) {{
        console.warn('[PPP IDB] Write failed:', err);
      }}

    }} else {{
      // Offline path — read from cache and render
      try {{
        const record = await getRecord(db);
        if (record) {{
          renderOfflineCard(record);
        }} else {{
          const root = document.getElementById('ppp-offline-root');
          if (root) {{
            root.innerHTML = `<div class="ppp-offline-banner">
              📴 No cached data found. Please reconnect to load your briefing pack.
            </div>`;
            root.style.display = 'block';
          }}
        }}
      }} catch(err) {{
        console.error('[PPP IDB] Read failed:', err);
      }}
    }}

  }}).catch(err => console.error('[PPP IDB] DB open failed:', err));

}})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
"""

    components.html(main_html, height=0 if not is_offline else 800, scrolling=False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. Sidebar status badge + Force Sync button
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    st.sidebar.divider()
    st.sidebar.subheader("📴 Offline Mode")

    if is_offline:
        st.sidebar.error("🔴 Offline — showing cached data", icon="📴")
    else:
        st.sidebar.caption("Briefing pack auto-cached on page load.")

        # Tiny zero-height widget that listens for the postMessage from
        # the main engine and updates a <span> with the cached_at time.
        status_html = """
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><style>
  body { margin:0; padding:0; background:transparent; font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; }
  #badge { font-size:12px; color:#00703c; }
</style></head>
<body>
<span id="badge">⏳ Checking cache…</span>
<script>
  window.addEventListener('message', function(evt) {
    if (evt.data && evt.data.type === 'ppp_idb_status' && evt.data.status === 'cached') {
      var d = new Date(evt.data.cached_at);
      var label = d.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});
      document.getElementById('badge').textContent = '🟢 Cached · ' + label;
    }
  });
</script>
</body></html>
"""
        with st.sidebar:
            components.html(status_html, height=28, scrolling=False)

        if st.sidebar.button("🔄 Force Sync", key="idb_force_sync_btn", use_container_width=True, help="Clear the local cache and re-fetch fresh data"):
            # Clear the IDB record then rerun to trigger a fresh write
            clear_html = f"""
<!DOCTYPE html><html><body style="margin:0">
<script>
(function() {{
  var req = indexedDB.open('ppp_offline_cache', 1);
  req.onsuccess = function(e) {{
    var db = e.target.result;
    var tx = db.transaction('briefing_packs', 'readwrite');
    tx.objectStore('briefing_packs').delete({json.dumps(user_name)});
  }};
}})();
</script>
</body></html>
"""
            components.html(clear_html, height=0, scrolling=False)
            st.rerun()

# core/analytics_engine.py
import re
import json
import logging
from typing import List, Dict, Any, Tuple, Optional
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from core.database_utils import query, execute, execute_silent
from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response, analyze_sentiment

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def ensure_date_indexes() -> None:
    """Creates indexes on date columns of meetings, emails, and site visit logs to optimize queries."""
    try:
        execute_silent("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meetings_date_recent ON meetings (date DESC);")
        execute_silent("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_emails_date_recent ON emails (date_sent DESC);")
        execute_silent("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_site_visit_date_recent ON site_visit_field_log (visit_date DESC);")
        logger.info("Database date indexes verified/created successfully.")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to create database date indexes: {e}")

def run_blocker_intelligence(days_limit: int = 90, bypass_cache: bool = False) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Identifies systemic rollout issues/blockers across multiple trusts.
    Queries recent meetings, emails, and site visits, then clusters friction points using Ollama.
    """
    ensure_date_indexes()
    
    # 1. Query raw texts (bounded by timeframe)
    date_param = f"-{days_limit} days"
    
    meetings_df = query(
        """
        SELECT m.date, m.title, m.summary, m.consortium_notes, m.decisions, o.name as org_name
        FROM meetings m
        JOIN projects p ON m.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        WHERE m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.date >= date('now', ?)
        ORDER BY m.date DESC
        LIMIT 150
        """,
        (date_param,)
    )
    
    emails_df = query(
        """
        SELECT e.date_sent, e.subject, e.body, o.name as org_name
        FROM emails e
        JOIN projects p ON e.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        WHERE e.is_deleted = 0 AND e.date_sent >= date('now', ?)
        ORDER BY e.date_sent DESC
        LIMIT 150
        """,
        (date_param,)
    )
    
    visits_df = query(
        """
        SELECT sv.visit_date, sv.visit_achievements, sv.follow_up_actions, o.name as org_name
        FROM site_visit_field_log sv
        JOIN projects p ON sv.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        WHERE sv.visit_date >= date('now', ?)
        ORDER BY sv.visit_date DESC
        LIMIT 100
        """,
        (date_param,)
    )
    
    # Assemble structured text logs
    log_entries = []
    
    if not meetings_df.empty:
        for _, row in meetings_df.iterrows():
            summary_txt = row['summary'] or ""
            notes_txt = row['consortium_notes'] or ""
            decisions_txt = row['decisions'] or ""
            text = f"Title: {row['title']} | Summary: {summary_txt} | Notes: {notes_txt} | Decisions: {decisions_txt}"
            log_entries.append({
                "source": "Meeting",
                "org": row['org_name'],
                "date": row['date'],
                "content": text
            })
            
    if not emails_df.empty:
        for _, row in emails_df.iterrows():
            body_txt = row['body'] or ""
            text = f"Subject: {row['subject']} | Body: {body_txt}"
            log_entries.append({
                "source": "Email",
                "org": row['org_name'],
                "date": row['date_sent'],
                "content": text
            })
            
    if not visits_df.empty:
        for _, row in visits_df.iterrows():
            achieve_txt = row['visit_achievements'] or ""
            actions_txt = row['follow_up_actions'] or ""
            text = f"Achievements: {achieve_txt} | Actions: {actions_txt}"
            log_entries.append({
                "source": "Site Visit",
                "org": row['org_name'],
                "date": row['visit_date'],
                "content": text
            })

    if not log_entries:
        logger.info("No communication or site visit logs found in the given timeframe.")
        return []

    # Compile the text payload
    payload_parts = []
    for entry in log_entries:
        payload_parts.append(
            f"--- Entry ({entry['source']}) ---\n"
            f"Trust/Organization: {entry['org']}\n"
            f"Date: {entry['date']}\n"
            f"Text: {entry['content']}\n"
        )
    payload_text = "\n".join(payload_parts)
    
    # Construct the LLM Prompt
    system_prompt = (
        "You are an expert PMO AI Analyst. Analyze the provided communication logs to perform named entity extraction "
        "and cluster core systemic friction points / blockers affecting NHS Trusts. "
        "You must respond ONLY with a valid JSON array of objects. Do not add any conversational text or formatting. "
        "Each object in the array must contain exactly these keys:\n"
        "1. \"thematic_blocker_name\": A descriptive name for the systemic friction point (e.g. 'Smartcard Access Issues', 'Local Wifi Coverage').\n"
        "2. \"trusts_affected\": Integer representation of how many distinct trusts appear to face this blocker.\n"
        "3. \"impact_level\": Must be either 'Critical' or 'Moderate'.\n"
        "4. \"remediation\": A proposed program-level remediation or mitigation strategy."
    )
    
    user_prompt = (
        f"Analyze the following communication logs and extract clustered blockers in the requested JSON format:\n\n"
        f"{payload_text[:12000]}"  # Truncate to safety limit
    )
    
    try:
        response = generate_ai_response(
            prompt=user_prompt,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            temperature=0.1,
            bypass_cache=bypass_cache
        )
        
        # Clean and parse the JSON response
        cleaned_response = response.strip()
        # Find JSON block if wrapped in markdown
        json_match = re.search(r"(\[.*\])", cleaned_response, re.DOTALL)
        if json_match:
            cleaned_response = json_match.group(1)
            
        blockers = json.loads(cleaned_response)
        if isinstance(blockers, list):
            return blockers
        else:
            logger.warning("AI did not return a list of blockers.")
            return []
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error executing blocker intelligence: {e}")
        return []

def run_sentiment_correlation(days_limit: int = 90) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Performs sentiment analysis correlation across Emails, Meetings, and Site Visits.
    Identifies what topics trigger negative sentiment/frictions.
    """
    ensure_date_indexes()
    date_param = f"-{days_limit} days"
    
    # 1. Fetch data
    emails_df = query(
        "SELECT date_sent, sentiment_score, subject, body FROM emails WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND date_sent >= date('now', ?) AND sentiment_score IS NOT NULL",
        (date_param,)
    )
    
    meetings_df = query(
        "SELECT date, sentiment_score, summary, decisions FROM meetings WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND date >= date('now', ?) AND sentiment_score IS NOT NULL AND document_type != 'Email Correspondence'",
        (date_param,)
    )
    
    visits_df = query(
        "SELECT visit_date, visit_achievements, follow_up_actions FROM site_visit_field_log WHERE visit_date >= date('now', ?)",
        (date_param,)
    )

    # Calculate TextBlob sentiment on site visits
    visit_data = []
    if not visits_df.empty:
        for _, row in visits_df.iterrows():
            ach = row['visit_achievements'] or ""
            fup = row['follow_up_actions'] or ""
            text = f"{ach} {fup}".strip()
            score = 0.0
            if text:
                try:
                    score = analyze_sentiment(text)['polarity']
                except Exception:
                    score = 0.0
            visit_data.append({
                "date": row['visit_date'],
                "sentiment_score": score,
                "text": text
            })
            
    # Compile Channel Stats
    def calc_channel_stats(scores: List[float]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        count = len(scores)
        if count == 0:
            return {"avg_sentiment": 0.0, "count": 0, "friction_count": 0, "friction_rate": 0.0}
        avg_score = sum(scores) / count
        f_count = sum(1 for s in scores if s < -0.1)
        return {
            "avg_sentiment": round(avg_score, 2),
            "count": count,
            "friction_count": f_count,
            "friction_rate": round((f_count / count) * 100, 1)
        }

    email_scores = emails_df['sentiment_score'].tolist() if not emails_df.empty else []
    meeting_scores = meetings_df['sentiment_score'].tolist() if not meetings_df.empty else []
    visit_scores = [v['sentiment_score'] for v in visit_data]

    channel_stats = {
        "Email": calc_channel_stats(email_scores),
        "Meeting": calc_channel_stats(meeting_scores),
        "Site Visit": calc_channel_stats(visit_scores)
    }

    # Define keywords for friction topics
    TOPICS = {
        "Smartcard / Authentication": ["smartcard", "smart card", "login", "authenticate", "auth", "token", "signon", "sign-on", "credential"],
        "Local Infrastructure": ["network", "bandwidth", "infrastructure", "hardware", "wi-fi", "wifi", "pc", "computer", "printer", "device", "latency", "server"],
        "Resource / Capacity": ["capacity", "understaffed", "busy", "workload", "time", "resource", "clinical", "pressure", "staffing"],
        "Training / Engagement": ["training", "engagement", "resistance", "unwilling", "sceptical", "skeptical", "briefing", "session", "course", "learn"],
        "Process / Data Cleanse": ["cleanse", "data extraction", "mapping", "extraction", "duplicate", "error", "format", "reconciliation"]
    }

    keyword_stats = []
    friction_correlation = []

    # Helper search function
    def count_occurrences(text: str, keywords: List[str]) -> bool:
        t = text.lower()
        return any(kw in t for kw in keywords)

    for topic, keywords in TOPICS.items():
        email_counts = 0
        meeting_counts = 0
        visit_counts = 0
        
        email_frictions = 0
        meeting_frictions = 0
        visit_frictions = 0

        # Scan Emails
        if not emails_df.empty:
            for _, row in emails_df.iterrows():
                full_text = f"{row['subject']} {row['body']}"
                if count_occurrences(full_text, keywords):
                    email_counts += 1
                    if row['sentiment_score'] < -0.1:
                        email_frictions += 1

        # Scan Meetings
        if not meetings_df.empty:
            for _, row in meetings_df.iterrows():
                full_text = f"{row['summary']} {row['decisions']}"
                if count_occurrences(full_text, keywords):
                    meeting_counts += 1
                    if row['sentiment_score'] < -0.1:
                        meeting_frictions += 1

        # Scan Site Visits
        for v in visit_data:
            if count_occurrences(v['text'], keywords):
                visit_counts += 1
                if v['sentiment_score'] < -0.1:
                    visit_frictions += 1

        total_occurrences = email_counts + meeting_counts + visit_counts
        total_frictions = email_frictions + meeting_frictions + visit_frictions

        keyword_stats.append({
            "Topic": topic,
            "Email": email_counts,
            "Meeting": meeting_counts,
            "Site Visit": visit_counts,
            "Total": total_occurrences
        })

        friction_correlation.append({
            "Topic": topic,
            "Total Frictions": total_frictions,
            "Friction Rate": round((total_frictions / total_occurrences * 100) if total_occurrences > 0 else 0.0, 1)
        })

    return {
        "channel_stats": channel_stats,
        "keyword_stats": keyword_stats,
        "friction_correlation": friction_correlation
    }

def synthesize_lessons_learned(rollout_phase: str, bypass_cache: bool = False) -> str:
    """
    Filters recent/active/closed project logs for the given rollout phase,
    and prompts Ollama to write a Lessons Learned executive wrap-up.
    """
    # 1. Fetch relevant projects
    projects_df = query(
        """
        SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.name, o.name as org_name, p.status
        FROM projects p
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        LEFT JOIN phase_history ph ON p.id = ph.project_id
        WHERE (p.status = ? OR ph.phase = ?) AND p.is_deleted = 0
        """,
        (rollout_phase, rollout_phase)
    )

    if projects_df.empty:
        return f"No projects or history recorded in the **{rollout_phase}** phase."

    context_parts = []
    for _, proj in projects_df.iterrows():
        pid = proj['id']
        context_parts.append(f"### Project Stream: {proj['name']} (Trust: {proj['org_name']})")
        
        # Get tasks
        tasks_df = query(
            "SELECT task, status, latest_update FROM actions WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 15",
            (pid,)
        )
        if not tasks_df.empty:
            context_parts.append("Tasks:")
            for _, t in tasks_df.iterrows():
                upd = f" - Update: {t['latest_update']}" if t['latest_update'] else ""
                context_parts.append(f"- [{t['status']}] {t['task']}{upd}")

        # Get risks
        risks_df = query(
            "SELECT description, mitigation, impact, status FROM risks WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 10",
            (pid,)
        )
        if not risks_df.empty:
            context_parts.append("Risks:")
            for _, r in risks_df.iterrows():
                mit = f" - Mitigation: {r['mitigation']}" if r['mitigation'] else ""
                context_parts.append(f"- [{r['status']}/{r['impact']}] {r['description']}{mit}")

        # Get meetings notes
        meetings_df = query(
            "SELECT title, summary, decisions, next_steps FROM meetings WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 10",
            (pid,)
        )
        if not meetings_df.empty:
            context_parts.append("Meetings:")
            for _, m in meetings_df.iterrows():
                sum_txt = m['summary'] or ""
                dec = f" - Decisions: {m['decisions']}" if m['decisions'] else ""
                context_parts.append(f"- {m['title']}: {sum_txt}{dec}")

        # Get site visits
        visits_df = query(
            "SELECT visit_achievements, follow_up_actions FROM site_visit_field_log WHERE project_id = ? LIMIT 10",
            (pid,)
        )
        if not visits_df.empty:
            context_parts.append("Site Visits:")
            for _, sv in visits_df.iterrows():
                ach = sv['visit_achievements'] or ""
                fup = sv['follow_up_actions'] or ""
                context_parts.append(f"- Achievements: {ach} | Follow-up: {fup}")

        # Get existing lessons
        lessons_df = query(
            "SELECT title, description, key_takeaways, recommendations FROM lessons_learned WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 5",
            (pid,)
        )
        if not lessons_df.empty:
            context_parts.append("Existing Lessons Learned:")
            for _, l in lessons_df.iterrows():
                context_parts.append(f"- {l['title']}: {l['description']} (Takeaway: {l['key_takeaways']}, Recommendation: {l['recommendations']})")

        context_parts.append("\n")

    full_context = "\n".join(context_parts)
    
    # Prompt formulation
    system_prompt = (
        f"You are a Senior Change Management Director compiling a post-phase lessons learned report "
        f"for NHS regional boards. You are reviewing the historical logs and activities of projects during the "
        f"'{rollout_phase}' phase.\n\n"
        f"Compile a high-level summary paragraph synthesizing the overall progress, successes, and key issues "
        f"faced during this phase, followed by an executive bulleted breakdown (suitable for a board pack or upward briefing). "
        f"The breakdown must include:\n"
        f"- Key Success Factors (what went well and why)\n"
        f"- Common Blocker Patterns (systemic issues encountered)\n"
        f"- Programmatic Recommendations (future modifications to rollout strategies).\n\n"
        f"Maintain an objective, executive, professional tone. Format the response in clean Markdown."
    )

    user_prompt = (
        f"Synthesize lessons learned for the '{rollout_phase}' rollout phase based on the following project tracking logs:\n\n"
        f"{full_context[:14000]}"
    )

    try:
        response = generate_ai_response(
            prompt=user_prompt,
            system_prompt=system_prompt,
            temperature=0.2,
            bypass_cache=bypass_cache
        )
        return response
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error in lessons learned synthesizer: {e}")
        return f"Could not generate lessons learned synthesis due to error: {e}"

def run_adkar_stance_risk_modeler(project_id: int) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Runs the Dynamic ADKAR Stance Risk Cascade Modeler for a project.
    Queries the database view 'view_stakeholder_risk_signals' to retrieve mapped 
    stakeholder scores, detects first ADKAR barrier points, and generates warning signals.
    """
    try:
        query_str = """
            SELECT 
                stakeholder_id,
                project_id,
                contact_id,
                stakeholder_name,
                job_title,
                influence,
                interest,
                current_stance,
                influence_score,
                interest_score,
                stance_score,
                stance_risk_score,
                adkar_awareness,
                adkar_desire,
                adkar_knowledge,
                adkar_ability,
                adkar_reinforcement,
                barrier_point,
                barrier_score,
                risk_level,
                mitigation_signal,
                escalation_required
            FROM view_stakeholder_risk_signals
            WHERE project_id = ?
            ORDER BY stance_risk_score DESC, stakeholder_name ASC
        """
        df = query(query_str, (project_id,))
        if df.empty:
            return []
        return df.to_dict(orient='records')
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error running ADKAR stance risk modeler: {e}")
        return []

def run_executive_sentiment_shift_tracker(
    project_id: Optional[int] = None,
    threshold: float = -0.3,
    num_weeks: int = 8
) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Applies sentiment calculations over communication records to flag sharp
    multi-week drops in stakeholder responses.
    """
    ensure_date_indexes()
    import pandas as pd

    # 1. Fetch active stakeholders
    if project_id is not None:
        sh_df = query(
            """
            SELECT s.id AS stakeholder_id, s.project_id, p.name AS project_name,
                   c.name, c.email, c.job_title, s.influence, s.current_stance
            FROM stakeholders s
            JOIN contacts c ON s.contact_id = c.id
            JOIN projects p ON s.project_id = p.id
            WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND s.project_id = ?
            """,
            (project_id,)
        )
    else:
        sh_df = query(
            """
            SELECT s.id AS stakeholder_id, s.project_id, p.name AS project_name,
                   c.name, c.email, c.job_title, s.influence, s.current_stance
            FROM stakeholders s
            JOIN contacts c ON s.contact_id = c.id
            JOIN projects p ON s.project_id = p.id
            WHERE s.is_deleted = 0
            """
        )

    if sh_df.empty:
        return []

    # Helper to parse dates
    def parse_date(date_str) -> Optional[datetime]:
        if not date_str:
            return None
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(str(date_str).strip(), fmt)
            except ValueError:
                continue
        return None

    # Helper to check if a title is executive
    def is_executive_title(title: Optional[str]) -> bool:
        if not title:
            return False
        title_lower = title.lower()
        exec_keywords = ['director', 'chief', 'executive', 'lead', 'head', 'chair', 'sponsor', 'manager', 'board', 'vp', 'president', 'exec']
        return any(kw in title_lower for kw in exec_keywords)

    # Determine reference date (ref_date)
    ref_date = datetime.now()

    # Fallback to max communication date in the DB if running in tests/historical data
    try:
        r_email = query("SELECT MAX(date_sent) as max_date FROM emails WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND date_sent IS NOT NULL")
        r_comm = query("SELECT MAX(timestamp) as max_date FROM comments WHERE timestamp IS NOT NULL")
        r_log = query("SELECT MAX(recorded_date) as max_date FROM stakeholder_sentiment_log WHERE recorded_date IS NOT NULL")
        
        dates = []
        if not r_email.empty and r_email.iloc[0]['max_date']:
            d = parse_date(r_email.iloc[0]['max_date'])
            if d: dates.append(d)
        if not r_comm.empty and r_comm.iloc[0]['max_date']:
            d = parse_date(r_comm.iloc[0]['max_date'])
            if d: dates.append(d)
        if not r_log.empty and r_log.iloc[0]['max_date']:
            d = parse_date(r_log.iloc[0]['max_date'])
            if d: dates.append(d)
            
        if dates:
            max_db_date = max(dates)
            if (ref_date - max_db_date).days > 1:
                ref_date = max_db_date
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Error checking max db date in sentiment shift tracker: {e}")

    cutoff_date = ref_date - timedelta(days=7 * num_weeks)
    cutoff_str = cutoff_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

    flagged_drops = []

    for _, sh in sh_df.iterrows():
        sh_id = int(sh['stakeholder_id'])
        email = sh['email']
        name = sh['name']

        # Collect sentiment scores with dates
        scores_with_dates = []

        # A. Emails
        if email:
            emails = query(
                """
                SELECT date_sent, sentiment_score, subject, body 
                FROM emails 
                WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND email_from LIKE ? AND date_sent >= ?
                """,
                (f"%{email}%", cutoff_str)
            )
            for _, row in emails.iterrows():
                d = parse_date(row['date_sent'])
                if d:
                    score = row['sentiment_score']
                    if score is None or pd.isna(score):
                        text = f"{row['subject'] or ''} {row['body'] or ''}".strip()
                        if text:
                            try:
                                score = analyze_sentiment(text)['polarity']
                            except Exception:
                                score = 0.0
                        else:
                            score = 0.0
                    scores_with_dates.append((d, float(score)))

        # B. Comments
        if name:
            comments = query(
                """
                SELECT timestamp, sentiment_score, comment_text 
                FROM comments 
                WHERE author = ? AND timestamp >= ?
                """,
                (name, cutoff_str)
            )
            for _, row in comments.iterrows():
                d = parse_date(row['timestamp'])
                if d:
                    score = row['sentiment_score']
                    if score is None or pd.isna(score):
                        text = (row['comment_text'] or '').strip()
                        if text:
                            try:
                                score = analyze_sentiment(text)['polarity']
                            except Exception:
                                score = 0.0
                        else:
                            score = 0.0
                    scores_with_dates.append((d, float(score)))

        # C. Stakeholder Sentiment Log
        logs = query(
            """
            SELECT recorded_date, sentiment_score 
            FROM stakeholder_sentiment_log 
            WHERE stakeholder_id = ? AND recorded_date >= ?
            """,
            (sh_id, cutoff_str)
        )
        for _, row in logs.iterrows():
            d = parse_date(row['recorded_date'])
            if d:
                scores_with_dates.append((d, float(row['sentiment_score'])))

        if not scores_with_dates:
            continue

        # Group by week: 1 to num_weeks
        weekly_buckets = {i: [] for i in range(1, num_weeks + 1)}
        for d, val in scores_with_dates:
            delta_days = (ref_date - d).days
            if delta_days < 0:
                delta_days = 0
            week_idx = (delta_days // 7) + 1
            if week_idx in weekly_buckets:
                weekly_buckets[week_idx].append(val)

        # Calculate weekly average sentiments
        weekly_avgs = []
        for i in range(1, num_weeks + 1):
            vals = weekly_buckets[i]
            avg = sum(vals) / len(vals) if vals else None
            weekly_avgs.append({
                "week": i,
                "score": round(avg, 2) if avg is not None else None,
                "count": len(vals)
            })

        # Calculate recent average (weeks 1 and 2)
        recent_vals = []
        for i in (1, 2):
            recent_vals.extend(weekly_buckets[i])
        recent_avg = sum(recent_vals) / len(recent_vals) if recent_vals else None

        # Calculate historical average (weeks 3 to num_weeks)
        historical_vals = []
        for i in range(3, num_weeks + 1):
            historical_vals.extend(weekly_buckets[i])
        historical_avg = sum(historical_vals) / len(historical_vals) if historical_vals else None

        # Check for drop
        if recent_avg is not None and historical_avg is not None:
            sentiment_drop = recent_avg - historical_avg
            if sentiment_drop <= threshold:
                is_exec = is_executive_title(sh['job_title'])
                
                exec_lbl = "Executive stakeholder" if is_exec else "Stakeholder"
                alert_msg = (
                    f"{exec_lbl} {name} ({sh['job_title'] or 'No Title'}) sentiment dropped sharply "
                    f"by {sentiment_drop:.2f} (Recent Avg: {recent_avg:.2f}, Historical Avg: {historical_avg:.2f}) "
                    f"over the past {num_weeks} weeks."
                )

                flagged_drops.append({
                    "stakeholder_id": sh_id,
                    "name": name,
                    "job_title": sh['job_title'],
                    "influence": sh['influence'],
                    "current_stance": sh['current_stance'],
                    "project_id": int(sh['project_id']),
                    "project_name": sh['project_name'],
                    "recent_avg": round(recent_avg, 2),
                    "historical_avg": round(historical_avg, 2),
                    "sentiment_drop": round(sentiment_drop, 2),
                    "is_executive": is_exec,
                    "weekly_sentiments": weekly_avgs,
                    "alert_message": alert_msg
                })

    # Sort drops so that the most negative drops are first
    flagged_drops.sort(key=lambda x: x['sentiment_drop'])
    return flagged_drops

# /Volumes/Crucial X9 Pro For Mac/Project Management/page_parts/change_management/kotter.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import altair as alt
from core.database_utils import query, execute, execute_many

def render(pid: int):
    """Renders the Kotter's 8-Step Change Model tab."""
    st.header("Kotter's 8-Step Change Model")
    st.caption("Track progress against Kotter's framework for leading organizational change.")
    st.info("""
    **How to use Kotter's 8-Step Model:**
    This is a top-down framework for leading large-scale organizational change. Follow the steps sequentially to build momentum and embed the change.
    1.  **Create Urgency:** Develop a compelling reason why change is needed now.
    2.  **Form a Powerful Coalition:** Assemble a group with enough power and influence to lead the change.
    3.  **Create a Vision for Change:** Shape a clear, simple, and inspiring vision of the future.
    4.  **Communicate the Vision:** Use every available channel to communicate the new vision and strategies.
    5.  **Remove Obstacles:** Empower people to act on the vision by removing barriers.
    6.  **Create Short-Term Wins:** Plan for and celebrate visible, short-term successes to build momentum.
    7.  **Build on the Change:** Consolidate gains and produce more change, tackling bigger challenges.
    8.  **Anchor Changes in Culture:** Institutionalize the new ways of working to ensure they become the norm.
    """)

    # --- NEW: Visualization ---
    df_kotter_viz = query("SELECT status, COUNT(id) as count FROM kotter_analysis WHERE project_id = ? GROUP BY status", (pid,))
    if df_kotter_viz.empty:
        df_kotter_viz = pd.DataFrame([{'status': 'Not Started', 'count': 8}])

    all_statuses = pd.DataFrame({'status': ["Not Started", "In Progress", "Completed"]})
    df_kotter_viz = pd.merge(all_statuses, df_kotter_viz, on='status', how='left').fillna(0)

    kotter_chart = alt.Chart(df_kotter_viz).mark_bar().encode(
        x=alt.X('sum(count):Q', title="Progress", stack='normalize', axis=alt.Axis(format='%')),
        color=alt.Color('status:N',
                        scale=alt.Scale(domain=["Completed", "In Progress", "Not Started"],
                                        range=['#00703c', '#ffdd00', '#d4351c']),
                        legend=alt.Legend(title="Status"))
    ).properties(
        title="Kotter's Model Progress"
    )
    st.altair_chart(kotter_chart, use_container_width=True)

    KOTTER_STEPS = [
        "1. Create Urgency", "2. Form a Powerful Coalition", "3. Create a Vision for Change",
        "4. Communicate the Vision", "5. Remove Obstacles", "6. Create Short-Term Wins",
        "7. Build on the Change", "8. Anchor Changes in Culture"
    ]
    STATUS_OPTIONS = ["Not Started", "In Progress", "Completed"]

    df_kotter = query("SELECT step_number, status, notes FROM kotter_analysis WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY step_number", (pid,))
    kotter_data = {row['step_number']: {'status': row['status'], 'notes': row['notes']} for _, row in df_kotter.iterrows()}

    with st.form("kotter_analysis_form"):
        for i, step_name in enumerate(KOTTER_STEPS):
            step_number = i + 1
            st.subheader(step_name)
            
            current_status = kotter_data.get(step_number, {}).get('status', 'Not Started')
            current_notes = kotter_data.get(step_number, {}).get('notes', '')
            
            k_c1, k_c2 = st.columns([0.3, 0.7])
            status_index = STATUS_OPTIONS.index(current_status) if current_status in STATUS_OPTIONS else 0
            new_status = k_c1.selectbox("Status", options=STATUS_OPTIONS, index=status_index, key=f"kotter_status_{step_number}")
            new_notes = k_c2.text_area("Notes & Evidence", value=current_notes, key=f"kotter_notes_{step_number}", label_visibility="collapsed")

        if st.form_submit_button("💾 Save Kotter Analysis", type="primary"):
            records_to_upsert = []
            for i, step_name in enumerate(KOTTER_STEPS):
                step_number = i + 1
                status = st.session_state[f"kotter_status_{step_number}"]
                notes = st.session_state[f"kotter_notes_{step_number}"]
                records_to_upsert.append((pid, step_number, step_name, status, notes))
            
            execute("DELETE FROM kotter_analysis WHERE project_id = ?", (pid,))
            execute_many("INSERT INTO kotter_analysis (project_id, step_number, step_name, status, notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", records_to_upsert)
            st.success("Kotter analysis saved successfully!")
            st.rerun()

# process_maps_view.py

import os
import json
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from typing import Dict, Any, List, Optional, cast
import streamlit.components.v1 as components

from core.database_utils import (
    get_process_maps_for_project,
    get_process_map,
    save_process_map,
    create_process_map,
    delete_process_map,
    log_audit_event
)

# Declare the custom bidirectional component
parent_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
build_dir = os.path.join(parent_dir, "core", "process_mapper")
_mapper_component = components.declare_component("process_mapper", path=build_dir)


def render_process_maps_tab(project_id: int, project_name: str) -> None:
    """
    Renders the Process Mapper workspace inside a Project Dashboard tab.
    Loads and saves diagrams to SQLite.
    """
    st.header("🗺️ Process Maps (Visio Light)")
    st.caption(
        "Design visual process maps with horizontal swimlanes to map roles, steps, and system integrations."
    )

    # 1. Fetch available maps for the project
    df_maps = get_process_maps_for_project(project_id)
    
    map_options = {}
    if not df_maps.empty:
        for _, row in df_maps.iterrows():
            map_options[int(row["id"])] = str(row["name"])

    # User details for audit logging
    current_user = getattr(st.session_state.app_state.user, "current_user_name", "System")
    current_user_role = getattr(st.session_state.app_state.user, "current_user_role", "Unknown")

    # Selector
    options_list = list(map_options.keys())
    options_labels = ["➕ Create New Map"] + [map_options[k] for k in options_list]
    
    col_sel, col_del_map = st.columns([0.82, 0.18])
    with col_sel:
        # Track selected option index
        selected_option = st.selectbox(
            "Select Process Map",
            options=options_labels,
            index=1 if len(options_list) > 0 else 0,
            key=f"map_selector_{project_id}"
        )
        
    with col_del_map:
        st.write("")
        st.write("")
        if selected_option != "➕ Create New Map":
            with st.popover("🗑️ Delete", use_container_width=True):
                st.warning(f"Delete '{selected_option}'?")
                if st.button("Confirm Delete", type="primary", use_container_width=True, key=f"btn_confirm_delete_map_{project_id}"):
                    map_id = None
                    for k, v in map_options.items():
                        if v == selected_option:
                            map_id = k
                            break
                    if map_id is not None:
                        delete_process_map(map_id)
                        log_audit_event("DELETE", "ProcessMap", current_user, current_user_role, map_id, details={"name": selected_option})
                        st.toast(f"Deleted map: {selected_option}")
                        st.rerun()

    if selected_option == "➕ Create New Map":
        # Form to create new map
        with st.form(key=f"create_map_form_{project_id}", border=True):
            st.subheader("Create Process Map")
            new_map_name = st.text_input("Map Name", placeholder="e.g. NHS Jobs Recruitment Workflow")
            new_map_desc = st.text_area("Description", placeholder="Describe the purpose of this process map...")
            
            submit = st.form_submit_button("Create Map", type="primary", use_container_width=True)
            
            if submit:
                if not new_map_name.strip():
                    st.error("Map Name is required.")
                else:
                    # Create process map with seeded lanes
                    default_swimlanes = json.dumps(["Leadership", "Operations", "System Integrator"])
                    new_id = create_process_map(
                        project_id=project_id,
                        name=new_map_name.strip(),
                        description=new_map_desc.strip(),
                        swimlanes=default_swimlanes,
                        nodes="[]",
                        links="[]"
                    )
                    log_audit_event("CREATE", "ProcessMap", current_user, current_user_role, new_id, details={"name": new_map_name})
                    st.success(f"Created process map: {new_map_name}")
                    st.rerun()

    else:
        # Load the selected map
        map_id = None
        for k, v in map_options.items():
            if v == selected_option:
                map_id = k
                break
                
        if map_id is not None:
            map_data = get_process_map(map_id)
            
            if map_data:
                # Expander for renaming / deleting / description
                with st.expander("📝 Map Settings & Metadata", expanded=False):
                    edit_name = st.text_input("Edit Map Name", value=map_data["name"])
                    edit_desc = st.text_area("Edit Description", value=map_data.get("description") or "")
                    
                    col_save, col_del = st.columns([0.8, 0.2])
                    with col_save:
                        if st.button("Save Settings", key=f"save_settings_btn_{map_id}", use_container_width=True):
                            if edit_name.strip():
                                save_process_map(
                                    map_id=map_id,
                                    name=edit_name.strip(),
                                    description=edit_desc.strip(),
                                    swimlanes=map_data["swimlanes"],
                                    nodes=map_data["nodes"],
                                    links=map_data["links"]
                                )
                                log_audit_event("UPDATE", "ProcessMap", current_user, current_user_role, map_id, details={"settings_updated": True, "name": edit_name})
                                st.success("Map settings updated!")
                                st.rerun()
                            else:
                                st.error("Map name cannot be empty.")
                    with col_del:
                        if st.button("🗑️ Delete Map", key=f"delete_map_btn_{map_id}", use_container_width=True, type="secondary"):
                            delete_process_map(map_id)
                            log_audit_event("DELETE", "ProcessMap", current_user, current_user_role, map_id, details={"name": map_data["name"]})
                            st.toast(f"Deleted map: {map_data['name']}")
                            st.rerun()
                
                # Show description below options if exists
                if map_data.get("description"):
                    st.info(f"**Description:** {map_data['description']}")
                
                # Setup lists to feed the component
                try:
                    swimlanes_list = json.loads(map_data["swimlanes"]) if map_data.get("swimlanes") else []
                except Exception:
                    swimlanes_list = []
                    
                try:
                    nodes_list = json.loads(map_data["nodes"]) if map_data.get("nodes") else []
                except Exception:
                    nodes_list = []
                    
                try:
                    links_list = json.loads(map_data["links"]) if map_data.get("links") else []
                except Exception:
                    links_list = []

                # Render custom bidirectional HTML5 visual editor
                result = _mapper_component(
                    swimlanes=swimlanes_list,
                    nodes=nodes_list,
                    links=links_list,
                    key=f"visual_mapper_comp_{map_id}"
                )

                # Catch save callback from the visual iframe
                if result is not None:
                    # Convert result dictionary structure back to JSON strings for equality check
                    res_swimlanes = json.dumps(result.get("swimlanes", []))
                    res_nodes = json.dumps(result.get("nodes", []))
                    res_links = json.dumps(result.get("links", []))
                    
                    db_swimlanes = map_data.get("swimlanes")
                    db_nodes = map_data.get("nodes")
                    db_links = map_data.get("links")
                    
                    # Check if changed to save and prevent recursive reruns
                    if (res_swimlanes != db_swimlanes) or (res_nodes != db_nodes) or (res_links != db_links):
                        save_process_map(
                            map_id=map_id,
                            name=map_data["name"],
                            description=map_data.get("description") or "",
                            swimlanes=res_swimlanes,
                            nodes=res_nodes,
                            links=res_links
                        )
                        log_audit_event(
                            "UPDATE", "ProcessMap", current_user, current_user_role, map_id, 
                            details={"diagram_saved": True, "name": map_data["name"]}
                        )
                        st.toast("Diagram layout saved successfully!")
                        st.rerun()
            else:
                st.error("Error loading process map details.")
