# pages/19_🏆_Benefits_Realisation.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime
import altair as alt

# 1. Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import apply_custom_css, render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons
from core.database_utils import query, execute, fetch_one, log_audit_event, execute_many
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.state import get_app_state

# 2. Page Setup & Security
handle_page_entry()
app_state = get_app_state()
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Strategy & Planning"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

if not user_can("view_project_dashboard"): # Re-use existing permission
    st.error("🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this page.")
    st.stop()
st.title("🏆 Benefits Realisation")
st.caption("Define, track, and measure the value delivered by your project.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# 3. Context & Security Check
if selected_org == "All Organisations" or selected_prj == "All Projects" or current_org_id is None:
    st.warning("⚠️ Please select a specific Organisation and Project Stream in the sidebar.")
    st.stop()

res = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE name=? AND org_id=? AND is_deleted=0", (selected_prj, current_org_id))
pid = res[0] if res else None

if not pid:
    st.error(f"Could not find project '{selected_prj}' for {selected_org}.")
    st.stop()

# --- Helper: Realisation Pipeline Stage Config ---
REALISATION_STAGES = [
    "System Change",
    "Process Change",
    "Training",
    "Benefit Realised",
]

STAGE_ICONS = {
    "System Change":    "⚙️",
    "Process Change":   "🔄",
    "Training":         "🎓",
    "Benefit Realised": "🏆",
}

TASK_STATUS_COMPLETE = {"Complete", "Done", "Completed", "Closed"}

def _task_completion_pct(tasks_for_stage: list) -> float:
    """Return 0.0–1.0 completion fraction for a list of task dicts."""
    if not tasks_for_stage:
        return 0.0
    done = sum(1 for t in tasks_for_stage if (t.get("status") or "") in TASK_STATUS_COMPLETE)
    return done / len(tasks_for_stage)

def _delivery_readiness_score(all_linked_tasks: list) -> float:
    """Overall delivery readiness score (0–100) across all linked tasks."""
    return round(_task_completion_pct(all_linked_tasks) * 100, 1)

def _status_colour(pct: float) -> str:
    if pct >= 1.0:
        return "🟢"
    if pct >= 0.5:
        return "🟡"
    return "🔴"

def render_delivery_pipeline(benefit_id: int, linked_tasks_full: pd.DataFrame):
    """
    Renders the Dynamic Metric Linker pipeline panel for a single benefit.
    Shows stage-by-stage progress from System Change → Benefit Realised.
    """
    if linked_tasks_full.empty:
        st.info("No tasks linked yet. Link delivering tasks via **Manage Benefit Definition** below.")
        return

    all_tasks = linked_tasks_full.to_dict("records")
    readiness = _delivery_readiness_score(all_tasks)
    colour = _status_colour(readiness / 100)

    # --- Delivery Readiness Score Banner ---
    st.markdown(
        f"""
        <div style="
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e 0%, #16213e 100%);
            border: 1px solid #0f3460;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px 18px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        ">
            <span style="font-size:1.6rem;">{colour}</span>
            <div>
                <div style="color:#a0aec0; font-size:0.75rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.08em;">
                    Delivery Readiness Score
                </div>
                <div style="color:#e2e8f0; font-size:1.3rem; font-weight:700;">
                    {readiness}%
                    <span style="color:#718096; font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:400;">
                        &nbsp;({sum(1 for t in all_tasks if (t.get('status') or '') in TASK_STATUS_COMPLETE)}/{len(all_tasks)} tasks complete)
                    </span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        """,
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )

    # --- Stage Pipeline ---
    stage_cols = st.columns(len(REALISATION_STAGES))
    for col, stage in zip(stage_cols, REALISATION_STAGES):
        stage_tasks = [t for t in all_tasks if (t.get("realisation_stage") or "System Change") == stage]
        pct = _task_completion_pct(stage_tasks)
        bar_colour = "#48bb78" if pct >= 1.0 else ("#f6ad55" if pct >= 0.5 else "#fc8181")
        bar_w = max(4, int(pct * 100))

        with col:
            st.markdown(
                f"""
                <div style="
                    background:#1a202c;
                    border:1px solid #2d3748;
                    border-radius:8px;
                    padding:10px 12px;
                    text-align:center;
                    min-height:110px;
                ">
                    <div style="font-size:1.4rem;">{STAGE_ICONS[stage]}</div>
                    <div style="color:#e2e8f0;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:600;margin:4px 0 6px;">
                        {stage}
                    </div>
                    <div style="background:#2d3748;border-radius:4px;height:6px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:6px;">
                        <div style="background:{bar_colour};width:{bar_w}%;height:100%;border-radius:4px;transition:width 0.4s;"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="color:#a0aec0;font-size:0.7rem;">
                        {len(stage_tasks)} task{"s" if len(stage_tasks) != 1 else ""}
                        &nbsp;·&nbsp;{round(pct*100)}%
                    </div>
                </div>
                """,
                unsafe_allow_html=True,
            )

    st.markdown("<div style='margin-top:8px;'></div>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

    # --- Task Detail Table per Stage ---
    with st.expander("📋 View Linked Task Details by Stage", expanded=False):
        for stage in REALISATION_STAGES:
            stage_tasks = [t for t in all_tasks if (t.get("realisation_stage") or "System Change") == stage]
            if not stage_tasks:
                continue
            st.markdown(f"**{STAGE_ICONS[stage]} {stage}**")
            rows = []
            for t in stage_tasks:
                status = t.get("status") or "—"
                done = status in TASK_STATUS_COMPLETE
                rows.append({
                    "Task": t.get("task", "")[:70],
                    "Assigned To": t.get("assigned_to") or "—",
                    "Due Date": t.get("due_date") or "—",
                    "Status": f"✅ {status}" if done else f"🔲 {status}",
                    "Category": t.get("category") or "—",
                })
            df_stage = pd.DataFrame(rows)
            st.dataframe(df_stage, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)


# --- Add New Benefit Form ---
with st.expander("🎯 Define a New Benefit"):
    with st.form("new_benefit_form", clear_on_submit=True):
        st.subheader("Define a New Project Benefit")
        benefit_name = st.text_input("Benefit Title", placeholder="e.g., Reduce administrative overhead for staff rostering")

            if benefit_name and benefit_metric and benefit_target:
                execute(
                    "INSERT INTO benefits (project_id, name, description, owner, metric, target_value, baseline_value) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",

                )

                st.success(f"Benefit '{benefit_name}' has been defined.")
                st.rerun()
            else:
                st.error("Benefit Title, Metric, and Target Value are required.")

st.divider()

# --- Display Existing Benefits & Track Progress ---
df_benefits = query("SELECT * FROM benefits WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (pid,))

if df_benefits.empty:
    st.info("No benefits have been defined for this project yet. Use the form above to add one.")
else:
    st.subheader("📈 Benefit Tracking")

    # --- Pre-fetch all measurements for all benefits in this project ---
    benefit_ids = df_benefits['id'].tolist()
    placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(benefit_ids))
    all_measurements_df = query(f"SELECT * FROM benefit_measurements WHERE benefit_id IN ({placeholders}) AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY benefit_id, measurement_date ASC", tuple(benefit_ids)) if benefit_ids else pd.DataFrame()
    measurements_map = all_measurements_df.groupby('benefit_id').apply(lambda x: x.to_dict('records')).to_dict() if not all_measurements_df.empty else {}

    # --- Item 133: Pre-fetch linked tasks WITH full action detail + realisation_stage ---
    all_links_full_df = query(f"""
        SELECT
            l.benefit_id,
            l.realisation_stage,
            t.id,
            t.task,
            t.assigned_to,
            t.due_date,
            t.status,
            t.category
        FROM actions t
        JOIN benefit_task_links l ON t.id = l.task_id
        WHERE l.benefit_id IN ({placeholders})
          AND t.is_deleted = 0
        ORDER BY l.benefit_id, l.realisation_stage, t.due_date
    """, tuple(benefit_ids)) if benefit_ids else pd.DataFrame()

    links_full_map = (
        all_links_full_df.groupby('benefit_id').apply(lambda x: x.reset_index(drop=True))
        if not all_links_full_df.empty else pd.DataFrame()
    )

    # Compact link display map (for header caption)
    links_summary_map = (
        all_links_full_df.groupby('benefit_id').apply(lambda x: x.to_dict('records')).to_dict()
        if not all_links_full_df.empty else {}
    )

    # Query average ADKAR scores for this project
    adkar_avg_df = query("""
        SELECT AVG(adkar_awareness) as Awareness,
               AVG(adkar_desire) as Desire,
               AVG(adkar_knowledge) as Knowledge,
               AVG(adkar_ability) as Ability,
               AVG(adkar_reinforcement) as Reinforcement
        FROM stakeholders
        WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0
    """, (pid,))
    
    adkar_avg = {
        "Awareness": adkar_avg_df['Awareness'].iloc[0] or 0.0,
        "Desire": adkar_avg_df['Desire'].iloc[0] or 0.0,
        "Knowledge": adkar_avg_df['Knowledge'].iloc[0] or 0.0,
        "Ability": adkar_avg_df['Ability'].iloc[0] or 0.0,
        "Reinforcement": adkar_avg_df['Reinforcement'].iloc[0] or 0.0,
    } if not adkar_avg_df.empty else {k: 0.0 for k in ["Awareness", "Desire", "Knowledge", "Ability", "Reinforcement"]}

    for _, benefit in df_benefits.iterrows():
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.markdown(f"#### {benefit['name']}")
            st.caption(f"Owner: {benefit['owner']} | Target: {benefit['target_value']} {benefit['metric']}")
 
            # Header: linked task summary
            linked_tasks_summary = links_summary_map.get(benefit['id'], [])
            if linked_tasks_summary:
                links_str = " | ".join([f"🔗 Task {r['id']}" for r in linked_tasks_summary])
                st.caption(f"**Delivered by:** {links_str}")

            # ADKAR prerequisites
            benefit_adkar_df = query("SELECT adkar_element FROM benefit_adkar_links WHERE benefit_id = ?", (benefit['id'],))
            prereqs = benefit_adkar_df['adkar_element'].tolist() if not benefit_adkar_df.empty else []
            if prereqs:
                prereqs_badges = []
                for pr in prereqs:
                    avg_score = adkar_avg.get(pr, 0.0)
                    status_emoji = "🟢" if avg_score >= 3.0 else ("🟡" if avg_score >= 2.0 else "🔴")
                    prereqs_badges.append(f"{status_emoji} {pr} (Avg: {round(avg_score, 1)})")
                
                st.caption(f"**ADKAR Prerequisites:** {', '.join(prereqs_badges)}")

            if benefit['description']:
                st.write(benefit['description'])

            # --- Item 133: Dynamic Metric Linker Pipeline ---
            st.markdown("**🔗 Delivery Pipeline — System Change → User Benefit**")
            benefit_linked_df = (
                all_links_full_df[all_links_full_df['benefit_id'] == benefit['id']].reset_index(drop=True)
                if not all_links_full_df.empty else pd.DataFrame()
            )
            render_delivery_pipeline(benefit['id'], benefit_linked_df)

            st.divider()

            # --- Measurement Chart ---
            measurements_list = measurements_map.get(benefit['id'], [])
            df_measurements = pd.DataFrame(measurements_list) if measurements_list else pd.DataFrame()

            if not df_measurements.empty:
                df_measurements['measurement_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_measurements['measurement_date'])
                
                base_chart = alt.Chart(df_measurements).encode(
                    x=alt.X('measurement_date:T', title="Date")
                )
                
                line = base_chart.mark_line(point=True).encode(
                    y=alt.Y('value:Q', title=benefit['metric']),
                    tooltip=['measurement_date', 'value', 'notes']
                )

                rule = alt.Chart(pd.DataFrame({'target': [benefit['target_value']]})).mark_rule(color='green', strokeDash=[5,5]).encode(y='target:Q')
                
                baseline_val = benefit.get('baseline_value')
                if baseline_val is not None and not pd.isna(baseline_val):
                    baseline_rule = alt.Chart(pd.DataFrame({'baseline': [baseline_val]})).mark_rule(color='red', strokeDash=[3,3]).encode(y='baseline:Q')
                    st.altair_chart((line + rule + baseline_rule).interactive(), use_container_width=True)
                else:
                    st.altair_chart((line + rule).interactive(), use_container_width=True)
            else:
                st.info("No measurements logged yet for this benefit.")

            # Log a new measurement
            with st.expander("Log New Measurement"):
                with st.form(f"log_measurement_{benefit['id']}", clear_on_submit=True):
                    m_c1, m_c2, m_c3 = st.columns(3)
                    measurement_date = m_c1.date_input("Measurement Date", value=datetime.now())
                    measurement_value = m_c2.number_input("Value", step=1.0)
                    measurement_notes = m_c3.text_input("Notes (Optional)")

                    if st.form_submit_button('Log Measurement', use_container_width=True, type='primary'):
                        execute(
                            "INSERT INTO benefit_measurements (benefit_id, measurement_date, value, notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                            (benefit['id'], str(measurement_date), measurement_value, measurement_notes)
                        )
                        st.toast("Measurement logged!")
                        st.rerun()

            # Edit/Delete the benefit definition
            with st.expander("Manage Benefit Definition"):
                with st.form(f"edit_benefit_{benefit['id']}"):
                    edit_name = st.text_input("Benefit Title", value=benefit['name'], key=f"edit_name_{benefit['id']}")
                    edit_desc = st.text_area("Benefit Description", value=benefit['description'], key=f"edit_desc_{benefit['id']}")
                    
                    ed_c1, ed_c2, ed_c3, ed_c4 = st.columns(4)
                    edit_owner = ed_c1.text_input("Benefit Owner", value=benefit['owner'], key=f"edit_owner_{benefit['id']}")
                    edit_metric = ed_c2.text_input("Metric", value=benefit['metric'], key=f"edit_metric_{benefit['id']}")
                    edit_baseline = ed_c3.number_input("Baseline Value", value=float(benefit.get('baseline_value') or 0.0), step=1.0, key=f"edit_baseline_{benefit['id']}")
                    edit_target = ed_c4.number_input("Target Value", value=float(benefit['target_value']), step=1.0, key=f"edit_target_{benefit['id']}")

                    # --- Link to Tasks with Realisation Stage tagging ---
                    st.divider()
                    st.write("**🔗 Link to Delivering Tasks & Assign Realisation Stage**")
                    st.caption("Tag each task to the delivery stage it represents: System Change → Process Change → Training → Benefit Realised.")

                    df_tasks = query("SELECT id, task, status, assigned_to, due_date, category FROM actions WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY due_date", (pid,))
                    task_options = {row['id']: row['task'] for _, row in df_tasks.iterrows()} if not df_tasks.empty else {}

                    # Current links with stages
                    df_linked_tasks_detail = query(
                        "SELECT task_id, realisation_stage FROM benefit_task_links WHERE benefit_id = ?",
                        (benefit['id'],)
                    )
                    linked_task_ids = df_linked_tasks_detail['task_id'].tolist() if not df_linked_tasks_detail.empty else []
                    linked_stage_map = (
                        dict(zip(df_linked_tasks_detail['task_id'], df_linked_tasks_detail['realisation_stage']))
                        if not df_linked_tasks_detail.empty else {}
                    )

                    selected_task_ids = st.multiselect(
                        "Select tasks that deliver this benefit",
                        options=list(task_options.keys()),
                        format_func=lambda x: f"Task {x}: {task_options.get(x, 'Unknown Task')[:60]}",
                        default=linked_task_ids,
                        key=f"benefit_task_link_{benefit['id']}"
                    )

                    # Stage assignment per selected task
                    stage_assignments = {}
                    if selected_task_ids:
                        st.markdown("**Assign each linked task to a Realisation Stage:**")
                        for tid in selected_task_ids:
                            task_label = task_options.get(tid, f"Task {tid}")[:55]
                            current_stage = linked_stage_map.get(tid, "System Change")
                            stage_assignments[tid] = st.selectbox(
                                f"↳ {task_label}",
                                options=REALISATION_STAGES,
                                index=REALISATION_STAGES.index(current_stage) if current_stage in REALISATION_STAGES else 0,
                                key=f"stage_{benefit['id']}_{tid}"
                            )

                    # --- Link to ADKAR Prerequisites ---
                    st.divider()
                    st.write("**Link to ADKAR Prerequisites**")
                    adkar_elements = ["Awareness", "Desire", "Knowledge", "Ability", "Reinforcement"]
                    
                    df_linked_adkar = query("SELECT adkar_element FROM benefit_adkar_links WHERE benefit_id = ?", (benefit['id'],))
                    linked_adkar = df_linked_adkar['adkar_element'].tolist() if not df_linked_adkar.empty else []
                    
                    selected_adkar = st.multiselect(
                        "Select ADKAR elements required as prerequisites for this benefit",
                        options=adkar_elements,
                        default=linked_adkar,
                        key=f"benefit_adkar_link_{benefit['id']}"
                    )

                    if st.form_submit_button('💾 Save Definition Changes', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
                        execute("UPDATE benefits SET name=?, description=?, owner=?, metric=?, target_value=?, baseline_value=? WHERE id=?",
                                (edit_name, edit_desc, edit_owner, edit_metric, edit_target, edit_baseline, benefit['id']))

                        # --- Item 133: Sync task links with realisation_stage ---
                        to_add = [tid for tid in selected_task_ids if tid not in linked_task_ids]
                        if to_add:
                            execute_many(
                                "INSERT INTO benefit_task_links (benefit_id, task_id, realisation_stage) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                                [(benefit['id'], tid, stage_assignments.get(tid, "System Change")) for tid in to_add]
                            )

                        # Update stage for already-linked tasks that may have changed stage
                        to_update_stage = [
                            tid for tid in selected_task_ids
                            if tid in linked_task_ids and stage_assignments.get(tid) != linked_stage_map.get(tid)
                        ]
                        for tid in to_update_stage:
                            execute(
                                "UPDATE benefit_task_links SET realisation_stage = ? WHERE benefit_id = ? AND task_id = ?",
                                (stage_assignments.get(tid, "System Change"), benefit['id'], tid)
                            )

                        to_remove = [tid for tid in linked_task_ids if tid not in selected_task_ids]
                        if to_remove:
                            rem_placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(to_remove))
                            execute(f"DELETE FROM benefit_task_links WHERE benefit_id = ? AND task_id IN ({rem_placeholders})", (benefit['id'], *to_remove))

                        # Sync ADKAR links
                        to_add_adkar = [elem for elem in selected_adkar if elem not in linked_adkar]
                        if to_add_adkar:
                            execute_many("INSERT INTO benefit_adkar_links (benefit_id, adkar_element) VALUES (?, ?)", [(benefit['id'], elem) for elem in to_add_adkar])
                            
                        to_remove_adkar = [elem for elem in linked_adkar if elem not in selected_adkar]
                        if to_remove_adkar:
                            placeholders_adkar = ','.join(['?'] * len(to_remove_adkar))
                            execute(f"DELETE FROM benefit_adkar_links WHERE benefit_id = ? AND adkar_element IN ({placeholders_adkar})", (benefit['id'], *to_remove_adkar))

                        log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Benefit", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", benefit['id'], details={"name": edit_name})
                        st.rerun()

                if st.button('🗑️ Delete Benefit', key=f"delete_benefit_{benefit['id']}", use_container_width=True, type='primary'):
                    execute("UPDATE benefits SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = ?", (benefit['id'],)); st.rerun()

    # AI Benefits Case Study Generator
    st.divider()
    st.subheader("🤖 AI Benefits Realisation Case Study Generator")
    st.caption("Generate a professional transformation case study based on defined targets and logged measurements.")
    
    if st.button('🧠 Generate Case Study Report', type='primary', key='btn_generate_benefits_case', use_container_width=True):
        with st.spinner("AI is analyzing benefits realization metrics..."):
            # Gather benefit data
            df_all_benefits = query("SELECT id, name, baseline_value, target_value, metric FROM benefits WHERE project_id=? AND is_deleted=0", (pid,))
            
            benefits_context = ""
            if not df_all_benefits.empty:
                for _, b in df_all_benefits.iterrows():
                    # Get latest measurement
                    latest_m = query("SELECT value, measurement_date FROM benefit_measurements WHERE benefit_id=? AND is_deleted=0 ORDER BY measurement_date DESC LIMIT 1", (b['id'],))
                    latest_val = latest_m.iloc[0]['value'] if not latest_m.empty else "No measurements logged"
                    latest_date = latest_m.iloc[0]['measurement_date'] if not latest_m.empty else "N/A"
                    
                    # Get pipeline readiness for this benefit
                    pipeline_df = query(f"""
                        SELECT l.realisation_stage, t.status FROM actions t
                        JOIN benefit_task_links l ON t.id = l.task_id
                        WHERE l.benefit_id = ? AND t.is_deleted = 0
                    """, (b['id'],))
                    if not pipeline_df.empty:
                        p_tasks = pipeline_df.to_dict("records")
                        p_score = round(_task_completion_pct(p_tasks) * 100, 1)
                        pipeline_summary = f"Delivery Readiness: {p_score}% ({len(p_tasks)} linked tasks)"
                    else:
                        pipeline_summary = "No tasks linked"
                    
                    benefits_context += f"- **Benefit:** {b['name']}\n  Baseline: {b['baseline_value']} {b['metric']}\n  Target: {b['target_value']} {b['metric']}\n  Latest Measurement: {latest_val} {b['metric']} (as of {latest_date})\n  Pipeline: {pipeline_summary}\n\n"
            else:
                benefits_context = "No benefits defined yet."
                
            prompt = f"""You are an NHSBSA Business Transformation Lead conducting a post-go-live benefits realisation review for:
- Trust: {selected_org}
- Project Stream: {selected_prj}

**Transformation Metrics Summary:**
{benefits_context}

**Required Case Study Sections:**
1. **Executive Summary:** A clear statement of the value delivered by this workforce system rollout.
2. **Benefits Realisation & Target Drift Analysis:** Assess which targets were successfully met, which were missed or are drifting, and explain typical operational reasons for this in NHS trusts.
3. **Delivery Pipeline Health:** Comment on the delivery readiness scores reported above and what they mean for sustained benefit realisation.
4. **Downstream Productivity Impact:** How these changes improve ward efficiency, reduce staffing friction, and optimize NHS funds.
5. **Actionable Recommendations:** Suggest 2-3 specific coaching or operational activities to sustain and maximize these benefits.

Write a formal NHS governance case study report with clean markdown headers."""
            
            try:
                from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response
                case_report = generate_ai_response(prompt, temperature=0.3, bypass_cache=True)
                st.session_state.benefits_case_report = case_report
                st.rerun()
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"Failed to generate case study: {e}")
                
    if 'benefits_case_report' in st.session_state:
        st.info("**AI Benefits Realisation Case Study:**")
        st.markdown(st.session_state.benefits_case_report)
        
        report_bytes = st.session_state.benefits_case_report.encode('utf-8')
        
        from core.pdf_utils import generate_benefits_case_study_pdf
        pdf_bytes = generate_benefits_case_study_pdf(selected_prj, selected_org, st.session_state.benefits_case_report)
        
        d_col1, d_col2 = st.columns(2)
        with d_col1:
            st.download_button(
                label="📥 Download Case Study Report (TXT)",
                data=report_bytes,
                file_name=f"Benefits_Case_Study_{selected_org.replace(' ', '_')}.txt",
                mime="text/plain",
                use_container_width=True
            )
        with d_col2:
            st.download_button(
                label="📥 Download Case Study Report (PDF)",
                data=pdf_bytes,
                file_name=f"Benefits_Case_Study_{selected_org.replace(' ', '_')}.pdf",
                mime="application/pdf",
                use_container_width=True
            )
            
        if st.button("🧹 Clear Case Study", use_container_width=True):
            del st.session_state.benefits_case_report
            st.rerun()

render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)


# --- 1.5 WIDGET DATA FUNCTIONS (with Caching) ---
@st.cache_data(ttl=300) # Cache for 5 minutes
def get_my_escalated_queries_data(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, user_name: str):
    return query(f"""
        SELECT o.name as Trust, p.name as Stream, cq.contact_name, cq.platform_domain, cq.interaction_text, cq.date_raised
        FROM customer_queries cq
        JOIN projects p ON cq.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
        WHERE {m_filter} AND cq.owner = ? AND cq.is_escalated = 1 AND cq.resolution_status NOT IN ('Resolved', 'Closed')
    """, (*prms, user_name))

@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def get_my_overdue_tasks_data(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, user_name: str, today_str: str):
    return query(f"""
        SELECT o.name as Trust, p.name as Stream, a.task, a.due_date
        FROM actions a JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
        WHERE {m_filter} AND a.assigned_to = ? AND a.status != 'Closed' AND a.due_date < ?
    """, (*prms, user_name, today_str))

@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def get_my_upcoming_tasks_data(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, user_name: str, today_str: str, future_date_str: str):
    return query(f"""
        SELECT o.name as Trust, p.name as Stream, a.task, a.due_date
        FROM actions a JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
        WHERE {m_filter} AND a.assigned_to = ? AND a.status != 'Closed' AND a.due_date BETWEEN ? AND ?
    """, (*prms, user_name, today_str, future_date_str))

@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def get_my_owned_risks_data(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, user_name: str):
    return query(f"""
        SELECT o.name as Trust, p.name as Stream, r.description, r.impact, r.likelihood, r.risk_score
        FROM risks r JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.id JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
        WHERE {m_filter} AND r.owner = ? AND r.status = 'Open'
        ORDER BY r.risk_score DESC
    """, (*prms, user_name))

@st.cache_data(ttl=300)
def get_my_projects_health_data(project_ids: List[int]) -> Dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Fetches all data needed for health scores for a list of projects in bulk."""
    if not project_ids:
        return {"risks": pd.DataFrame(), "tasks": pd.DataFrame(), "sentiments": pd.DataFrame()}

    placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(project_ids))
    
    risks_df = query(f"SELECT project_id, risk_score FROM risks WHERE project_id IN ({placeholders}) AND status='Open' AND is_deleted=0", tuple(project_ids))
    tasks_df = query(f"SELECT project_id, status FROM actions WHERE project_id IN ({placeholders}) AND is_deleted=0", tuple(project_ids))
    
    # Combine sentiment from both meetings and emails
    sentiments_df = query(f"""
        SELECT project_id, sentiment_score FROM meetings WHERE project_id IN ({placeholders}) AND sentiment_score IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0
        UNION ALL
        SELECT project_id, sentiment_score FROM emails WHERE project_id IN ({placeholders}) AND sentiment_score IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0
    """, tuple(project_ids + project_ids))
    
    return {"risks": risks_df, "tasks": tasks_df, "sentiments": sentiments_df}

def render_my_project_health_scores(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, user_id: Optional[int], **kwargs):
    st.write("**My Project Health Scores**")
    if not user_id:
        st.warning("Could not find your user ID.")
        return

    # Fetch projects the user is allocated to
    my_projects_df = query(f"""
        SELECT p.id, o.name as Trust, p.name as Stream, p.rag_status
        FROM resource_allocations ra
        JOIN projects p ON ra.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
        WHERE {m_filter} AND ra.user_id = ? AND ra.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status NOT IN ('Complete', 'Withdrawn')
    """, (*prms, user_id))

    if my_projects_df.empty:
        st.info("You are not allocated to any active projects in this filter to calculate health scores.")
    else:
        project_ids = my_projects_df['id'].tolist()
        health_data = get_my_projects_health_data(project_ids)
        
        avg_risks = health_data['risks'].groupby('project_id')['risk_score'].mean()
        avg_sentiments = health_data['sentiments'].groupby('project_id')['sentiment_score'].mean()
        
        task_counts = health_data['tasks'].groupby('project_id')['status'].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)
        if not task_counts.empty:
            closed_statuses = get_config('TASK_STATUS_CLOSED') or ["Closed", "Done", "Cancelled", "Completed"]
            closed_cols = [col for col in closed_statuses if col in task_counts.columns]
            task_counts['completion_rate'] = task_counts[closed_cols].sum(axis=1) / task_counts.sum(axis=1)

        health_scores = []
        for _, project_row in my_projects_df.iterrows():
            pid = project_row['id']
            rag_score = {"Green": 1.0, "Amber": 0.5, "Red": 0.0}.get(project_row['rag_status'], 0.0)
            risk_health_score = 1.0 - ((avg_risks.get(pid, 0.0)) / 25.0)
            task_completion_rate = task_counts.loc[pid]['completion_rate'] if 'completion_rate' in task_counts.columns and pid in task_counts.index else 1.0
            sentiment_health_score = (avg_sentiments.get(pid, 0.0) + 1.0) / 2.0
            
            score = round(((rag_score * 0.3) + (risk_health_score * 0.3) + (task_completion_rate * 0.2) + (sentiment_health_score * 0.2)) * 100, 1)
            health_scores.append({"Trust": project_row['Trust'], "Stream": project_row['Stream'], "Health Score": f"{score}%"})
        st.dataframe(pd.DataFrame(health_scores), hide_index=True, use_container_width=True)

def render_my_upcoming_meetings(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, user_name: str, **kwargs):
    st.write("**My Upcoming Meetings (Next 14 Days)**")
    fourteen_days_from_now = (today_date + timedelta(days=14))
    # The attendees column is a TEXT field with comma-separated names.
    # We need to use LIKE to find if the user's name is in the string.
    my_meetings_df = query(f"""
        SELECT o.name as Trust, p.name as Stream, mt.date, mt.summary
        FROM meetings mt
        JOIN projects p ON mt.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
        WHERE {m_filter} AND mt.attendees LIKE ? AND mt.date BETWEEN ? AND ? AND mt.is_deleted = 0
        ORDER BY mt.date ASC
    """, (*prms, f"%{user_name}%", str(today_date), str(fourteen_days_from_now)))
    if my_meetings_df.empty:
        st.info("You have no meetings scheduled in the next 14 days.")
    else:
        st.dataframe(my_meetings_df, hide_index=True, use_container_width=True)

def render_task_completion_rates(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, **kwargs):
    st.write("**Task Completion Rates (Weekly Trend)**")
    unaliased_filter, unaliased_params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im) # Regenerate for unaliased query
    df_tc = query(f"SELECT a.date_completed FROM actions a JOIN projects ON a.project_id = projects.id {join_logic_unaliased} WHERE {unaliased_filter} AND a.status IN ('Closed', 'Done', 'Cancelled') AND a.date_completed IS NOT NULL", params=unaliased_params)
    if not df_tc.empty:
        df_tc['date_completed'] = pd.to_datetime(df_tc['date_completed']).dt.to_period('W').dt.start_time
        tc_counts = df_tc.groupby('date_completed').size().reset_index(name='Tasks Completed')
        st.altair_chart(alt.Chart(tc_counts).mark_bar(color='#00703c').encode(
            x=alt.X('date_completed:T', title="Week"), 
            y=alt.Y('Tasks Completed:Q', title="Closed Tasks"),
            tooltip=['date_completed:T', 'Tasks Completed:Q']
        ).properties(height=250).interactive(), use_container_width=True)
    else:
        st.info("No closed tasks recorded for trend analysis.")

def render_global_burnup_chart(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, **kwargs):
    st.write("**Global Action Burn-up (Scope vs Delivery)**")
    unaliased_filter, unaliased_params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im) # Regenerate for unaliased query
    df_bu = query(f"SELECT a.start_date, a.date_completed, a.status FROM actions a JOIN projects ON a.project_id = projects.id {join_logic_unaliased} WHERE {unaliased_filter} AND a.is_deleted=0 AND a.start_date IS NOT NULL", params=unaliased_params)
    if not df_bu.empty:
        df_bu['start_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_bu['start_date'], errors='coerce')
        df_bu['date_completed'] = pd.to_datetime(df_bu['date_completed'], errors='coerce')
        min_date = df_bu['start_date'].min()
        max_date = pd.Timestamp(datetime.now())
        if pd.notnull(min_date):
            date_range = pd.date_range(start=min_date, end=max_date, freq='W')
            bu_data = [{"Date": d, "Total Scope": len(df_bu[df_bu['start_date'] <= d]), "Completed": len(df_bu[(df_bu['status'].isin(['Closed', 'Done', 'Cancelled'])) & (df_bu['date_completed'] <= d)])} for d in date_range]
            bu_df = pd.DataFrame(bu_data)
            base_bu = alt.Chart(bu_df).encode(x=alt.X('Date:T', title="Timeline"))
            scope_line = base_bu.mark_line(color='#d4351c', strokeDash=[5,5]).encode(y=alt.Y('Total Scope:Q', title="Tasks"))
            done_line = base_bu.mark_line(color='#00703c', strokeWidth=3).encode(y='Completed:Q')
            st.altair_chart((scope_line + done_line).properties(height=250).interactive(), use_container_width=True)
    else:
        st.info("No task timeline data available.")

def render_stakeholder_vibe_metric(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, **kwargs):
    st.write("**Stakeholder Vibe**")
    unaliased_filter, unaliased_params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im) # Regenerate for unaliased query
    # This needs to be recalculated here since it's on a new page
    combined_query = f"""
        SELECT 
            (SELECT AVG(sentiment_score) FROM meetings JOIN projects ON meetings.project_id = projects.id {join_logic_unaliased} WHERE {unaliased_filter} AND meetings.sentiment_score IS NOT NULL AND meetings.document_type = 'Email Correspondence') as email_vibe,
            (SELECT AVG(sentiment_score) FROM meetings JOIN projects ON meetings.project_id = projects.id {join_logic_unaliased} WHERE {unaliased_filter} AND meetings.sentiment_score IS NOT NULL AND meetings.document_type = 'Meeting Minutes') as meeting_vibe,
            (SELECT AVG(sentiment_score) FROM actions JOIN projects ON actions.project_id = projects.id {join_logic_unaliased} WHERE {unaliased_filter} AND actions.sentiment_score IS NOT NULL) as action_vibe
    """
    metrics_data = query(combined_query, params=(*unaliased_params, *unaliased_params, *unaliased_params))
    if not metrics_data.empty:
        email_vibe = metrics_data['email_vibe'].iloc[0] if pd.notnull(metrics_data['email_vibe'].iloc[0]) else 0
        meeting_vibe = metrics_data['meeting_vibe'].iloc[0] if pd.notnull(metrics_data['meeting_vibe'].iloc[0]) else 0
        action_vibe = metrics_data['action_vibe'].iloc[0] if pd.notnull(metrics_data['action_vibe'].iloc[0]) else 0
        avg_vibe = (email_vibe * 0.5) + (meeting_vibe * 0.3) + (action_vibe * 0.2)
    else:
        avg_vibe = 0
    vibe_label = "Positive" if avg_vibe > 0.1 else "Negative" if avg_vibe < -0.1 else "Neutral"
    st.metric(vibe_label, "", delta=f"{avg_vibe:.1f}")
    st.caption("Weighted average of email, meeting, and task update sentiment.")

def render_rag_narrative_drafter(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, user_name: str, user_id: Optional[int], **kwargs):
    st.write("🤖 **RAG Narrative Auto-Drafter**")
    st.caption("Draft and save RAG progress justification narratives for your active projects using local AI.")
    
    if not user_id:
        st.warning("User context missing.")
        return
        
    # Get user's active projects
    my_projects = query(f"""
        SELECT p.id, o.name as org_name, p.name as proj_name, p.status, p.rag_status, p.rag_narrative
        FROM resource_allocations ra
        JOIN projects p ON ra.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
        WHERE {m_filter} AND ra.user_id = ? AND ra.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status NOT IN ('Complete', 'Withdrawn')
    """, (*prms, user_id))
    
    if my_projects.empty:
        st.info("You have no active projects allocated to you to draft narratives for.")
        return
        
    # Select box to select which project to draft for
    project_options = {row['id']: f"{row['org_name']} - {row['proj_name']}" for _, row in my_projects.iterrows()}
    sel_pid = st.selectbox("Select Project to Draft Narrative", options=list(project_options.keys()), format_func=lambda x: project_options[x], key=f"rag_drafter_pid_sel_{user_id}")
    
    if sel_pid:
        proj_row = my_projects[my_projects['id'] == sel_pid].iloc[0]
        curr_rag = proj_row['rag_status'] or "Green"
        
        # Display current narrative
        st.text_area("Current Saved Narrative", value=proj_row['rag_narrative'] or "", disabled=True, height=60, key=f"curr_narrative_disp_{sel_pid}")
        
        # Display latest pre-populated weekly draft narrative if it exists
        latest_weekly_draft = query(
            "SELECT draft_narrative, created_at FROM ai_project_status_drafts WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1",
            (sel_pid,)
        )
        if not latest_weekly_draft.empty:
            w_draft_row = latest_weekly_draft.iloc[0]
            st.info(f"🤖 **Weekly Pre-populated AI Status Draft** ({w_draft_row['created_at']}):\n\n{w_draft_row['draft_narrative']}")
            if st.button("📋 Use Weekly Draft Narrative", key=f"use_weekly_draft_btn_{sel_pid}", use_container_width=True):
                st.session_state[f"draft_narrative_val_{sel_pid}"] = w_draft_row['draft_narrative']
                st.rerun()

        # Select RAG to draft for
        draft_rag = st.selectbox("Draft Narrative for RAG Status", ["Green", "Amber", "Red"], index=["Green", "Amber", "Red"].index(curr_rag) if curr_rag in ["Green", "Amber", "Red"] else 0, key=f"draft_rag_sel_{sel_pid}")
        
        # Draft Narrative Button
        if st.button('🤖 Generate AI RAG Narrative', type='primary', key=f'btn_draft_rag_narrative_{sel_pid}', use_container_width=True):
            with st.spinner("Analyzing tasks and risks to draft narrative..."):
                # Fetch tasks and risks
                df_act = query("SELECT task, status, due_date FROM actions WHERE project_id=? AND status='Open' AND is_deleted=0", (sel_pid,))
                df_rsk = query("SELECT impact, description, mitigation FROM risks WHERE project_id=? AND status='Open' AND is_deleted=0", (sel_pid,))
                
                tasks_str = df_act.to_string(index=False) if not df_act.empty else "No open tasks."
                risks_str = df_rsk.to_string(index=False) if not df_rsk.empty else "No open risks."
                
                from core.prompts import RAG_JUSTIFICATION_PROMPT_TEMPLATE
                from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response
                
                context = f"Project: {project_options[sel_pid]}\nOpen Tasks:\n{tasks_str}\nOpen Risks:\n{risks_str}"
                prompt = RAG_JUSTIFICATION_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(new_rag=draft_rag, context=context)
                
                try:
                    res_narrative = generate_ai_response(prompt=prompt, temperature=0.2, bypass_cache=True)
                    st.session_state[f"draft_narrative_val_{sel_pid}"] = res_narrative
                except Exception as e:
                    st.error(f"Failed to generate narrative: {e}")
                    
        # If draft exists in session state
        sess_key = f"draft_narrative_val_{sel_pid}"
        if sess_key in st.session_state:
            drafted_text = st.text_area("Review & Edit Drafted Narrative", value=st.session_state[sess_key], height=150, key=f"edit_draft_narrative_{sel_pid}")
            
            col_d1, col_d2 = st.columns(2)
            if col_d1.button("💾 Save to Project & Update RAG", type="primary", use_container_width=True, key=f"save_rag_narrative_{sel_pid}"):
                execute("UPDATE projects SET rag_status=?, rag_narrative=? WHERE id=?", (draft_rag, drafted_text, sel_pid))
                
                # Audit log
                from core.database_utils import log_audit_event
                log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Project", user_name, "Implementation Advisor (IA)", sel_pid, 
                                details={"rag_status": draft_rag, "rag_narrative": drafted_text, "source": "Dashboard Widget"})
                
                # Clean up session state
                del st.session_state[sess_key]
                st.success("RAG Status and Narrative updated successfully!")
                st.rerun()
                
            if col_d2.button("❌ Discard", use_container_width=True, key=f"discard_rag_narrative_{sel_pid}"):
                del st.session_state[sess_key]
                st.rerun()

def render_my_we_care_awards(user_id: Optional[int], **kwargs):
    st.write("⭐ **My We CARE Awards Summary**")
    if not user_id:
        st.warning("User context missing.")
        return
        
    # Get total count
    awards_cnt = fetch_one("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM we_care_awards WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (user_id,))
    total_stars = awards_cnt[0] if awards_cnt else 0
    
    st.metric("Total We CARE Stars Received", total_stars)
    
    latest_df = query("""
        SELECT date_received, received_from, value_category, citation 
        FROM we_care_awards 
        WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 
        ORDER BY date_received DESC LIMIT 3
    """, (user_id,))
    
    if latest_df.empty:
        st.info("No stars logged yet.")
    else:
        st.write("**Latest Stars Received:**")
        for _, row in latest_df.iterrows():
            emojis = {
                "Thank you": "👏",
                "Happy birthday": "🎂",
                "Living our values": "🫶",
                "Welcome": "🤝",
                "Happy workversary": "📅",
                "Happy retirement": "🎆",
                "Congratulations": "🎉",
                "Friendship": "💚"
            }
            badge_emoji = emojis.get(row['value_category'], "⭐")
            
            st.markdown(f"**{badge_emoji} {row['value_category']}** from *{row['received_from']}* ({row['date_received']})")
            st.caption(f"\"{row['citation']}\"")
            
    st.page_link("pages/45_⭐_We_CARE_Awards.py", label="Open We CARE Awards Page", use_container_width=True)

        if STREAMLIT_SORTABLES_AVAILABLE:

            all_widgets = list(WIDGET_LIBRARY.keys())

            form_inactive_widgets = [w for w in all_widgets if w not in form_active_widgets]

                {'header': 'Inactive Widgets', 'items': form_inactive_widgets}
            ]

            sorted_items = sort_items(items_for_sorting, multi_containers=True)
            new_num_columns = st.slider("Number of Columns", 1, 4, value=num_columns_config)
            
            if st.form_submit_button('Save Configuration', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
                new_active_widgets = sorted_items[0]['items']
                new_config = {"widgets": new_active_widgets, "columns": new_num_columns}
                if current_user:
                    execute("UPDATE rit_team SET dashboard_config = ? WHERE name = ?", (json.dumps(new_config), current_user))
                st.toast("Dashboard saved!")
                st.rerun()
        else:
            st.warning("`streamlit-sortables` is not installed, so drag-and-drop is disabled. For a better experience, please run: `pip install streamlit-sortables`", icon="⚠️")
            st.write("Select and arrange the widgets for your personal dashboard.")
            selected_widgets = st.multiselect("Select Widgets", options=list(WIDGET_LIBRARY.keys()), default=active_widgets_config)
            new_num_columns = st.slider("Number of Columns", 1, 4, value=num_columns_config)
            if st.form_submit_button('Save Configuration', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
                new_config = {"widgets": selected_widgets, "columns": new_num_columns}
                if current_user:
                    execute("UPDATE rit_team SET dashboard_config = ? WHERE name = ?", (json.dumps(new_config), current_user))
                st.toast("Dashboard saved!")
                st.rerun()

# --- 4. RENDER THE DASHBOARD ---
if not active_widgets_config:
    st.info("Your dashboard is empty. Add some widgets using the configuration expander above.")
else:
    cols = st.columns(num_columns_config)
    for i, widget_name in enumerate(active_widgets_config):
        if widget_name in WIDGET_LIBRARY:
            with cols[i % num_columns_config]:
                with st.container(border=True):
                    # All widgets are now called with the same signature for consistency
                    WIDGET_LIBRARY[widget_name](
                        m_filter=master_filter, 
                        prms=tuple(params), 
                        user_name=current_user, 
                        user_id=current_user_id
                    )

# pages/91_🏢_Organisations.py
import streamlit as st
from typing import List, Dict, Any
from datetime import datetime

import pandas as pd
# Custom Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, render_page_navigation_buttons, handle_page_entry
from core.database_utils import (

# --- RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) ---
handle_page_entry()
if not user_can("view_management_console"):
    st.error(f"🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this page.")
    st.info("Please contact a System Administrator if you require access.")
    st.stop()

# 1. Page Setup
app_state = get_app_state()
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Administration"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

render_main_editor_modal()

current_user_role = app_state.user.current_user_role or "System"

# 2. Dynamic Configuration Fetching
SUB_REGIONS = sorted(list(get_region_map().keys()))

st.title("🏢 Manage Organisations")
st.caption("Administer Trust / Organisation details and their regional mappings.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# Button to add a new organisation
if st.button('➕ Add New Trust / Organisation', use_container_width=True, type='primary'):
    st.session_state.modal_edit_entity = {
        "type": "add_organisation",
        "additional_data": {"sub_regions": SUB_REGIONS}
    }
    st.rerun()

st.divider()
st.header("📤 Bulk Upload Organisations")
st.caption("Upload a CSV file to add or update multiple organisations at once.")

with st.expander("Bulk Upload Organisations"):
    # 1. Download template
    template_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
        "name", "region", "org_group", "exclude_digest",
        "address_line_1", "address_line_2", "city", "county", "postcode"
    ])
    
    @st.cache_data
    def to_csv(df):
        # Use io.StringIO to handle the CSV in memory
        output = io.StringIO()
        df.to_csv(output, index=False)
        return output.getvalue().encode('utf-8')

    csv_data = to_csv(template_df)
    st.download_button(label='📥 Download Template (CSV)', data=csv_data, file_name='organisation_upload_template.csv', mime='text/csv', use_container_width=True)

    st.divider()

    # Fetch all current org data for export
    all_orgs_df = query("SELECT name, region, org_group, exclude_digest, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, county, postcode FROM orgs WHERE is_deleted=0 ORDER BY name")

    # Convert to CSV using the existing helper function
    all_orgs_csv = to_csv(all_orgs_df)

    # Create the download button for existing data
    st.download_button(label='📥 Download All Current Organisations (for editing)', data=all_orgs_csv, file_name='all_organisations_export.csv', mime='text/csv', help='Download the current list of all organisations to add addresses and re-upload.', use_container_width=True)
    # 2. Upload file
    uploaded_file = st.file_uploader("Upload completed template", type=["csv"])

    if uploaded_file:
        try:
            upload_df = pd.read_csv(uploaded_file)
            
            st.write("### Please verify the data before committing:")
            
            required_cols = ["name", "region"]
            missing_cols = [col for col in required_cols if col not in upload_df.columns]
            if missing_cols:
                st.error(f"Upload failed. The following required columns are missing from your CSV: {', '.join(missing_cols)}")
            else:
                # Fill NaN values for optional columns
                upload_df['exclude_digest'] = upload_df['exclude_digest'].fillna(0).astype(int)
                # NEW: Fill NaN for address and group fields
                for col in ["org_group", "address_line_1", "address_line_2", "city", "county", "postcode"]:
                    if col not in upload_df.columns:
                        upload_df[col] = ''
                    upload_df[col] = upload_df[col].fillna('')
                
                existing_orgs_df = query("SELECT id, name FROM orgs WHERE is_deleted=0")
                existing_orgs_map = dict(zip(existing_orgs_df['name'], existing_orgs_df['id']))
                
                upload_df['Status'] = upload_df['name'].apply(lambda x: 'New' if x not in existing_orgs_map else 'Update')
                
                st.dataframe(upload_df)

                if st.button('✅ Confirm and Commit to Database', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
                    with st.spinner("Processing and updating organisations..."):
                        updated_count = 0
                        inserted_count = 0
                        
                        for _, row in upload_df.iterrows():
                            if not row['name'] or not row['region']:
                                st.warning(f"Skipping row with missing required field: {row.get('name', 'N/A')}")
                                continue

                            if row['Status'] == 'Update':
                                org_id = existing_orgs_map[row['name']]
                                execute("UPDATE orgs SET region=?, org_group=?, exclude_digest=?, address_line_1=?, address_line_2=?, city=?, county=?, postcode=? WHERE id=?",
                                        (row['region'], row['org_group'], row['exclude_digest'], row['address_line_1'], row['address_line_2'], row['city'], row['county'], row['postcode'], org_id))
                                updated_count += 1
                            else: # New
                                execute("INSERT INTO orgs (name, region, org_group, exclude_digest, last_updated, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, county, postcode) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, '0', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                        (row['name'], row['region'], row['org_group'], row['exclude_digest'], row['address_line_1'], row['address_line_2'], row['city'], row['county'], row['postcode']))
                                inserted_count += 1

                        log_audit_event("BULK_UPDATE", "Organisation", current_user, current_user_role, details={"inserted": inserted_count, "updated": updated_count})
                        st.success(f"Database updated! Inserted: {inserted_count} new organisations. Updated: {updated_count} existing organisations.")
                        st.cache_data.clear()
                        st.rerun()

        except Exception as e:
            st.error(f"An error occurred while processing the file: {e}")

st.divider()
st.subheader("🏢 Existing Organisations")
df_org_inv = query("SELECT * FROM orgs WHERE is_deleted=0 ORDER BY name ASC")

if df_org_inv.empty:
    st.info("No organisations registered yet.")
else:
    st.dataframe(df_org_inv, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
    
    org_options = {}
    for _, row in df_org_inv.iterrows():
        display_label = row['name']
        group = row.get('org_group')
        if pd.notna(group) and str(group).strip() and str(group).lower() not in ('nan', 'none'):
            display_label += f" ({group})"
        org_options[row['id']] = display_label
    org_options[0] = "Select an organisation to manage..."
    
    selected_org_id = st.selectbox("Manage Organisation", options=list(org_options.keys()), format_func=lambda x: org_options[x])

    if st.button('Manage Selected Organisation', disabled=selected_org_id == 0, use_container_width=True):
        org_data = df_org_inv[df_org_inv['id'] == selected_org_id].iloc[0].to_dict()
        
        # Fetch custom fields for this specific org

        additional_data = {

        }
        
        st.session_state['modal_edit_entity'] = {
            "type": "organisation",
            "data": org_data,
            "additional_data": additional_data
        }
        st.rerun()

            ),

                required=True,
            ),
        },
        use_container_width=True,
        hide_index=True,
        key="project_streams_editor"
    )

    if st.button('Save Changes', use_container_width=True, type='primary'):
        original_consent_map = df_inv.set_index('id')['ai_consent_given'].to_dict()
        original_status_map = df_inv.set_index('id')['status'].to_dict()
        
        consent_updates = []
        status_updates = []

        for _, row in edited_df.iterrows():
            project_id = row['id']
            if bool(original_consent_map.get(project_id, 0)) != bool(row['ai_consent_given']):
                consent_updates.append((int(row['ai_consent_given']), project_id))
            
            if original_status_map.get(project_id) != row['status']:
                status_updates.append((row['status'], project_id))
        
        total_updates = 0
        if consent_updates:
            execute_many("UPDATE projects SET ai_consent_given = ? WHERE id = ?", consent_updates)
            log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Project", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", None, details={"message": f"Bulk update of AI consent for {len(consent_updates)} projects."})
            total_updates += len(consent_updates)
        
        if status_updates:
            try:
                for status, project_id in status_updates:
                    update_project_phase(project_id, status)
                log_audit_event("UPDATE", "Project", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", None, details={"message": f"Bulk update of status for {len(status_updates)} projects."})
                total_updates += len(status_updates)
            except ValueError as e:
                st.error(str(e))
                st.stop()
        
        if total_updates > 0:
            st.toast(f"Updated {total_updates} change(s) across projects.")
            st.rerun()
        else:
            st.toast("No changes detected.")
    
    project_options: Dict[int, str] = {row['id']: f"{row['Trust']} - {row['Stream']}" for _, row in df_inv.iterrows()}
    project_options[0] = "Select a project stream to manage..."

    if st.button('Manage Selected Stream', disabled=selected_project_id == 0, use_container_width=True):
        project_data = query("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = ?", (selected_project_id,)).iloc[0].to_dict()
        
        prj_cfs = get_custom_fields('project')
        prj_cf_vals = get_custom_field_values('project', selected_project_id)
        
        all_allocations_df = query("SELECT rt.name, ra.allocation_pct FROM resource_allocations ra JOIN rit_team rt ON ra.user_id = rt.id WHERE ra.project_id = ? AND ra.is_deleted = 0", (selected_project_id,))
        
        additional_data = {
            "custom_fields_config": prj_cfs,
            "custom_fields_values": prj_cf_vals,
            "all_orgs_df": df_o_data,
            "all_ias": ia_list,
            "current_allocations": all_allocations_df.to_dict('records')
        }
        
        st.session_state['modal_edit_entity'] = {
            "type": "project_stream",
            "data": project_data,
            "additional_data": additional_data
        }
        st.rerun()

# pages/37_✉️_Correspondence_Draftsman.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Core Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons
from core.database_utils import query, execute, fetch_one
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.state import get_app_state
from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response

# 1. PAGE ENTRY & PERMISSIONS Check
handle_page_entry()
app_state = get_app_state()

can_view, reason = user_can("view_dashboard")
if not can_view:
    st.error(f"🔒 Access Denied: {reason}")
    st.stop()

app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Intelligence & AI"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

st.title("✉️ Advisory Correspondence Draftsman")
st.caption("AI-powered automated correspondence draftsman tailored for Implementation Advisors.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# 2. Check and Sync SLA Escalation Context
prefilled_recipient_name = ""
prefilled_recipient_title = ""
prefilled_recipient_email = ""
prefilled_notes = ""
default_template_idx = 0
default_tone_idx = 0

if "pending_esc_action_id" in st.session_state:
    action_id = st.session_state.pending_esc_action_id
    action_info = fetch_one("""
        SELECT a.task, a.assigned_to, a.due_date, p.name as project_name, o.name as org_name
        FROM actions a
        JOIN projects p ON a.project_id = p.id
        JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
        WHERE a.id = ?
    """, (int(action_id),))
    if action_info:
        task_name, assigned_to, due_date, project_name, org_name = action_info
        if selected_org != org_name or selected_prj != project_name:
            app_state.filters.global_org_filter = org_name
            app_state.filters.global_prj_filter = project_name
            st.session_state["sidebar_org_filter_widget"] = org_name
            st.session_state["sidebar_prj_filter_widget"] = project_name
            st.rerun()
        else:
            st.session_state.pop("pending_esc_action_id", None)
            prefilled_recipient_name = assigned_to
            prefilled_recipient_title = "Supplier Lead / Account Manager"
            prefilled_notes = f"Urgent: SLA breach for task '{task_name}' which was due on {due_date}. Please provide an immediate recovery plan."
            default_template_idx = 0  # SLA Breach Warning (Supplier)
            default_tone_idx = 2  # Urgent & Warning

# 2. Project Context Check
if selected_org == "All Organisations" or selected_prj == "All Projects" or current_org_id is None:
    st.warning("⚠️ Please select a specific Organisation and Project Stream in the sidebar to load context.")
    st.stop()

# Query project details
res = fetch_one("SELECT id, status, RAG_status, due_date FROM projects WHERE name=? AND org_id=? AND is_deleted=0", (selected_prj, current_org_id))
if not res:
    st.error("Project context not found.")
    st.stop()

pid, phase, rag_status, due_date = res

# 3. Fetch Project Statistics for AI Prompt Context
# Fetch checklist completion rate
checklist_res = fetch_one("SELECT checklist_data FROM projects WHERE id=?", (pid,))
completed_items = 0
total_items = 0
if checklist_res and checklist_res[0]:
    import json
    try:
        items = json.loads(checklist_res[0])
        total_items = len(items)
        completed_items = sum(1 for x in items if x.get('Status') in ['Green', 'Completed', 'Complete'])
    except Exception:
        pass
readiness_pct = (completed_items / total_items * 100) if total_items > 0 else 0.0

# Fetch open risks (including likelihood and mitigation)
risks_df = query("SELECT description, impact, likelihood, mitigation FROM risks WHERE project_id=? AND status='Open' AND is_deleted=0", (pid,))
critical_risks_count = len(risks_df[risks_df['impact'].isin(['Critical', 'High'])]) if not risks_df.empty else 0

# Fetch project milestones

    ]) if not completed_milestones.empty else "No completed milestones."

    active_milestones_summary = "No active upcoming milestones."
    completed_milestones_summary = "No completed milestones."


# Fetch overdue actions

actions_df = query("SELECT task, assigned_to, due_date FROM actions WHERE project_id=? AND status='Open' AND is_deleted=0", (pid,))

overdue_count = len(overdue_actions)

        body_content = edited_draft
        for i, line in enumerate(lines[:5]):
            if line.lower().startswith("subject:"):
                subj = line[len("subject:"):].strip()
                body_content = "\n".join(lines[i+1:]).strip()
                break
            elif line.startswith("# "):
                subj = line[2:].strip()
                body_content = "\n".join(lines[i+1:]).strip()
                break
        
        # Calculate sentiment
        from core.ai_utils import analyze_sentiment
        try:
            sentiment = analyze_sentiment(body_content)
            score = sentiment.get("polarity", 0.0)
        except Exception:
            score = 0.0
            
        # Log to DB
        from core.database_utils import log_audit_event
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        sender = app_state.user.current_user or "Advisor"

            (pid, sender, recipient_email or "recipient@nhs.net", subj, body_content, timestamp, score)
        )
        
        log_audit_event(
            action="Log Sent Correspondence",
            entity_type="email",
            user_name=sender,
            user_role=app_state.user.current_role or "Advisor",
            details={"recipient": recipient_email, "subject": subj}
        )
        st.success("🎉 Correspondence successfully logged to the project Email Log!")

        del st.session_state.drafted_email
        st.rerun()

with tab_upload:

    col_up1, col_up2 = st.columns([0.7, 0.3])
    
    with col_up1:
        # File uploaders
        up_old = st.file_uploader("1. Staff List BEFORE Restructure (CSV or Excel)", type=["csv", "xlsx"], key="up_old_staff")

            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"Error loading competency mapping report: {e}")

    with col_up2:
        st.write("#### 🧪 Sandbox Tools")
        st.caption("No files on hand? Initialize with synthetic restructure files to evaluate the matching algorithm.")
        if st.button("🧪 Load Sample Restructure Data", use_container_width=True, type="primary"):
            st.session_state.comp_mapper_old_staff = get_mock_old_staff()
            st.session_state.comp_mapper_new_staff = get_mock_new_staff()
            st.session_state.comp_mapper_competencies = get_mock_competencies()
            st.toast("Loaded sample dataset!", icon="🧪")
            st.rerun()
            
        if st.button("🔄 Reset Uploaded Datasets", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state.comp_mapper_old_staff = None
            st.session_state.comp_mapper_new_staff = None
            st.session_state.comp_mapper_competencies = None
            st.toast("Cleared upload memory.", icon="🔄")
            st.rerun()

    # Column Mapping Selectors (only if files are loaded)
    df_old = st.session_state.comp_mapper_old_staff
    df_new = st.session_state.comp_mapper_new_staff
    df_comp = st.session_state.comp_mapper_competencies

    def normalize_col(name: str) -> str:
        return "".join(c for c in name.lower() if c.isalnum())

    def detect_default_column(cols: list, priorities: list, general_patterns: list, fallback=None) -> str:
        if not cols:
            return fallback
        normalized_cols = {normalize_col(c): c for c in cols}
        
        # 1. Try normalization matches in priority list
        for p in priorities:
            norm_p = normalize_col(p)
            if norm_p in normalized_cols:
                return normalized_cols[norm_p]
                
        # 2. Try substring normalization matches in priority list
        for p in priorities:
            norm_p = normalize_col(p)
            for nc, original in normalized_cols.items():
                if norm_p in nc or nc in norm_p:
                    return original
                    
        # 3. Try general substring patterns
        for gp in general_patterns:
            norm_gp = normalize_col(gp)
            for nc, original in normalized_cols.items():
                if norm_gp in nc or nc in norm_gp:
                    return original
                    
        return fallback

    if df_old is not None or df_new is not None or df_comp is not None:
        st.divider()
        st.write("### ⚙️ Align Column Mappings")
        st.caption("Confirm columns containing key identifiers to ensure accurate matching.")
        
        c_map1, c_map2, c_map3 = st.columns(3)
        
        with c_map1:
            if df_old is not None:
                with st.container(border=True):
                    st.write("**Before Restructure List**")
                    cols = list(df_old.columns)
                    # Auto-detect defaults using normalized prioritized candidate lists
                    def_emp = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["employee number", "employee id", "employee_number", "employee_id", "staff id", "staff_id"], 
                        general_patterns=["employee", "staff", "id", "num"],
                        fallback=cols[0]
                    )
                    def_pos = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["position number", "position code", "position_number", "position_code", "position", "role code"], 
                        general_patterns=["position", "post", "role", "code"],
                        fallback=cols[-1]
                    )
                    def_first = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["first name", "forename", "first_name", "first", "given name"], 
                        general_patterns=["first", "forename"],
                        fallback=None
                    )
                    def_last = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["last name", "surname", "last_name", "last", "family name", "employee name", "staff name", "name"], 
                        general_patterns=["name", "last", "surname"],
                        fallback=None
                    )
                    def_title = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["job title", "position title", "post title", "role title", "title", "role description"], 
                        general_patterns=["title", "description", "job"],
                        fallback=None
                    )
                    
                    sel_old_emp = st.selectbox("Employee ID Column", cols, index=cols.index(def_emp) if def_emp in cols else 0, key="col_old_emp")
                    sel_old_pos = st.selectbox("Position Code Column", cols, index=cols.index(def_pos) if def_pos in cols else 0, key="col_old_pos")
                    sel_old_first = st.selectbox("First Name Column (Opt)", ["-- None --"] + cols, index=cols.index(def_first)+1 if def_first and def_first in cols else 0, key="col_old_first")
                    sel_old_last = st.selectbox("Last Name Column (Opt)", ["-- None --"] + cols, index=cols.index(def_last)+1 if def_last and def_last in cols else 0, key="col_old_last")
                    sel_old_title = st.selectbox("Job Title Column (Opt)", ["-- None --"] + cols, index=cols.index(def_title)+1 if def_title and def_title in cols else 0, key="col_old_title")
            else:
                st.info("Upload 'Before' staff list to configure mapping.")
                
        with c_map2:
            if df_new is not None:
                with st.container(border=True):
                    st.write("**After Restructure List**")
                    cols = list(df_new.columns)
                    def_emp = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["employee number", "employee id", "employee_number", "employee_id", "staff id", "staff_id"], 
                        general_patterns=["employee", "staff", "id", "num"],
                        fallback=cols[0]
                    )
                    def_pos = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["position number", "position code", "position_number", "position_code", "position", "role code"], 
                        general_patterns=["position", "post", "role", "code"],
                        fallback=cols[-1]
                    )
                    def_first = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["first name", "forename", "first_name", "first", "given name"], 
                        general_patterns=["first", "forename"],
                        fallback=None
                    )
                    def_last = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["last name", "surname", "last_name", "last", "family name", "employee name", "staff name", "name"], 
                        general_patterns=["name", "last", "surname"],
                        fallback=None
                    )
                    def_title = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["job title", "position title", "post title", "role title", "title", "role description"], 
                        general_patterns=["title", "description", "job"],
                        fallback=None
                    )
                    
                    sel_new_emp = st.selectbox("Employee ID Column", cols, index=cols.index(def_emp) if def_emp in cols else 0, key="col_new_emp")
                    sel_new_pos = st.selectbox("Position Code Column", cols, index=cols.index(def_pos) if def_pos in cols else 0, key="col_new_pos")
                    sel_new_first = st.selectbox("First Name Column (Opt)", ["-- None --"] + cols, index=cols.index(def_first)+1 if def_first and def_first in cols else 0, key="col_new_first")
                    sel_new_last = st.selectbox("Last Name Column (Opt)", ["-- None --"] + cols, index=cols.index(def_last)+1 if def_last and def_last in cols else 0, key="col_new_last")
                    sel_new_title = st.selectbox("Job Title Column (Opt)", ["-- None --"] + cols, index=cols.index(def_title)+1 if def_title and def_title in cols else 0, key="col_new_title")
            else:
                st.info("Upload 'After' staff list to configure mapping.")
                
        with c_map3:
            if df_comp is not None:
                with st.container(border=True):
                    st.write("**Position-Competency List**")
                    cols = list(df_comp.columns)
                    def_pos = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["inherited from", "position number", "position code", "position_code", "position_number", "position"], 
                        general_patterns=["position", "post", "role", "code"],
                        fallback=cols[0]
                    )
                    def_code = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["competence full name", "competency code", "competency_code", "competency name", "competency_name", "competency"], 
                        general_patterns=["competence", "competency", "code"],
                        fallback=cols[-1]
                    )
                    def_name = detect_default_column(
                        cols, 
                        priorities=["essential", "competency name", "competency_name", "name", "title"],

                        fallback=None
                    )
                    
                    sel_comp_pos = st.selectbox("Position Code Column", cols, index=cols.index(def_pos) if def_pos in cols else 0, key="col_comp_pos")

                    sel_comp_name = st.selectbox("Competency Name (Opt)", ["-- None --"] + cols, index=cols.index(def_name)+1 if def_name and def_name in cols else 0, key="col_comp_name")
