                st.info("Upload competency mapping to configure mapping.")

# Helper to load cleaned aligned tables
def get_clean_mapped_data():
    o = st.session_state.comp_mapper_old_staff
    n = st.session_state.comp_mapper_new_staff
    c = st.session_state.comp_mapper_competencies
    
    if o is None or n is None or c is None:
        return None, None, None, None
        
    def parse_pos_code(val):
        val_str = str(val).strip()
        if "|" in val_str:
            return val_str.split("|")[0].strip()
        return val_str
        
    def get_combined_name_row(row, col_first, col_last):
        parts = []
        if col_first != "-- None --" and col_first in row and pd.notna(row[col_first]):
            parts.append(str(row[col_first]).strip())
        if col_last != "-- None --" and col_last in row and pd.notna(row[col_last]):
            parts.append(str(row[col_last]).strip())
        return " ".join(parts) if parts else "Unknown Employee"

    def get_title_row(row, col_title):
        if col_title != "-- None --" and col_title in row and pd.notna(row[col_title]):
            return str(row[col_title]).strip()
        return ""
        
    try:
        # Before Restructure
        col_old_emp = st.session_state.col_old_emp
        col_old_pos = st.session_state.col_old_pos
        col_old_first = st.session_state.col_old_first
        col_old_last = st.session_state.col_old_last
        col_old_title = st.session_state.col_old_title
        
        df_o = pd.DataFrame({
            "Emp_ID": o[col_old_emp].astype(str).str.strip(),
            "Old_Pos": o[col_old_pos].apply(parse_pos_code),
            "Emp_Name": o.apply(lambda r: get_combined_name_row(r, col_old_first, col_old_last), axis=1),
            "Old_Title": o.apply(lambda r: get_title_row(r, col_old_title), axis=1)
        })
            
        # After Restructure
        col_new_emp = st.session_state.col_new_emp
        col_new_pos = st.session_state.col_new_pos
        col_new_first = st.session_state.col_new_first
        col_new_last = st.session_state.col_new_last
        col_new_title = st.session_state.col_new_title
        
        df_n = pd.DataFrame({
            "Emp_ID": n[col_new_emp].astype(str).str.strip(),
            "New_Pos": n[col_new_pos].apply(parse_pos_code),
            "Emp_Name": n.apply(lambda r: get_combined_name_row(r, col_new_first, col_new_last), axis=1),
            "New_Title": n.apply(lambda r: get_title_row(r, col_new_title), axis=1)
        })
            
        # Competency Report
        col_comp_pos = st.session_state.col_comp_pos
        col_comp_code = st.session_state.col_comp_code
        col_comp_name = st.session_state.col_comp_name
        
        df_c = pd.DataFrame({
            "Pos_Code": c[col_comp_pos].apply(parse_pos_code),
            "Comp_Code": c[col_comp_code].astype(str).str.strip()
        })
        if col_comp_name != "-- None --":
            df_c["Comp_Name"] = c[col_comp_name].astype(str).str.strip()
        else:
            df_c["Comp_Name"] = ""
            
        return df_o, df_n, df_c, True
    except Exception as ex:
        st.error(f"Mapping alignment error: {ex}")
        return None, None, None, False

# Try loading and running mapper logic
df_o, df_n, df_c, parse_success = get_clean_mapped_data()

# ==========================================
# RECONCILIATION LOGIC ENGINE
# ==========================================
transfer_records = []
new_starters_records = []
leavers_records = []
unmapped_positions = set()

if parse_success:
    # 1. Resolve Name mappings across datasets
    o_names = df_o.set_index("Emp_ID")["Emp_Name"].to_dict()
    n_names = df_n.set_index("Emp_ID")["Emp_Name"].to_dict()
    
    # Combined dictionary of names
    all_names = {}
    for eid, name in o_names.items():
        if name and name.lower() != "nan":
            all_names[eid] = name
    for eid, name in n_names.items():
        if name and name.lower() != "nan" and eid not in all_names:
            all_names[eid] = name

    # Fill name columns
    df_o["Emp_Name"] = df_o["Emp_ID"].map(all_names).fillna("Unknown Employee")
    df_n["Emp_Name"] = df_n["Emp_ID"].map(all_names).fillna("Unknown Employee")
    
    # 2. Competency profile maps
    pos_to_comps = {} # Pos_Code -> list of (Comp_Code, Comp_Name)
    comp_code_to_name = {}
    
    for _, r in df_c.iterrows():
        pcode = r["Pos_Code"]
        ccode = r["Comp_Code"]
        cname = r["Comp_Name"]
        comp_code_to_name[ccode] = cname
        if pcode not in pos_to_comps:
            pos_to_comps[pcode] = []
        pos_to_comps[pcode].append((ccode, cname))

    # Identify positions in staff lists
    all_restructure_positions = set(df_o["Old_Pos"].unique()) | set(df_n["New_Pos"].unique())
    unmapped_positions = all_restructure_positions - set(pos_to_comps.keys())

    # 3. Employee transition mapping
    emp_before = df_o.set_index("Emp_ID")
    emp_after = df_n.set_index("Emp_ID")
    
    # Common employees (mapped)
    mapped_emp_ids = set(emp_before.index).intersection(set(emp_after.index))
    
    # New starters (in new but not old)
    new_starter_ids = set(emp_after.index) - set(emp_before.index)
    for ns_id in sorted(new_starter_ids):
        row_n = emp_after.loc[ns_id]
        if isinstance(row_n, pd.DataFrame):
            row_n = row_n.iloc[0]
        new_starters_records.append({
            "Employee Number": ns_id,
            "Employee Name": row_n["Emp_Name"],
            "Position Number": row_n["New_Pos"],
            "Job Title": row_n["New_Title"]
        })
        
    # Leavers (in old but not new)
    leaver_ids = set(emp_before.index) - set(emp_after.index)
    for lv_id in sorted(leaver_ids):
        row_o = emp_before.loc[lv_id]
        if isinstance(row_o, pd.DataFrame):
            row_o = row_o.iloc[0]
        leavers_records.append({
            "Employee Number": lv_id,
            "Employee Name": row_o["Emp_Name"],
            "Position Number": row_o["Old_Pos"],
            "Job Title": row_o["Old_Title"]
        })

    # Competency mapping per mapped employee
    for eid in sorted(mapped_emp_ids):
        row_o = emp_before.loc[eid]
        row_n = emp_after.loc[eid]
        
        # Handle duplicate indices if any (should ideally be unique)
        if isinstance(row_o, pd.DataFrame):
            row_o = row_o.iloc[0]
        if isinstance(row_n, pd.DataFrame):
            row_n = row_n.iloc[0]
            
        old_pos = row_o["Old_Pos"]
        new_pos = row_n["New_Pos"]
        emp_name = row_n["Emp_Name"]
        old_title = row_o["Old_Title"]
        new_title = row_n["New_Title"]
        
        # Get competencies
        old_comps = {c[0]: c[1] for c in pos_to_comps.get(old_pos, [])}
        new_comps = {c[0]: c[1] for c in pos_to_comps.get(new_pos, [])}
        
        # Competencies to transfer: in old but not in new
        trans_codes = set(old_comps.keys()) - set(new_comps.keys())
        
        for ccode in sorted(trans_codes):
            transfer_records.append({
                "Employee Number": eid,
                "Employee Name": emp_name,
                "Old Position Number": old_pos,
                "Old Job Title": old_title,
                "New Position Number": new_pos,
                "New Job Title": new_title,
                "Competency": ccode,
                "Essential": old_comps[ccode]
            })

df_transfers = pd.DataFrame(transfer_records)
df_starters = pd.DataFrame(new_starters_records)
df_leavers = pd.DataFrame(leavers_records)

# Extract Gaps Globally
df_gaps = pd.DataFrame()
if parse_success:
    df_impacted_staff = df_n[df_n["New_Pos"].isin(unmapped_positions)].copy()
    if not df_impacted_staff.empty:
        df_gaps = pd.DataFrame({
            "New Position Number": df_impacted_staff["New_Pos"],
            "Employee Name": df_impacted_staff["Emp_Name"],
            "Employee Number": df_impacted_staff["Emp_ID"],
            "Position Title": df_impacted_staff["New_Title"]
        }).sort_values(by=["New Position Number", "Employee Name"])

# Helper function to generate CSV downloads
def convert_df_to_csv(df_in):
    return df_in.to_csv(index=False).encode('utf-8')

# Helper function to generate Excel downloads with auto-fitted columns
def convert_df_to_xlsx(df_in, sheet_name="Data"):
    output = BytesIO()
    with pd.ExcelWriter(output, engine='openpyxl') as writer:
        df_in.to_excel(writer, sheet_name=sheet_name, index=False)
        workbook = writer.book
        worksheet = workbook[sheet_name]
        for col in worksheet.columns:
            max_len = max(len(str(cell.value or '')) for cell in col)
            col_letter = col[0].column_letter
            worksheet.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = max(max_len + 3, 12)
    return output.getvalue()

# Helper function to generate consolidated multi-sheet Excel report
def convert_all_to_xlsx(df_trans, df_start, df_leave, df_gap, mapped_count, project_id):
    output = BytesIO()
    with pd.ExcelWriter(output, engine='openpyxl') as writer:
        # Create Executive Summary Sheet
        summary_data = {
            "Metric / Parameter": [
                "Project ID / Reference",
                "Reconciliation Date & Time",
                "Total Transitioning Staff Checked",
                "Impacted Staff (Requiring Competency Transfers)",
                "Total Competency Links to Transfer",
                "New Starters Detected (Additions)",
                "Leavers Flagged (Deletions)",
                "Positions Missing Competency Mappings",
                "Staff Impacted by Missing Competency Profiles"
            ],
            "Value": [
                str(project_id),
                pd.Timestamp.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                int(mapped_count),
                int(df_trans["Employee Number"].nunique()) if not df_trans.empty else 0,
                int(len(df_trans)),
                int(len(df_start)),
                int(len(df_leave)),
                int(len(unmapped_positions)),
                int(len(df_gap))
            ],
            "Description": [
                "Unique identifier of the project stream context",
                "Timestamp of when this report was compiled",
                "Total employees successfully matched between employee lists",
                "Transitioning employees requiring at least one competency link",
                "Total distinct competency links to be added to employee records",
                "Employees in the new employee list who are not in the old employee list",
                "Employees in the old employee list who are not in the new employee list",
                "Distinct position codes referenced in employee lists but missing from mappings library",
                "Transitioning employees assigned to unmapped positions"
            ]
        }
        df_summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_data)
        df_summary.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Executive Summary", index=False)
        
        # Write other dataframes
        df_trans.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Competency Transfers", index=False)
        df_start.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="New Starters (Additions)", index=False)
        df_leave.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Leavers (Deletions)", index=False)
        if not df_gap.empty:
            df_gap.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Missing Position Gaps", index=False)
        
        # Auto-fit columns
        workbook = writer.book
        for sheet_name in workbook.sheetnames:
            worksheet = workbook[sheet_name]
            for col in worksheet.columns:
                max_len = max(len(str(cell.value or '')) for cell in col)
                col_letter = col[0].column_letter
                worksheet.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = max(max_len + 3, 12)
                
    return output.getvalue()




from fpdf import FPDF

# Flashy PDF summary compiler using fpdf2
class FlashySummaryPDF(FPDF):
    def header(self):
        # Draw a beautiful top accent bar
        self.set_fill_color(0, 94, 184) # Deep Blue
        self.rect(0, 0, 210, 20, "F")
        
        self.set_text_color(255, 255, 255)
        self.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 13)
        self.set_xy(10, 5)
        self.cell(0, 10, "RESTRUCTURE COMPETENCY RECONCILIATION SUMMARY", align="L")
        self.ln(20)
        
    def footer(self):
        self.set_y(-15)
        self.set_font("Helvetica", "I", 8)
        self.set_text_color(128, 128, 128)
        self.cell(0, 10, f"Page {self.page_no()}/{{nb}} | Automated Data Cleansing Portal", align="C")

        ("Total competency links to transfer", f"{total_trans}", "High Volume" if total_trans > 50 else "Standard", (224, 109, 20) if total_trans > 0 else (100, 100, 100)),
        ("New starters (not in historical old list)", f"{starters}", "Verify Standard Comps", (0, 94, 184) if starters > 0 else (100, 100, 100)),
        ("Leavers/deletions (not in new structure)", f"{leavers}", "Verify Removal", (100, 100, 100)),
        ("Missing position competency profiles", f"{gaps_pos}", "CRITICAL" if gaps_pos > 0 else "Clean", (213, 40, 27) if gaps_pos > 0 else (0, 127, 59)),
        ("Employees blocked by missing profiles", f"{gaps_staff}", "CRITICAL" if gaps_staff > 0 else "Clean", (213, 40, 27) if gaps_staff > 0 else (0, 127, 59))
    ]
    
    for desc, val, status, color in metrics:
        pdf.set_x(15)
        pdf.cell(110, 7, desc, border=1)
        pdf.cell(30, 7, val, border=1, align="C")
        pdf.set_text_color(*color)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 9)
        pdf.cell(40, 7, status, border=1, align="C")
        pdf.set_text_color(33, 37, 41)
        pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 9)
        pdf.ln(7)
        
    pdf.ln(8)
    pdf.set_x(15)
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "B", 10)
    pdf.set_text_color(0, 94, 184)
    pdf.cell(0, 6, "RECOMMENDED NEXT ACTIONS:")
    pdf.ln(7)
    
    actions = [
        "1. Export the 'Competency Transfers' list and upload it to the LMS / HR system to link training records.",
        "2. Resolve the 'Position Profile Gaps' by adding competency mappings for the unmapped position numbers in Tab 4.",
        "3. Review the 'New Starters' list to ensure standard induction competencies are assigned.",
        "4. Review 'Leavers / Deletions' to clean up historical system access profiles."
    ]
    
    pdf.set_font("Helvetica", "", 9)
    pdf.set_text_color(60, 60, 60)
    for act in actions:
        pdf.set_x(20)
        pdf.multi_cell(170, 5, act)
        pdf.ln(2)
        
    return bytes(pdf.output())

def convert_to_custom_updates_df(df_filtered):
    if df_filtered.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            "Record Type", "Position Number", "Competence", 
            "Low", "High", "Essential?", "Date From", "Date To"
        ])
    
    today_str = pd.Timestamp.now().strftime("%d-%b-%Y")
    pos_col = "New Position Number" if "New Position Number" in df_filtered.columns else "New_Pos"
    comp_col = "Competency" if "Competency" in df_filtered.columns else "Competence"
    ess_col = "Essential" if "Essential" in df_filtered.columns else "Essential?"
    
    df_custom = pd.DataFrame({
        "Record Type": ["Add"] * len(df_filtered),
        "Position Number": df_filtered[pos_col].astype(str).str.split(" | ").str[0].str.strip(),
        "Competence": df_filtered[comp_col].astype(str),
        "Low": [""] * len(df_filtered),
        "High": [""] * len(df_filtered),
        "Essential?": df_filtered[ess_col].apply(lambda v: "Yes" if str(v).strip().lower() in ["yes", "y", "true", "1"] else "No"),
        "Date From": [today_str] * len(df_filtered),
        "Date To": [""] * len(df_filtered)
    })
    return df_custom

def convert_to_custom_updates_xlsx(df_filtered):
    df_custom = convert_to_custom_updates_df(df_filtered)
    return convert_df_to_xlsx(df_custom, "Sheet1")

# Helper function to generate consolidated ZIP archive of Excel workbooks
def convert_all_to_zip(df_trans, df_start, df_leave, df_gap, mapped_count, project_id, unmapped_positions):
    zip_buffer = BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_buffer, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zip_file:
        # 1. Executive Summary Excel
        summary_data = {
            "Metric / Parameter": [
                "Project ID / Reference",
                "Reconciliation Date & Time",
                "Total Transitioning Staff Checked",
                "Impacted Staff (Requiring Competency Transfers)",
                "Total Competency Links to Transfer",
                "New Starters Detected (Additions)",
                "Leavers Flagged (Deletions)",
                "Positions Missing Competency Mappings",
                "Staff Impacted by Missing Competency Profiles"
            ],
            "Value": [
                str(project_id),
                pd.Timestamp.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                int(mapped_count),
                int(df_trans["Employee Number"].nunique()) if not df_trans.empty else 0,
                int(len(df_trans)),
                int(len(df_start)),
                int(len(df_leave)),
                int(len(unmapped_positions)),
                int(len(df_gap))
            ],
            "Description": [
                "Unique identifier of the project stream context",
                "Timestamp of when this report was compiled",
                "Total employees successfully matched between employee lists",
                "Transitioning employees requiring at least one competency link",
                "Total distinct competency links to be added to employee records",
                "Employees in the new employee list who are not in the old employee list",
                "Employees in the old employee list who are not in the new employee list",
                "Distinct position codes referenced in employee lists but missing from mappings library",
                "Transitioning employees assigned to unmapped positions"
            ]
        }
        df_summary = pd.DataFrame(summary_data)
        zip_file.writestr("Executive_Summary.xlsx", convert_df_to_xlsx(df_summary, "Executive Summary"))
        
        # 2. Executive Summary PDF (Flashy!)
        pdf_bytes = generate_exec_summary_pdf(df_trans, df_start, df_leave, df_gap, mapped_count, project_id, unmapped_positions)
        zip_file.writestr("Executive_Summary.pdf", pdf_bytes)
        
        # 3. Competency Transfers
        zip_file.writestr("Competency_Transfers.xlsx", convert_df_to_xlsx(df_trans, "Competency Transfers"))
        
        # 4. Competency Updates post Restructure (Legacy Upload XLS!)
        df_custom_trans = convert_to_custom_updates_df(df_trans)
        try:
            import xlwt
            xls_buffer = BytesIO()
            with pd.ExcelWriter(xls_buffer, engine="xlwt") as xls_writer:
                df_custom_trans.to_excel(xls_writer, sheet_name="Sheet1", index=False)
                worksheet = xls_writer.sheets["Sheet1"]
                for i, col in enumerate(df_custom_trans.columns):
                    max_len = max(df_custom_trans[col].astype(str).map(len).max(), len(str(col)))
                    worksheet.col(i).width = max(max_len + 3, 10) * 256
            zip_file.writestr("Competency_Updates_post_Restructure.xls", xls_buffer.getvalue())
        except ImportError:
            # Fallback to xlsx format inside ZIP but name it .xlsx to avoid warning popup
            zip_file.writestr("Competency_Updates_post_Restructure.xlsx", convert_df_to_xlsx(df_custom_trans, "Sheet1"))
        
        # 5. New Starters
        zip_file.writestr("New_Starters.xlsx", convert_df_to_xlsx(df_start, "New Starters"))
        
        # 6. Leavers
        zip_file.writestr("Leavers.xlsx", convert_df_to_xlsx(df_leave, "Leavers"))
        
        # 7. Missing Position Gaps
        df_gap_write = df_gap if not df_gap.empty else pd.DataFrame(columns=["New Position Number", "Employee Name", "Employee Number", "Position Title"])
        zip_file.writestr("Missing_Position_Gaps.xlsx", convert_df_to_xlsx(df_gap_write, "Missing Position Gaps"))
        
    return zip_buffer.getvalue()

# Helper to show native Mac save dialog
def show_mac_save_dialog(default_name, prompt="Save File:"):
    try:
        cmd = f'POSIX path of (choose file name with prompt "{prompt}" default name "{default_name}")'
        proc = subprocess.run(
            ['osascript', '-e', cmd],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True
        )
        if proc.returncode == 0:
            path = proc.stdout.strip()
            return path, None
        else:
            err = proc.stderr.strip()
            if "User canceled" in err or "-128" in err:
                return None, "cancelled"
            return None, err
    except Exception as e:
        return None, str(e)

def save_dataframe_as_xls(df_custom, selected_path):
    try:
        import xlwt
        with pd.ExcelWriter(selected_path, engine="xlwt") as writer:
            df_custom.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Sheet1", index=False)
            worksheet = writer.sheets["Sheet1"]
            for i, col in enumerate(df_custom.columns):
                max_len = max(df_custom[col].astype(str).map(len).max(), len(str(col)))
                worksheet.col(i).width = max(max_len + 3, 10) * 256
        return True, None
    except ImportError:
        # Fallback: Write XLSX, and convert it to XLS via AppleScript if Excel is installed
        xlsx_temp_path = selected_path + ".xlsx"
        try:
            with pd.ExcelWriter(xlsx_temp_path, engine="openpyxl") as writer:
                df_custom.to_excel(writer, sheet_name="Sheet1", index=False)
                workbook = writer.book
                worksheet = workbook["Sheet1"]
                for col in worksheet.columns:
                    max_len = max(len(str(cell.value or '')) for cell in col)
                    col_letter = col[0].column_letter
                    worksheet.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = max(max_len + 3, 12)
            
            import os
            abs_xlsx = os.path.abspath(xlsx_temp_path)
            abs_xls = os.path.abspath(selected_path)
            
            applescript_cmd = f'''
            tell application "Microsoft Excel"
                open POSIX file "{abs_xlsx}"
                save workbook as active workbook filename POSIX file "{abs_xls}" file format Excel 97-2004 file format
                close active workbook saving no
            end tell
            '''
            proc = subprocess.run(
                ['osascript', '-e', applescript_cmd],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True
            )
            
            if os.path.exists(xlsx_temp_path):
                try:
                    os.remove(xlsx_temp_path)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            
            if proc.returncode == 0:
                return True, None
            else:
                err = proc.stderr.strip()
                return False, f"Microsoft Excel automation failed: {err}"
        except Exception as e:
            if os.path.exists(xlsx_temp_path):
                try:
                    os.remove(xlsx_temp_path)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            return False, str(e)
    except Exception as e:
        return False, str(e)

# Helper to execute native Mac downloads
def download_file_action(label, data_func, file_name, key, is_custom_xls=False, df_for_xls=None):
    if st.button(label, key=key, use_container_width=True):
        selected_path, error_msg = show_mac_save_dialog(file_name, prompt=f"Select destination for {file_name}:")
        if selected_path:
            try:
                if is_custom_xls and df_for_xls is not None:
                    # Special legacy XLS compilation flow
                    success, err = save_dataframe_as_xls(df_for_xls, selected_path)
                    if success:
                        st.success(f"🎉 Legacy XLS updates successfully saved to: `{selected_path}`")
                    else:
                        st.error(f"❌ Failed to compile legacy XLS file: {err}")
                        st.info("💡 To enable direct Python XLS writes without opening Excel, run this command in your terminal:\n\n`./venv/bin/pip install xlwt`")
                else:
                    data = data_func()
                    with open(selected_path, "wb") as f:
                        f.write(data)
                    st.success(f"🎉 File successfully saved to: `{selected_path}`")
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"❌ Failed to save file: {e}")
        elif error_msg == "cancelled":
            st.warning("⚠️ Download cancelled.")
        else:
            st.error(f"❌ Could not open native Save Dialog: {error_msg}")
            st.info("💡 Make sure your terminal or IDE application has 'Automation' permissions enabled in macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security.")

with tab_gaps:

    st.write("Check consistency issues, missing configuration profiles, and data formatting bugs.")

        st.info("💡 Upload restructure datasets or load sample mock data in Tab 1 to run mapping.")
    else:
        # Gaps analysis
        gaps_list = list(unmapped_positions)
        
        # Filter the new staff list for employees whose positions are in the unmapped set
        df_impacted_staff = df_n[df_n["New_Pos"].isin(unmapped_positions)].copy()
        
        g_count = len(gaps_list)
        if g_count > 0:
            st.error(f"🚨 **{g_count} Positions Missing Competency Mappings**")
            st.markdown(
                "The following table displays all employees in the new employee list who are assigned to these unmapped position numbers. "
                "Since these positions do not exist in the Position-Competency report, these employees cannot have their competencies mapped or transferred."
            )
            
            if not df_impacted_staff.empty:
                df_gaps_table = pd.DataFrame({
                    "New Position Number": df_impacted_staff["New_Pos"],
                    "Employee Name": df_impacted_staff["Emp_Name"],
                    "Employee Number": df_impacted_staff["Emp_ID"],
                    "Position Title": df_impacted_staff["New_Title"]
                }).sort_values(by=["New Position Number", "Employee Name"])
                
                st.dataframe(df_gaps_table, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
                
                # Export Gaps
                g_col1, g_col2 = st.columns(2)
                download_file_action(

                    file_name="impacted_staff_gaps.csv",
                    key="btn_download_gaps_csv"
                )
                download_file_action(
                    label="📥 Download Impacted Staff Gaps (Excel)",
                    data_func=lambda: convert_df_to_xlsx(df_gaps_table, "Missing Position Gaps"),
                    file_name="impacted_staff_gaps.xlsx",
                    key="btn_download_gaps_excel"
                )
            else:
                st.info("No staff in the new employee list are impacted by these missing position mappings. (They might only affect the old employee list leavers/deletions).")
        else:
            st.success("🎉 All referenced position codes mapped perfectly to the Position-Competency profile library!")
            
        st.divider()
        st.write("#### 🛡️ Employee Schema & Format Audits")
        st.caption("Checks for duplicate employee records or formatting anomalies.")
        
        # Duplicates Checks
        old_dups = df_o[df_o.duplicated(subset=["Emp_ID"], keep=False)]
        new_dups = df_n[df_n.duplicated(subset=["Emp_ID"], keep=False)]

            c_counts.columns = ["Competency", "Transfer Count"]
            
            chart_top_comps = alt.Chart(c_counts.head(10)).mark_bar(cornerRadiusTopRight=4, cornerRadiusBottomRight=4).encode(
                y=alt.Y("Competency:N", sort="-x", title=None),
                x=alt.X("Transfer Count:Q", title="Number of Transfers Required"),
                color=alt.value("#E06D14"),
                tooltip=["Competency", "Transfer Count"]
            ).properties(
                title="Top 10 Competencies to Transfer (By Volume)",
                height=300
            ).configure_axis(grid=False).configure_view(strokeWidth=0)
        else:
            chart_top_comps = None
        
        col_ch1, col_ch2 = st.columns(2)
        with col_ch1:
            st.altair_chart(chart_flows, use_container_width=True)
        with col_ch2:
            if chart_top_comps is not None:
                st.altair_chart(chart_top_comps, use_container_width=True)
            else:
                st.info("No competencies to display in chart.")
            
        st.divider()
        
        # Table summary by employee
        if len(df_transfers) > 0:
            st.markdown("**Transitioning Staff Competency Transfer Volumes**")
            emp_counts = df_transfers.groupby(["Employee Number", "Employee Name", "Old Position Number", "Old Job Title", "New Position Number", "New Job Title"]).size().reset_index(name="Transfers Needed")
            emp_counts = emp_counts.sort_values(by="Transfers Needed", ascending=False)
            
            # Altair histogram of transfers per employee
            chart_hist = alt.Chart(emp_counts).mark_bar(binSpacing=1, color="#7C2855").encode(
                x=alt.X("Transfers Needed:Q", bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=10), title="Transfers Needed per Employee"),
                y=alt.Y("count():Q", title="Employee Count"),
                tooltip=["count()"]
            ).properties(
                title="Distribution of Transfer Workload",
                height=250
            ).configure_axis(grid=False).configure_view(strokeWidth=0)
            
            col_ch3, col_ch4 = st.columns([0.6, 0.4])
            with col_ch3:
                st.dataframe(emp_counts, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
            with col_ch4:
                st.altair_chart(chart_hist, use_container_width=True)
        else:
            st.info("No transfers to analyze.")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HELPER CONSTANTS & FUNCTIONS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Change Size axis labels (X) – maps score range → label
CHANGE_SIZE_BANDS = [
    (15, 29, "Minimal"),
    (30, 42, "Moderate"),
    (43, 52, "Significant"),
    (53, 63, "Major"),
    (64, 75, "Transformational"),
]

# Org Readiness axis labels (Y) – maps score range → label
# NOTE: In Prosci's model a HIGH Org Attributes score means MORE challenging attributes
# (lower readiness), so the band labels intentionally run inverse to the score.
ORG_READINESS_BANDS = [
    (15, 29, "Very High"),   # Low OA score  → org is well-prepared
    (30, 42, "High"),
    (43, 52, "Moderate"),
    (53, 63, "Low"),
    (64, 75, "Very Low"),    # High OA score → org has many challenging attributes
]

# Rollout Complexity Profile matrix [readiness_band_idx][change_size_band_idx]
# Rows = readiness (idx 0 = Very High readiness → idx 4 = Very Low readiness)
# Cols = change size (idx 0 = Minimal → idx 4 = Transformational)
COMPLEXITY_MATRIX = [
    # Minimal              Moderate             Significant           Major                  Transformational
    ["Low Complexity",    "Low Complexity",    "Manageable",         "Manageable",          "Elevated Complexity"],  # Very High readiness
    ["Low Complexity",    "Manageable",        "Manageable",         "Elevated Complexity", "High Complexity"],      # High
    ["Manageable",        "Manageable",        "Elevated Complexity","High Complexity",     "Critical Exposure"],    # Moderate
    ["Manageable",        "Elevated Complexity","High Complexity",   "Critical Exposure",   "Extreme Overload"],     # Low
    ["Critical Exposure", "Critical Exposure", "Critical Exposure",  "Extreme Overload",    "Extreme Overload"],     # Very Low readiness
]

COMPLEXITY_COLOURS = {
    "Low Complexity":      "#00703c",
    "Manageable":          "#5b9bd5",
    "Elevated Complexity": "#ffdd00",
    "High Complexity":     "#f4a320",
    "Critical Exposure":   "#d4351c",
    "Extreme Overload":    "#7b0d1e",
}

COMPLEXITY_ORDER = [
    "Low Complexity",
    "Manageable",
    "Elevated Complexity",
    "High Complexity",
    "Critical Exposure",
    "Extreme Overload",
]


def band_index(score: float, bands: list) -> int:
    for i, (lo, hi, _) in enumerate(bands):
        if lo <= score <= hi:
            return i
    return len(bands) - 1


def band_label(score: float, bands: list) -> str:
    for lo, hi, label in bands:
        if lo <= score <= hi:
            return label
    return bands[-1][2]


def get_complexity_profile(cc: float, oa: float) -> str:
    cs_idx = band_index(cc, CHANGE_SIZE_BANDS)
    rd_idx = band_index(oa, ORG_READINESS_BANDS)
    return COMPLEXITY_MATRIX[rd_idx][cs_idx]


def get_risk_category(cc: float, oa: float) -> str:
    mid = 45
    if cc > mid and oa > mid:
        return "High Risk"
    elif cc <= mid and oa <= mid:
        return "Low Risk"
    else:
        return "Medium Risk"


def complexity_numeric(profile: str) -> int:
    try:
        return COMPLEXITY_ORDER.index(profile)
    except ValueError:
        return 0


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. DATA RETRIEVAL
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
st.header("Record Prosci Scores")

f_sil = st.session_state.get("filter_sil", "All SILs")
f_il  = st.session_state.get("filter_il",  "All ILs")
f_im  = st.session_state.get("filter_im",  "All IMs")

conditions = ["o.is_deleted = 0"]
params = []
if f_sil != "All SILs":
    conditions.append("REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || m.sil_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ?")
    params.append(f"%,{f_sil},%")
if f_il != "All ILs":
    conditions.append("REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || m.il_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ?")
    params.append(f"%,{f_il},%")
if f_im != "All IMs":
    conditions.append("REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || m.im_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ?")
    params.append(f"%,{f_im},%")

org_filter = " AND ".join(conditions)

df_orgs_db = query(f"""
    SELECT o.id, o.name FROM orgs o
    JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
    WHERE {org_filter} ORDER BY o.name
""", tuple(params))
org_names_list = df_orgs_db["name"].tolist()
org_id_map = dict(zip(df_orgs_db["name"], df_orgs_db["id"]))

org_ids = df_orgs_db["id"].tolist()
if org_ids:
    placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(org_ids))
    latest_scores_sql = f"""
        WITH LatestScores AS (
            SELECT
                org_id,
                change_characteristics,
                org_attributes,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY org_id ORDER BY timestamp DESC) as rn
            FROM prosci_scores
            WHERE org_id IN ({placeholders})
        )
        SELECT org_id, change_characteristics, org_attributes
        FROM LatestScores WHERE rn = 1
    """
    latest_scores_df = query(latest_scores_sql, tuple(org_ids))
    initial_prosci_df = pd.merge(
        df_orgs_db, latest_scores_df,
        left_on="id", right_on="org_id", how="left"
    ).rename(columns={
        "name": "Organisation",
        "change_characteristics": "Change_Characteristics",
        "org_attributes": "Org_Attributes",
    })[["Organisation", "Change_Characteristics", "Org_Attributes", "id"]].rename(columns={"id": "org_id"})
else:
    initial_prosci_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["Organisation", "Change_Characteristics", "Org_Attributes", "org_id"])

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. DATA EDITOR
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_edited = st.data_editor(
    initial_prosci_df,
    column_config={
        "Organisation": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn("Organisation", options=org_names_list, required=True),
        "Change_Characteristics": st.column_config.NumberColumn(
            "Change Size (15-75)", min_value=15, max_value=75, step=1, format="%d",
            help="Score representing the scope and scale of the change (Change Characteristics).",
        ),
        "Org_Attributes": st.column_config.NumberColumn(
            "Org Readiness (15-75)", min_value=15, max_value=75, step=1, format="%d",
            help="Score representing the organisation's current capacity and readiness for change (Organisational Attributes).",
        ),
        "org_id": None,
    },
    num_rows="dynamic",
    hide_index=True,
)

# Clean & Save
df = df_edited.dropna(subset=["Organisation", "Change_Characteristics", "Org_Attributes"]).copy()
df["org_id"] = df["Organisation"].map(org_id_map)
df = df.dropna(subset=["org_id"])

if st.button("💾 Save Prosci Scores", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        execute(
            "INSERT INTO prosci_scores (org_id, change_characteristics, org_attributes, timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (int(row["org_id"]), int(row["Change_Characteristics"]), int(row["Org_Attributes"]),
             datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
        )
    st.success("Prosci scores saved successfully!")
    st.rerun()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. COMPUTED ANALYTICS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if not df.empty:
    df["Change_Characteristics"] = pd.to_numeric(df["Change_Characteristics"]).astype(int)
    df["Org_Attributes"]         = pd.to_numeric(df["Org_Attributes"]).astype(int)

    df["Risk Score"]         = df["Change_Characteristics"] + df["Org_Attributes"]
    df["Risk Category"]      = df.apply(lambda r: get_risk_category(r["Change_Characteristics"], r["Org_Attributes"]), axis=1)
    df["Change Size Band"]   = df["Change_Characteristics"].apply(lambda s: band_label(s, CHANGE_SIZE_BANDS))
    df["Readiness Band"]     = df["Org_Attributes"].apply(lambda s: band_label(s, ORG_READINESS_BANDS))
    df["Complexity Profile"] = df.apply(lambda r: get_complexity_profile(r["Change_Characteristics"], r["Org_Attributes"]), axis=1)
    df["Complexity Score"]   = df["Complexity Profile"].apply(complexity_numeric)

    category_order = {"High Risk": 0, "Medium Risk": 1, "Low Risk": 2}
    df["cat_sort"] = df["Risk Category"].map(category_order)
    df_sorted = df.sort_values(by=["cat_sort", "Complexity Score"], ascending=[True, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
    df_sorted["Rank"] = df_sorted.index + 1
else:
    df_sorted = pd.DataFrame()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. PROSCI RISK GRID  (original scatter chart – preserved)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
is_dark = st.session_state.get("is_dark", True)
chart_bg = "transparent" if is_dark else "#f9f9f9"
label_color = "#e7e5e4" if is_dark else "#333333"
title_color = "#e7e5e4" if is_dark else "#333333"
grid_color = "rgba(225, 182, 117, 0.15)" if is_dark else "#e0e0e0"
quadrant_label_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)" if is_dark else "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)"
cell_stroke = "rgba(28, 26, 24, 0.8)" if is_dark else "#ffffff"

if not df_sorted.empty:
    h_line = alt.Chart(pd.DataFrame({"y": [45]})).mark_rule(color=grid_color, strokeDash=[5, 5], size=2).encode(y="y:Q")
    v_line = alt.Chart(pd.DataFrame({"x": [45]})).mark_rule(color=grid_color, strokeDash=[5, 5], size=2).encode(x="x:Q")

    quadrant_labels = pd.DataFrame([
        {"x": 30, "y": 30, "label": "Low Risk"},
        {"x": 60, "y": 60, "label": "High Risk"},

    text_labels = alt.Chart(quadrant_labels).mark_text(

    scatter_plot = alt.Chart(df_sorted).mark_circle(size=100).encode(

                title="Change Size Score",

        y=alt.Y("Org_Attributes:Q",

        tooltip=[

    final_chart = (h_line + v_line + text_labels + scatter_plot).properties(background=chart_bg).interactive()
else:

# ── 7a. Methodology expander ──────────────────────────────────────────────
with st.expander("ℹ️ How is the matrix calculated?", expanded=False):
    st.markdown("""
**Change Size Bands** (derived from Change Characteristics score 15–75):

| Band | Score Range | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| Minimal | 15 – 29 | Narrow scope, few roles affected, low impact |
| Moderate | 30 – 42 | Defined scope, some process changes |
| Significant | 43 – 52 | Cross-functional, notable workflow disruption |
| Major | 53 – 63 | Organisation-wide, significant retraining needed |
| Transformational | 64 – 75 | Fundamental restructuring, culture shift required |

**Organisational Readiness Bands** (derived from Org Attributes score 15–75):

| Band | Score Range | Description |
|------|------------|-------------|
| Very Low | 15 – 29 | Little awareness, poor sponsorship, resistant culture |
| Low | 30 – 42 | Some awareness, weak change history |
| Moderate | 43 – 52 | Mixed readiness, average sponsor engagement |
| High | 53 – 63 | Strong capacity, supportive culture |
| Very High | 64 – 75 | Experienced change, active sponsors, aligned staff |

**Rollout Complexity Profiles** (intersection of the two bands):

| Profile | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| 🟢 Low Complexity | Org well-prepared; standard rollout plan sufficient |
| 🔵 Manageable | Minor targeted support needed; low risk of derailment |
| 🟡 Elevated Complexity | Proactive readiness activities required; monitor closely |
| 🟠 High Complexity | Significant change management resource investment required |
| 🔴 Critical Exposure | Org lacks capacity; phased approach essential |
| ⬛ Extreme Overload | Fundamental mismatch; change must be rescoped or major readiness programme deployed |
""")

# ── 7b. Static 5×5 reference matrix ──────────────────────────────────────
st.subheader("Reference Matrix")

cs_labels = [b[2] for b in CHANGE_SIZE_BANDS]
rd_labels  = [b[2] for b in ORG_READINESS_BANDS]

matrix_th_bg = "#2e2b28" if is_dark else "#f0f0f0"
matrix_th_border = "rgba(225, 182, 117, 0.15)" if is_dark else "#ddd"
matrix_td_side_bg = "#262321" if is_dark else "#fafafa"
matrix_text_color = "#e7e5e4" if is_dark else "#222222"

header_row = f"<tr><th style='background:{matrix_th_bg};color:{matrix_text_color};padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid {matrix_th_border};min-width:130px;'>Readiness ↕ / Change →</th>"
for cs in cs_labels:
    header_row += f"<th style='background:{matrix_th_bg};color:{matrix_text_color};padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid {matrix_th_border};text-align:center;'>{cs}</th>"
header_row += "</tr>"

body_rows = ""
# Iterate idx 0→4 so Very High readiness (idx 0, low OA score) appears at the top
for rd_idx in range(len(rd_labels)):
    rd_label = rd_labels[rd_idx]
    body_rows += f"<tr><td style='font-weight:600;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid {matrix_th_border};background:{matrix_td_side_bg};color:{matrix_text_color};'>{rd_label}</td>"
    for cs_idx in range(len(cs_labels)):
        profile = COMPLEXITY_MATRIX[rd_idx][cs_idx]
        bg      = COMPLEXITY_COLOURS.get(profile, "#ffffff")
        dark_bgs = {"#00703c", "#d4351c", "#7b0d1e"}
        txt_col  = "#ffffff" if bg in dark_bgs else "#222222"
        body_rows += (
            f"<td style='padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid {matrix_th_border};background:{bg};"
            f"color:{txt_col};text-align:center;font-size:0.82rem;'>{profile}</td>"
        )
    body_rows += "</tr>"

matrix_html = (
    "<div style='overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:1rem;'>"
    "<table style='border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:0.9rem;'>"
    f"<thead>{header_row}</thead>"
    f"<tbody>{body_rows}</tbody>"
    "</table></div>"
)
st.markdown(matrix_html, unsafe_allow_html=True)

# ── 7c. Organisation placements ───────────────────────────────────────────
st.subheader("Organisation Placements")

if df_sorted.empty:
    st.info("No Prosci scores recorded yet. Enter and save scores above to see organisation placements.")
else:
    # KPI summary badges
    complexity_counts = df_sorted["Complexity Profile"].value_counts()
    total             = len(df_sorted)
    kpi_cols = st.columns(len(COMPLEXITY_ORDER))
    for i, profile in enumerate(COMPLEXITY_ORDER):
        count   = complexity_counts.get(profile, 0)
        bg_col  = COMPLEXITY_COLOURS[profile]
        dark_bg = bg_col in {"#00703c", "#d4351c", "#7b0d1e"}
        txt_col = "#ffffff" if dark_bg else "#222222"
        kpi_cols[i].markdown(
            f"""<div style="background:{bg_col};border-radius:8px;padding:10px 6px;text-align:center;">
                <div style="font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:{txt_col};">{count}</div>
                <div style="font-size:0.65rem;color:{txt_col};line-height:1.2;">{profile}</div>
            </div>""",
            unsafe_allow_html=True,
        )

    st.markdown("")

    # ── 7d. Altair heatmap ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    cell_data = []
    for _, row in df_sorted.iterrows():
        cs_lbl  = row["Change Size Band"]
        rd_lbl  = row["Readiness Band"]
        profile = row["Complexity Profile"]
        cs_idx  = next((i for i, b in enumerate(CHANGE_SIZE_BANDS)   if b[2] == cs_lbl), 0)
        rd_idx  = next((i for i, b in enumerate(ORG_READINESS_BANDS) if b[2] == rd_lbl), 0)
        cell_data.append({
            "Change Size":        cs_lbl,
            "Org Readiness":      rd_lbl,
            "Complexity Profile": profile,
            "Organisation":       row["Organisation"],
            "cs_order":           cs_idx,
            "rd_order":           rd_idx,
        })

    df_cells = pd.DataFrame(cell_data)
    df_agg = (
        df_cells.groupby(
            ["Change Size", "Org Readiness", "Complexity Profile", "cs_order", "rd_order"], as_index=False
        ).agg(
            Orgs=("Organisation", lambda x: ", ".join(sorted(x))),
            Count=("Organisation", "count"),
        )
    )

    cs_sort_order = [b[2] for b in CHANGE_SIZE_BANDS]
    # Reverse so Very High readiness appears at the top of the Y axis in Altair
    rd_sort_order = list(reversed([b[2] for b in ORG_READINESS_BANDS]))

    colour_scale = alt.Scale(
        domain=list(COMPLEXITY_COLOURS.keys()),
        range=list(COMPLEXITY_COLOURS.values()),
    )

    base_rect = alt.Chart(df_agg).mark_rect(stroke=cell_stroke, strokeWidth=1.5).encode(
        x=alt.X("Change Size:N", sort=cs_sort_order,
                axis=alt.Axis(title="Change Size →", labelAngle=0, titleColor=title_color, labelColor=label_color)),
        y=alt.Y("Org Readiness:N", sort=rd_sort_order,
                axis=alt.Axis(title="Organisational Readiness ↕", titleColor=title_color, labelColor=label_color)),
        color=alt.Color("Complexity Profile:N", scale=colour_scale,
                        legend=alt.Legend(title="Complexity Profile", labelColor=label_color, titleColor=title_color)),
        tooltip=[
            alt.Tooltip("Change Size:N",       title="Change Size"),
            alt.Tooltip("Org Readiness:N",      title="Org Readiness"),
            alt.Tooltip("Complexity Profile:N", title="Profile"),
            alt.Tooltip("Count:Q",              title="# Orgs"),
            alt.Tooltip("Orgs:N",              title="Organisations"),
        ],
    )

    text_count = alt.Chart(df_agg).mark_text(
        align="center", baseline="middle", fontSize=14, fontWeight="bold",
    ).encode(
        x=alt.X("Change Size:N",   sort=cs_sort_order),
        y=alt.Y("Org Readiness:N", sort=rd_sort_order),
        text=alt.Text("Count:Q"),
        color=alt.condition(
            alt.FieldOneOfPredicate(
                field="Complexity Profile",
                oneOf=["Critical Exposure", "Extreme Overload", "Low Complexity"]
            ),
            alt.value("#ffffff"),
            alt.value("#222222"),
        ),
    )

    heatmap = (base_rect + text_count).properties(
        height=320, background=chart_bg
    ).configure_view(stroke=None)

    st.altair_chart(heatmap, use_container_width=True)

    # ── 7e. Organisation complexity detail table ──────────────────────────
    st.subheader("Organisation Complexity Detail")

    RISK_EMOJI = {"Low Risk": "🟢", "Medium Risk": "🟡", "High Risk": "🔴"}
    COMPLEXITY_EMOJI = {
        "Low Complexity":      "🟢",
        "Manageable":          "🔵",
        "Elevated Complexity": "🟡",
        "High Complexity":     "🟠",
        "Critical Exposure":   "🔴",
        "Extreme Overload":    "⬛",
    }

    detail_df = df_sorted[[
        "Rank", "Organisation",
        "Change Size Band", "Change_Characteristics",
        "Readiness Band", "Org_Attributes",
        "Risk Category", "Complexity Profile", "Risk Score",
    ]].copy()

    detail_df["Change Size"] = detail_df.apply(
        lambda r: f"{r['Change Size Band']}  ({int(r['Change_Characteristics'])})", axis=1
    )
    detail_df["Org Readiness"] = detail_df.apply(
        lambda r: f"{r['Readiness Band']}  ({int(r['Org_Attributes'])})", axis=1
    )
    detail_df["Risk Category"]      = detail_df["Risk Category"].apply(
        lambda x: f"{RISK_EMOJI.get(x, '')} {x}"
    )
    detail_df["Complexity Profile"] = detail_df["Complexity Profile"].apply(
        lambda x: f"{COMPLEXITY_EMOJI.get(x, '')} {x}"
    )

    st.dataframe(
        detail_df[["Rank", "Organisation", "Change Size", "Org Readiness",
                   "Risk Category", "Complexity Profile", "Risk Score"]],
        column_config={
            "Rank":               st.column_config.NumberColumn("Rank", format="%d"),
            "Organisation":       st.column_config.TextColumn("Organisation"),
            "Change Size":        st.column_config.TextColumn("Change Size"),
            "Org Readiness":      st.column_config.TextColumn("Org Readiness"),
            "Risk Category":      st.column_config.TextColumn("Risk Category"),
            "Complexity Profile": st.column_config.TextColumn("Complexity Profile"),
            "Risk Score":         st.column_config.NumberColumn("Combined Score", format="%d"),
        },
        hide_index=True,
        use_container_width=True,
    )


    # ── 7f. Recommended rollout actions ───────────────────────────────────
    st.markdown("")
    st.subheader("🛠️ Recommended Rollout Actions")

    # Dynamically styled cards to match dark/light theme
    st.markdown(f"""
    <style>
    .ra-card {{ 
        background: {"rgba(28, 26, 24, 0.4)" if is_dark else "#ffffff"} !important; 
        border: 1px solid {"rgba(225, 182, 117, 0.18)" if is_dark else "#e0deda"} !important;
        border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;
        margin-bottom:12px; padding:14px 18px; font-family:sans-serif; 
    }}
    .ra-card .ra-orgs  {{ 
        color: {"#94a3b8" if is_dark else "#64748b"} !important; font-size:0.82rem;
        font-style:italic; margin-left:10px; 
    }}
    .ra-card .ra-body  {{ 
        color: {"#e7e5e4" if is_dark else "#161513"} !important; font-size:0.88rem;
        line-height:1.6; margin-top:8px; 
    }}
    .ra-card .ra-body strong {{ 
        color: {"#ffffff" if is_dark else "#161513"} !important; font-weight:700; 
    }}
    </style>
    """, unsafe_allow_html=True)

    RECOMMENDED_ACTIONS = {
        "Low Complexity":
            "<strong>✅ Standard rollout plan</strong> is appropriate. Maintain routine comms cadence, "
            "confirm sponsor availability, and proceed with scheduled go-live dates.",
        "Manageable":
            "<strong>🔵 Light-touch change support</strong> recommended. Run a targeted impact assessment, "
            "ensure training materials are ready, and schedule a readiness check-in two weeks before go-live.",
        "Elevated Complexity":
            "<strong>🟡 Proactive readiness programme</strong> required. Assign a dedicated change resource, "
            "run structured stakeholder engagement sessions, and build a resistance management plan.",
        "High Complexity":
            "<strong>🟠 Significant change investment</strong> needed. Commission a full change impact & readiness "
            "assessment, establish a local change champion network, increase sponsor coaching intensity, "
            "and consider a phased or pilot rollout approach.",
        "Critical Exposure":
            "<strong>🔴 Phased approach essential.</strong> Do not proceed with full rollout until a structured "
            "readiness sprint is completed. Engage executive sponsors immediately, pause non-critical "
            "workstreams to free internal capacity, and agree formal success criteria before wave entry.",
        "Extreme Overload":
            "<strong>⬛ Critical intervention required.</strong> The scale of change fundamentally exceeds current "
            "organisational readiness. Escalate to programme board, rescope change delivery timeline, "
            "commission an urgent organisational readiness recovery plan, and implement an executive-led "
            "communications strategy before any rollout activity.",
    }

    present_profiles = df_sorted["Complexity Profile"].unique()
    shown = [p for p in reversed(COMPLEXITY_ORDER) if p in present_profiles]

    for profile in shown:
        bg        = COMPLEXITY_COLOURS[profile]
        drk       = bg in {"#00703c", "#d4351c", "#7b0d1e"}
        badge_txt = "#ffffff" if drk else "#222222"

                <div>
                    <span style="background:{bg};color:{badge_txt};padding:3px 12px;

                    <span class="ra-orgs">{orgs_str}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="ra-body">{RECOMMENDED_ACTIONS[profile]}</div>
            </div>""",
            unsafe_allow_html=True,

def export_gantt_to_pptx(df, project_name):
    from pptx import Presentation
    from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
    from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
    from io import BytesIO
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta

    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.33)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)
    
    # Blank slide layout
    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
    
    # Title
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(0.5), Inches(12.33), Inches(0.8))
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = f"Project Roadmap: {project_name}"
    p.font.size = Pt(28)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184) # NHS Blue
    
    # Add subtitle
    p_sub = tf.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.text = f"Generated on {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} | People Portal Programme"
    p_sub.font.size = Pt(12)
    p_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(100, 116, 139) # Grey

    # Gantt layout params
    timeline_left = 3.5
    timeline_width = 9.0
    timeline_top = 1.8
    row_height = 0.4
    
    df_clean = df.copy()
    df_clean['start_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_clean['start_date']).dt.date
    df_clean['due_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_clean['due_date']).dt.date
    
    min_date = df_clean['start_date'].min()
    max_date = df_clean['due_date'].max()
    if pd.isnull(min_date) or pd.isnull(max_date):
        min_date = datetime.now().date()
        max_date = min_date + timedelta(days=30)
    
    total_days = max(1, (max_date - min_date).days)
    
    # Draw time markers (vertical grid lines)
    for i in range(5):
        fraction = i / 4
        x_pos = timeline_left + timeline_width * fraction
        
        m_date = min_date + timedelta(days=int(total_days * fraction))
        tx = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x_pos - 0.5), Inches(timeline_top - 0.35), Inches(1.0), Inches(0.3))
        tx.text_frame.text = m_date.strftime("%d %b")
        tx.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(8)
        tx.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(148, 163, 184)
        
        shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
            1, # MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE
            Inches(x_pos), Inches(timeline_top), Inches(0.01), Inches(row_height * len(df_clean))
        )
        shape.fill.solid()
        shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(241, 245, 249)
        shape.line.fill.background()
        
    # Draw rows
    for idx, (_, row) in enumerate(df_clean.iterrows()):
        y_pos = timeline_top + row_height * idx
        
        tx_label = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.5), Inches(y_pos), Inches(2.9), Inches(0.35))
        tx_label.text_frame.text = f"{row['task'][:40]}..." if len(row['task']) > 40 else row['task']
        tx_label.text_frame.word_wrap = True
        p_label = tx_label.text_frame.paragraphs[0]
        p_label.font.size = Pt(9)
        p_label.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(15, 23, 42)
        
        task_start = row['start_date']
        task_end = row['due_date']
        
        start_fraction = (task_start - min_date).days / total_days
        end_fraction = (task_end - min_date).days / total_days
        
        bar_left = timeline_left + timeline_width * start_fraction
        bar_width = timeline_width * (end_fraction - start_fraction)
        
        if bar_width <= 0:
            bar_width = 0.1
            
        bar_shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
            1, # MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE
            Inches(bar_left), Inches(y_pos + 0.05), Inches(bar_width), Inches(row_height - 0.1)
        )
        
        color_rgb = RGBColor(174, 183, 189) # Default Grey
        chart_status = row.get('chart_status', '')
        if chart_status == 'Completed':
            color_rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184) # NHS Blue
        elif chart_status == 'Critical Path':
            color_rgb = RGBColor(213, 56, 150) # Magenta
        elif chart_status == 'Overdue':
            color_rgb = RGBColor(212, 53, 28) # NHS Red
        elif chart_status == 'Green':
            color_rgb = RGBColor(0, 112, 60) # Green
        elif chart_status == 'Amber':
            color_rgb = RGBColor(255, 221, 0) # Amber
            
        bar_shape.fill.solid()
        bar_shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color_rgb
        bar_shape.line.fill.background()
        
    ppt_io = BytesIO()
    prs.save(ppt_io)
    ppt_io.seek(0)
    return ppt_io

handle_page_entry()
app_state = get_app_state()
can_view, reason = user_can("view_project_dashboard")
if not can_view:
    st.error(f"🔒 {reason}")
    st.stop()
try:

# --- Image Preview Helpers ---
_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {'.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.webp', '.bmp', '.svg'}

def _is_image_file(file_name: str) -> bool:
    """Returns True if the file extension indicates an image."""
    ext = os.path.splitext(str(file_name or '').lower())[1]
    return ext in _IMAGE_EXTENSIONS

def _render_image_preview(file_path: str, file_name: str, width: int = 300) -> None:
    """Decrypts and renders an image inline via st.image().
    
    Falls back silently if the file is missing or cannot be decrypted.
    """
    try:
        if file_path and os.path.exists(file_path):
            img_bytes = decrypt_file(file_path)
            st.image(img_bytes, caption=file_name, width=width)
    except Exception:
        pass  # Don't block the rest of the UI on an image decode failure
