# --- Quick Preview & Apply ---
st.subheader("🖥️ Quick Preview & Apply")
prev_col1, prev_col2 = st.columns([0.3, 0.7], vertical_alignment="center")

def preview_sync_theme() -> None:
    is_dark = st.session_state.dark_mode_preview_widget
    app_state.dark_mode = is_dark
    val = 'Dark' if is_dark else 'Light'
    if fetch_one("SELECT id FROM app_config WHERE category = 'THEME_PREF'"):
        execute("UPDATE app_config SET value = ? WHERE category = 'THEME_PREF'", (val,))
    else:
        execute("INSERT INTO app_config (category, value, display_order) VALUES (?, ?, 0)", ('THEME_PREF', val))
        
def preview_sync_brand() -> None:
    selected_brand = st.session_state.brand_theme_preview_widget.lower()
    app_state.brand_theme = selected_brand
    st.session_state['app_branding_mode'] = 'people_portal' if selected_brand == 'nhs' else 'fnws'
    if fetch_one("SELECT id FROM app_config WHERE category = 'APP_BRAND_THEME'"):
        execute("UPDATE app_config SET value = ? WHERE category = 'APP_BRAND_THEME'", (selected_brand,))
    else:
        execute("INSERT INTO app_config (category, value, display_order) VALUES (?, ?, 0)", ('APP_BRAND_THEME', selected_brand))

# Import THEME_CONFIGS for display list
from core.theme_configs import THEME_CONFIGS
brand_options = sorted([k.title() for k in THEME_CONFIGS.keys()])
current_theme_title = app_state.brand_theme.title()
brand_idx = brand_options.index(current_theme_title) if current_theme_title in brand_options else 0

with prev_col1:
    st.toggle("🌙 Dark Mode", value=app_state.dark_mode, key="dark_mode_preview_widget", on_change=preview_sync_theme)
with prev_col2:
    st.selectbox(
        "Active Application Theme",
        options=brand_options,
        index=brand_idx,
        key="brand_theme_preview_widget",
        on_change=preview_sync_brand
    )

st.divider()

# --- Helper Functions ---
def hex_to_rgba(hex_str: str, alpha: float) -> str:
    hex_str = hex_str.lstrip('#')
    if len(hex_str) == 3:
        hex_str = ''.join([c*2 for c in hex_str])
    try:
        r = int(hex_str[0:2], 16)
        g = int(hex_str[2:4], 16)
        b = int(hex_str[4:6], 16)
        return f"rgba({r}, {g}, {b}, {alpha})"
    except Exception:
        return f"rgba(0, 0, 0, {alpha})"

# --- Load Custom & Existing Themes ---
from core.theme_configs import THEME_CONFIGS

all_themes = {}
for k, v in THEME_CONFIGS.items():
    all_themes[k.title()] = v

custom_themes_list = []
try:
    rows = query("SELECT name, theme_json FROM user_themes").to_dict(orient="records")
    for r in rows:
        t_name = r["name"]
        all_themes[t_name] = json.loads(r["theme_json"])
        custom_themes_list.append(t_name)
except Exception:
    pass

# --- Theme Workspace State ---
if "builder_theme_name" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state["builder_theme_name"] = "My Custom Theme"

if "builder_theme_data" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state["builder_theme_data"] = DEFAULT_THEME_TEMPLATE.copy()

# --- File Upload Handling ---
st.subheader("📥 Import Theme")
uploaded_file = st.file_uploader("Upload custom theme JSON file", type=["json"], key="theme_uploader")
if uploaded_file is not None:
    try:
        uploaded_data = json.loads(uploaded_file.read().decode("utf-8"))
        if "dark" in uploaded_data and "light" in uploaded_data:
            st.session_state["builder_theme_data"] = uploaded_data
            st.success("Theme uploaded and loaded into the workspace!")
        else:
            st.error("Invalid theme file: Must contain both 'light' and 'dark' mode configs.")
    except Exception as e:
        st.error(f"Error parsing theme JSON: {e}")

st.divider()

# --- Select/Load/Delete Workspace ---
st.subheader("🛠️ Theme Workspace")
ws_col1, ws_col2 = st.columns([0.7, 0.3])

options = ["[New Theme]"] + sorted(list(all_themes.keys()))

if "active_theme_name" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state["active_theme_name"] = "[New Theme]"

try:
    default_idx = options.index(st.session_state["active_theme_name"])
except ValueError:
    default_idx = 0

with ws_col1:
    selected_theme = st.selectbox(
        "Select Theme to Edit/Load",
        options=options,
        index=default_idx,
        key="theme_selector_widget"
    )
    
    # Handle changes on select
    if selected_theme != st.session_state["active_theme_name"]:
        st.session_state["active_theme_name"] = selected_theme
        if selected_theme == "[New Theme]":
            st.session_state["builder_theme_name"] = "My Custom Theme"
            st.session_state["builder_theme_data"] = DEFAULT_THEME_TEMPLATE.copy()
        else:
            st.session_state["builder_theme_name"] = selected_theme
            st.session_state["builder_theme_data"] = all_themes[selected_theme]
        st.rerun()

with ws_col2:
    st.markdown("<br>", unsafe_allow_html=True)
    is_custom_theme = (st.session_state["active_theme_name"] in custom_themes_list)
    if is_custom_theme:
        is_override = (st.session_state["active_theme_name"].lower() in [k.lower() for k in THEME_CONFIGS.keys()])
        btn_label = "🔄 Reset to Default Theme" if is_override else "🗑️ Delete Theme"
        if st.button(btn_label, type="primary", use_container_width=True):
            execute("DELETE FROM user_themes WHERE name = ?", (st.session_state["active_theme_name"],))
            log_audit_event("THEME_DELETE", "user_themes", app_state.user.current_user, app_state.user.current_user_role, details={"theme_name": st.session_state["active_theme_name"]})
            st.success(f"Removed override/custom theme for '{st.session_state['active_theme_name']}'!")
            st.session_state["active_theme_name"] = "[New Theme]"
            st.session_state["builder_theme_name"] = "My Custom Theme"
            st.session_state["builder_theme_data"] = DEFAULT_THEME_TEMPLATE.copy()
            time.sleep(1)
            st.rerun()

st.divider()

# --- Theme Configuration Form ---
st.subheader("🎨 Editor")
suffix = st.session_state["active_theme_name"]
theme_name_input = st.text_input("Theme Name", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_name"], key=f"theme_name_input_{suffix}")

tab_visual, tab_json = st.tabs(["🖌️ Visual Designer", "💻 Raw JSON Config"])

with tab_visual:
    st.markdown("### Core Theme Colors")

        st.markdown("#### 🌙 Dark Mode Colors")
        dark_primary = st.color_picker("Primary Brand Color (Dark)", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_data"]["dark"].get("border_color", "#ffb000"), key=f"dark_pick_prim_{suffix}")

        dark_card = st.color_picker("Card/Pane Background (Dark)", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_data"]["dark"].get("card_bg", "#160e05"), key=f"dark_pick_card_{suffix}")
        dark_text = st.color_picker("Text Color (Dark)", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_data"]["dark"].get("text_color", "#ffb000"), key=f"dark_pick_text_{suffix}")

    with col_l:
        st.markdown("#### ☀️ Light Mode Colors")
        light_primary = st.color_picker("Primary Brand Color (Light)", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_data"]["light"].get("border_color", "#ff8800"), key=f"light_pick_prim_{suffix}")
        light_bg = st.color_picker("Page Background (Light)", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_data"]["light"].get("body_bg", "#fbf6ee"), key=f"light_pick_bg_{suffix}")
        light_card = st.color_picker("Card/Pane Background (Light)", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_data"]["light"].get("card_bg", "#f5ebd6"), key=f"light_pick_card_{suffix}")
        light_text = st.color_picker("Text Color (Light)", value=st.session_state["builder_theme_data"]["light"].get("text_color", "#5e3200"), key=f"light_pick_text_{suffix}")
        
    if st.button("Generate Config from Colors", use_container_width=True, key=f"btn_gen_config_{suffix}"):
        st.session_state["builder_theme_name"] = theme_name_input
        st.session_state["builder_theme_data"] = generate_theme_from_core(

            dark_primary, dark_bg, dark_card, dark_text,
            light_primary, light_bg, light_card, light_text
        )

        st.rerun()

with tab_json:

                time.sleep(1)

# pages/21a_📊_Board_Report_Generator.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import io
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt, RGBColor
from typing import List, Any, Dict, Tuple, Optional

# 1. Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import apply_custom_css, render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons, clear_all_filters
from core.database_utils import query, get_config, get_master_filter_where_clause, execute, log_audit_event, fetch_one
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.pdf_utils import ReportPDF
from core.state import get_app_state
from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response

handle_page_entry()

# Check permissions
can_view, reason = user_can("view_custom_reports") # Re-using report viewing permission
if not can_view:
    st.error("🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this page.")
    st.stop()

# 2. Page Setup & Sidebar
app_state = get_app_state()
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Administration"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

# GLOBAL FILTER LOGIC
f_sil = st.session_state.get('filter_sil', "All SILs")
f_il = st.session_state.get('filter_il', "All ILs")
f_im = st.session_state.get('filter_im', "All IMs")

master_filter, params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im, proj_alias="projects", org_alias="orgs")
join_logic = """
    JOIN orgs ON projects.org_id = orgs.id
    JOIN region_mapping m ON orgs.region = m.sub_region
"""

st.title("📊 Board Report Generator")
st.caption("Auto-generate a comprehensive NHS-branded regional/national status briefing for board governance.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# 3. Data Gathering Queries
# Heatmap Data
heatmap_sql = f"""
    SELECT 
        orgs.name as Trust, 
        projects.name as Stream, 
        projects.rag_status as Health, 
        projects.status as Phase
    FROM projects {join_logic} WHERE {master_filter} AND projects.is_deleted = 0
"""
df_heatmap = query(heatmap_sql, params=params)

# Pipeline Counts
PHASES = get_config('PHASE')
active_phases = [p for p in PHASES if p not in ["Withdrawn", "Not Applicable"]]
df_pipeline = pd.DataFrame([{"Phase": p, "Count": len(df_heatmap[df_heatmap['Phase'] == p])} for p in active_phases]) if not df_heatmap.empty else pd.DataFrame(columns=['Phase', 'Count'])

# Top Risks
risks_sql = f"""
    SELECT orgs.name as Trust, projects.name as Project, r.description, r.impact, r.likelihood, r.mitigation
    FROM risks r
    JOIN projects ON r.project_id = projects.id
    JOIN orgs ON projects.org_id = orgs.id
    JOIN region_mapping m ON orgs.region = m.sub_region
    WHERE {master_filter} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'Open' AND r.impact IN ('Critical', 'High')
    ORDER BY r.impact DESC
"""
df_risks = query(risks_sql, params=params)

# Forward Look (Upcoming Actions/Milestones in the next 30 days)
today_date = datetime.now().date()
month_date = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=30)).date()
tasks_sql = f"""
    SELECT orgs.name as Trust, actions.task, actions.due_date, actions.assigned_to
    FROM actions
    JOIN projects ON actions.project_id = projects.id
    JOIN orgs ON projects.org_id = orgs.id
    JOIN region_mapping m ON orgs.region = m.sub_region
    WHERE {master_filter} AND actions.is_deleted = 0 AND actions.status != 'Closed' AND actions.due_date BETWEEN ? AND ?
    ORDER BY actions.due_date ASC
"""
df_tasks = query(tasks_sql, params=params + (str(today_date), str(month_date)))

# 4. Word/PDF Document Exporter Functions
def to_word_board_report(summary: str, df_heatmap: pd.DataFrame, df_pipeline: pd.DataFrame, df_risks: pd.DataFrame, df_tasks: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    doc = Document()
    
    # Page setup
    for section in doc.sections:
        section.top_margin = Inches(1)
        section.bottom_margin = Inches(1)
        section.left_margin = Inches(1)
        section.right_margin = Inches(1)
        
    # Title
    title = doc.add_heading(level=0)
    run = title.add_run('NHSBSA Transformation Rollout — Board Report')
    run.font.name = 'Arial'
    run.font.size = Pt(24)
    run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184) # NHS Blue
    run.bold = True
    
    # Subtitle
    p_sub = doc.add_paragraph()
    run_sub = p_sub.add_run(f"Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%d %B %Y')} | Scope: National Programme Status")
    run_sub.font.name = 'Arial'
    run_sub.font.size = Pt(11)
    run_sub.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(100, 100, 100)
    
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(12)
    
    # 1. Executive Summary
    h1 = doc.add_heading(level=1)
    run_h1 = h1.add_run('1. Executive Programme Summary')
    run_h1.font.name = 'Arial'
    run_h1.font.size = Pt(18)
    run_h1.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184)
    run_h1.bold = True
    
    if summary:
        for p_text in summary.split('\n\n'):
            if p_text.strip():
                doc.add_paragraph(p_text.strip())
    else:
        doc.add_paragraph("No executive summary draft generated. Run the AI builder or add commentary.")
        
    # 2. Programme RAG Status
    h2 = doc.add_heading(level=1)
    run_h2 = h2.add_run('2. Programme RAG Status Heatmap')
    run_h2.font.name = 'Arial'
    run_h2.font.size = Pt(18)
    run_h2.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184)
    run_h2.bold = True
    
    if not df_heatmap.empty:
        table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=4)
        table.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
        hdr_cells = table.rows[0].cells
        hdr_cells[0].text = 'Organisation (Trust)'
        hdr_cells[1].text = 'Project Stream'
        hdr_cells[2].text = 'RAG Health'
        hdr_cells[3].text = 'Current Phase'
        
        for _, row in df_heatmap.iterrows():
            row_cells = table.add_row().cells
            row_cells[0].text = str(row['Trust'])
            row_cells[1].text = str(row['Stream'])
            row_cells[2].text = str(row['Health'])
            row_cells[3].text = str(row['Phase'])
    else:
        doc.add_paragraph("No active projects found matching the current scope.")
        
    # 3. Pipeline Metrics
    h3 = doc.add_heading(level=1)
    run_h3 = h3.add_run('3. Rollout Phase Pipeline')
    run_h3.font.name = 'Arial'
    run_h3.font.size = Pt(18)
    run_h3.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184)
    run_h3.bold = True
    
    if not df_pipeline.empty:
        table_p = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
        table_p.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
        hdr_p = table_p.rows[0].cells
        hdr_p[0].text = 'Phase'
        hdr_p[1].text = 'Count'
        for _, row in df_pipeline.iterrows():
            row_cells = table_p.add_row().cells
            row_cells[0].text = str(row['Phase'])
            row_cells[1].text = str(row['Count'])
    else:
        doc.add_paragraph("No pipeline metrics available.")
        
    # 4. Top Critical / High Risks
    h4 = doc.add_heading(level=1)
    run_h4 = h4.add_run('4. Top Programme Risks')
    run_h4.font.name = 'Arial'
    run_h4.font.size = Pt(18)
    run_h4.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184)
    run_h4.bold = True
    
    if not df_risks.empty:
        table_r = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=5)
        table_r.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
        hdr_r = table_r.rows[0].cells
        hdr_r[0].text = 'Trust / Project'
        hdr_r[1].text = 'Description'
        hdr_r[2].text = 'Impact'
        hdr_r[3].text = 'Likelihood'
        hdr_r[4].text = 'Mitigation'
        
        for _, row in df_risks.iterrows():
            row_cells = table_r.add_row().cells
            row_cells[0].text = f"{row['Trust']} - {row['Project']}"
            row_cells[1].text = str(row['description'])
            row_cells[2].text = str(row['impact'])
            row_cells[3].text = str(row['likelihood'])
            row_cells[4].text = str(row['mitigation']) if pd.notna(row['mitigation']) else ""
    else:
        doc.add_paragraph("No critical or high risks currently active in the selected scope.")
        
    # 5. Forward Look (Tasks)
    h5 = doc.add_heading(level=1)
    run_h5 = h5.add_run('5. Forward Look: Key Milestones & Actions')
    run_h5.font.name = 'Arial'
    run_h5.font.size = Pt(18)
    run_h5.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0, 94, 184)
    run_h5.bold = True
    
    if not df_tasks.empty:
        table_t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=4)
        table_t.style = 'Light Shading Accent 1'
        hdr_t = table_t.rows[0].cells
        hdr_t[0].text = 'Trust'
        hdr_t[1].text = 'Task / Action'
        hdr_t[2].text = 'Due Date'
        hdr_t[3].text = 'Owner'
        
        for _, row in df_tasks.iterrows():
            row_cells = table_t.add_row().cells
            row_cells[0].text = str(row['Trust'])
            row_cells[1].text = str(row['task'])
            row_cells[2].text = str(row['due_date'])
            row_cells[3].text = str(row['assigned_to'])
    else:
        doc.add_paragraph("No upcoming key tasks scheduled for the next 30 days.")
        
    output = io.BytesIO()
    doc.save(output)
    return output.getvalue()


def generate_board_report_pdf(summary: str, df_heatmap: pd.DataFrame, df_pipeline: pd.DataFrame, df_risks: pd.DataFrame, df_tasks: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    pdf = ReportPDF(title="NHSBSA Rollout — Board Report")
    pdf.add_page()
    
    # 1. Executive Summary
    pdf.chapter_title("1. Executive Programme Summary", level=1)
    if summary:
        pdf.markdown_to_pdf(summary)
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No executive summary draft generated. Run the AI builder or add commentary.")
    pdf.ln(5)
        
    # 2. Programme RAG Status Heatmap
    pdf.chapter_title("2. Programme RAG Status Heatmap", level=1)
    if not df_heatmap.empty:
        df_heatmap_pdf = df_heatmap[['Trust', 'Stream', 'Health', 'Phase']].copy()
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_heatmap_pdf, col_widths=[50, 50, 30, 50])
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No active projects found.")
    pdf.ln(5)
        
    # 3. Pipeline Metrics
    pdf.chapter_title("3. Rollout Phase Pipeline", level=1)
    if not df_pipeline.empty:
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_pipeline, col_widths=[90, 40])
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No pipeline metrics available.")
    pdf.ln(5)
        
    # 4. Top Risks
    if pdf.get_y() + 40 > pdf.h - pdf.b_margin:
        pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_title("4. Top Programme Risks", level=1)
    if not df_risks.empty:
        df_risks_pdf = df_risks[['Trust', 'description', 'impact', 'likelihood']].copy()
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_risks_pdf, col_widths=[40, 80, 30, 30])
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No critical/high risks active in scope.")
    pdf.ln(5)
        
    # 5. Forward Look
    if pdf.get_y() + 40 > pdf.h - pdf.b_margin:
        pdf.add_page()
    pdf.chapter_title("5. Forward Look: Key Milestones & Actions", level=1)
    if not df_tasks.empty:
        df_tasks_pdf = df_tasks[['Trust', 'task', 'due_date', 'assigned_to']].copy()
        pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_tasks_pdf, col_widths=[45, 65, 30, 40])
    else:
        pdf.chapter_body("No upcoming tasks scheduled.")
        
    return bytes(pdf.output())


# --- UI LAYOUT ---

# Setup session state key for saving the generated AI board summary
if "board_report_summary" not in st.session_state:

            prompt = f"""You are a Senior NHSBSA Transformation Director preparing a Board Report for: {aud}.

**Rollout Status Statistics:**

**Pipeline Phase Status:**
{pipeline_summary}

**Top Risks:**
{risks_summary}

**Instructions:**
1. Write a professional, executive narrative suitable for NHS board members.
2. Group the briefing into 3 key sections: Executive Summary, Current Delivery Status, and Risk & Remediation Plan.
3. Be objective, highlighting clear blockers, dependencies, and mitigations.
4. Keep the output clean and return ONLY the markdown-formatted report contents (do not wrap in markdown ``` block).

# Text Area to review/edit summary
user_summary = st.text_area("Review & Edit Board Summary", value=st.session_state.board_report_summary, height=250)

# Section Previews
st.divider()
st.subheader("📋 Document Previews")

tab1, tab2, tab3 = st.tabs(["📊 Phase Pipeline Status", "🛑 Top Open Risks", "🗓️ Forward Look (30 Days)"])

with tab1:
    if df_pipeline.empty:
        st.info("No pipeline data.")
    else:
        st.dataframe(df_pipeline, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)

with tab2:
    if df_risks.empty:
        st.success("No critical or high open risks active.")
    else:
        st.dataframe(df_risks, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)

with tab3:
    if df_tasks.empty:
        st.info("No upcoming tasks in the next 30 days.")
    else:
        st.dataframe(df_tasks, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)

# Export Section
st.divider()
st.subheader("📥 Export & Distribution")

exp1, exp2 = st.columns(2)

    word_bytes = to_word_board_report(user_summary, df_heatmap, df_pipeline, df_risks, df_tasks)
    st.download_button(label='📥 Download Report as Word (.docx)', data=word_bytes, file_name=f"NHSBSA_Board_Report_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.docx", mime='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', use_container_width=True)

with exp2:
    pdf_bytes = generate_board_report_pdf(user_summary, df_heatmap, df_pipeline, df_risks, df_tasks)
    st.download_button(
        label="📄 Download Report as PDF",
        data=pdf_bytes,
        file_name=f"NHSBSA_Board_Report_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.pdf",
        mime="application/pdf",

# pages/32_🚦_Go_No-Go_Dashboard.py
import streamlit as st

        with st.container(border=True):

# pages/33_💬_Customer_Queries.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# 1. Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons
from core.database_utils import query, execute, fetch_one, log_audit_event, get_config
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.state import get_app_state
from core.logic import get_leadership_team, create_notifications_for_event
from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response

# 2. Page Setup & Security
handle_page_entry()
app_state = get_app_state()
can_view, reason = user_can("view_issue_log") # Re-using issue log permission
if not can_view:
    st.error(f"🔒 Access Denied: {reason}")
    st.stop()

app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Project Delivery"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

st.title("💬 Customer Queries & SLA Help Desk")
st.caption("Log support queries, check SLA countdowns, auto-suggest answers, and compile project FAQ sheets.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# 3. Context & Security Check
if selected_org == "All Organisations" or selected_prj == "All Projects" or current_org_id is None:
    st.warning("⚠️ Please select a specific Organisation and Project Stream in the sidebar.")
    st.stop()

# Get project ID
res = fetch_one("SELECT p.id, o.region FROM projects p JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id WHERE p.name=? AND o.id=? AND p.is_deleted=0", (selected_prj, current_org_id))
if not res:
    st.error("Project context not found.")
    st.stop()
pid, project_region = res

# 4. Configurable Lookups
QUERY_STATUSES = ["Open", "In Progress", "Awaiting Customer", "Resolved", "Closed"]
PLATFORM_DOMAINS = ["NHS Jobs", "ESR", "Pensions", "HR Shared Services", "General"]

# 5. Add New Query Form
can_add, reason = user_can("add_issue")
if can_add:
    with st.expander("➕ Log New Customer Query"):
        with st.form("new_query_form", clear_on_submit=True):
            st.subheader("Log a New Query")
            contact_name = st.text_input("Client Contact Name")
            platform_domain = st.selectbox("Platform/Domain", PLATFORM_DOMAINS)
            interaction_text = st.text_area("Interaction Summary / Query Text")
            
            escalate_to_advisor = st.toggle("Escalate to Advisor", help="Flag this for review by the responsible IL/IM.")

            if st.form_submit_button('Log Query', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
                if interaction_text:
                    owner = None
                    is_escalated = 0
                    date_escalated = None
                    if escalate_to_advisor:
                        is_escalated = 1
                        leadership = get_leadership_team(project_region)
                        owner = leadership.get('IM') if leadership and leadership.get('IM') != 'Unassigned' else (leadership.get('IL') if leadership and leadership.get('IL') != 'Unassigned' else None)
                        if owner:
                            owner = owner.split(',')[0].strip()

                        date_escalated = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    new_query_id = execute(
                        "INSERT INTO customer_queries (project_id, contact_name, platform_domain, interaction_text, date_raised, owner, is_escalated, date_escalated) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (pid, contact_name, platform_domain, interaction_text, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), owner, is_escalated, date_escalated),
                        return_lastrowid=True
                    )
                    log_audit_event("CREATE", "CustomerQuery", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", new_query_id, details={"contact": contact_name, "project_id": pid, "escalated": is_escalated})
                    
                    if is_escalated and owner:
                        create_notifications_for_event(
                            event_type='ESCALATION_ASSIGNED',
                            message=f"New escalation from {contact_name} on '{selected_prj}'.",
                            link="pages/33_💬_Customer_Queries.py",
                            direct_user=owner
                        )
                        st.success(f"Query logged and escalated to {owner}.")
                    else:
                        st.success("Query logged successfully!")
                    st.rerun()
                else:
                    st.error("Interaction Summary is required.")
else:
    st.info(reason)

st.divider()

# Create Tabs for different views
tab_list, tab_kanban, tab_faq = st.tabs(["📋 List View", "📊 SLA Kanban Board", "📚 Export FAQ"])

# Fetch open queries for the project
df_all_queries = query("SELECT * FROM customer_queries WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY date_raised DESC", (pid,))

with tab_list:
    st.subheader("Customer Query Logs")
    df_open_list = df_all_queries[~df_all_queries['resolution_status'].isin(['Resolved', 'Closed'])]
    
    if df_open_list.empty:
        st.success("✅ No open queries for this project.")
    else:
        for _, query_row in df_open_list.iterrows():
            with st.container(border=True):
                # Calculate SLA Status
                raised_date = pd.to_datetime(query_row['date_raised']).date()
                days_open = (datetime.now().date() - raised_date).days
                if days_open <= 1:
                    sla_badge = "🟢 On Track (SLA < 24h)"
                elif days_open <= 3:
                    sla_badge = "🟡 Warning (SLA < 72h)"
                else:
                    sla_badge = "🔴 SLA Breached! (> 72h)"
                
                c1, c2 = st.columns([0.7, 0.3])
                escalation_emoji = "🔥 " if query_row['is_escalated'] else ""
                c1.markdown(f"**{escalation_emoji}{query_row['platform_domain']}: Query from {query_row['contact_name']}**")
                c1.caption(f"Raised: {query_row['date_raised']} | Owner: {query_row['owner'] or 'Unassigned'} | Status: {query_row['resolution_status']}")
                c2.markdown(f"**{sla_badge}**")
                
                with st.expander("View Interaction & Manage"):
                    st.write(query_row['interaction_text'])
                    
                    st.divider()
                    st.subheader("💡 Similar Historic Solutions")
                    
                    # Fetch resolved/closed queries to find similar ones
                    resolved_queries = query("""
                        SELECT id, platform_domain, interaction_text, contact_name, date_raised
                        FROM customer_queries
                        WHERE resolution_status IN ('Resolved', 'Closed') AND is_deleted = 0 AND id != ?
                    """, (query_row['id'],))
                    
                    similar_matches = []
                    if not resolved_queries.empty:
                        active_text = query_row['interaction_text'] or ""
                        active_domain = query_row['platform_domain'] or ""
                        
                        # simple keyword set
                        active_words = set(w.lower() for w in active_text.split() if len(w) > 3)
                        
                        for _, res_row in resolved_queries.iterrows():
                            score = 0.0
                            # Domain match boost
                            if res_row['platform_domain'] == active_domain:
                                score += 5.0
                                
                            # Keyword overlap
                            res_text = res_row['interaction_text'] or ""
                            res_words = set(w.lower() for w in res_text.split() if len(w) > 3)
                            
                            if active_words and res_words:
                                intersection = active_words.intersection(res_words)
                                union = active_words.union(res_words)
                                overlap = len(intersection) / len(union) if union else 0
                                score += overlap * 20.0
                                
                            if score > 0:
                                similar_matches.append({
                                    "id": res_row["id"],
                                    "platform_domain": res_row["platform_domain"],
                                    "contact_name": res_row["contact_name"],
                                    "date_raised": res_row["date_raised"],
                                    "interaction_text": res_text,
                                    "score": score
                                })
                                
                        # Sort by score descending
                        similar_matches = sorted(similar_matches, key=lambda x: x['score'], reverse=True)[:3]
                        
                    if similar_matches:
                        for match in similar_matches:
                            with st.container(border=True):
                                st.markdown(f"**{match['platform_domain']} Query** (from {match['contact_name']} on {match['date_raised']})")
                                st.caption(match['interaction_text'][:200] + ("..." if len(match['interaction_text']) > 200 else ""))
                                if st.button("📋 Use for context", key=f"use_hist_{query_row['id']}_{match['id']}", use_container_width=True):
                                    with st.spinner("Drafting answer using this query as context..."):
                                        prompt = f"""
                                        You are an NHSBSA support expert. Draft a helpful, formal response to the active query, using the similar historic query and its resolution as reference.

                                        **Active Query Text:** {query_row['interaction_text']}
                                        
                                        **Historic Query (Resolved):** {match['interaction_text']}
                                        
                                        Suggest a step-by-step resolution path and draft a polite email response to the customer.
                                        """
                                        st.session_state[f"ai_res_draft_{query_row['id']}"] = generate_ai_response(prompt, temperature=0.2)
                                        st.rerun()
                    else:
                        st.info("No similar resolved queries found in the system.")
                        
                    st.divider()
                    st.subheader("🤖 AI Resolution Suggester")
                    
                    # Suggest Button
                    if st.button('Recommend Resolution', key=f"rec_res_{query_row['id']}", use_container_width=True):
                        with st.spinner("AI is searching previous resolutions and drafting answer..."):
                            # Simple lookup for similar platform queries
                            past_queries_df = query("""
                                SELECT interaction_text FROM customer_queries 
                                WHERE platform_domain = ? AND resolution_status IN ('Resolved', 'Closed') AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 2
                            """, (query_row['platform_domain'],))
                            
                            past_text = ""
                            if not past_queries_df.empty:
                                past_text = "\n**Past Resolutions Context:**\n" + "\n".join(past_queries_df['interaction_text'].tolist())
                            
                            prompt = f"""

                            """
                            st.session_state[f"ai_res_draft_{query_row['id']}"] = generate_ai_response(prompt, temperature=0.2)
                            
                    if f"ai_res_draft_{query_row['id']}" in st.session_state:
                        st.info("**AI Suggested Resolution:**")
                        st.markdown(st.session_state[f"ai_res_draft_{query_row['id']}"])
                    
                    st.divider()
                    can_edit, reason = user_can("edit_issue", owner=query_row['owner'])
                    
                    with st.form(f"manage_query_{query_row['id']}"):
                        edit_status = st.selectbox("Status", options=QUERY_STATUSES, index=QUERY_STATUSES.index(query_row['resolution_status']), key=f"status_{query_row['id']}", disabled=not can_edit)
                        edit_owner = st.text_input("Owner", value=query_row['owner'] or "", key=f"owner_{query_row['id']}", disabled=not can_edit)
                        
                        col_update, col_escalate = st.columns(2)
                        
                        if col_update.form_submit_button("Update", disabled=not can_edit, use_container_width=True):
                            execute(

                                (edit_status, edit_owner, query_row['id'])
                            )
                            log_audit_event("UPDATE", "CustomerQuery", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", query_row['id'], details={"status": edit_status, "owner": edit_owner})
                            st.rerun()

                                    if owner:

                                execute(
                                    "UPDATE customer_queries SET is_escalated=1, date_escalated=?, owner=? WHERE id=?",
                                    (datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), owner, query_row['id'])
                                )
                                create_notifications_for_event(
                                    event_type='ESCALATION_ASSIGNED',

                                    link="pages/33_💬_Customer_Queries.py",
                                    direct_user=owner
                                )
                                log_audit_event("ESCALATE", "CustomerQuery", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", query_row['id'])
                                st.rerun()

def sync_library_to_vector_store():
    """Syncs generic resources (national guidelines, GDPR, user manuals) to global ChromaDB."""
    # Query all generic resources
    df_resources = query("""
        SELECT id, resource_type, title, content, file_path, pdf_file_path 
        FROM generic_resources 
        WHERE is_deleted = 0
    """)
    
    with global_chroma_lock:
        client = get_global_chroma_client()
        collection = client.get_or_create_collection(name="policy_library")
        existing_data = collection.get(include=['metadatas'])
        
        if df_resources.empty:
            # Delete everything from collection if there are no active resources
            if existing_data and 'ids' in existing_data and existing_data['ids']:
                collection.delete(ids=existing_data['ids'])
            return collection
            
        existing_ids = set(existing_data['ids']) if existing_data and 'ids' in existing_data else set()
        chroma_metadatas_map = {doc_id: meta for doc_id, meta in zip(existing_data['ids'], existing_data['metadatas'])} if existing_data else {}
        
        docs_to_upsert = []
        ids_to_upsert = []
        metadatas_to_upsert = []
        
        for _, row in df_resources.iterrows():
            doc_id = f"resource_{row['id']}"
            res_type = row['resource_type']
            doc_text = f"Resource Type: {res_type}\nTitle: {row['title']}\n"
            if row['content']:
                doc_text += f"Content: {row['content']}\n"
            
            file_path = row['pdf_file_path'] if row['pdf_file_path'] and pd.notna(row['pdf_file_path']) else row['file_path']
            if file_path and pd.notna(file_path) and os.path.exists(file_path):
                try:
                    # Decrypt and extract text from file
                    raw_text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
                    if raw_text:
                        doc_text += f"Document Content Extract:\n{raw_text}\n"
                except Exception:
                    pass
            
            # Content hashing to see if it changed
            current_hash = hashlib.sha256(doc_text.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore')).hexdigest()
            
            metadata = {
                "title": str(row['title']),
                "type": res_type,
                "content_hash": current_hash
            }
            
            if doc_id not in chroma_metadatas_map or chroma_metadatas_map[doc_id].get('content_hash') != current_hash:
                docs_to_upsert.append(doc_text)
                ids_to_upsert.append(doc_id)
                metadatas_to_upsert.append(metadata)
                
        if docs_to_upsert:
            collection.upsert(documents=docs_to_upsert, ids=ids_to_upsert, metadatas=metadatas_to_upsert)
            
        # Clean up deleted resources in ChromaDB
        active_ids = {f"resource_{rid}" for rid in df_resources['id']}
        ids_to_delete = [doc_id for doc_id in existing_ids if doc_id not in active_ids]
        if ids_to_delete:
            collection.delete(ids=ids_to_delete)
            
        return collection

def prepare_html_with_styles(content, res_type):
    if not content:
        return ""
    lower_content = content.lower()
    is_ebs = res_type == 'HTML Appraisal (Oracle EBS)'
    is_bootstrap = res_type == 'Web Portlet (Bootstrap)'
    if res_type == 'Web Portlet / HTML Appraisal':
        if "ebusiness" in lower_content or "appraisal" in lower_content:
            is_ebs = True
        else:
            is_bootstrap = True
            
    if is_ebs:
        style_header = '<link rel="stylesheet" href="/app/static/oracle_ebs.css">'
        script_footer = ''
    elif is_bootstrap:
        style_header = f'<link href="{get_bootstrap_css_url()}" rel="stylesheet">'
        script_footer = f'<script src="{get_bootstrap_js_url()}"></script>'
    else:
        return content

    if "</head>" in lower_content:
        head_end_idx = lower_content.find("</head>")
        result = content[:head_end_idx] + style_header + content[head_end_idx:]
        if "</body>" in lower_content and script_footer:
            body_end_idx = result.lower().find("</body>")
            result = result[:body_end_idx] + script_footer + result[body_end_idx:]
        elif script_footer:
            result += script_footer
        return result
    elif "<body>" in lower_content:
        body_start_idx = lower_content.find("<body>")
        result = content[:body_start_idx] + f"<head>{style_header}</head>" + content[body_start_idx:]
        if "</body>" in lower_content and script_footer:
            body_end_idx = result.lower().find("</body>")
            result = result[:body_end_idx] + script_footer + result[body_end_idx:]
        elif script_footer:
            result += script_footer
        return result
    else:
        return f'<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">{style_header}</head><body>{content}{script_footer}</body></html>'

def create_export_zip(title, content, assets_dir=None):
    import io
    import zipfile
    
    safe_title = "".join(c for c in title if c.isalnum() or c in "._- ").strip()
    safe_title = safe_title.replace(" ", "_")
    if not safe_title:
        safe_title = "resource"
        
    zip_buffer = io.BytesIO()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_buffer, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zip_file:
        # 1. Code file
        zip_file.writestr(f"{safe_title}.txt", content or "")
        
        # 2. Assets
        if assets_dir and assets_dir.exists():
            for file_path in assets_dir.iterdir():
                if file_path.is_file() and not file_path.name.startswith('.'):
                    zip_file.write(file_path, arcname=f"assets/{file_path.name}")
                    
        # 3. README.txt
        readme_content = f"""# Export Package for {title}

This package contains the code and static assets for the resource: "{title}".

## Directory Structure:
- {safe_title}.txt (Code file)
- assets/ (Folder containing associated asset files)
- README.txt (This guide)

## Important Step for Deployment to ESR:
You need to update all asset paths in your code before deployment.
1. Upload the files inside the `assets/` folder to ESR (Electronic Staff Record).
2. Note the new URLs generated by ESR for these uploaded assets.
3. Open `{safe_title}.txt`, locate any reference to local assets (e.g. starting with `/app/static/project_assets/...`), and replace them with the corresponding ESR URLs.
"""
        zip_file.writestr("README.txt", readme_content)
        
    zip_buffer.seek(0)
    return zip_buffer.getvalue()

                                        st.rerun()

    with sync_col3:
        if st.button("🗑️ Clear Chat", use_container_width=True, help="Clear chatbot history"):
            st.session_state.policy_messages = [
                {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hello! I am your Policy Assistant. Ask me anything about the documents, templates, or notes in the Resource Library."}
            ]
            st.rerun()
                    
    if "policy_messages" not in st.session_state:
        st.session_state.policy_messages = [
            {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hello! I am your Policy Assistant. Ask me anything about the documents, templates, or notes in the Resource Library."}
        ]
        
    for msg in st.session_state.policy_messages:
        with st.chat_message(msg["role"]):
            st.markdown(msg["content"])
            if "sources" in msg and msg["sources"]:
                with st.expander("🔍 Sources Consulted"):
                    for src in msg["sources"]:
                        st.markdown(f"- **{src['title']}** ({src['type']})")

    if user_query:
        st.session_state.policy_messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user_query})
        with st.chat_message("user"):
            st.markdown(user_query)

            sources = []
            context_str = ""
            with st.spinner("Searching library..."):
                try:
                    with global_chroma_lock:
                        client = get_global_chroma_client()
                        collection = client.get_or_create_collection(name="policy_library")
                        if collection.count() > 0:
                            results = collection.query(query_texts=[user_query], n_results=min(3, collection.count()))
                            if results and results.get('documents') and results['documents'][0]:
                                context_str = "\n\n".join(results['documents'][0])
                                for idx, meta in enumerate(results['metadatas'][0]):
                                    sources.append({
                                        "title": meta.get("title", "Unknown"),
                                        "type": meta.get("type", "Unknown")
                                    })
                except Exception as e:
                    st.error(f"Search failed: {e}")
                
                if not context_str:
                    context_str = "No resources found in the library matching this query."

                from core.prompts import RAG_SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE
                sys_prompt = RAG_SYSTEM_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(context_str=context_str)
                messages = [
                    {"role": "system", "content": sys_prompt},
                    {"role": "user", "content": user_query}
                ]
                answer = st.write_stream(stream_ai_response(messages=messages, temperature=0.1))
            except Exception as e:
                answer = f"AI Error: Failed to generate response. Details: {e}"
                st.error(answer)
                
            if sources:
                with st.expander("🔍 Sources Consulted"):
                    for src in sources:
                        st.markdown(f"- **{src['title']}** ({src['type']})")
                        
            log_audit_event(
                action="POLICY_CHAT_QUERY",
                entity_type="ResourceLibrary",
                user_name=app_state.user.current_user or "Unknown",
                user_role=app_state.user.current_user_role or "Unknown",
                details={"query": user_query, "sources_count": len(sources)}
            )
            
            st.session_state.policy_messages.append({
                "role": "assistant",
                "content": answer,
                "sources": sources
            })
            st.rerun()

# pages/28_scenario_planner.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# 1. Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons
from core.database_utils import query, fetch_one
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.logic import run_scenario_simulation

# 2. Page Setup & Security
handle_page_entry()
if not user_can("view_scenario_planner")[0]:
    st.error("🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to use this feature.")
    st.stop()

selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()
st.session_state.active_sidebar_category = "Strategy & Planning"

st.title("🔬 Scenario Planner")
st.caption("Model the combined impact of multiple 'what-if' changes to your project.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# 3. Context & Security Check
if selected_org == "All Organisations" or selected_prj == "All Projects" or current_org_id is None:
    st.warning("⚠️ Please select a specific Organisation and Project Stream in the sidebar.")
    st.stop()

res = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE name=? AND org_id=? AND is_deleted=0", (selected_prj, current_org_id))
pid = res[0] if res else None

if not pid:
    st.error(f"Could not find project '{selected_prj}' for {selected_org}.")
    st.stop()

# 4. UI for Scenario Definition
st.subheader("1. Define Your Scenario")
st.write("Add one or more potential changes to the project plan below. You can add new rows to model multiple changes at once.")

# Fetch data for dropdowns
tasks_df = query("SELECT id, task FROM actions WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 AND status != 'Closed'", (pid,))
task_options = tasks_df['task'].tolist()

# Initialize scenario in session state
if 'scenario_events' not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.scenario_events = []

# Use data_editor to manage the list of changes
scenario_df = pd.DataFrame(st.session_state.scenario_events)
edited_scenario = st.data_editor(
    scenario_df,
    num_rows="dynamic",
    column_config={
        "change_type": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn(
            "Change Type",
            options=["Delay Task", "Add Resources", "Reduce Budget"],
            required=True
        ),
        "target_item": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn(
            "Target Item",
            options=task_options,
            required=True
        ),
        "value": st.column_config.NumberColumn("Value", required=True, help="The magnitude of the change (e.g., 2, 5000)."),
        "unit": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn(
            "Unit",
            options=["Days", "Weeks", "People", "GBP"],
            required=True
        )
    },
    hide_index=True,
    use_container_width=True,
    key="scenario_editor"
)

# Update session state from the editor
st.session_state.scenario_events = edited_scenario.to_dict('records')

# 5. Run Simulation
st.subheader("2. Run Simulation")
avg_weekly_cost = st.number_input(
    "Estimated Weekly Staff & Operational Cost (£)",
    min_value=0.0, value=5000.0, step=500.0, format="%.2f",
    help="This is used to calculate the financial impact of delays."
)

if st.button("📈 Run Scenario Analysis", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
    if not st.session_state.scenario_events:
        st.warning("Please add at least one change to the scenario.")
    else:
        with st.spinner("AI is modeling the scenario... This may take a moment."):
            try:
                results = run_scenario_simulation(pid, st.session_state.scenario_events, avg_weekly_cost)
                st.session_state.scenario_results = results
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"An error occurred during simulation: {e}")

# 6. Display Results
if 'scenario_results' in st.session_state:
    st.divider()
    st.subheader("3. Scenario Impact Analysis")
    results = st.session_state.scenario_results

    with st.container(border=True):
        st.markdown("#### Executive Summary")
        st.markdown(results.get("summary", "No summary generated."))

    col1, col2 = st.columns(2)
    with col1:
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.markdown("#### Financial Impact")
            st.metric(
                "Estimated Cost Change",
                f"£{results.get('financial_impact', 0):,.2f}",
                delta=f"{results.get('financial_impact', 0):,.2f}",
                delta_color="inverse"
            )
            st.metric(
                "New Remaining Budget",
                f"£{results.get('new_remaining_budget', 0):,.2f}"
            )
            if results.get('new_remaining_budget', 0) < 0:
                st.error(f"🚨 Budget Alert: This scenario projects a budget overrun of £{-results.get('new_remaining_budget', 0):,.2f}.")

    with col2:
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.markdown("#### Timeline Impact")
            st.metric(
                "Projected Delay",
                f"{results.get('timeline_impact_days', 0)} days"
            )
            st.metric(
                "New Predicted Completion Date",
                results.get('new_completion_date', "N/A")
            )

    with st.container(border=True):
        st.markdown("#### Identified Risks")
        st.markdown(results.get("risk_analysis", "No new risks identified by AI."))

import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, date
import json
import altair as alt

# 1. Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons, get_jspdf_url, get_vis_network_url, get_d3_url, get_mermaid_url
from core.database_utils import query, execute, fetch_one, log_audit_event, execute_many, get_stakeholder_segment_aggregation
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.state import get_app_state
from core.ui_components import render_main_editor_modal
from core.analytics_engine import run_executive_sentiment_shift_tracker

def render_visjs_network(df_sh, df_rel, local_token, pid):
    import json
    
    # Construct nodes list
    nodes = []
    for _, sh in df_sh.iterrows():
        inf = sh['influence']
        size = 35 if inf == "High" else (25 if inf == "Medium" else 15)
        
        stance = sh['current_stance']
        if stance == "Advocate":
            color_border = "#005a30"
            color_background = "#00703c"
            font_color = "#ffffff"
        elif stance == "Supporter":
            color_border = "#154e7d"
            color_background = "#1d70b8"
            font_color = "#ffffff"
        elif stance == "Blocker":
            color_border = "#9b2212"
            color_background = "#d4351c"
            font_color = "#ffffff"
        else: # Neutral
            color_border = "#b1b4b6"
            color_background = "#f0f4f5"
            font_color = "#0b0c0c"
            
        nodes.append({
            "id": int(sh['id']),
            "label": f"{sh['name']}\\n({sh['job_title'] or ''})",
            "size": size,
            "shape": "dot",
            "color": {
                "border": color_border,
                "background": color_background,
                "highlight": {
                    "border": "#38bdf8",
                    "background": color_background
                }
            },
            "font": {
                "color": font_color,
                "size": 12,
                "bold": True
            }
        })
        
    # Construct edges list
    edges = []
    for _, rel in df_rel.iterrows():
        edges.append({
            "from": int(rel['source_stakeholder_id']),
            "to": int(rel['target_stakeholder_id']),
            "label": rel['relationship_type'],
            "arrows": "to",
            "color": {
                "color": "#38bdf8",
                "highlight": "#f43f5e"
            },
            "font": {
                "color": "#e2e8f0",
                "size": 10,
                "align": "horizontal"
            }
        })
        
    nodes_json = json.dumps(nodes)
    edges_json = json.dumps(edges)
    
    html_content = f"""
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8"/>
        <script type="text/javascript" src="{get_vis_network_url()}"></script>
        <script src="{get_jspdf_url()}"></script>
        <style type="text/css">
            #mynetwork {{
                width: 100%;
                height: 500px;
                border: 1px solid #475569;
                background-color: #0f172a;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }}
            .vis-button {{
                padding: 6px 12px;
                background-color: #1e293b;
                color: #f1f5f9;
                border: 1px solid #475569;
                border-radius: 4px;
                cursor: pointer;
                font-family: sans-serif;
                font-size: 12px;
                margin-right: 8px;
                margin-top: 8px;
            }}
            .vis-button:hover {{
                background-color: #334155;
            }}
            .controls-panel {{
                display: flex;
                margin-top: 10px;
            }}
        </style>
    </head>
    <body>
        <div id="mynetwork"></div>
        <div class="controls-panel">
            <button class="vis-button" onclick="exportPNG()">📸 Export PNG</button>
            <button class="vis-button" onclick="exportPDF()">📄 Export PDF</button>
        </div>
        
        <script type="text/javascript">
            var nodes = new vis.DataSet({nodes_json});
            var edges = new vis.DataSet({edges_json});
            var container = document.getElementById('mynetwork');
            var data = {{
                nodes: nodes,
                edges: edges
            }};
            
            var options = {{
                physics: {{
                    barnesHut: {{
                        gravitationalConstant: -2000,
                        centralGravity: 0.3,
                        springLength: 150,
                        springConstant: 0.04,
                        damping: 0.09,
                        avoidOverlap: 0.2
                    }},
                    minVelocity: 0.75
                }},
                interaction: {{
                    hover: true,
                    navigationButtons: true,
                    keyboard: true
                }},
                manipulation: {{
                    enabled: true,
                    addEdge: function(edgeData, callback) {{
                        if (edgeData.from === edgeData.to) {{
                            alert("Cannot connect a stakeholder to themselves.");
                            callback(null);
                            return;
                        }}
                        var relType = prompt("Enter relationship type (e.g. Influences, Reports To, Collaborates With, Lobbies):", "Influences");
                        if (!relType) {{
                            callback(null);
                            return;
                        }}
                        
                        // Send API request
                        var url = "/API?local_token={local_token}&action=create_relationship&project_id={pid}&source_id=" + edgeData.from + "&target_id=" + edgeData.to + "&relationship_type=" + encodeURIComponent(relType);
                        
                        fetch(url)
                            .then(function(res) {{ return res.json(); }})
                            .then(function(result) {{
                                if (result.success) {{
                                    edgeData.label = relType;
                                    edgeData.arrows = "to";
                                    edgeData.color = {{ color: "#38bdf8" }};
                                    callback(edgeData);
                                    setTimeout(function() {{
                                        window.parent.location.reload();
                                    }}, 800);
                                }} else {{
                                    alert("Failed to add relationship: " + result.error);
                                    callback(null);
                                }}
                            }})
                            .catch(function(err) {{
                                alert("API connection error: " + err);
                                callback(null);
                             }});
                    }}
                }}
            }};
            
            var network = new vis.Network(container, data, options);
            
            function exportPNG() {{
                network.once('afterDrawing', function() {{
                    var canvas = container.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0];
                    if (canvas) {{
                        var imgUrl = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
                        var link = document.createElement('a');
                        link.href = imgUrl;
                        link.download = "stakeholder_relationship_map.png";
                        document.body.appendChild(link);
                        link.click();
                        document.body.removeChild(link);
                    }} else {{
                        alert("Canvas not found.");
                    }}
                }});
                network.redraw();
            }}

            function exportPDF() {{
                network.once('afterDrawing', function() {{
                    var canvas = container.getElementsByTagName('canvas')[0];
                    if (canvas) {{
                        var imgData = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
                        var { jsPDF } = window.jspdf;
                        var pdf = new jsPDF('l', 'px', [canvas.width, canvas.height]);
                        pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
                        pdf.save("stakeholder_relationship_map.pdf");
                    }} else {{
                        alert("Canvas not found.");
                    }}
                }});
                network.redraw();
            }}
        </script>
    </body>
    </html>
    """
    return html_content

def render_d3_network(df_sh, df_rel, pid):
    import json
    
    # Construct nodes list
    nodes = []
    for _, sh in df_sh.iterrows():
        inf = sh['influence']
        size = 25 if inf == "High" else (18 if inf == "Medium" else 12)
        nodes.append({
            "id": int(sh['id']),
            "name": sh['name'],
            "job_title": sh['job_title'] or "",
            "influence": inf,
            "stance": sh['current_stance'],
            "size": size
        })
        
    # Construct edges list
    edges = []
    for _, rel in df_rel.iterrows():
        edges.append({
            "source": int(rel['source_stakeholder_id']),
            "target": int(rel['target_stakeholder_id']),
            "label": rel['relationship_type']
        })
        
    nodes_json = json.dumps(nodes)
    edges_json = json.dumps(edges)
    
    html_content = f"""
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8"/>
        <script src="{get_d3_url()}"></script>
        <script src="{get_jspdf_url()}"></script>
        <style>
            body {{
                margin: 0;
                background-color: #0f172a;
                color: #f1f5f9;
                font-family: sans-serif;
                overflow: hidden;
            }}
            #chart-container {{
                width: 100%;
                height: 500px;
                border: 1px solid #475569;
                border-radius: 8px;
                position: relative;
            }}
            svg {{
                width: 100%;
                height: 100%;
            }}
            .node circle {{
                stroke-width: 2px;

                font-size: 11px;
