                background-color: #1e293b;
                color: #f1f5f9;
                border: 1px solid #475569;
                border-radius: 4px;
                cursor: pointer;
                font-size: 12px;
                margin-right: 8px;
                margin-top: 8px;
            }}
            .vis-button:hover {{
                background-color: #334155;
            }}
            .controls {{
                padding: 5px;
                display: flex;
            }}
            .tooltip {{
                position: absolute;
                text-align: center;
                padding: 6px;
                font-size: 12px;
                background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9);
                color: #fff;
                border: 1px solid #475569;
                border-radius: 4px;
                pointer-events: none;
                opacity: 0;
                transition: opacity 0.2s;
                z-index: 10;
            }}
        </style>
    </head>
    <body>
        <div id="chart-container">
            <svg></svg>
            <div class="tooltip" id="tooltip"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="controls">
            <button class="vis-button" onclick="exportPNG()">📸 Export PNG</button>
            <button class="vis-button" onclick="exportPDF()">📄 Export PDF</button>
            <button class="vis-button" onclick="resetZoom()">🔄 Reset View</button>
        </div>
        <script>
            const nodesData = {nodes_json};
            const linksData = {edges_json};

            const svg = d3.select("svg");
            const container = svg.append("g");
            
            let width = document.getElementById("chart-container").clientWidth || 800;
            let height = 500;

            // Set up SVG definitions for markers (arrows)
            svg.append("defs").append("marker")
                .attr("id", "arrow")
                .attr("viewBox", "0 -5 10 10")
                .attr("refX", 20)
                .attr("refY", 0)
                .attr("markerWidth", 6)
                .attr("markerHeight", 6)
                .attr("orient", "auto")
                .append("path")
                .attr("d", "M0,-5L10,0L0,5")
                .attr("fill", "#38bdf8");

            // Zoom setup
            const zoom = d3.zoom()
                .scaleExtent([0.1, 4])
                .on("zoom", (event) => {{
                    container.attr("transform", event.transform);
                }});
            svg.call(zoom);

            function resetZoom() {{
                svg.transition().duration(750).call(
                    zoom.transform,
                    d3.zoomIdentity
                );
            }}

            // Color coding by stance
            function getNodeColor(stance) {{
                switch(stance) {{
                    case "Advocate": return "#00703c";
                    case "Supporter": return "#1d70b8";
                    case "Blocker": return "#d4351c";
                    default: return "#f0f4f5";
                }}
            }}
            function getNodeStroke(stance) {{
                switch(stance) {{
                    case "Advocate": return "#005a30";
                    case "Supporter": return "#154e7d";
                    case "Blocker": return "#9b2212";
                    default: return "#b1b4b6";
                }}
            }}

            // Force simulation
            const simulation = d3.forceSimulation(nodesData)
                .force("link", d3.forceLink(linksData).id(d => d.id).distance(150))
                .force("charge", d3.forceManyBody().strength(-400))
                .force("center", d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2))
                .force("collision", d3.forceCollide().radius(d => d.size + 15));

            // Draw links
            const link = container.append("g")
                .selectAll("line")
                .data(linksData)
                .join("line")
                .attr("class", "link")
                .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrow)");

            // Draw link labels
            const linkLabel = container.append("g")
                .selectAll("text")
                .data(linksData)
                .join("text")
                .attr("class", "link-label")
                .text(d => d.label);

            // Draw nodes
            const node = container.append("g")
                .selectAll(".node")
                .data(nodesData)
                .join("g")
                .attr("class", "node")
                .call(d3.drag()
                    .on("start", dragstarted)
                    .on("drag", dragged)
                    .on("end", dragended));

            const tooltip = d3.select("#tooltip");

            node.append("circle")
                .attr("r", d => d.size)
                .attr("fill", d => getNodeColor(d.stance))
                .attr("stroke", d => getNodeStroke(d.stance))
                .on("mouseover", function(event, d) {{
                    tooltip.style("opacity", 1)
                        .html(`<strong>${{d.name}}</strong><br/>${{d.job_title || ''}}<br/>Stance: ${{d.stance}}<br/>Influence: ${{d.influence}}`)
                        .style("left", (event.clientX - 60) + "px")
                        .style("top", (event.clientY - 80) + "px");
                }})
                .on("mousemove", function(event) {{
                    tooltip.style("left", (event.clientX - 60) + "px")
                           .style("top", (event.clientY - 80) + "px");
                }})
                .on("mouseleave", function() {{
                    tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
                }});

            node.append("text")
                .attr("dy", d => d.size + 14)
                .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
                .text(d => d.name);

            simulation.on("tick", () => {{
                link
                    .attr("x1", d => d.source.x)
                    .attr("y1", d => d.source.y)
                    .attr("x2", d => d.target.x)
                    .attr("y2", d => d.target.y);

                linkLabel
                    .attr("x", d => (d.source.x + d.target.x) / 2)
                    .attr("y", d => (d.source.y + d.target.y) / 2 - 5);

                node
                    .attr("transform", d => `translate(${{d.x}}, ${{d.y}})`);
            }});

            function dragstarted(event, d) {{
                if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0.3).restart();
                d.fx = d.x;
                d.fy = d.y;
            }}

            function dragged(event, d) {{
                d.fx = event.x;
                d.fy = event.y;
            }}

            function dragended(event, d) {{
                if (!event.active) simulation.alphaTarget(0);
                d.fx = null;
                d.fy = null;
            }}

            function exportPNG() {{
                saveSvgAsPng(document.querySelector("svg"), "stakeholder_influence_map.png");
            }}

            function exportPDF() {{
                const svgEl = document.querySelector("svg");
                const svgString = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgEl);
                const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                canvas.width = width * 2;
                canvas.height = height * 2;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
                ctx.scale(2, 2);
                
                const img = new Image();
                const svgBlob = new Blob([svgString], {{type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}});
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
                
                img.onload = function() {{
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
                    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    
                    const imgData = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
                    const {{ jsPDF }} = window.jspdf;
                    const pdf = new jsPDF('l', 'px', [width, height]);
                    pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, 0, width, height);
                    pdf.save("stakeholder_influence_map.pdf");
                }};
                img.src = url;
            }}

            function saveSvgAsPng(svgElement, filename) {{
                const svgString = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svgElement);
                const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                canvas.width = width * 2;
                canvas.height = height * 2;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
                ctx.scale(2, 2);
                
                const img = new Image();
                const svgBlob = new Blob([svgString], {{type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}});
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
                
                img.onload = function() {{
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
                    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    
                    const imgUrl = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
                    const link = document.createElement('a');
                    link.href = imgUrl;
                    link.download = filename;
                    document.body.appendChild(link);
                    link.click();
                    document.body.removeChild(link);
                }};
                img.src = url;
            }}
        </script>
    </body>
    </html>
    """
    return html_content

def render_mermaid_network(df_sh, df_rel, pid):
    import json
    # Construct Mermaid diagram script
    mermaid_diag = "graph TD\\n"
    for _, sh in df_sh.iterrows():
        node_id = f"SH{sh['id']}"
        label_clean = f"{sh['name']} ({sh['job_title'] or ''})"
        label_clean = label_clean.replace('"', "'")
        mermaid_diag += f'  {node_id}["{label_clean}"]\\n'
        
        # Style nodes based on stance
        stance = sh['current_stance']
        if stance == "Advocate":
            mermaid_diag += f"  style {node_id} fill:#00703c,stroke:#005a30,color:#ffffff\\n"
        elif stance == "Supporter":
            mermaid_diag += f"  style {node_id} fill:#1d70b8,stroke:#154e7d,color:#ffffff\\n"
        elif stance == "Blocker":
            mermaid_diag += f"  style {node_id} fill:#d4351c,stroke:#9b2212,color:#ffffff\\n"
        else:
            mermaid_diag += f"  style {node_id} fill:#f0f4f5,stroke:#b1b4b6,color:#0b0c0c\\n"
            
    for _, rel in df_rel.iterrows():
        src_id = f"SH{rel['source_stakeholder_id']}"
        tgt_id = f"SH{rel['target_stakeholder_id']}"
        r_type = rel['relationship_type']
        mermaid_diag += f"  {src_id} -->|{r_type}| {tgt_id}\\n"

    html_content = f"""
    <!DOCTYPE html>
    <html>
    <head>
        <meta charset="utf-8"/>
        <script src="{get_mermaid_url()}"></script>
        <script src="{get_jspdf_url()}"></script>
        <style type="text/css">
            body {{
                margin: 0;
                background-color: #0f172a;
                color: #f1f5f9;
                font-family: sans-serif;
            }}
            #mermaid-wrapper {{
                width: 100%;
                min-height: 480px;
                border: 1px solid #475569;
                background-color: #0f172a;
                border-radius: 8px;
                display: flex;
                justify-content: center;
                align-items: center;
                overflow: auto;
                padding: 20px;
                box-sizing: border-box;
            }}
            .vis-button {{
                padding: 6px 12px;
                background-color: #1e293b;
                color: #f1f5f9;
                border: 1px solid #475569;
                border-radius: 4px;
                cursor: pointer;
                font-family: sans-serif;
                font-size: 12px;
                margin-right: 8px;
                margin-top: 8px;
            }}
            .vis-button:hover {{
                background-color: #334155;
            }}
            .controls-panel {{
                display: flex;
                margin-top: 10px;
            }}
        </style>
    </head>
    <body>
        <div id="mermaid-wrapper">
            <pre class="mermaid" id="mynetwork">
{mermaid_diag}
            </pre>
        </div>
        <div class="controls-panel">
            <button class="vis-button" onclick="exportPNG()">📸 Export PNG</button>
            <button class="vis-button" onclick="exportPDF()">📄 Export PDF</button>
        </div>
        
        <script type="text/javascript">
            mermaid.initialize({{
                startOnLoad: true,
                theme: 'dark',
                securityLevel: 'loose'
            }});
            
            function exportPNG() {{
                const svgEl = document.querySelector("#mermaid-wrapper svg");
                if (!svgEl) {{
                    alert("SVG element not found yet. Please wait for Mermaid to finish rendering.");
                    return;
                }}
                
                const bbox = svgEl.getBBox();
                const svgWidth = bbox.width + 40;
                const svgHeight = bbox.height + 40;
                
                const clonedSvg = svgEl.cloneNode(true);
                clonedSvg.setAttribute("width", svgWidth);
                clonedSvg.setAttribute("height", svgHeight);
                clonedSvg.setAttribute("viewBox", `${{bbox.x - 20}} ${{bbox.y - 20}} ${{svgWidth}} ${{svgHeight}}`);
                
                const svgString = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clonedSvg);
                const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                canvas.width = svgWidth * 2;
                canvas.height = svgHeight * 2;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
                ctx.scale(2, 2);
                
                const img = new Image();
                const svgBlob = new Blob([svgString], {{type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}});
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
                
                img.onload = function() {{
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, svgWidth, svgHeight);
                    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, svgWidth, svgHeight);
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    
                    const imgUrl = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
                    const link = document.createElement('a');
                    link.href = imgUrl;
                    link.download = "stakeholder_mermaid_map.png";
                    document.body.appendChild(link);
                    link.click();
                    document.body.removeChild(link);
                }};
                img.src = url;
            }}
            
            function exportPDF() {{
                const svgEl = document.querySelector("#mermaid-wrapper svg");
                if (!svgEl) {{
                    alert("SVG element not found yet.");
                    return;
                }}
                
                const bbox = svgEl.getBBox();
                const svgWidth = bbox.width + 40;
                const svgHeight = bbox.height + 40;
                
                const clonedSvg = svgEl.cloneNode(true);
                clonedSvg.setAttribute("width", svgWidth);
                clonedSvg.setAttribute("height", svgHeight);
                clonedSvg.setAttribute("viewBox", `${{bbox.x - 20}} ${{bbox.y - 20}} ${{svgWidth}} ${{svgHeight}}`);
                
                const svgString = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(clonedSvg);
                const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
                canvas.width = svgWidth * 2;
                canvas.height = svgHeight * 2;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
                ctx.scale(2, 2);
                
                const img = new Image();
                const svgBlob = new Blob([svgString], {{type: "image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8"}});
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);
                
                img.onload = function() {{
                    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
                    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, svgWidth, svgHeight);
                    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, svgWidth, svgHeight);
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
                    
                    const imgData = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
                    const {{ jsPDF }} = window.jspdf;
                    const orientation = svgWidth > svgHeight ? 'l' : 'p';
                    const pdf = new jsPDF(orientation, 'px', [svgWidth, svgHeight]);
                    pdf.addImage(imgData, 'PNG', 0, 0, svgWidth, svgHeight);
                    pdf.save("stakeholder_mermaid_map.pdf");
                }};
                img.src = url;
            }}
        </script>
    </body>
    </html>
    """
    return html_content

# Initialize stakeholder relationships table
execute("""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stakeholder_relationships (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    source_stakeholder_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    target_stakeholder_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    relationship_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- e.g. "Influences", "Reports To", "Collaborates With", "Lobbies"
    is_deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0
)
""")

can_edit = user_can("edit_stakeholder_engagement")

def stakeholder_belongs_to_groups(group_tag_val, target_groups):
    if not group_tag_val:
        return 'Unassigned' in target_groups
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(group_tag_val)
        if isinstance(parsed, list):
            return any(t in target_groups for t in parsed)
        return str(parsed) in target_groups
    except Exception:
        tags = [t.strip() for t in str(group_tag_val).split(',') if t.strip()]
        return any(t in target_groups for t in tags)

# --- Load Segment Options & Set Up Filter ---
db_groups = query("SELECT group_name FROM stakeholder_groups")
if db_groups.empty:
    default_groups = [
        ("Clinical Leads", "Clinical leadership stakeholders involved in system adoption."),
        ("HR Managers", "Human resources managers responsible for staff profiling."),
        ("IT Administrators", "Technical leads responsible for Smartcard, ESR, and active directory integration."),
        ("Project Team", "Core project transformation team members."),
        ("Executive Sponsors", "Executive board members and project sponsors."),
        ("Finance Directors", "Financial stakeholders managing project budget and resources.")
    ]
    execute_many("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO stakeholder_groups (group_name, description) VALUES (?, ?)", default_groups)
    db_groups = query("SELECT group_name FROM stakeholder_groups")

global_group_list = db_groups['group_name'].tolist() if not db_groups.empty else []

df_segments = query("SELECT segment_name FROM stakeholder_segments WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (pid,))
custom_segments = df_segments['segment_name'].tolist() if not df_segments.empty else []
default_segments = ["Clinical Leads", "HR Managers", "IT Administrators", "Project Team", "Executive Sponsors", "Finance Directors"]
all_segments = sorted(list(set(default_segments + custom_segments + global_group_list)))

st.write("### 🔍 Global Segment Filter")
selected_groups = st.multiselect(
    "Isolate data by selected structural stakeholder groups",

    default=all_segments,
    key="global_group_filter",
    help="Filters the stakeholder register, Gantt timeline, email drafting, and other views based on the selected groups."
)

    st.info("💡 Please select at least one stakeholder group in the filter above to view segmented data.")
    st.stop()

# --- 4. Load Stakeholders & Filter ---
df_stakeholders = query("""
    SELECT s.id, s.project_id, s.contact_id, c.name, c.job_title, c.email, s.influence, s.interest, s.current_stance, s.engagement_strategy,
           s.group_tag, s.health_score, s.adkar_awareness, s.adkar_desire, s.adkar_knowledge, s.adkar_ability, s.adkar_reinforcement
    FROM stakeholders s
    JOIN contacts c ON s.contact_id = c.id
    WHERE s.project_id = ? AND s.is_deleted = 0
""", (pid,))

if not df_stakeholders.empty:
    df_stakeholders['belongs_to_filter'] = df_stakeholders['group_tag'].apply(lambda val: stakeholder_belongs_to_groups(val, selected_groups))
    df_filtered_stakeholders = df_stakeholders[df_stakeholders['belongs_to_filter']]
else:
    df_filtered_stakeholders = df_stakeholders.copy()

# Format group_tag for AgGrid and other displays
def format_group_tag_display(g_val):
    if not g_val:
        return ""
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(g_val)
        if isinstance(parsed, list):
            return ", ".join(parsed)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return str(g_val)

                unregistered_contacts = query("""

                    LEFT JOIN stakeholders s ON pc.contact_id = s.contact_id AND s.project_id = pc.project_id AND s.is_deleted = 0
                    WHERE pc.project_id = ? AND s.id IS NULL
                """, (pid,))
                if not unregistered_contacts.empty:

                else:

    else:
        st.info("You do not have permission to edit the stakeholder register.")

    if df_filtered_stakeholders.empty:
        st.info("No stakeholders match the selected filter or none are registered.")
    else:
        from st_aggrid import AgGrid, GridOptionsBuilder, GridUpdateMode, DataReturnMode, JsCode

        df_stakeholders_display = df_filtered_stakeholders.copy()
        df_stakeholders_display['group_tag'] = df_stakeholders_display['group_tag'].apply(format_group_tag_display)

        gob = GridOptionsBuilder.from_dataframe(df_stakeholders_display)
        gob.configure_column("id", hide=True)
        gob.configure_column("project_id", hide=True)
        gob.configure_column("contact_id", hide=True)
        gob.configure_column("name", editable=False, pinned="left")
        gob.configure_column("job_title", editable=False, pinned="left")
        gob.configure_column("email", editable=False)
        gob.configure_column("adkar_awareness", hide=True)
        gob.configure_column("adkar_desire", hide=True)
        gob.configure_column("adkar_knowledge", hide=True)
        gob.configure_column("adkar_ability", hide=True)
        gob.configure_column("adkar_reinforcement", hide=True)

        stance_jscode = """
        function(params) {
            if (params.value === 'Blocker') {
                return {'backgroundColor': '#ffe6e6', 'color': '#000000', 'fontWeight': 'bold'};
            } else if (params.value === 'Advocate') {
                return {'backgroundColor': '#e6ffe6', 'color': '#000000', 'fontWeight': 'bold'};
            } else if (params.value === 'Supporter') {
                return {'backgroundColor': '#eefcee', 'color': '#000000'};
            } else if (params.value === 'Neutral') {
                return {'backgroundColor': '#f0f4f5', 'color': '#000000'};
            }
            return null;
        }
        """

        gob.configure_column("influence", editable=can_edit, cellEditor="agSelectCellEditor", cellEditorParams={"values": ["High", "Medium", "Low"]})
        gob.configure_column("interest", editable=can_edit, cellEditor="agSelectCellEditor", cellEditorParams={"values": ["High", "Medium", "Low"]})
        gob.configure_column("current_stance", editable=can_edit, cellEditor="agSelectCellEditor", cellEditorParams={"values": ["Advocate", "Supporter", "Neutral", "Blocker"]}, cellStyle=JsCode(stance_jscode))
        gob.configure_column("group_tag", editable=can_edit, cellEditor="agSelectCellEditor", cellEditorParams={"values": all_segments}, headerName="Segment Group")
        gob.configure_column("health_score", editable=False, headerName="Health Score (%)", width=120)
        gob.configure_column("engagement_strategy", editable=can_edit, cellEditor="agLargeTextCellEditor", width=250)

        grid_options = gob.build()
        grid_response = AgGrid(
            df_stakeholders_display,
            gridOptions=grid_options,
            data_return_mode=DataReturnMode.FILTERED_AND_SORTED,
            update_mode=GridUpdateMode.VALUE_CHANGED,
            fit_columns_on_grid_load=True,
            allow_unsafe_jscode=True,
            theme="alpine",
            key="stakeholder_aggrid"
        )
        edited_df = pd.DataFrame(grid_response['data'])

        if st.button('💾 Save Register Changes', disabled=not can_edit, use_container_width=True, type='primary', key="btn_save_register_changes"):
            for _, new_row in edited_df.iterrows():
                original_row = df_stakeholders[df_stakeholders['id'] == new_row['id']].iloc[0]
                fields_to_check = ['influence', 'interest', 'current_stance', 'engagement_strategy']
                changed = False
                for f in fields_to_check:
                    if str(new_row.get(f)) != str(original_row.get(f)):
                        changed = True
                        break
                
                original_group_tag_display = format_group_tag_display(original_row.get('group_tag'))
                if str(new_row.get('group_tag')) != original_group_tag_display:
                    changed = True

                if changed:
                    grid_val = new_row.get('group_tag')
                    if grid_val:
                        try:
                            parsed = json.loads(grid_val)
                            if isinstance(parsed, list):
                                save_val = json.dumps(parsed)
                            else:
                                save_val = json.dumps([str(parsed)])
                        except Exception:
                            save_val = json.dumps([t.strip() for t in str(grid_val).split(',') if t.strip()])
                    else:
                        save_val = None

                    execute(
                        "UPDATE stakeholders SET influence=?, interest=?, current_stance=?, engagement_strategy=?, group_tag=? WHERE id=?",
                        (new_row['influence'], new_row['interest'], new_row['current_stance'], new_row['engagement_strategy'], save_val, new_row['id'])
                    )
                    from core.logic import calculate_stakeholder_health_score
                    calculate_stakeholder_health_score(new_row['id'])
            log_audit_event("UPDATE", "StakeholderRegister", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", pid, details={"message": "Bulk update from data editor."})
            st.toast("Stakeholder register updated!")
            st.rerun()

    # --- Sentiment Analytics Heatmap ---
    st.write("##")
    st.subheader("📈 Stakeholder Sentiment Analytics Heatmap")
    st.caption("Average email and comment sentiment mapped onto the influence/interest grid.")

    if df_filtered_stakeholders.empty:
        st.info("No stakeholder data to display in the sentiment heatmap.")
    else:
        stakeholder_sentiments = []
        for _, sh in df_filtered_stakeholders.iterrows():
            email_addr = sh.get('email')
            sentiment_val = 0.0
            sentiment_count = 0
            if email_addr:
                df_emails = query("SELECT sentiment_score FROM emails WHERE project_id = ? AND email_from LIKE ? AND is_deleted = 0", (pid, f"%{email_addr}%"))
                if not df_emails.empty:
                    sentiment_val += df_emails['sentiment_score'].sum()
                    sentiment_count += len(df_emails)
            
            name = sh.get('name')
            if name:
                df_comments = query("SELECT sentiment_score FROM comments WHERE author = ?", (name,))
                if not df_comments.empty and 'sentiment_score' in df_comments.columns:
                    sentiment_val += df_comments['sentiment_score'].dropna().sum()
                    sentiment_count += df_comments['sentiment_score'].dropna().count()
                    
            avg_sentiment = (sentiment_val / sentiment_count) if sentiment_count > 0 else 0.0
            stakeholder_sentiments.append(round(avg_sentiment, 2))
            
        df_filtered_stakeholders_heat = df_filtered_stakeholders.copy()
        df_filtered_stakeholders_heat['avg_sentiment'] = stakeholder_sentiments

        # Warning alerts for High Influence / Blocker / Negative sentiment
        blockers = df_filtered_stakeholders_heat[
            ((df_filtered_stakeholders_heat['influence'] == 'High') | (df_filtered_stakeholders_heat['influence'] == 'Medium')) & 
            ((df_filtered_stakeholders_heat['current_stance'] == 'Blocker') | (df_filtered_stakeholders_heat['avg_sentiment'] < -0.1))
        ]
        if not blockers.empty:
            st.warning("⚠️ **Deteriorating Stakeholder Sentiment / Blocker Warning**")
            for _, b in blockers.iterrows():
                sentiment_lbl = f"sentiment score: {b['avg_sentiment']}" if b['avg_sentiment'] != 0.0 else "neutral/unrecorded sentiment"
                st.error(f"🚨 **{b['name']}** ({b['job_title']}) is a **{b['current_stance']}** with **{b['influence']}** influence and **{sentiment_lbl}**.")

        # Render Altair Heatmap
        import altair as alt
        interest_order = ['Low', 'Medium', 'High']
        influence_order = ['Low', 'Medium', 'High']
        
        chart = alt.Chart(df_filtered_stakeholders_heat).mark_circle(size=400).encode(
            x=alt.X('interest:N', sort=interest_order, title="Interest"),
            y=alt.Y('influence:N', sort=influence_order, title="Influence"),
            color=alt.Color('avg_sentiment:Q', scale=alt.Scale(scheme='redyellowgreen', domain=[-1.0, 1.0]), title="Avg Sentiment Score"),
            tooltip=['name', 'job_title', 'influence', 'interest', 'current_stance', 'avg_sentiment']
        ).properties(
            title="Stakeholder Sentiment Influence vs. Interest Grid",
            height=300
        ).interactive()
        
        st.altair_chart(chart, use_container_width=True)

    # --- Executive Sentiment Shift Tracker (Item 149) ---
    st.write("##")
    st.subheader("📉 Executive Communication Sentiment Shift Tracker")
    st.caption("Analyzes the weekly sentiment trend of communications for each stakeholder over the last 8 weeks to detect sharp drops (≤ -0.3).")
    
    with st.spinner("Analyzing communication sentiment trends..."):
        flagged_shifts = run_executive_sentiment_shift_tracker(project_id=pid)
        
    if not flagged_shifts:
        st.success("✅ **No sharp sentiment drops detected** among active stakeholders in the past 8 weeks.")
    else:
        st.warning(f"⚠️ **{len(flagged_shifts)} sentiment shift alert(s) detected**.")
        for shift in flagged_shifts:
            name = shift['name']
            job_title = shift['job_title'] or 'No Title'
            sentiment_drop = shift['sentiment_drop']
            recent_avg = shift['recent_avg']
            historical_avg = shift['historical_avg']
            is_exec = shift['is_executive']
            influence = shift['influence']
            current_stance = shift['current_stance']
            weekly_sentiments = shift['weekly_sentiments']
            
            # Highlight executive stakeholders differently
            if is_exec:
                st.error(f"🚨 **Executive Alert**: **{name}** ({job_title}) sentiment dropped sharply by **{sentiment_drop:+.2f}** (Recent Avg: {recent_avg:.2f}, Historical Avg: {historical_avg:.2f})")
            else:
                st.warning(f"⚠️ **Alert**: **{name}** ({job_title}) sentiment dropped by **{sentiment_drop:+.2f}** (Recent Avg: {recent_avg:.2f}, Historical Avg: {historical_avg:.2f})")
                
            # Expandable detail section
            with st.expander(f"🔍 View detailed trend for {name}"):
                st.markdown(f"**Influence:** `{influence}` | **Current Stance:** `{current_stance}`")
                st.markdown(f"**Recent Sentiment (Weeks 1-2):** `{recent_avg:.2f}` | **Historical Sentiment (Weeks 3-8):** `{historical_avg:.2f}`")
                
                # Render a simple weekly trend list
                st.markdown("**Weekly Sentiment History (rolling 7-day windows):**")
                trend_parts = []
                for entry in weekly_sentiments:
                    score_str = f"{entry['score']:+.2f}" if entry['score'] is not None else "N/A"
                    count_str = f"{entry['count']} response(s)"
                    trend_parts.append(f"- **Week {entry['week']}** ({(entry['week']-1)*7}-{entry['week']*7} days ago): `{score_str}` ({count_str})")
                st.markdown("\n".join(trend_parts))

    # --- Communication Plan Timeline (Item 33) ---
    st.write("##")
    st.subheader("📣 Communication Plan Timeline Gantt")
    st.caption("Visualizes the timeline of planned and logged communications against project milestones.")
    
    df_comms = query("SELECT comms_date, audience, channel, message, response_outcome, effectiveness_score FROM communication_log WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (pid,))
    df_milestones = query("SELECT name as milestone_name, planned_date as target_date, status FROM project_milestones WHERE project_id = ?", (pid,))
    
    # Filter communications and milestones by selected groups
    filtered_stakeholder_names = set(df_filtered_stakeholders['name'].tolist()) if not df_filtered_stakeholders.empty else set()
    
    def is_comm_in_selected_groups(audience_val):
        if not audience_val:
            return False
        if any(g.lower() in audience_val.lower() for g in selected_groups):
            return True
        if any(name.lower() in audience_val.lower() for name in filtered_stakeholder_names):
            return True
        return False

    def is_milestone_in_selected_groups(name_val):
        if len(selected_groups) == len(all_segments):
            return True
        if not name_val:
            return False
        return any(g.lower() in name_val.lower() for g in selected_groups)

    if not df_comms.empty:
        df_comms = df_comms[df_comms['audience'].apply(is_comm_in_selected_groups)]
    if not df_milestones.empty:
        df_milestones = df_milestones[df_milestones['milestone_name'].apply(is_milestone_in_selected_groups)]

    if df_comms.empty and df_milestones.empty:
        st.info("No communication logs or milestones match the selected stakeholder group filter.")
    else:
        points_data = []
        if not df_comms.empty:
            for _, row in df_comms.iterrows():
                points_data.append({
                    "Date": row['comms_date'],
                    "Label": f"{row['audience']} ({row['channel']})",
                    "Type": "Communication",
                    "Details": f"Message: {row['message'][:100]}... Outcome: {row['response_outcome']} (Eff: {row['effectiveness_score']})"
                })
        if not df_milestones.empty:
            for _, row in df_milestones.iterrows():
                points_data.append({
                    "Date": row['target_date'],
                    "Label": row['milestone_name'],
                    "Type": "Milestone",
                    "Details": f"Milestone Status: {row['status']}"
                })
                
        if points_data:
            df_timeline = pd.DataFrame(points_data)
            df_timeline['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_timeline['Date'], errors='coerce')
            df_timeline = df_timeline.dropna(subset=['Date'])
            if not df_timeline.empty:
                is_dark = app_state.dark_mode
                comm_color = '#d25427' if is_dark else '#c74616'
                ms_color = '#e28743' if is_dark else '#c27c38'
                timeline_chart = alt.Chart(df_timeline).mark_circle(size=150).encode(
                    x=alt.X('Date:T', title='Date/Timeline'),
                    y=alt.Y('Label:N', title=None, sort='x'),
                    color=alt.Color('Type:N', scale=alt.Scale(domain=["Communication", "Milestone"], range=[comm_color, ms_color]), title="Event Type"),
                    tooltip=['Date:T', 'Type:N', 'Label:N', 'Details:N']
                ).properties(
                    title="Project Touchpoints & Milestone Timeline",
                    height=200
                ).interactive()
                
                st.altair_chart(timeline_chart, use_container_width=True)
            else:
                st.info("No valid dates found in timeline records.")
        else:
            st.info("No timeline records available.")

                                    calculate_stakeholder_health_score(selected_stakeholder_id)

                            sent_points.append({

                            })

                    ms_notes = st.text_area("Notes / Context", key=f"ms_notes_{selected_stakeholder_id}")

            st.divider()
            st.subheader("🤖 AI Stakeholder Engagement Planner")
            
            c_name = sel_sh_info['name']
            c_title = sel_sh_info['job_title']
            c_infl = sel_sh_info['influence']
            c_int = sel_sh_info['interest']
            c_stance = sel_sh_info['current_stance']
            
            # Recalculate average sentiment for the selected stakeholder
            email_addr = sel_sh_info.get('email')
            sentiment_val = 0.0
            sentiment_count = 0
            if email_addr:
                df_emails = query("SELECT sentiment_score FROM emails WHERE project_id = ? AND email_from LIKE ? AND is_deleted = 0", (pid, f"%{email_addr}%"))
                if not df_emails.empty:
                    sentiment_val += df_emails['sentiment_score'].sum()
                    sentiment_count += len(df_emails)
            if c_name:
                df_comments = query("SELECT sentiment_score FROM comments WHERE author = ?", (c_name,))
                if not df_comments.empty and 'sentiment_score' in df_comments.columns:
                    sentiment_val += df_comments['sentiment_score'].dropna().sum()
                    sentiment_count += df_comments['sentiment_score'].dropna().count()
            c_sent = round(sentiment_val / sentiment_count, 2) if sentiment_count > 0 else 0.0

            st.markdown(f"**Stakeholder:** {c_name} — *{c_title}*")
            st.caption(f"Influence: **{c_infl}** | Interest: **{c_int}** | Stance: **{c_stance}** | Email/Comment Sentiment: **{c_sent}**")

            st.markdown("##### 📊 ADKAR Change Readiness Radar")
            adkar_key = f"adkar_readiness_{selected_stakeholder_id}"
            col_r1, col_r2 = st.columns([0.4, 0.6])
            
            with col_r1:
                if st.button('🤖 Analyze ADKAR Change Readiness', key=f'btn_adkar_{selected_stakeholder_id}', use_container_width=True):
                    with st.spinner("AI is analyzing interaction logs and assessing readiness..."):
                        sh_logs = query("SELECT engagement_date, notes FROM engagement_log WHERE stakeholder_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY engagement_date DESC LIMIT 5", (selected_stakeholder_id,))
                        logs_text = sh_logs.to_string(index=False) if not sh_logs.empty else "No direct engagement logs."
                        
                        prompt = f"""You are an NHS Change Management Expert. Assess this stakeholder for ADKAR (Awareness, Desire, Knowledge, Ability, Reinforcement) alignment using these details:
- Name: {c_name}
- Job Title: {c_title}
- Stance: {c_stance}
- Historical Sentiment: {c_sent}
- Direct Engagement History:
{logs_text}

Provide your assessment in this exact JSON format (and nothing else):
{{
  "Awareness": 3,
  "Desire": 2,
  "Knowledge": 4,
  "Ability": 3,
  "Reinforcement": 3,
  "Narrative": "A short 2-sentence summary of their main barrier and change stance."
}}
Ensure the numeric values are integers between 1 and 5."""
                        try:
                            from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response
                            res_json_str = generate_ai_response(prompt, temperature=0.1, bypass_cache=True)
                            if "```json" in res_json_str:
                                res_json_str = res_json_str.split("```json")[1].split("```")[0].strip()
                            elif "```" in res_json_str:
                                res_json_str = res_json_str.split("```")[1].split("```")[0].strip()
                            
                            adkar_data = json.loads(res_json_str)
                            st.session_state[adkar_key] = adkar_data
                        except Exception as e:
                            st.error(f"Failed to assess ADKAR readiness: {e}")
                            
            if adkar_key not in st.session_state:
                st.session_state[adkar_key] = {
                    "Awareness": sel_sh_info['adkar_awareness'] if pd.notna(sel_sh_info['adkar_awareness']) else 3,
                    "Desire": sel_sh_info['adkar_desire'] if pd.notna(sel_sh_info['adkar_desire']) else 3,
                    "Knowledge": sel_sh_info['adkar_knowledge'] if pd.notna(sel_sh_info['adkar_knowledge']) else 3,
                    "Ability": sel_sh_info['adkar_ability'] if pd.notna(sel_sh_info['adkar_ability']) else 3,
                    "Reinforcement": sel_sh_info['adkar_reinforcement'] if pd.notna(sel_sh_info['adkar_reinforcement']) else 3,
                    "Narrative": "No analysis performed yet."
                }
                
            ad = st.session_state[adkar_key]
            with col_r2:
                st.markdown("**Adjust ADKAR Scores (1-5):**")
                awareness_val = st.slider("Awareness", 1, 5, int(ad.get("Awareness", 3)), key=f"sld_aw_{selected_stakeholder_id}")
                desire_val = st.slider("Desire", 1, 5, int(ad.get("Desire", 3)), key=f"sld_ds_{selected_stakeholder_id}")
                knowledge_val = st.slider("Knowledge", 1, 5, int(ad.get("Knowledge", 3)), key=f"sld_kn_{selected_stakeholder_id}")
                ability_val = st.slider("Ability", 1, 5, int(ad.get("Ability", 3)), key=f"sld_ab_{selected_stakeholder_id}")
                reinforcement_val = st.slider("Reinforcement", 1, 5, int(ad.get("Reinforcement", 3)), key=f"sld_rf_{selected_stakeholder_id}")
                
                ad["Awareness"] = awareness_val
                ad["Desire"] = desire_val
                ad["Knowledge"] = knowledge_val
                ad["Ability"] = ability_val
                ad["Reinforcement"] = reinforcement_val
                st.session_state[adkar_key] = ad
                
                if st.button('💾 Save ADKAR Scores to Database', key=f'save_adkar_btn_{selected_stakeholder_id}', use_container_width=True, type='primary'):
                    execute("""
                        UPDATE stakeholders 
                        SET adkar_awareness = ?, adkar_desire = ?, adkar_knowledge = ?, adkar_ability = ?, adkar_reinforcement = ?
                        WHERE id = ?
                    """, (awareness_val, desire_val, knowledge_val, ability_val, reinforcement_val, selected_stakeholder_id))
                    calculate_stakeholder_health_score(selected_stakeholder_id)
                    st.toast("ADKAR scores and health score saved!")
                    st.rerun()

                    st.info(f"**AI Narrative:** {ad['Narrative']}")

            barriers = []
            for metric, val in [("Awareness", awareness_val), ("Desire", desire_val), ("Knowledge", knowledge_val), ("Ability", ability_val), ("Reinforcement", reinforcement_val)]:
                if val < 3:

            if barriers:

            st.write("##")
            st.markdown("### 🤖 Advisor Copilot Suite")

                        prompt = f"""You are an NHSBSA Implementation Advisor rolling out the Future NHS Workforce Solution / People Portal.

                        try:

with tab_network:
    st.subheader("🤝 Stakeholder Relationship Network Map")
    st.caption("Model and visualize strategic lobbying pathways and hierarchical reporting structures.")

    df_relationships = query("""
        SELECT r.id, r.source_stakeholder_id, r.target_stakeholder_id, r.relationship_type,
               c1.name as source_name, c2.name as target_name
        FROM stakeholder_relationships r
        JOIN stakeholders s1 ON r.source_stakeholder_id = s1.id
        JOIN contacts c1 ON s1.contact_id = c1.id
        JOIN stakeholders s2 ON r.target_stakeholder_id = s2.id
        JOIN contacts c2 ON s2.contact_id = c2.id
        WHERE r.project_id = ? AND r.is_deleted = 0
    """, (pid,))

    if df_filtered_stakeholders.empty:
        st.info("No stakeholder data matches the selected filter.")
    else:
        # Filter network elements based on selected groups
        df_sh_network = df_filtered_stakeholders.copy()
        df_rel_network = df_relationships[
            df_relationships['source_stakeholder_id'].isin(df_filtered_stakeholders['id']) &
            df_relationships['target_stakeholder_id'].isin(df_filtered_stakeholders['id'])
        ].copy()

        local_token_row = fetch_one("SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE category = 'LOCAL_API_TOKEN'")
        if not local_token_row:
            import uuid
            local_token = str(uuid.uuid4())
            execute("INSERT INTO app_config (category, value, display_order) VALUES ('LOCAL_API_TOKEN', ?, 0)", (local_token,))
        else:
            local_token = local_token_row[0]

        tab_vis, tab_d3, tab_mermaid = st.tabs(["🌐 Vis.js Relationship Map (Editable)", "📊 D3.js Influence Map (Zoom/Pan & PNG/PDF Export)", "🧜‍♀️ Mermaid Relationship Map (PNG/PDF Export)"])
        
        with tab_vis:
            st.write("##### Network Visualization Map")
            st.caption("Drag nodes to organize. Use manipulation mode ('Edit' menu inside network canvas) to draw connections / add new relationships directly by dragging.")
            vis_html = render_visjs_network(df_sh_network, df_rel_network, local_token, pid)
            st.components.v1.html(vis_html, height=560)
            
        with tab_d3:
            st.write("##### D3.js Stakeholder Influence Network")
            st.caption("An interactive network showing node sizes proportional to influence level. Use mouse wheel/drag to zoom & pan.")
            d3_html = render_d3_network(df_sh_network, df_rel_network, pid)
            st.components.v1.html(d3_html, height=560)

        with tab_mermaid:
            st.write("##### Mermaid Relationship Map")
            st.caption("A styled SVG hierarchy map showing relation direction and stance color coding. Export to crisp PNG/PDF.")
            mermaid_html = render_mermaid_network(df_sh_network, df_rel_network, pid)
            st.components.v1.html(mermaid_html, height=560)
            
        st.caption("🎨 **Legend:** 🟩 Advocate | 🟦 Supporter | 🟥 Blocker | ⬜ Neutral. Node sizes are proportional to **Influence Level** (High, Medium, Low).")
        
        if can_edit:
            with st.expander("Manage Stakeholder Relationships"):
                with st.form("relationship_form"):
                    rc1, rc2 = st.columns(2)
                    sh_names = {row['id']: row['name'] for _, row in df_sh_network.iterrows()}
                    
                    if not sh_names:
                        st.info("No stakeholders in this filter view to connect.")
                    else:
                        src_sh = rc1.selectbox("Source Stakeholder", options=list(sh_names.keys()), format_func=lambda x: sh_names[x], key="src_sh_sel")
                        target_options = [k for k in sh_names.keys() if k != src_sh]
                        tgt_sh = rc2.selectbox("Target Stakeholder", options=target_options, format_func=lambda x: sh_names[x] if x in sh_names else "", key="tgt_sh_sel")
                        rel_type = st.selectbox("Relationship Type", options=["Influences", "Reports To", "Collaborates With", "Lobbies"], key="rel_type_sel")
                        
                        if st.form_submit_button('Add Relationship Link', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
                            if src_sh == tgt_sh:
                                st.error("Source and target stakeholder cannot be the same.")
                            else:
                                existing = fetch_one("""
                                    SELECT id FROM stakeholder_relationships 
                                    WHERE source_stakeholder_id=? AND target_stakeholder_id=? AND is_deleted=0
                                """, (src_sh, tgt_sh))
                                if existing:
                                    st.warning("This relationship link already exists.")
                                else:
                                    execute("""
                                        INSERT INTO stakeholder_relationships (project_id, source_stakeholder_id, target_stakeholder_id, relationship_type)
                                        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                                    """, (pid, src_sh, tgt_sh, rel_type))
                                    log_audit_event("CREATE", "StakeholderRelationship", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", pid, details={"source": src_sh, "target": tgt_sh, "type": rel_type})
                                    st.success("Relationship link added successfully!")
                                    st.rerun()
                                    
                if not df_rel_network.empty:
                    st.write("**Existing Relationship Links**")
                    for _, r in df_rel_network.iterrows():
                        col1, col2 = st.columns([0.8, 0.2])
                        col1.write(f"🔗 **{r['source_name']}** {r['relationship_type'].lower()} **{r['target_name']}**")
                        if col2.button("Remove Link", key=f"del_rel_{r['id']}", use_container_width=True):
                            execute("UPDATE stakeholder_relationships SET is_deleted=1 WHERE id=?", (r['id'],))
                            log_audit_event("SOFT_DELETE", "StakeholderRelationship", app_state.user.current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", r['id'])
                            st.success("Link removed!")
                            st.rerun()

        st.write("**Create New Global Group**")
        with st.form("new_global_group_form", clear_on_submit=True):
            gg_name = st.text_input("Global Group Name", placeholder="e.g. Clinical Chiefs")
            gg_desc = st.text_area("Description")
            if st.form_submit_button('Create Global Group', type='primary', use_container_width=True):

# pages/27_🔔_Notification_Center.py
import streamlit as st

    if not show_read:
        sql_conditions.append("is_read = 0")

    if selected_types:
        placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_types))
        sql_conditions.append(f"event_type IN ({placeholders})")
        sql_params.extend(selected_types)

    if selected_priorities and len(selected_priorities) < len(PRIORITY_OPTIONS):
        placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_priorities))
        sql_conditions.append(f"COALESCE(priority, 'FYI') IN ({placeholders})")
        sql_params.extend(selected_priorities)

    where_clause = " AND ".join(sql_conditions)
    notifications_df = query(
        f"SELECT id, message, is_read, link, timestamp, event_type, "
        f"COALESCE(priority, 'FYI') as priority "
        f"FROM notifications WHERE {where_clause} ORDER BY "
        f"CASE COALESCE(priority, 'FYI') WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'Important' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, "
        f"timestamp DESC",
        tuple(sql_params)
    )

# Helpers to parse markdown tables returned by LLM
def parse_raw_table(lines: List[str], expected_cols: List[str]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    rows = []
    headers = []
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line.startswith("|"):
            continue
        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.split("|")[1:-1]]
        if not cells:
            continue
        # Skip markdown separator row (e.g. |:---|:---|)
        if all(re.match(r'^:?-+:?$', c) for c in cells):
            continue
        if not headers:
            headers = [h.strip() for h in cells]
            continue
        
        row_dict = {}
        # Map values to expected columns based on headers matching or index fallback
        for i, col in enumerate(expected_cols):
            h_idx = -1
            for idx, h in enumerate(headers):
                if col.lower() in h.lower() or h.lower() in col.lower():
                    h_idx = idx
                    break
            if h_idx != -1 and h_idx < len(cells):
                row_dict[col] = cells[h_idx]
            elif i < len(cells):
                row_dict[col] = cells[i]
            else:
                row_dict[col] = ""
        rows.append(row_dict)
    return rows

def parse_staged_tables(ai_text: str):
    action_items = []
    decisions = []
    
    # Split by headings
    action_section = ""
    decision_section = ""
    
    parts = re.split(r'(?i)###\s*Action\s*Items|###\s*Operational\s*Decisions', ai_text)
    headings = re.findall(r'(?i)###\s*Action\s*Items|###\s*Operational\s*Decisions', ai_text)
    
    for idx, heading in enumerate(headings):
        content = parts[idx + 1] if idx + 1 < len(parts) else ""
        if "action" in heading.lower():
            action_section = content
        elif "decision" in heading.lower():
            decision_section = content
            
    # Fallback if headings didn't match cleanly
    if not action_section and not decision_section:
        lines = ai_text.strip().split("\n")
        current_table = []
        all_tables = []
        for line in lines:
            line = line.strip()
            if line.startswith("|"):
                current_table.append(line)
            else:
                if current_table:
                    all_tables.append(current_table)
                    current_table = []
        if current_table:
            all_tables.append(current_table)
            
        if len(all_tables) >= 1:
            action_items = parse_raw_table(all_tables[0], ["Task", "Owner", "Due Date Raw"])
        if len(all_tables) >= 2:
            decisions = parse_raw_table(all_tables[1], ["Decision", "Owner/Involved", "Details"])
    else:
        if action_section:
            action_items = parse_raw_table(action_section.strip().split("\n"), ["Task", "Owner", "Due Date Raw"])
        if decision_section:
            decisions = parse_raw_table(decision_section.strip().split("\n"), ["Decision", "Owner/Involved", "Details"])
            
    return action_items, decisions


def partition_transcript(text: str, max_words: int = 2000, overlap_words: int = 150) -> List[str]:
    words = text.split()
    if len(words) <= max_words:
        return [text]
    
    chunks = []
    start = 0
    while start < len(words):
        end = min(start + max_words, len(words))
        chunk_words = words[start:end]
        chunks.append(" ".join(chunk_words))
        if end == len(words):
            break
        start += max_words - overlap_words
    return chunks

            temp_path = os.path.join(scratch_dir, f"temp_whisper_input{os.path.splitext(audio_name)[1]}")
            
            try:
                with open(temp_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(active_audio.read())
                    
                # 2. Run standalone Whisper script
                with st.spinner("Step 2a: Running local Whisper transcription script... (may take a few minutes)"):
                    python_executable = sys.executable
                    script_path = os.path.join(project_base_dir, "transcribe_meeting.py")
                    
                    cmd = [python_executable, script_path, "--audio", temp_path, "--model", whisper_model]
                    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
                    
                    if result.returncode != 0:
                        st.error(f"Whisper script error: {result.stderr}")
                        if os.path.exists(temp_path):
                            os.remove(temp_path)
                        st.stop()
                    
                    transcription_text = result.stdout.strip()
                    st.session_state['offline_transcription_result'] = transcription_text
                    st.success("Transcription complete!")
                    
                # Clean up temp file
                if os.path.exists(temp_path):
                    os.remove(temp_path)
                    
                # 3. Distill transcript with Llama 3 (with text block partitioning)
                with st.spinner("Step 2b: Partitioning transcript & distilling intelligence with Llama 3..."):
                    blocks = partition_transcript(transcription_text, max_words=2000, overlap_words=150)
                    num_blocks = len(blocks)
                    
                    all_actions_list = []
                    all_decisions_list = []
                    raw_distillation_parts = []
                    
                    for idx, block in enumerate(blocks):
                        block_status = f"Distilling partition {idx + 1} of {num_blocks}..."
                        st.write(f"🔄 {block_status}")
                        
                        distill_prompt = f"""You are an expert project assistant. Analyze the following meeting transcript segment (Part {idx + 1} of {num_blocks}).
Your goal is to extract:
1. Action Items: Tasks that need to be done, who is assigned (Owner), and the due date (Due Date).
2. Operational Decisions: Key decisions made, who made them or who was involved (Owner/Involved), and the status/notes.

You must format the response as two distinct sections, each containing a markdown table:

### ACTION ITEMS
| Task | Owner | Due Date Raw |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Description of task | Name of person/team | Due date or timeline |

### OPERATIONAL DECISIONS
| Decision | Owner/Involved | Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Description of decision | Name of person/team | Details, context or status |

Framing Instructions:
- For "Owner": If not mentioned, write "Unassigned".
- For "Due Date Raw": If not mentioned, write "Not Specified".
- For "Owner/Involved": If not mentioned, write "Team".
- Keep the table syntax clean and strictly return the two tables under their respective headings. Do not include any conversational filler, introductory remarks, or concluding remarks.

Transcript Segment:
{block}
"""
                        distill_result = generate_ai_response(distill_prompt, bypass_cache=True)
                        raw_distillation_parts.append(f"### Partition {idx + 1} of {num_blocks} Distillation\n{distill_result}")
                        
                        # Parse partition results
                        actions_part, decisions_part = parse_staged_tables(distill_result)
                        all_actions_list.extend(actions_part)
                        all_decisions_list.extend(decisions_part)

                    # De-duplicate actions
                    seen_tasks = set()
                    unique_actions = []
                    for act in all_actions_list:
                        t_clean = act.get("Task", "").strip().lower()
                        if t_clean and t_clean not in seen_tasks:
                            seen_tasks.add(t_clean)
                            unique_actions.append(act)
                    
                    # De-duplicate decisions
                    seen_decisions = set()
                    unique_decisions = []
                    for dec in all_decisions_list:
                        d_clean = dec.get("Decision", "").strip().lower()
                        if d_clean and d_clean not in seen_decisions:
                            seen_decisions.add(d_clean)
                            unique_decisions.append(dec)

                    st.session_state['offline_distillation_raw'] = "\n\n---\n\n".join(raw_distillation_parts)
                    
                    # Add Import/State fields
                    for action in unique_actions:
                        action["Import"] = True
                    for dec in unique_decisions:
                        dec["Import"] = True
                        
                    st.session_state['staged_offline_actions'] = unique_actions
                    st.session_state['staged_offline_decisions'] = unique_decisions
                    st.success("Intelligence successfully extracted!")
                    st.rerun()
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"Error executing local pipelines: {e}")
                if os.path.exists(temp_path):
                    os.remove(temp_path)
        else:
            st.warning("Please record audio or upload an audio file first.")

    # Render results if they exist in session state
    if st.session_state['offline_transcription_result']:
        st.divider()
        with st.expander("📝 View Raw Audio Transcription Text", expanded=False):
            st.text_area("Transcription Text", st.session_state['offline_transcription_result'], height=200)

    if st.session_state['offline_distillation_raw']:
        with st.expander("🤖 View Raw AI Distillation Output (Markdown Tables)", expanded=False):
            st.markdown(st.session_state['offline_distillation_raw'])
            
    # --- PM Review & Database Save Step ---
    if st.session_state['staged_offline_actions'] or st.session_state['staged_offline_decisions']:
        st.divider()
        st.subheader("🚀 Step 3: Review and Commit to Database")
        
        with st.form("offline_review_and_commit_form"):
            st.markdown("#### 📋 Staged Action Items")
            st.write("Review, edit, and select which actions to import into project task log:")
            edited_actions = st.data_editor(
                st.session_state['staged_offline_actions'],
                column_config={
                    "Import": st.column_config.CheckboxColumn("Import?"),
                    "Task": st.column_config.TextColumn("Task Description", width="large"),
                    "Owner": st.column_config.TextColumn("Owner"),
                    "Due Date Raw": st.column_config.TextColumn("Due Date (Raw)")
                },
                hide_index=True,
                use_container_width=True,
                key="edited_offline_actions_editor"
            )
            
            st.markdown("#### 🤝 Staged Operational Decisions")
            st.write("Review, edit, and select which decisions to log under meeting history:")
            edited_decisions = st.data_editor(
                st.session_state['staged_offline_decisions'],
                column_config={
                    "Import": st.column_config.CheckboxColumn("Import?"),
                    "Decision": st.column_config.TextColumn("Decision Summary", width="large"),
                    "Owner/Involved": st.column_config.TextColumn("Involved Parties/Owner"),
                    "Details": st.column_config.TextColumn("Context/Details", width="large")
                },
                hide_index=True,
                use_container_width=True,
                key="edited_offline_decisions_editor"
            )
            
            # Form submission
            if st.form_submit_button("🚀 Commit Action Items & Decisions to Project Feed", use_container_width=True):
                # 1. Commit action items
                actions_saved_count = 0
                for row in edited_actions:
                    if row.get("Import", False):
                        due_raw = row.get("Due Date Raw", "Not Specified")
                        try:
                            clean_due = dparser.parse(due_raw, fuzzy=True, default=datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                        except Exception:
                            clean_due = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                            
                        execute(
                            "INSERT INTO actions (project_id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, status, latest_update, rag_status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                            (pid, row.get("Task", "Unnamed task"), row.get("Owner", "Unassigned"), datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), clean_due, "Open", "Imported via Offline Meeting Assistant", "Grey")
                        )
                        actions_saved_count += 1
                
                # 2. Format decisions and insert a new meeting record
                decisions_saved_count = 0
                decisions_list = []
                for row in edited_decisions:
                    if row.get("Import", False):
                        decisions_list.append(f"- **{row.get('Decision', 'Unnamed Decision')}** (Involved: {row.get('Owner/Involved', 'Team')}) - {row.get('Details', '')}")
                        decisions_saved_count += 1
                        
                decisions_text = "\n".join(decisions_list) if decisions_list else "No decisions logged."
                
                meeting_title = f"Offline Meeting Debrief - {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
                meeting_summary = f"Meeting minutes and action items parsed locally using Whisper transcription and Llama 3 model."
                transcription_text = st.session_state['offline_transcription_result']
                
                meeting_id = execute(
                    "INSERT INTO meetings (project_id, date, title, attendees, summary, thematic, decisions, next_steps, document_type, sentiment_score) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (pid, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), meeting_title, "AI System", meeting_summary, transcription_text, decisions_text, "Action items generated.", "Meeting Minutes", 0.0),
                    return_lastrowid=True
                )
                
                update_timestamp(current_org_id)
                
                # Reset Session States
                st.session_state['staged_offline_actions'] = []
                st.session_state['staged_offline_decisions'] = []
                st.session_state['offline_transcription_result'] = ""
                st.session_state['offline_distillation_raw'] = ""
                st.session_state['offline_uploader_counter'] += 1
                
                st.success(f"Successfully committed intelligence to Project Feed! Saved {actions_saved_count} tasks and {decisions_saved_count} decisions linked to Meeting ID #{meeting_id}.")
                st.rerun()

This application uses **GitHub Flavored Markdown** for formatting text in areas like meeting summaries, risk mitigations, and comments. This allows you to create rich text, lists, and links using simple syntax.
""")

st.markdown("""
ℹ️ For a complete reference, please visit the official **<a href="https://www.markdownguide.org/cheat-sheet/" target="_blank">Markdown Guide Cheat Sheet</a>** (opens in a new window).
""", unsafe_allow_html=True)

st.subheader("Live Examples")
st.markdown("Below are live examples of commonly used formatting options that you can use throughout the application.")

def _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet: str, language: str, key: str):
    """
    Renders a code snippet and provides a 'Copy to Clipboard' button.
    """
    st.code(code_snippet, language=language)
    button_id = f"copy_button_{key}"
    script = f"""
    <script>
    function copyToClipboard_{key}() {{
        const text = `{code_snippet.replace('`', '\\`')}`; // Escape backticks
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function() {{
            const button = document.getElementById('{button_id}');
            const originalText = button.innerHTML;
            button.innerHTML = 'Copied!';
            setTimeout(() => {{
                button.innerHTML = originalText;
            }}, 1500);
        }}).catch(function(err) {{
            console.error('Could not copy text: ', err);
        }});
    }}
    </script>
    <button id="{button_id}" onclick="copyToClipboard_{key}()" class="copy-code-button">
        Copy Code
    </button>
    """
    components.html(script, height=40)

with st.container(border=True):
    st.write("**Headers**")
    code_snippet = """
# Header 1
## Header 2
### Header 3
    """
    _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "headers_code")
    st.markdown("""
# Header 1
## Header 2
### Header 3
    """)

with st.container(border=True):
    st.write("**Text Styles**")
    code_snippet = """
**Bold Text**
*Italic Text* or _Italic Text_
~~Strikethrough~~
    """
    _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "text_styles_code")
    st.markdown("**Bold Text**, *Italic Text*, ~~Strikethrough~~")

with st.container(border=True):
    st.write("**Lists**")
    c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
    with c1:
        st.write("Bulleted List")
        code_snippet = """
- Item 1
- Item 2
  - Sub-item 2a
        """
        _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "bulleted_list_code")
        st.markdown("""
- Item 1
- Item 2
  - Sub-item 2a
        """)
    with c2:
        st.write("Numbered List")
        code_snippet = """
1. First Item
2. Second Item
3. Third Item
        """
        _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "numbered_list_code")
        st.markdown("""
1. First Item
2. Second Item
3. Third Item
        """)

with st.container(border=True):
    st.write("**Task Lists (Checklists)**")
    code_snippet = """
- [x] Completed task
- [ ] Incomplete task
    """
    _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "task_list_code")
    st.markdown("""
- [x] Completed task
- [ ] Incomplete task
    """)

with st.container(border=True):
    st.write("**Other Useful Elements**")
    st.write("Blockquote")
    code_snippet = "> This is a blockquote. It's useful for highlighting text."
    _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "blockquote_code")
    st.markdown("> This is a blockquote. It's useful for highlighting text.")
    
    st.write("Horizontal Rule (Divider)")
    code_snippet = "---"
    _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "hr_code")
    st.markdown("---")

    st.write("Link")
    code_snippet = "Link to NHS Digital"
    _render_code_snippet_with_copy(code_snippet, "markdown", "link_code")
    st.markdown("[Link to NHS Digital](https://digital.nhs.uk/)")

# pages/95_🔐_Users_&_Permissions.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import json
import hashlib
from typing import List, Any, cast

# Custom Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, render_page_navigation_buttons, handle_page_entry
from core.database_utils import (
    query, execute, get_config, execute_many, log_audit_event
)
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.constants import ALL_ACTIONS
from core.state import get_app_state

# --- RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) ---
handle_page_entry()
if not user_can("view_admin_page"):
    st.error(f"🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this page.")
    st.info("Please contact a System Administrator if you require access.")
    st.stop()

# 1. Page Setup
app_state = get_app_state()
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Administration"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

st.title("🔐 Role-Based Permissions")

# This page now has a single responsibility: managing the permissions matrix.
# User creation and management is handled in '94_👥_Team_Directory.py'.

render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)
st.subheader("🔐 Role-Based Permissions Management")
st.write("Define which actions each user role is allowed to perform across the application.")
st.info("Changes are applied instantly. The '*' action grants a role full administrative permissions.")

roles_list = get_config('ROLE')
if "Super Admin" not in roles_list:
    roles_list.insert(0, "Super Admin")
if "Read Only Viewer" not in roles_list:
    roles_list.append("Read Only Viewer")

df_perms = query("SELECT role, action FROM permissions")

perm_data = {role: [False] * len(ALL_ACTIONS) for role in roles_list}
perm_df = pd.DataFrame(perm_data, index=ALL_ACTIONS)

for _, row in df_perms.iterrows():
    if row['role'] in perm_df.columns and row['action'] in perm_df.index:
        perm_df.loc[row['action'], row['role']] = True

st.write("**Permission Matrix**")
edited_perms_df = st.data_editor(
    perm_df,
    use_container_width=True,
    height=600
)

if st.button("💾 Save Permission Changes", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
    inserts = []
    deletes = []
    for action in edited_perms_df.index:
        for role in edited_perms_df.columns:
            has_perm_new = edited_perms_df.loc[action, role]
            has_perm_old = perm_df.loc[action, role]
            if has_perm_new and not has_perm_old:
                inserts.append((role, action))
            elif not has_perm_new and has_perm_old:
                deletes.append((role, action))
    
    if inserts:
        execute_many("INSERT INTO permissions (role, action) VALUES (?, ?)", inserts)
    if deletes:
        for role, action in deletes:
            execute("DELETE FROM permissions WHERE role = ? AND action = ?", (role, action))
    
    st.toast("Permissions updated successfully!")
    st.cache_data.clear()
    st.rerun()

import streamlit as st

from typing import List, Any

handle_page_entry()
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

def to_word_digest(df: pd.DataFrame) -> bytes:
    """Converts structured meeting data into a professional Word doc."""
    doc = Document()
    doc.add_heading('Weekly National Project Digest', level=0)
    doc.add_paragraph(f"Report Period: Last 7 Days | Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")

    if df.empty:
        doc.add_paragraph("No updates found for this period.")
    else:
        for _, row in df.iterrows():
            doc.add_heading(f"{row['Org']} - {row['Project']}", level=1)
            doc.add_paragraph(f"Meeting Date: {row.get('date', 'N/A')}")
            
            summary_text = decompress_text_if_needed(row.get('summary'), row.get('summary_blob'))
            if summary_text:
                doc.add_heading("Executive Summary", level=2)
                add_markdown_to_doc(doc, summary_text)
            
            decisions_text = decompress_text_if_needed(row.get('decisions'), row.get('decisions_blob'))
            if decisions_text:
                doc.add_heading("Key Decisions", level=2)
                add_markdown_to_doc(doc, decisions_text)
            
            next_steps_text = decompress_text_if_needed(row.get('next_steps'), row.get('next_steps_blob'))
            if next_steps_text:
                doc.add_heading("Strategic Outlook", level=2)
                add_markdown_to_doc(doc, next_steps_text)

            doc.add_paragraph("-" * 30)

    output = io.BytesIO()
    doc.save(output)
    return output.getvalue()
