def calculate_standing(row, closed_statuses: List[str]):
    """Calculates the standing of a task based on its status and due date."""
    if row['status'] in closed_statuses: return '✅ COMPLETE'
    if pd.isnull(row['due_date']): return '⚪ NO DATE'
    today = datetime.now().date()
    if row['due_date'] < today: return '🚨 OVERDUE'
    elif row['due_date'] < (today + timedelta(days=3)): return '⚠️ DUE SOON'
    else: return '🔵 ON TRACK'

def find_critical_path(df: pd.DataFrame) -> List[int]:
    """
    Finds a critical path in a task DataFrame.
    This is a simplified approach that finds the longest path (by number of tasks)
    to the task with the latest due date.
    """
    if df.empty:
        return []

    # Make a copy to avoid SettingWithCopyWarning and ensure data types are correct
    df_with_dates = df.copy()
    df_with_dates['due_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df_with_dates['due_date'], errors='coerce')
    df_with_dates.dropna(subset=['due_date'], inplace=True)

    if df_with_dates.empty:
        return [] # No tasks with due dates to determine a critical path

    nodes = set(df['id'])
    predecessors_map: Dict[int, List[int]] = {node_id: [] for node_id in nodes}

    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        if pd.notnull(row['depends_on_id']) and row['depends_on_id'] in nodes:
            source = int(row['depends_on_id'])
            # Ensure target is an int as well for consistency
            target = int(row['id'])
            predecessors_map[target].append(source)

    # Find all nodes that are not predecessors to any other node (end nodes)
    all_predecessors = set()
    for preds in predecessors_map.values():
        all_predecessors.update(preds)
    
    end_nodes_ids = [node_id for node_id in nodes if node_id not in all_predecessors]

    if not end_nodes_ids:
        # Fallback if there are no clear end nodes (e.g., a cycle).
        # Use the node with the latest due date in the entire filtered dataset.
        latest_task_id = df_with_dates.loc[df_with_dates['due_date'].idxmax()]['id']
    else:
        # Filter the end nodes to only those that have dates
        end_nodes_with_dates_df = df_with_dates[df_with_dates['id'].isin(end_nodes_ids)]

        if end_nodes_with_dates_df.empty:
            # Fallback if end nodes have no dates.
            # Use the node with the latest due date in the entire filtered dataset.
            latest_task_id = df_with_dates.loc[df_with_dates['due_date'].idxmax()]['id']
        else:
            # Find the end node with the latest due date
            latest_task_id = end_nodes_with_dates_df.loc[end_nodes_with_dates_df['due_date'].idxmax()]['id']

    memo: Dict[int, List[int]] = {}
    def get_longest_path(node_id: int, recursion_stack: set) -> List[int]:
        if node_id in recursion_stack:
            # Cycle detected, return a minimal path to avoid infinite recursion
            logging.warning(f"Cycle detected in task dependencies involving task ID {node_id}. Critical path may be inaccurate.")
            return [node_id]
        if node_id in memo:
            return memo[node_id]

        recursion_stack.add(node_id)

        preds = predecessors_map.get(node_id, [])
        if not preds:
            recursion_stack.remove(node_id)
            return [node_id]

        # Filter out predecessors that don't exist in the original df
        valid_preds = [p for p in preds if p in nodes]
        if not valid_preds:
            recursion_stack.remove(node_id)
            return [node_id]

        longest_path = max((get_longest_path(pred, recursion_stack) for pred in valid_preds), key=len)
        result = longest_path + [node_id]
        recursion_stack.remove(node_id)
        memo[node_id] = result
        return result

    return get_longest_path(int(latest_task_id), set())
# 2. HELPER: National Gantt logic
def render_national_gantt(df: pd.DataFrame, can_edit: bool = False) -> None:
    """
    Renders a national interactive Gantt chart using a hypothetical custom component.
    This function prepares data for the component and handles its outputs.
    """
    if df.empty:
        st.info("No tasks match the current filters to display a timeline.") # type: ignore
        return

    # Data Processing for Altair Chart
    chart_df = df.copy()
    chart_df['due_date'] = pd.to_datetime(chart_df['due_date'], errors='coerce')
    chart_df['start_date'] = pd.to_datetime(chart_df['start_date'], errors='coerce')

    # Handle missing dates robustly
    chart_df['start_date'] = chart_df['start_date'].fillna(chart_df['due_date'] - pd.Timedelta(days=1))
    chart_df['due_date'] = chart_df['due_date'].fillna(chart_df['start_date'] + pd.Timedelta(days=1))
    chart_df['start_date'] = chart_df['start_date'].fillna(pd.Timestamp.now())
    chart_df['due_date'] = chart_df['due_date'].fillna(chart_df['start_date'] + pd.Timedelta(days=1))
    
    # Ensure end is after start
    invalid_duration = chart_df['due_date'] <= chart_df['start_date']
    chart_df.loc[invalid_duration, 'due_date'] = chart_df.loc[invalid_duration, 'start_date'] + pd.Timedelta(days=1)

    # --- NEW: Color Logic ---
    critical_path_nodes = find_critical_path(df)
    def get_bar_color_status(row):
        if row['id'] in critical_path_nodes:
            return 'Critical Path'
        if row['status'] in CLOSED_STATUSES:
            return 'Completed'
        if pd.notna(row['due_date']) and row['due_date'].date() < datetime.now().date():
            return 'Overdue'
        # Use rag_status for health coloring, fallback to 'Planned'
        return row['rag_status'] if pd.notna(row['rag_status']) else 'Planned'
    
    chart_df['chart_status'] = chart_df.apply(get_bar_color_status, axis=1)

    # Define a color scale
    status_color_map = {
        'Critical Path': '#da291c', # NHS Bright Red
        'Completed': '#005eb8',    # NHS Blue
        'Overdue': '#851200',      # Dark Crimson
        'Red': '#851200',          # RAG Status Red
        'Amber': '#ffdd00',       # RAG Status Amber ('At Risk')
        'Green': '#00703c',        # RAG Status Green ('On Track')
        'Grey': '#aeb7bd',         # RAG Status Grey ('Not Yet Started')
        'Planned': '#aeb7bd',       # Fallback for null RAG status
    }
    
    domain = chart_df['chart_status'].unique().tolist()
    color_range = [status_color_map.get(s, '#aeb7bd') for s in domain]

    # Add today's marker
    today_marker = pd.DataFrame({'today': [datetime.now()]})

    # Add controls above the Gantt chart
    group_by = st.selectbox("Group Gantt Chart By", ["Task Name", "Project Stream", "Owner", "Status"], index=0, key="gantt_group_by")
    y_field = 'task:N'
    y_title = None
    if group_by == "Project Stream":
        y_field = 'Stream:N'
        y_title = "Project Stream"
    elif group_by == "Owner":
        y_field = 'Owner:N'
        y_title = "Owner"
    elif group_by == "Status":
        y_field = 'chart_status:N'
        y_title = "Status"

    # Create the chart
    chart = alt.Chart(chart_df).mark_bar(cornerRadius=3, height=20).encode(
        x=alt.X('start_date:T', title="Timeline"),
        x2='due_date:T',
        y=alt.Y(y_field, sort='-x', title=y_title),
        color=alt.Color('chart_status:N', legend=alt.Legend(title="Status"), scale=alt.Scale(domain=domain, range=color_range)),
        tooltip=['Trust', 'Stream', 'task', 'Owner', 'start_date', 'due_date', 'status']
    ).properties(title="National Gantt Chart").interactive()

    # Today line
    rule = alt.Chart(today_marker).mark_rule(color='red', strokeWidth=2).encode(x='today:T')

    st.subheader("Gantt Chart Timeline")
    st.altair_chart(chart + rule, use_container_width=True)


def render_task_tree(task_id: int, all_tasks_dict: Dict[int, Any], all_tasks_in_project_df: pd.DataFrame, indent_level: int = 0) -> None:
    """
    
    Recursively renders a task and its children from a pre-processed dictionary.
    """
    task = all_tasks_dict[task_id]
    
    if indent_level > 0:
        st.markdown(f"<div style='margin-left: {indent_level * 30}px;'>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

    with st.container(border=True):
        is_overdue = task.get('Standing') == '🚨 OVERDUE'
        if is_overdue:
            st.markdown('<div class="overdue-marker"></div>', unsafe_allow_html=True)
            
        c1, c2 = st.columns([0.85, 0.15])
        if is_overdue:
            c1.markdown("<span style='color: #d4351c; font-weight: bold;'>🚨 SLA BREACH: OVERDUE</span>", unsafe_allow_html=True)
        
        rag_map_display = {"Green": "🟢", "Amber": "🟡", "Red": "🔴", "Grey": "⚪"}
        
        is_complete = task['status'] in CLOSED_STATUSES
        if is_complete:
            rag_emoji = "🔵" # Complete is Blue
        else:
            rag_status = task.get('rag_status', 'Grey')
            rag_emoji = rag_map_display.get(rag_status, '⚪')

        _frg = task.get('frg_activity') or ''
        task_label = f"**{rag_emoji}" + (f" {_frg}:" if _frg else "") + f"** {task['task']}"
        is_checked = c1.checkbox(task_label, value=is_complete, key=f"complete_checkbox_tree_{task['id']}", help="Mark task as complete/incomplete")
        
        if is_checked != is_complete:
            if is_checked:
                execute("UPDATE actions SET status='Closed', date_completed=? WHERE id=?", (datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), task['id']))
            else:
                execute("UPDATE actions SET status='Open', date_completed=NULL WHERE id=?", (task['id'],))
            st.rerun()
        
        display_date = task['due_date'] if pd.notnull(task['due_date']) else ""
        display_start_date = task.get('start_date') if pd.notnull(task.get('start_date')) else ""
        _owner = task.get('Owner') or ''
        _tg = task.get('task_group') or ''
        _date_parts = [p for p in [f"Start: {display_start_date}" if display_start_date else "", f"Due: {display_date}" if display_date else ""] if p]
        
        # NOTE FOR INTEGRATION (Feature 106 - Out of Office / Delegation Badge):
        # To display a cover badge next to the owner's name when they are Out of Office:
        # 1. Look up owner's user_id from rit_team: SELECT id FROM rit_team WHERE name = _owner
        # 2. Check OOO preferences: SELECT ooo_enabled, ooo_start_date, ooo_end_date, covering_colleague_id FROM user_preferences WHERE user_id = :owner_id
        # 3. If ooo_enabled = 1 and current_date falls between ooo_start_date and ooo_end_date, retrieve the colleague's name: SELECT name FROM rit_team WHERE id = :covering_colleague_id
        # 4. Append f" ⚠️ Covered by {covering_colleague_name}" to the Owner caption string below.
        
        c1.caption(f"ID: {task['id']}" + (f" | Owner: {_owner}" if _owner else "") + (f" | {' | '.join(_date_parts)}" if _date_parts else "") + (f" | 📦 Work Package: {_tg}" if _tg else ""))
        
        # --- Management Popover ---
        if c2.button("Manage", key=f"manage_tree_{task['id']}", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state['modal_edit_entity'] = {
                "type": "task",
                "data": task,
                "additional_data": {
                    "all_tasks_in_project_df": all_tasks_in_project_df
                }
            }
            st.rerun()

    # --- RECURSIVE CALL FOR CHILDREN ---
    for child_id in task.get('children', []):
        render_task_tree(child_id, all_tasks_dict, all_tasks_in_project_df, indent_level + 1)

                                   (pid, t_task['task'], t_task['assigned_to_role'] or "", today_str, due_date, "Open", "Grey", t_task['project_phase'] or "", t_task['task_group'] or ""),
                                   return_lastrowid=True
                               )
                               task_id_map[t_task['id']] = new_task_id
                           
                           # Update dependencies
                           for _, t_task in df_t_tasks.iterrows():
                               if t_task['depends_on_template_task_id'] and t_task['depends_on_template_task_id'] in task_id_map:
                                   execute("UPDATE actions SET depends_on_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (task_id_map[t_task['depends_on_template_task_id']], task_id_map[t_task['id']]))

                           st.toast(f"Successfully imported {len(df_t_tasks)} template tasks!")

# Build Filtered Query based on Sidebar [cite: 223]
f_sil = st.session_state.get('filter_sil', "All SILs")

master_filter, params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im)
params = list(params)
filter_sql = f"WHERE actions.is_deleted=0 AND {master_filter}"

if not show_completed:
    closed_status_placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(CLOSED_STATUSES))
    filter_sql += f" AND (actions.status NOT IN ({closed_status_placeholders}) OR actions.status IS NULL)"
    params.extend(CLOSED_STATUSES)

if my_work_filter_on and current_user_name:
    filter_sql += " AND actions.assigned_to = ?"
    params.append(current_user_name)
    my_user = current_user_name


if selected_org != "All Organisations":
    filter_sql += " AND orgs.name = ?"
    params.append(selected_org)

if selected_prj != "All Projects":
    filter_sql += " AND projects.name = ?"
    params.append(selected_prj)

# --- NEW: Server-Side Filtering & Pagination ---
is_filtered_by_search = bool(search_q or my_user != "-- View All --" or selected_priorities)

if search_q:
    filter_sql += " AND (LOWER(orgs.name) LIKE ? OR LOWER(projects.name) LIKE ? OR LOWER(actions.task) LIKE ? OR actions.id IN (SELECT aa.action_id FROM action_assignments aa JOIN rit_team rt ON aa.user_id = rt.id WHERE LOWER(rt.name) LIKE ?))"
    like_term = f"%{search_q}%"
    params.extend([like_term] * 4)

if my_user != "-- View All --":
    user_id_row = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM rit_team WHERE name = ?", (my_user,))
    if user_id_row:
        filter_sql += " AND actions.id IN (SELECT action_id FROM action_assignments WHERE user_id = ?)"
        params.append(user_id_row[0])

if selected_priorities:
    placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_priorities))
    filter_sql += f" AND actions.priority IN ({placeholders})"
    params.extend(selected_priorities)

base_query_select = f'''
    SELECT actions.id, projects.id as project_id, orgs.name as Trust, projects.name as Stream, actions.task,           GROUP_CONCAT(rt.name, ', ') as Owner,           actions.start_date, actions.due_date,            actions.latest_update, actions.latest_update_blob, actions.status, actions.priority, actions.frg_activity, actions.rag_status,
           actions.parent_id, actions.depends_on_id,
           actions.is_recurring, actions.recurring_frequency, actions.next_occurrence_date, actions.original_task_id, actions.task_group
'''
base_query_from_join = f'''
    FROM actions
    LEFT JOIN projects ON actions.project_id = projects.id
    LEFT JOIN orgs ON projects.org_id = orgs.id
    LEFT JOIN region_mapping m ON orgs.region = m.sub_region
    LEFT JOIN action_assignments aa ON actions.id = aa.action_id
    LEFT JOIN rit_team rt ON aa.user_id = rt.id
'''

PAGE_SIZE = 50

# The GROUP BY actions.id is needed to correctly count unique actions when joining with action_assignments
count_query = f"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT actions.id) {base_query_from_join} {filter_sql}"
total_records = int(query(count_query, params=tuple(params)).iloc[0, 0])

start_idx, end_idx = render_pagination_controls(total_records, PAGE_SIZE, "task_list")

    # --- Task Batch Update / Bulk Operations ---
    with st.expander("🛠️ Task Batch Update / Bulk Operations"):

            )
            
            # Action select
            action_type = st.radio("Choose Action to Perform", ["Change Status", "Assign Owner", "Change Work Package"], horizontal=True)

                    if selected_ids:
                        date_completed = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if new_status in CLOSED_STATUSES else None
                        placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_ids))
                        execute(f"UPDATE actions SET status = ?, date_completed = ? WHERE id IN ({placeholders})", [new_status, date_completed] + list(selected_ids))
                        st.toast(f"Successfully updated status to '{new_status}' for {len(selected_ids)} tasks.")
                        st.rerun()
                    else:
                        st.warning("Please select at least one task.")
                        
            elif action_type == "Assign Owner":
                new_owner = st.selectbox("New Owner", active_owners)
                if st.button("Apply Bulk Owner Assignment", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
                    if selected_ids and new_owner != "-- View All --":
                        user_id_row = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM rit_team WHERE name = ?", (new_owner,))
                        if user_id_row:
                            user_id = user_id_row[0]
                            placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_ids))
                            execute(f"UPDATE actions SET assigned_to = ? WHERE id IN ({placeholders})", [new_owner] + list(selected_ids))
                            for tid in selected_ids:
                                execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO action_assignments (action_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)", (tid, user_id))
                            st.toast(f"Successfully assigned {new_owner} to {len(selected_ids)} tasks.")
                            st.rerun()
                    else:
                        st.warning("Please select tasks and a valid owner.")
                        
            elif action_type == "Change Work Package":
                new_wp = st.text_input("New Work Package / Task Group Name")
                if st.button("Apply Bulk Work Package Update", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
                    if selected_ids and new_wp.strip():
                        placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_ids))
                        execute(f"UPDATE actions SET task_group = ? WHERE id IN ({placeholders})", [new_wp.strip()] + list(selected_ids))
                        st.toast(f"Successfully updated Work Package to '{new_wp.strip()}' for {len(selected_ids)} tasks.")
                        st.rerun()
                    else:
                        st.warning("Please select tasks and specify a work package name.")
        else:
            st.info("No tasks available in current view for batch operations.")

    v_col1, v_col2 = st.columns([0.6, 0.4])
    t_view = v_col2.radio("Display Mode", ["Hierarchical List", "Kanban Board", "Timeline", "Dependency Graph"], horizontal=True) 

    if t_view == "Timeline":
        render_national_gantt(df_filtered)
    elif t_view == "Dependency Graph":
        st.subheader("🕸️ Task Dependency Network")
        if df_filtered.empty:
            st.info("No tasks to visualize.")
        else:
            # --- 1. CRITICAL PATH CALCULATION ---
            # Use the full project data for accurate path finding, not just the filtered view
            project_df = df_all_t[df_all_t['project_id'] == pid] if pid and not df_all_t.empty else df_all_t
            critical_path_nodes = find_critical_path(project_df)
            critical_path_edges = set()
            for i in range(len(critical_path_nodes) - 1):
                critical_path_edges.add((critical_path_nodes[i], critical_path_nodes[i+1]))

            net = Network(height="750px", width="100%", bgcolor="#222222", font_color="white", notebook=False, directed=True)
            
            # Add nodes
            for _, row in df_filtered.iterrows():
                task_id = row['id']
                label = f"ID: {task_id}\n{row['task']}"
                base_color = "#00703c" if row['status'] in CLOSED_STATUSES else ("#d4351c" if row['Standing'] == '🚨 OVERDUE' else "#1d70b8")
                
                is_critical = task_id in critical_path_nodes
                
                color_obj = {
                    'border': '#FFD700' if is_critical else '#2B7CE9',
                    'background': base_color,
                    'highlight': {'border': '#FF4500', 'background': '#FFC0CB'},
                    'hover': {'border': '#FF4500', 'background': '#FFC0CB'}
                }

                # Add custom properties to the node for the JS to use
                net.add_node(task_id, label=label, title=row['task'], color=color_obj, borderWidth=3 if is_critical else 1,
                             # Store original state for JS reset
                             originalColor=color_obj,
                             originalBorderWidth=3 if is_critical else 1)

            # Add edges
            for _, row in df_filtered.iterrows():
                if pd.notnull(row['depends_on_id']):
                    source = int(row['depends_on_id'])
                    target = row['id']
                    if source in net.get_nodes() and target in net.get_nodes():
                        is_critical_edge = (source, target) in critical_path_edges
                        edge_color = '#FFD700' if is_critical_edge else '#848484'
                        edge_width = 3 if is_critical_edge else 1
                        net.add_edge(source, target, color=edge_color, width=edge_width,
                                     # Store original state for JS reset
                                     originalColor=edge_color,
                                     originalWidth=edge_width)
            
            # --- 2. CLICK-TO-HIGHLIGHT ---
            # Inject JavaScript for interactivity. This function will be a string passed to pyvis.
            click_handler_js = """
            function(params) {
                var allNodes = this.body.data.nodes.get({ returnType: "Array" });
                var allEdges = this.body.data.edges.get({ returnType: "Array" });

                // 1. Reset all nodes and edges to their original state
                var nodesToUpdate = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < allNodes.length; i++) {
                    var node = allNodes[i];
                    if (node.originalColor) {
                        nodesToUpdate.push({id: node.id, color: node.originalColor, borderWidth: node.originalBorderWidth});
                    }
                }
                if (nodesToUpdate.length > 0) { this.body.data.nodes.update(nodesToUpdate); }

                var edgesToUpdate = [];
                for (var i = 0; i < allEdges.length; i++) {
                    var edge = allEdges[i];
                    if (edge.originalColor) {
                        edgesToUpdate.push({id: edge.id, color: {color: edge.originalColor, highlight: edge.originalColor}, width: edge.originalWidth});
                    }
                }
                if (edgesToUpdate.length > 0) { this.body.data.edges.update(edgesToUpdate); }

                // 2. If a node was clicked, find and highlight its dependency chain
                if (params.nodes.length > 0) {
                    var clickedNodeId = params.nodes[0];
                    
                    // Helper functions to traverse the graph
                    function getSuccessors(nodeId, visited, edges) {
                        var successors = new Set();
                        if (visited.has(nodeId)) return successors;
                        visited.add(nodeId);
                        for (var i = 0; i < edges.length; i++) {
                            if (edges[i].from === nodeId) {
                                successors.add(edges[i].to);
                                getSuccessors(edges[i].to, visited, edges).forEach(item => successors.add(item));
                            }
                        }
                        return successors;
                    }

                    function getPredecessors(nodeId, visited, edges) {
                        var predecessors = new Set();
                        if (visited.has(nodeId)) return predecessors;
                        visited.add(nodeId);
                        for (var i = 0; i < edges.length; i++) {
                            if (edges[i].to === nodeId) {
                                predecessors.add(edges[i].from);
                                getPredecessors(edges[i].from, visited, edges).forEach(item => predecessors.add(item));
                            }
                        }
                        return predecessors;
                    }

                    var downstreamNodes = Array.from(getSuccessors(clickedNodeId, new Set(), allEdges));
                    var upstreamNodes = Array.from(getPredecessors(clickedNodeId, new Set(), allEdges));
                    
                    // 3. Apply highlights
                    var updates = [{id: clickedNodeId, color: { border: '#FF4500' }, borderWidth: 4}]; // Clicked
                    upstreamNodes.forEach(id => updates.push({id: id, color: { border: '#ADFF2F' }})); // Upstream
                    downstreamNodes.forEach(id => updates.push({id: id, color: { border: '#FFA500' }})); // Downstream
                    this.body.data.nodes.update(updates);
                }
            }
            """ 

            # Generate HTML
            try:
                # Generate the base HTML content from pyvis
                # The cdn_resources='remote' parameter in the Network constructor
                # should handle pointing to the CDN, making the regex unnecessary.
                html_content = net.generate_html()

                # Inject the JavaScript click handler into the generated HTML.
                # We find the end of the main script tag and insert our handler just before it.
                # Find the network initialization line
                network_init_pattern = r"(var network = new vis\.Network\(container, data, options\);)"
                
                # The script to inject
                injection_script = f'network.on("click", {click_handler_js});'

                # Replace the network initialization line with itself plus our injection script
                html_with_click = re.sub(network_init_pattern, r"\1\n" + injection_script, html_content, flags=re.MULTILINE)

                # Display the modified HTML
                components.html(html_with_click, height=760)
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"Could not generate graph: {e}")
    elif t_view == "Kanban Board":
        st.subheader("📋 Interactive Kanban Board")
        st.caption("Drag and drop tasks to update their status.")
 
        kanban_statuses = [s for s in TASK_STATUSES if s not in CLOSED_STATUSES]
        if not kanban_statuses:
            st.info("No active statuses configured for Kanban board.")
        else:
            # --- ENHANCEMENT: Interactive Drag-and-Drop Kanban Board ---
            # This uses the `streamlit-dnd-board` library to create an interactive Kanban board.
            # It takes a dictionary of items grouped by status and returns the updated dictionary if a card is moved.

            # 1. Prepare items for the board
            board_items = {status: [] for status in kanban_statuses}
            for status in kanban_statuses:
                tasks_in_status = df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == status]
                for _, task in tasks_in_status.iterrows():
                    rag_map_display = {"Green": "🟢", "Amber": "🟡", "Red": "🔴", "Grey": "⚪"}

                    display_date = task['due_date'] if pd.notnull(task['due_date']) else "No Date"

                    # The content of the card is defined here as markdown
                    card_content = f"""
                    **{rag_emoji} {task['task']}**
                    <br><small>Due: {display_date} | Owner: {task['Owner']}</small>
                    <br><small>Project: {task['Stream']}</small>
                    """
                    board_items[status].append({"id": task['id'], "content": card_content})

            # 2. Render the drag-and-drop board
            updated_board = None
            try:
                from streamlit_kanban import kanban_board  # type: ignore

            except ImportError:
                st.warning("Interactive Kanban component (`streamlit-kanban`) not found. Displaying a read-only view. Please ask an administrator to install it (`pip install streamlit-kanban`).", icon="⚠️")
                # Fallback to a read-only view if the library is not installed
                cols = st.columns(len(kanban_statuses))
                for i, status in enumerate(kanban_statuses):
                    with cols[i]:
                        st.markdown(f"##### {status}")
                        st.divider()
                        tasks_in_status = df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == status]
                        if tasks_in_status.empty:
                            st.caption("No tasks in this status.")
                        for _, task in tasks_in_status.iterrows():
                            with st.container(border=True):
                                rag_map_display = {"Green": "🟢", "Amber": "🟡", "Red": "🔴", "Grey": "⚪"}
                                rag_emoji = rag_map_display.get(task.get('rag_status', 'Grey'), '⚪')
                                display_date = task['due_date'] if pd.notnull(task['due_date']) else "No Date"
                                card_content = f"""
                                **{rag_emoji} {task['task']}**
                                <br><small>Due: {display_date} | Owner: {task['Owner']}</small>
                                <br><small>Project: {task['Stream']}</small>
                                """
                                st.markdown(card_content, unsafe_allow_html=True)

                                # Move status dropdown
                                available_transitions = [s for s in kanban_statuses if s != status]
                                selected_next_status = st.selectbox(
                                    "Move to...",
                                    options=["-- Move Status --"] + available_transitions,
                                    key=f"move_select_{task['id']}",
                                    label_visibility="collapsed"
                                )
                                if selected_next_status != "-- Move Status --":
                                    date_completed = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if selected_next_status in CLOSED_STATUSES else None
                                    execute("UPDATE actions SET status=?, date_completed=? WHERE id=?", (selected_next_status, date_completed, task['id']))
                                    st.toast(f"Moved task to {selected_next_status}")
                                    st.rerun()

                                # Manage task button
                                if st.button("🔧 Manage", key=f"manage_card_{task['id']}", use_container_width=True):
                                    st.session_state['modal_edit_entity'] = {
                                        "type": "task",

                                    st.rerun()

            # 3. Process the results if the board was updated
            if updated_board:
                changes_found = False
                for new_status, items in updated_board.items():
                    for item in items:
                        task_id = item['id']
                        # Find the original status of the task from the dataframe
                        original_task_status = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered['id'] == task_id, 'status'].iloc[0]

                        if original_task_status != new_status:

                            date_completed = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d") if new_status in CLOSED_STATUSES else None
                            execute("UPDATE actions SET status=?, date_completed=? WHERE id=?", (new_status, date_completed, task_id))
                            changes_found = True

                if changes_found:
                    st.toast("Kanban board updated!")
                    st.rerun()
    else:
        is_filtered = is_filtered_by_search # Use the flag defined earlier
        if is_filtered:
            if not df_filtered.empty:
                st.subheader("📝 Filtered Task List")
                st.caption("Displaying a flat list of tasks matching your search. Clear filters to see the full hierarchy.")
                for _, row in df_filtered.iterrows():
                    with st.container(border=True):
                        is_overdue = row.get('Standing') == '🚨 OVERDUE'
                        if is_overdue:
                            st.markdown('<div class="overdue-marker"></div>', unsafe_allow_html=True)

                            latest_update_text = decompress_text_if_needed(row.get('latest_update'), row.get('latest_update_blob'))

                        tasks_dict: Dict[int, Any] = grp_tasks_df.set_index('id', drop=False).to_dict('index')
                        root_tasks: List[int] = []
                        for t_id, task_data in tasks_dict.items():
                            tasks_dict[t_id]['children'] = []
                        
                        for t_id, task_data in tasks_dict.items():
                            parent_id = task_data.get('parent_id')
                            if pd.notnull(parent_id) and parent_id in tasks_dict:
                                tasks_dict[parent_id]['children'].append(int(t_id))
                            else:
                                root_tasks.append(int(t_id))
                                
                        for t_id in root_tasks:
                            if t_id in group_df['id'].values:
                                render_task_tree(t_id, tasks_dict, grp_tasks_df, 0)
                        st.divider()
                else:
                    # FIX: Preserve 'id' in dictionary values using drop=False [KeyError Fix] [cite: 236]
                    tasks_dict: Dict[int, Any] = all_tasks_in_project_df.set_index('id', drop=False).to_dict('index')

                    root_tasks: List[int] = []
                    for t_id, task_data in tasks_dict.items():
                        tasks_dict[t_id]['children'] = []

                    for t_id, task_data in tasks_dict.items():
                        parent_id = task_data.get('parent_id')
                        if pd.notnull(parent_id) and parent_id in tasks_dict:
                            tasks_dict[parent_id]['children'].append(int(t_id))
                        else:
                            root_tasks.append(int(t_id))
                    
                    # Render the tree starting from root tasks [cite: 239]
                    for t_id in root_tasks:
                        if t_id in group_df['id'].values:
                            render_task_tree(t_id, tasks_dict, all_tasks_in_project_df, 0)
                    st.divider()
else:
    if not is_filtered_by_search:
        st.success("🎉 No open tasks for this selection!")

# pages/16_🗺️_Regional_Directory.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import os
import base64
from io import BytesIO
from datetime import datetime
from typing import List, Dict, Any

# Custom Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, render_page_navigation_buttons, handle_page_entry
from core.database_utils import query
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.encryption_utils import decrypt_file
from core.pdf_utils import generate_regional_directory_pdf
from core.state import get_app_state

# --- 1. ACCESS CONTROL ---
handle_page_entry()
if not user_can("view_dashboard"):
    st.error("🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this page.")
    st.stop()

# --- 2. PAGE SETUP ---
app_state = get_app_state()
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Dashboards & Overviews"
render_sidebar()

st.title("🗺️ Regional Directory")
st.caption("A directory of all RIT Team members, grouped by their regional assignments.")

render_page_navigation_buttons("All Organisations", "All Projects") # Directory is always global
# --- 3. DATA FETCHING ---
@st.cache_data(ttl=600)
def get_directory_data() -> Dict[str, Any]:
    region_hierarchy_df = query("SELECT regional_group, sil_lead, il_lead, im_lead, ia_leads, ssrl_lead, srl_lead, scel_lead, cel_lead FROM region_mapping")
    region_hierarchy_df = region_hierarchy_df[~region_hierarchy_df['regional_group'].isin(['England', 'England and Wales', 'Midlands and East England'])]
    
    directory = {}
    for group_name in sorted(region_hierarchy_df['regional_group'].dropna().unique()):
        directory[group_name] = {"sils": set(), "ils": set(), "ims": set(), "ias": set(), "ssrls": set(), "srls": set(), "scels": set(), "cels": set()}

    for _, row in region_hierarchy_df.iterrows():
        group = row['regional_group']
        if group in directory:
            lead_map = [
                ("sils", "sil_lead"), ("ils", "il_lead"), ("ims", "im_lead"), ("ias", "ia_leads"),
                ("ssrls", "ssrl_lead"), ("srls", "srl_lead"), ("scels", "scel_lead"), ("cels", "cel_lead")
            ]
            for lead_type, col_name in lead_map:
                if pd.notna(row[col_name]):
                    names = [name.strip() for name in str(row[col_name]).split(',') if name.strip()]
                    directory[group][lead_type].update(names)

    all_names = set()
    for group_data in directory.values():
        for role_names in group_data.values():
            all_names.update(role_names)

    # photo_data_map stores tuples of (base64_string, mime_type) for each person
    photo_data_map = {}
    if all_names:
        placeholders = ','.join(['?'] * len(all_names))
        photo_df = query(f"SELECT name, photo_path FROM rit_team WHERE name IN ({placeholders})", tuple(all_names))
        
        # Process images here, inside the cached function
        for _, row in photo_df.iterrows():
            name = row['name']
            photo_path = row['photo_path']
            if pd.notna(photo_path) and os.path.exists(str(photo_path)):
                try:
                    decrypted_data = decrypt_file(str(photo_path))
                    if hasattr(decrypted_data, 'read'):
                        binary_data = decrypted_data.read()
                    else:
                        binary_data = decrypted_data
                    encoded = base64.b64encode(binary_data).decode()
                    # Determine MIME type from the stored file extension
                    ext = os.path.splitext(str(photo_path))[1].lower()
                    mime_type = "image/jpeg" if ext in (".jpg", ".jpeg") else "image/png"
                    photo_data_map[name] = (encoded, mime_type)
                except Exception as e:
                    # If decryption or encoding fails, the name won't be in the map,
                    # and the helper function will use the default avatar.
                    import logging
                    logging.getLogger(__name__).warning(f"Could not load photo for '{name}': {e}")

    final_directory = {group: {role: sorted(list(names)) for role, names in data.items()} for group, data in directory.items()}
    # Return the map with base64 data
    return {"directory": final_directory, "photos": photo_data_map}

# --- 4. HELPER: RENDER PRE-ENCODED PHOTO ---
def get_image_html(name: str, photo_map: Dict[str, Any]):
    """Returns an HTML img tag with correctly-typed base64 encoded data."""
    photo_entry = photo_map.get(name)
    if photo_entry:
        encoded_photo, mime_type = photo_entry
        return f'''
            <div style="text-align:center; margin: 15px; min-width: 120px;">
                <img src="data:{mime_type};base64,{encoded_photo}" 
                     style="width:110px; height:110px; object-fit:cover; border-radius:50%; border: 3px solid #d6d6d6;">
                <br><span style="font-size:1em; font-weight: 500;">{name}</span>
            </div>'''
    
    # Fallback for users with no photo or if an error occurred during encoding
    return f'''
        <div style="text-align:center; margin: 15px; min-width: 120px;">
            <div style="width:110px; height:110px; line-height:110px; border-radius:50%; background:#f0f4f5; color:#212b32; display:inline-block; font-size:30px; border: 3px solid #d6d6d6;">👤</div>
            <br><span style="font-size:1em;">{name}</span>
        </div>'''

# --- PDF EXPORT BUTTON ---
# We get the data once here to pass to both the PDF generator and the HTML renderer
directory_blob = get_directory_data()
directory_data_for_page = directory_blob.get("directory", {})
photo_map_for_page = directory_blob.get("photos", {})

if directory_data_for_page:
    st.download_button(label='📄 Download as PDF (A3 Portrait)', data=generate_regional_directory_pdf(directory_data_for_page, photo_map_for_page), file_name=f"Regional_Directory_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.pdf", mime='application/pdf', use_container_width=True)

# --- 5. RENDER DIRECTORY ---
directory_data = directory_data_for_page
photo_map = photo_map_for_page

if not directory_data:
    st.warning("No regional data found.")
else:
    region_names = sorted(directory_data.keys())
    
    # CSS for larger images and horizontal scrolling
    st.markdown("""
        <style>
            .scroll-wrapper {
                width: 100%;
                overflow-x: auto;
                border: 1px solid #d6d6d6;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
            .directory-table {
                width: 100%;
                border-collapse: collapse;
                color: inherit;
                min-width: """ + str(len(region_names) * 250) + """px; /* Ensures space for large photos */
            }
            .directory-table th {
                border-bottom: 2px solid #d6d6d6;
                border-left: 1px solid #d6d6d6;
                padding: 20px;
                text-align: center;
                font-size: 1.2em;
                background-color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.05);
            }
            .directory-table td {
                border-left: 1px solid #d6d6d6;
                padding: 15px;
                vertical-align: top;
            }
            .directory-table th:first-child, .directory-table td:first-child {
                border-left: none;
            }
            .role-header {
                background-color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.1);
                font-weight: bold;
                padding: 15px !important;
                border-top: 1px solid #d6d6d6;
                border-bottom: 1px solid #d6d6d6;
                text-transform: uppercase;
                letter-spacing: 1px;
                font-size: 0.9em;
                position: sticky;
                left: 0;
            }
            .member-container {
                display: flex;
                flex-wrap: wrap;
                justify-content: center;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }
        </style>
    """, unsafe_allow_html=True)

    # Build the HTML Table String
    html = '<div class="scroll-wrapper"><table class="directory-table"><thead><tr>'
    for name in region_names:
        html += f'<th>{name}</th>'
    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>'

    roles_to_render = [
        ("Senior Implementation Leads (SILs)", "sils"),
        ("Implementation Leads (ILs)", "ils"),
        ("Implementation Managers (IMs)", "ims"),
        ("Implementation Advisors (IAs)", "ias"),
        ("Senior Solution Readiness Leads (SSRLs)", "ssrls"),
        ("Solution Readiness Leads (SRLs)", "srls"),
        ("Senior Change & Enablement Leads (SCELs)", "scels"),
        ("Change & Enablement Leads (CELs)", "cels"),
    ]

    for role_title, role_key in roles_to_render:
        html += f'<tr><td colspan="{len(region_names)}" class="role-header">{role_title}</td></tr>'
        html += '<tr>'
        for region in region_names:
            members = directory_data[region].get(role_key, [])
            html += '<td><div class="member-container">'
            if not members:
                html += '<span style="color:gray; font-size:0.9em; margin: 20px;">Unassigned</span>'
            else:
                for member in members:
                    html += get_image_html(member, photo_map)
            html += '</div></td>'
        html += '</tr>'

    html += '</tbody></table></div>'
    
    st.markdown(html, unsafe_allow_html=True)



==================================================

# pages/38_🧪_Data_Cleanse_Sandbox.py

# --- Create Tabs ---

with tab_sandbox:

1001,John Doe,Specialist Nurse,j.doe@nhs.net,QQ123456A,Nursing,9001,RXR,Y02804,Band 5
1002,Jane Smith,Clinical Director,j.smith_at_nhs.net,QQ123456A,Clinical,9002,RTD,A81001,Band 8b
1003,Bob Johnson,,b.johnson@nhs.net,invalid_ni,Operations,9001,invalid_ods,,Band 3
