# pages/14_✅_FRG_Heatmap.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import json
from datetime import datetime

# Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import apply_custom_css, render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons
from core.database_utils import query
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.constants import FOUNDATIONAL_READINESS_CHECKLIST

handle_page_entry()

if not user_can("view_dashboard"):
    st.error("🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this page.")
    st.stop()

# Page Setup & Sidebar
from core.state import get_app_state
app_state = get_app_state()
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Dashboards & Overviews"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

# GLOBAL FILTER LOGIC
f_sil = st.session_state.get('filter_sil', "All SILs")
f_il = st.session_state.get('filter_il', "All ILs")
f_im = st.session_state.get('filter_im', "All IMs")

conditions = ["p.is_deleted=0", "o.is_deleted=0", "p.name = 'Foundational Readiness'"]
params = []
if f_sil != "All SILs":
    conditions.append("REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || m.sil_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ?")
    params.append(f'%,{f_sil},%')
if f_il != "All ILs":
    conditions.append("REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || m.il_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ?")
    params.append(f'%,{f_il},%')
if f_im != "All IMs":
    conditions.append("REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || m.im_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ?")
    params.append(f'%,{f_im},%')

master_filter_frg = " AND ".join(conditions)

st.title("✅ FRG Heatmap")
st.caption("Live status of all FRG activities for 'Foundational Readiness' projects.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

if any(x not in ["All SILs", "All ILs", "All IMs"] for x in [f_sil, f_il, f_im]):
    st.caption(f"🎯 **Filtered View Active:** SIL: {f_sil} | IL: {f_il} | IM: {f_im}")

frg_sql = f"""
    SELECT
        p.id as project_id,
        p.status as phase,
        p.checklist_data,
        p.sharepoint_link,
        o.name as org_name,
        o.region,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(o.imp_lead, ''), m.il_lead) as imp_lead,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(o.imp_manager, ''), m.im_lead) as imp_manager,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(p.imp_advisor, ''), m.ia_leads) as imp_advisor
    FROM projects p
    JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
    JOIN region_mapping m ON o.region = m.sub_region
    WHERE {master_filter_frg}
"""
df_frg_projects = query(frg_sql, params=tuple(params))

# Add de-duplication step to ensure one row per organisation
df_frg_projects.drop_duplicates(subset=['org_name'], keep='first', inplace=True)

if df_frg_projects.empty:
    st.info("No 'Foundational Readiness' projects found for the current filter.")
else:
    def calculate_completion(checklist_json):
        if not checklist_json:
            return 0.0
        try:
            items = json.loads(checklist_json)
            if not items:
                return 0.0
            completed = sum(1 for item in items if item.get('Status') in ['Green', 'Completed', 'Complete'])
            return (completed / len(items)) * 100.0
        except Exception:
            return 0.0

    heatmap_data = []
    frg_activities = {activity_id: text for activity_id, text in FOUNDATIONAL_READINESS_CHECKLIST}
 
    for _, row in df_frg_projects.iterrows():
        project_id = row['project_id']
        
        # Calculate current completion status
        curr_score = calculate_completion(row['checklist_data'])
        
        # Fetch previous historical checklist data (second-most-recent record)
        prev_df = query(
            "SELECT checklist_data FROM project_checklist_history WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1",
            (project_id,)
        )
        
        trend_arrow = ""
        if not prev_df.empty:
            prev_checklist_json = prev_df.iloc[0]['checklist_data']
            prev_score = calculate_completion(prev_checklist_json)
            if curr_score > prev_score:
                trend_arrow = "↑"
            elif curr_score < prev_score:
                trend_arrow = "↓"
            else:
                trend_arrow = "→"
        
        completion_str = f"{curr_score:.0f}%"
        if trend_arrow:
            completion_str += f" {trend_arrow}"

        heatmap_row = {
            "Organisation": row['org_name'],
            "Phase": row['phase'],
            "Lead": row['imp_lead'] or "Unassigned",
            "Manager": row['imp_manager'] or "Unassigned",
            "Advisor": row['imp_advisor'] or "Unassigned",
            "Completion": completion_str,
            "SharePoint Link": row.get('sharepoint_link') or ""
        }

        if row['checklist_data']:
            try:
                checklist_items = json.loads(row['checklist_data'])
                checklist_status_map = {item.get('Task ID'): item.get('Status', 'Grey') for item in checklist_items}
                for activity_id, activity_text in frg_activities.items():
                    heatmap_row[f"{activity_id}"] = checklist_status_map.get(activity_id, 'Grey')
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
                for activity_id in frg_activities: heatmap_row[f"{activity_id}"] = 'Error'
        else:
            for activity_id in frg_activities: heatmap_row[f"{activity_id}"] = 'Grey'
        
        heatmap_data.append(heatmap_row)

    df_heatmap = pd.DataFrame(heatmap_data)
    
    # --- EXCEL EXPORT FUNCTION ---
    def export_matrix_to_excel(df: pd.DataFrame, chk_keys: list) -> bytes:
        import io
        import openpyxl
        from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill, Font, Alignment, Border, Side
        
        wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
        ws = wb.active
        ws.title = "FRG Heatmap"
        
        header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F4E78", end_color="1F4E78", fill_type="solid")
        header_font = Font(name="Calibri", size=11, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
        
        green_fill = PatternFill(start_color="C6EFCE", end_color="C6EFCE", fill_type="solid")
        amber_fill = PatternFill(start_color="FFEB9C", end_color="FFEB9C", fill_type="solid")
        red_fill = PatternFill(start_color="FFC7CE", end_color="FFC7CE", fill_type="solid")
        grey_fill = PatternFill(start_color="EFEFEF", end_color="EFEFEF", fill_type="solid")
        
        standard_font = Font(name="Calibri", size=11, color="000000")
        status_font = Font(name="Calibri", size=11, bold=True, color="000000")
        
        thin_border = Border(
            left=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9'),
            right=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9'),
            top=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9'),
            bottom=Side(style='thin', color='D9D9D9')
        )
        
        headers = list(df.columns)
        ws.append(headers)
        
        for col_num, header in enumerate(headers, start=1):
            cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col_num)
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.font = header_font
            cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
            cell.border = thin_border
            
        for r_idx, row in enumerate(df.itertuples(index=False), start=2):
            for c_idx, val in enumerate(row, start=1):
                cell = ws.cell(row=r_idx, column=c_idx)
                cell.value = val
                cell.font = standard_font
                cell.border = thin_border
                
                col_name = headers[c_idx - 1]
                if col_name in chk_keys:
                    val_str = str(val)
                    if val_str == "Green":
                        cell.fill = green_fill
                        cell.font = status_font
                    elif val_str == "Amber":
                        cell.fill = amber_fill
                        cell.font = status_font
                    elif val_str == "Red":
                        cell.fill = red_fill
                        cell.font = status_font
                    elif val_str == "Grey":
                        cell.fill = grey_fill
                        cell.font = standard_font
                elif col_name in ["Organisation", "Lead", "Manager", "Advisor", "SharePoint Link"]:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="center")
                else:
                    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
                    
        for col in ws.columns:
            max_len = max(len(str(cell.value or '')) for cell in col)
            col_letter = openpyxl.utils.get_column_letter(col[0].column)
            ws.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = max(max_len + 3, 10)
            
        ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 25
        for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
            ws.row_dimensions[r].height = 20
            
        out = io.BytesIO()
        wb.save(out)
        return out.getvalue()

    # --- SEARCH & FILTER BAR ---
    col_search, col_export = st.columns([3, 1])
    with col_search:
        search_query = st.text_input("🔍 Search Heatmap (filters by trust name, advisor, lead, or manager)", "").strip().lower()
    
    if search_query:
        def matches_row(row):
            for field in ["Organisation", "Lead", "Manager", "Advisor", "SharePoint Link"]:
                if search_query in str(row.get(field, "")).lower():
                    return True
            for col in frg_activities:
                if search_query == col.lower():
                    if str(row.get(col, "")).lower() != 'grey':
                        return True
                if search_query in str(row.get(col, "")).lower() and search_query in ['green', 'amber', 'red', 'grey']:
                    return True
            return False
        df_heatmap = df_heatmap[df_heatmap.apply(matches_row, axis=1)]
        
    with col_export:
        st.write("") # vertical spacing
        excel_bytes = export_matrix_to_excel(df_heatmap, list(frg_activities.keys()))
        st.download_button(
            label="📥 Export to Excel",
            data=excel_bytes,
            file_name=f"FRG_Heatmap_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.xlsx",
            mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
            use_container_width=True
        )

    # --- AGGRID TABLE RENDER ---
    from st_aggrid import AgGrid, GridOptionsBuilder, GridUpdateMode, DataReturnMode, JsCode

    gob = GridOptionsBuilder.from_dataframe(df_heatmap)
    gob.configure_column("Organisation", editable=False, pinned="left")
    gob.configure_column("Phase", editable=False, pinned="left")
    
    completion_jscode = """
    function(params) {
        if (params.value && typeof params.value === 'string') {
            if (params.value.indexOf('↑') !== -1) {
                return {'color': '#00703c', 'fontWeight': 'bold'};
            } else if (params.value.indexOf('↓') !== -1) {
                return {'color': '#d4351c', 'fontWeight': 'bold'};
            } else if (params.value.indexOf('→') !== -1) {
                return {'color': '#b57a00', 'fontWeight': 'bold'};
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    """
    gob.configure_column("Completion", editable=False, cellStyle=JsCode(completion_jscode), width=120)
    gob.configure_column("Lead", editable=False, width=150)
    gob.configure_column("Manager", editable=False, width=150)
    gob.configure_column("Advisor", editable=False, width=150)
    sharepoint_renderer_jscode = """
    class SharePointButtonRenderer {
        init(params) {
            this.eGui = document.createElement('div');
            this.eGui.style.textAlign = 'center';
            this.eGui.style.display = 'flex';
            this.eGui.style.justifyContent = 'center';
            this.eGui.style.alignItems = 'center';
            this.eGui.style.height = '100%';
            
            if (params.value && params.value.trim() !== '') {
                var url = params.value.trim();
                if (!url.startsWith('http://') && !url.startsWith('https://')) {
                    url = 'https://' + url;
                }
                this.eGui.innerHTML = '<a href="' + url + '" target="_blank" style="text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; background-color: #c74616; color: #ffffff; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; border: none; cursor: pointer;">🔗 Go to Site</a>';
            } else {
                this.eGui.innerHTML = '<span style="color: #9e9e9e; font-size: 11px;">No Link</span>';
            }
        }
        getGui() {
            return this.eGui;
        }
        refresh(params) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    """
    gob.configure_column("SharePoint Link", editable=False, cellRenderer=JsCode(sharepoint_renderer_jscode), width=150)

    status_jscode = """
    function(params) {
        if (params.value === 'Green') {
            return {'backgroundColor': '#2e7d32', 'color': 'transparent'};
        } else if (params.value === 'Amber') {
            return {'backgroundColor': '#ffb300', 'color': 'transparent'};
        } else if (params.value === 'Red') {
            return {'backgroundColor': '#d32f2f', 'color': 'transparent'};
        } else if (params.value === 'Grey') {
            return {'backgroundColor': '#9e9e9e', 'color': 'transparent'};
        }
        return null;
    }
    """
    for key in frg_activities.keys():
        gob.configure_column(
            key,
            header_name=key,
            editable=False,
            cellStyle=JsCode(status_jscode),
            width=100
        )

    grid_options = gob.build()
    
    AgGrid(
        df_heatmap,
        gridOptions=grid_options,
        data_return_mode=DataReturnMode.FILTERED_AND_SORTED,
        update_mode=GridUpdateMode.NO_UPDATE,
        fit_columns_on_grid_load=True,
        allow_unsafe_jscode=True,
        theme="alpine",
        key="frg_heatmap_grid"
    )

    st.divider()

        st.caption(f"**{activity_id}:** {activity_text}")

    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    colleague_name TEXT,
    manager_name TEXT,
    conversation_date TEXT NOT NULL,
    
    -- Past 12 Months
    team_goals_support TEXT,
    values_displayed TEXT,
    biggest_successes TEXT,
    biggest_challenges TEXT,
    
    -- Wellbeing
    wellbeing TEXT,
    wellbeing_support TEXT,
    
    -- Next 12 Months
    team_goals_next TEXT,
    
    -- Career Aspirations
    career_persona TEXT,
    conversation_summary TEXT,
    
    is_deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT
);
""")

execute("""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS great_conversation_objectives (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    key_area TEXT,
    personal_objective TEXT,
    completion_date TEXT,
    status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending',
    reflection_notes TEXT,
    is_new INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
    is_deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES great_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
""")

# Self-healing upgrades for existing great_conversation_objectives table
for col, col_type, default_val in [("status", "TEXT", "DEFAULT 'Pending'"), ("reflection_notes", "TEXT", ""), ("is_new", "INTEGER", "DEFAULT 1")]:
    try:
        execute(f"ALTER TABLE great_conversation_objectives ADD COLUMN {col} {col_type} {default_val};")
    except Exception:
        pass

execute("""
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS great_conversation_development (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dev_objective TEXT,
    help_needed TEXT,
    is_deleted INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES great_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
""")

# Resolve User ID and Name
current_user_id = app_state.user.current_user_id
current_user = st.session_state.get("current_user")

        current_user = "NHSBSA User"

    current_user_id = current_user_id_row[0] if current_user_id_row else 1
else:
    if not current_user:
        user_row = fetch_one("SELECT name FROM rit_team WHERE id = ?", (current_user_id,))
        current_user = user_row[0] if user_row else "NHSBSA User"

            st.session_state.selected_conv_id = "NEW"

        )
        
    # Switch active conversation state
    if "prev_selected_conv_id" not in st.session_state or st.session_state.prev_selected_conv_id != selected_conv_id:

        for k in list(st.session_state.keys()):
            if k.startswith("gc_objectives_loaded_") or k.startswith("gc_dev_loaded_") or k.startswith("carry_over_done_") or k.startswith("gc_past_loaded_") or k.startswith("gc_work_loaded_"):
                del st.session_state[k]

            success_count = 0
            for dev in st.session_state.gc_dev_objectives:
                # Check if it already exists to prevent duplicate exports
                exists = fetch_one(
                    "SELECT 1 FROM career_goals WHERE user_id = ? AND title = ? AND is_deleted = 0",
                    (current_user_id, dev["dev_objective"])
                )
                if not exists:
                    execute("""
                        INSERT INTO career_goals (user_id, title, description, timescale, complexity, status, created_at, updated_at)

                    """, (
                        current_user_id,
                        dev["dev_objective"],
                        f"Growth Goal derived from Great Conversations. Alignment help needed: {dev['help_needed']}",
                        datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
                        datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    ))
                    success_count += 1
            if success_count > 0:
                save_db_to_disk()
                st.success(f"Successfully exported {success_count} objective(s) to your Career Planner goals list!")
            else:
                st.info("All objectives already exist in your Career Planner.")

            # Load Career Planner Context
            latest_vision = fetch_one(
                "SELECT overall_vision, vision_2_years, vision_5_years FROM career_vision WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
                (current_user_id,)
            )
            latest_factors = fetch_one(
                "SELECT strengths, usp, feedback FROM career_factors WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
                (current_user_id,)
            )
            active_goals = fetch_all(
                "SELECT title, description FROM career_goals WHERE user_id = ? AND status = 'Active' AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 5",
                (current_user_id,)
            )
            
            # Load We CARE Awards Context
            recent_awards = fetch_all(
                "SELECT value_category, citation, received_from FROM we_care_awards WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 5",
                (current_user_id,)
            )
            
            # Assemble Prompt Context
            vision_text = f"Career Vision: {latest_vision[0]} (2-Year target: {latest_vision[1]})" if latest_vision else "No vision statement registered."
            factors_text = f"Strengths: {latest_factors[0]}. USP: {latest_factors[1]}. Manager Feedback: {latest_factors[2]}" if latest_factors else "No SWOT registered."
            goals_text = "\n".join([f"- Goal: {g[0]} ({g[1]})" for g in active_goals]) if active_goals else "No active planner goals."
            awards_text = "\n".join([f"- Award Category: {a[0]} from {a[2]}. Citation: {a[1]}" for a in recent_awards]) if recent_awards else "No We CARE awards received."
            
            prompt = f"""
            You are a premium career alignment coach for the NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA).
            Draft a tailored 'Reflect and Shape' appraisal preparation dossier based on the employee's logs:
            
            [EMPLOYEE CAREER VISION]
            {vision_text}
            
            [STRENGTHS & SWOT]
            {factors_text}
            
            [ACTIVE STRATEGIC GOALS]
            {goals_text}
            
            [WE CARE AWARDS & STARS RECEIVED]
            {awards_text}
            
            Deliver your response formatted in neat markdown representing:
            1. **Past 12 Months Highlights**: Synthesize successes from active goals and values displayed from We CARE awards (Collaborative, Energetic, Reliable, Adventurous).
            2. **Proposed Successes & Challenges**: Draft 2 successes and 1 challenge they can review.
            3. **Wellbeing & resilience summary**: Formulate comments on how to focus on wellbeing.
            4. **Proposed Work & Development Objectives**: Suggest 3 tactical work objectives and 2 development objectives matching the NHSBSA goals (Customer, Our People, Value/Efficiency, ESG).
            """
            
            ai_draft = generate_ai_response(prompt, temperature=0.4)
            st.session_state["gc_ai_appraisal_prep"] = ai_draft
            st.success("Appraisal Prep Draft generated successfully!")
            st.rerun()

    if "gc_ai_appraisal_prep" in st.session_state and st.session_state["gc_ai_appraisal_prep"]:
        with st.container(border=True):
            st.markdown("### 📝 AI-Generated Reflect & Shape Prep Notes")
            st.markdown(st.session_state["gc_ai_appraisal_prep"])
            if st.button("Clear AI Prep Notes", key="btn_clear_ai_prep"):
                del st.session_state["gc_ai_appraisal_prep"]
                st.rerun()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BOTTOM NAVIGATION & SAVE ACTION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
st.write("")
st.divider()

save_col1, save_col2 = st.columns(2)

with save_col1:
    if st.button("💾 Save Conversation Draft", use_container_width=True, type="primary"):
        # Insert / Update Conversation
        is_new_appraisal = (conv_id is None)
        if conv_id:
            execute("""
                UPDATE great_conversations

                    team_goals_support = ?, values_displayed = ?, biggest_successes = ?, biggest_challenges = ?, 
                    wellbeing = ?, wellbeing_support = ?, team_goals_next = ?,

            """, (

                team_goals_support, values_displayed, biggest_successes, biggest_challenges,
                wellbeing, wellbeing_support, team_goals_next,
                career_persona, conversation_summary, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),

            # Delete old work objectives

            # Delete old dev objectives

        else:
            execute("""
                INSERT INTO great_conversations (user_id, colleague_name, manager_name, conversation_date,
                    team_goals_support, values_displayed, biggest_successes, biggest_challenges,

        for obj in st.session_state.gc_past_objectives:

            """, (conv_id, obj["key_area"], obj["personal_objective"], obj["completion_date"], obj.get("status", "Pending"), obj.get("reflection_notes", "")))

            execute("""
                INSERT INTO great_conversation_objectives (conversation_id, key_area, personal_objective, completion_date, is_new)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 1)

        for dev in st.session_state.gc_dev_objectives:

        data=pdf_bytes,
        file_name=pdf_filename,
        mime="application/octet-stream",
        use_container_width=True,

# pages/24a_📅_Stakeholder_Calendar.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime
import json

# Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons, clean_display_value
from core.database_utils import query, execute, fetch_one
from core.auth_utils import user_can
from core.state import get_app_state

# Third-party imports
from streamlit_calendar import calendar

# 1. Access Control & Page Setup
handle_page_entry()
can_view, reason = user_can("view_stakeholder_engagement")
if not can_view:
    st.error(f"🔒 Access Denied: {reason}")
    st.stop()

app_state = get_app_state()
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Strategy & Planning"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

st.title("📅 Stakeholder Communication Calendar")
st.caption("Track, filter, and plan communications, meetings, and sentiment checkpoints for stakeholders.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# Context check
if selected_org == "All Organisations" or selected_prj == "All Projects" or current_org_id is None:
    st.warning("⚠️ Please select a specific Organisation and Project Stream in the sidebar to view the calendar.")
    st.stop()

# Get project ID
res = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM projects WHERE name=? AND org_id=? AND is_deleted=0", (selected_prj, current_org_id))
if not res:
    st.error("Project context not found.")
    st.stop()
pid = res[0]

# --- Load Stakeholder Data ---
df_sh = query("""
    SELECT s.id as sh_id, c.name, s.group_tag, c.email
    FROM stakeholders s
    JOIN contacts c ON s.contact_id = c.id
    WHERE s.project_id = ? AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0
""", (pid,))

if df_sh.empty:
    st.info("ℹ️ No stakeholders registered for this project yet. Please register them in the 'Stakeholder Engagement' hub first.")
    st.stop()

# --- Sidebar Filters ---
st.sidebar.divider()
st.sidebar.subheader("🗓️ Calendar Filter Controls")

# Emojis & options for show/hide toggles
show_touchpoints = st.sidebar.checkbox("Show Engagement Touchpoints", value=True, help="Display logged communication touchpoints (Orange)")
show_sentiment = st.sidebar.checkbox("Show Sentiment Checkpoints", value=True, help="Display manual sentiment entries (Purple)")
show_emails = st.sidebar.checkbox("Show Project Emails", value=True, help="Display archived emails (Blue)")
show_meetings = st.sidebar.checkbox("Show Meetings", value=True, help="Display meetings containing stakeholders (Green)")

# Parse group_tags correctly for each stakeholder
def parse_group_tags(g_val):
    if not g_val:
        return []
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(g_val)
        if isinstance(parsed, list):
            return [str(t).strip() for t in parsed if t]
        else:
            return [str(parsed).strip()]
    except Exception:
        return [t.strip() for t in str(g_val).split(',') if t.strip()]

df_sh['decoded_groups'] = df_sh['group_tag'].apply(parse_group_tags)
df_sh['groups_display'] = df_sh['decoded_groups'].apply(lambda x: ", ".join(x) if x else "No Group")

# Find all unique groups
all_unique_groups = set()
for grps in df_sh['decoded_groups']:
    all_unique_groups.update(grps)
segment_groups = sorted(list(all_unique_groups))

if segment_groups:
    selected_segments = st.sidebar.multiselect("Filter by Segment Group", options=segment_groups, default=segment_groups)
else:
    selected_segments = []

# Filter by individual stakeholder
filtered_sh = df_sh
if selected_segments:
    filtered_sh = df_sh[df_sh['decoded_groups'].apply(lambda grps: any(g in selected_segments for g in grps) or (not grps and "Unassigned" in selected_segments))]

sh_options = {row['sh_id']: f"{row['name']} ({row['groups_display']})" for _, row in filtered_sh.iterrows()}
selected_sh_ids = st.sidebar.multiselect("Filter by Stakeholder", options=list(sh_options.keys()), format_func=lambda x: sh_options[x], default=list(sh_options.keys()))

# --- Event Loading ---
calendar_events = []
can_edit = user_can("edit_stakeholder_engagement")

if selected_sh_ids:
    sh_list = filtered_sh[filtered_sh['sh_id'].isin(selected_sh_ids)]
    
    # 1. Load Touchpoints
    if show_touchpoints:
        sh_ids_placeholder = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_sh_ids))
        df_touchpoints = query(f"""
            SELECT el.id, el.engagement_date, el.channel, el.notes, c.name as sh_name
            FROM engagement_log el
            JOIN stakeholders s ON el.stakeholder_id = s.id
            JOIN contacts c ON s.contact_id = c.id
            WHERE s.id IN ({sh_ids_placeholder}) AND el.is_deleted = 0
        """, tuple(selected_sh_ids))
        
        for _, row in df_touchpoints.iterrows():
            sh_name = clean_display_value(row['sh_name'], fallback="Unknown")
            channel = clean_display_value(row['channel'], fallback="Other")
            notes = clean_display_value(row['notes'], fallback="No notes provided.")
            calendar_events.append({
                "id": f"touchpoint_{row['id']}",
                "title": f"💬 {sh_name} ({channel})",
                "start": row['engagement_date'],
                "end": row['engagement_date'],
                "color": "#f4901e", # NHS Amber
                "allDay": True,
                "extendedProps": {
                    "notes": notes,
                    "type": "Touchpoint",
                    "details": f"Channel: {channel}"
                }
            })

    # 2. Load Sentiment Checkpoints
    if show_sentiment:
        sh_ids_placeholder = ','.join(['?'] * len(selected_sh_ids))
        df_sentiments = query(f"""
            SELECT ssl.id, ssl.recorded_date, ssl.sentiment_score, ssl.notes, c.name as sh_name
            FROM stakeholder_sentiment_log ssl
            JOIN stakeholders s ON ssl.stakeholder_id = s.id
            JOIN contacts c ON s.contact_id = c.id
            WHERE s.id IN ({sh_ids_placeholder})
        """, tuple(selected_sh_ids))
        
        for _, row in df_sentiments.iterrows():
            sh_name = clean_display_value(row['sh_name'], fallback="Unknown")
            notes = clean_display_value(row['notes'], fallback="No notes provided.")
            calendar_events.append({
                "id": f"sentiment_{row['id']}",
                "title": f"❤️ {sh_name} (Score: {row['sentiment_score']})",
                "start": row['recorded_date'],
                "end": row['recorded_date'],
                "color": "#512DA8", # Purple
                "allDay": True,
                "extendedProps": {
                    "notes": notes,
                    "type": "Sentiment Checkpoint",
                    "details": f"Sentiment Score: {row['sentiment_score']}"
                }
            })

    # 3. Load Project Emails
    if show_emails:
        emails_list = sh_list['email'].dropna().tolist()
        if emails_list:
            df_emails = query("""
                SELECT e.id, e.date_sent, e.subject, e.body, e.email_from, e.email_to
                FROM emails e
                WHERE e.project_id = ? AND e.is_deleted = 0
            """, (pid,))
            
            for _, row in df_emails.iterrows():
                # Check if email is from/to any of our selected stakeholders
                from_str = row['email_from'] or ""
                to_str = row['email_to'] or ""
                matched_sh = []
                for _, sh_row in sh_list.iterrows():
                    sh_email = sh_row['email']
                    if sh_email and (sh_email.lower() in from_str.lower() or sh_email.lower() in to_str.lower()):
                        matched_sh.append(sh_row['name'])
                
                if matched_sh:
                    matched_names = ", ".join(matched_sh)
                    date_str = str(row['date_sent'])[:10]
                    subject = clean_display_value(row['subject'], fallback="No Subject")
                    body = clean_display_value(row['body'], fallback="Empty body.")
                    email_from = clean_display_value(row['email_from'], fallback="Unknown")
                    email_to = clean_display_value(row['email_to'], fallback="Unknown")
                    calendar_events.append({
                        "id": f"email_{row['id']}",
                        "title": f"✉️ Email: {subject}",
                        "start": date_str,
                        "end": date_str,
                        "color": "#005eb8", # NHS Blue
                        "allDay": True,
                        "extendedProps": {
                            "notes": body,
                            "type": "Email",
                            "details": f"Stakeholders: {matched_names}\nFrom: {email_from}\nTo: {email_to}"
                        }
                    })

    # 4. Load Meetings
    if show_meetings:
        df_meetings = query("""
            SELECT id, date, title, summary, attendees FROM meetings WHERE project_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0
        """, (pid,))
        
        for _, row in df_meetings.iterrows():
            attendees_str = row['attendees'] or ""
            matched_sh = []
            for _, sh_row in sh_list.iterrows():
                if sh_row['name'].lower() in attendees_str.lower():
                    matched_sh.append(sh_row['name'])
            
            if matched_sh:
                matched_names = ", ".join(matched_sh)
                title = clean_display_value(row['title'], fallback="No Title")
                summary = clean_display_value(row['summary'], fallback="No summary.")
                attendees = clean_display_value(row['attendees'], fallback="Unknown")
                calendar_events.append({
                    "id": f"meeting_{row['id']}",
                    "title": f"👥 Meeting: {title}",
                    "start": row['date'],
                    "end": row['date'],
                    "color": "#007f3b", # NHS Green
                    "allDay": True,
                    "extendedProps": {
                        "notes": summary,
                        "type": "Meeting",
                        "details": f"Attendees: {attendees}\nStakeholders Matched: {matched_names}"
                    }
                })

# --- Render Calendar ---
calendar_options = {
    "headerToolbar": {
        "left": "prev,next today",
        "center": "title",
        "right": "dayGridMonth,timeGridWeek,timeGridDay"
    },
    "initialView": "dayGridMonth",
    "editable": can_edit,
    "selectable": True
}

if not calendar_events:
    st.info("📅 No stakeholder events matching the active filter selections were found.")
else:
    state = calendar(events=calendar_events, options=calendar_options, key="stakeholder_calendar_widget")
    
    # Clicked Event Details Panel
    if isinstance(state, dict) and "eventClick" in state:
        clicked_event = state["eventClick"].get("event", {})
        if clicked_event:
            st.divider()
            st.subheader("🔍 Event Details")
            props = clicked_event.get("extendedProps", {})
            st.markdown(f"**Type:** `{props.get('type', 'Unknown')}`")
            st.markdown(f"**Title:** {clicked_event.get('title', 'No Title')}")
            st.markdown(f"**Date:** {clicked_event.get('start', '')[:10]}")
            if props.get('details'):
                st.text(props.get('details'))
            st.markdown("**Notes:**")
            st.info(props.get('notes', 'No details provided.'))

    # Reschedule (Drag & Drop) Handler
    if can_edit and isinstance(state, dict):
        event_data = None
        action_type = ""
        if "eventDrop" in state:
            event_data = state["eventDrop"].get("event", {})
            action_type = "rescheduled"
        elif "eventResize" in state:
            event_data = state["eventResize"].get("event", {})
            action_type = "resized"
            
        if event_data:
            event_id = event_data.get("id")
            new_start = event_data.get("start")
            
            if event_id and new_start:
                new_date = new_start[:10]
                
                if event_id.startswith("touchpoint_"):
                    tid = int(event_id.replace("touchpoint_", ""))
                    execute("UPDATE engagement_log SET engagement_date = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_date, tid))
                    st.toast(f"📅 Touchpoint rescheduled to {new_date}!")
                    st.rerun()
                elif event_id.startswith("sentiment_"):
                    sid = int(event_id.replace("sentiment_", ""))
                    execute("UPDATE stakeholder_sentiment_log SET recorded_date = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_date, sid))
                    st.toast(f"📅 Sentiment Checkpoint rescheduled to {new_date}!")
                    st.rerun()
                elif event_id.startswith("meeting_"):
                    mid = int(event_id.replace("meeting_", ""))
                    execute("UPDATE meetings SET date = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_date, mid))
                    st.toast(f"📅 Meeting rescheduled to {new_date}!")
                    st.rerun()
                elif event_id.startswith("email_"):
                    st.error("⚠️ Project Emails are historical communication records and cannot be rescheduled.")
                    st.rerun()

from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response

# Helper Function: Calculate Data Quality
def calculate_data_quality_score(df: pd.DataFrame, rules: list) -> tuple:
    """Calculates data quality score based on validation rules."""
    total_checks = 0
    passed_checks = 0
    errors = []
    
    for rule in rules:
        col = rule.get("column_name")
        rtype = rule.get("rule_type")
        rval = rule.get("rule_value")
        
        if col not in df.columns:
            errors.append(f"❌ Missing column: '{col}' required by validation rules.")
            continue
            
        series = df[col]
        total_rows = len(df)
        total_checks += total_rows
        
        if rtype == "not_empty":
            passed = series.notna() & (series != "")
            passed_checks += passed.sum()
            failed_count = total_rows - passed.sum()
            if failed_count > 0:
                errors.append(f"Column '{col}' has {failed_count} empty values.")
                
        elif rtype == "is_unique":
            passed_checks += series.nunique()
            failed_count = total_rows - series.nunique()
            if failed_count > 0:
                errors.append(f"Column '{col}' has {failed_count} duplicate values.")
                
        elif rtype == "format_regex":
            import re
            pattern = str(rval)
            try:
                rx = re.compile(pattern)
                matches = series.fillna("").apply(lambda val: bool(rx.match(str(val))))
                passed_checks += matches.sum()
                failed_count = total_rows - matches.sum()
                if failed_count > 0:
                    errors.append(f"Column '{col}' has {failed_count} formatting anomalies.")
            except Exception as ex:
                errors.append(f"Invalid regex for column '{col}': {ex}")
                
        elif rtype == "in_list":
            allowed = [x.strip() for x in str(rval).split(",") if x.strip()]
            matches = series.isin(allowed)
            passed_checks += matches.sum()
            failed_count = total_rows - matches.sum()
            if failed_count > 0:
                errors.append(f"Column '{col}' has {failed_count} invalid values (allowed: {allowed}).")

        elif rtype == "ods_code":
            matches = series.fillna("").apply(validate_ods_code_with_spine)
            passed_checks += matches.sum()
            failed_count = total_rows - matches.sum()
            if failed_count > 0:
                errors.append(f"Column '{col}' has {failed_count} invalid ODS codes.")
                
        elif rtype == "afc_band":
            valid_bands = {
                "BAND 1", "BAND 2", "BAND 3", "BAND 4", "BAND 5", "BAND 6", "BAND 7", 
                "BAND 8A", "BAND 8B", "BAND 8C", "BAND 8D", "BAND 9"
            }
            matches = series.fillna("").apply(lambda val: str(val).strip().upper() in valid_bands)
            passed_checks += matches.sum()
            failed_count = total_rows - matches.sum()
            if failed_count > 0:
                errors.append(f"Column '{col}' has {failed_count} non-standard Agenda for Change bands.")
                
        elif rtype == "nhs_job_role":
            valid_roles = {
                "NURSE", "MIDWIFE", "DOCTOR", "HEALTHCARE ASSISTANT", "CONSULTANT", 
                "ADMINISTRATIVE ASSISTANT", "IMPLEMENTATION ADVISOR", "PROJECT MANAGER", 
                "CLINICAL DIRECTOR", "OCCUPATIONAL THERAPIST", "PHYSIOTHERAPIST", "PHARMACIST"
            }
            matches = series.fillna("").apply(lambda val: str(val).strip().upper() in valid_roles)
            passed_checks += matches.sum()
            failed_count = total_rows - matches.sum()
            if failed_count > 0:
                errors.append(f"Column '{col}' has {failed_count} unrecognized NHS standard job roles.")
                
    score = (passed_checks / total_checks) * 100 if total_checks > 0 else 100.0
    return round(score, 1), errors

if selected_tab == "Cross-System Reconciliation":
    st.subheader("🔄 Automated Cross-System Reconciliation Engine")
    st.caption("Compare legacy system roster data against ESR payroll employee profiles side-by-side to highlight discrepancies.")
    
    col_u1, col_u2 = st.columns(2)
    with col_u1:
        roster_file = st.file_uploader("Upload Legacy Roster File (CSV/XLSX)", type=["csv", "xlsx"], key="recon_roster")
    with col_u2:
        esr_file = st.file_uploader("Upload ESR Employee Profile File (CSV/XLSX)", type=["csv", "xlsx"], key="recon_esr")
        
    st.write("### ⚙️ Reconciliation Options")
    col_sel1, col_sel2 = st.columns(2)
    recon_key = col_sel1.selectbox(
        "Select Reconciliation Matching Key Column",
        ["National_Insurance_Number", "Employee_Number", "Email_Address"],
        help="This column must be present in both files and contain unique identifiers (e.g. NI numbers)."
    )
    
    fields_to_compare = col_sel2.multiselect(
        "Select Fields to Reconcile",
        ["Pay Band", "Job Title", "Email", "Department"],
        default=["Pay Band", "Job Title"]
    )
    
    if roster_file and esr_file:
        try:
            if roster_file.name.endswith('.csv'):
                roster_df = pd.read_csv(roster_file)
            else:
                roster_df = pd.read_excel(roster_file)
                
            if esr_file.name.endswith('.csv'):
                esr_df = pd.read_csv(esr_file)
            else:
                esr_df = pd.read_excel(esr_file)
                
            st.success("Both files uploaded successfully!")
            
            with st.expander("Preview Uploaded Data"):
                st.write("**Legacy Roster Preview:**")
                st.dataframe(roster_df.head(5))
                st.write("**ESR Employee Profile Preview:**")
                st.dataframe(esr_df.head(5))
                
            if st.button("🔄 Run Reconciliation Analysis", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
                if recon_key not in roster_df.columns:
                    st.error(f"❌ Matching key column '{recon_key}' not found in Roster File. Available: {list(roster_df.columns)}")
                elif recon_key not in esr_df.columns:
                    st.error(f"❌ Matching key column '{recon_key}' not found in ESR Employee Profile File. Available: {list(esr_df.columns)}")
                else:
                    with st.spinner("Running deep reconciliation comparison..."):
                        roster_df[recon_key] = roster_df[recon_key].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
                        esr_df[recon_key] = esr_df[recon_key].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper()
                        
                        roster_keys = set(roster_df[recon_key].dropna().unique())
                        esr_keys = set(esr_df[recon_key].dropna().unique())
                        
                        common_keys = roster_keys.intersection(esr_keys)
                        only_roster = roster_keys - esr_keys
                        only_esr = esr_keys - roster_keys
                        
                        field_terms = {
                            "Pay Band": ['grade', 'band', 'payband', 'pay_band'],
                            "Job Title": ['title', 'role', 'job', 'job_title'],
                            "Email": ['email', 'mail', 'email_address'],
                            "Department": ['dept', 'department', 'ward']
                        }
                        
                        def find_similar_col(df, terms):
                            for col in df.columns:
                                if any(t in col.lower() for t in terms):
                                    return col
                            return None
                        
                        field_mappings = {}
                        for f in fields_to_compare:
                            r_col = find_similar_col(roster_df, field_terms[f])
                            e_col = find_similar_col(esr_df, field_terms[f])
                            field_mappings[f] = {"roster": r_col, "esr": e_col}
                        
                        mismatches = []
                        for key in sorted(list(common_keys)):
                            r_row = roster_df[roster_df[recon_key] == key].iloc[0]
                            e_row = esr_df[esr_df[recon_key] == key].iloc[0]
                            
                            key_mismatches = {}
                            has_any_mismatch = False
                            
                            for field in fields_to_compare:
                                r_col = field_mappings[field]["roster"]
                                e_col = field_mappings[field]["esr"]
                                
                                if r_col and e_col:
                                    r_val = str(r_row[r_col]).strip()
                                    e_val = str(e_row[e_col]).strip()
                                    if r_val.lower() in ('nan', 'none', '<na>'): r_val = ""
                                    if e_val.lower() in ('nan', 'none', '<na>'): e_val = ""
                                    
                                    is_diff = r_val.lower() != e_val.lower()
                                    if is_diff:
                                        has_any_mismatch = True
                                    key_mismatches[field] = {
                                        "roster": r_val,
                                        "esr": e_val,
                                        "mismatch": is_diff
                                    }
                            
                            if has_any_mismatch:
                                mismatches.append({
                                    "key": key,
                                    "fields": key_mismatches
                                })
                                
                        st.session_state.recon_mismatches = mismatches
                        st.session_state.recon_only_roster = list(only_roster)
                        st.session_state.recon_only_esr = list(only_esr)
                        st.session_state.recon_common_count = len(common_keys)
                        st.session_state.recon_field_mappings = field_mappings
                        st.session_state.recon_ran = True
                        st.rerun()

            if st.session_state.get("recon_ran"):
                mismatches = st.session_state.recon_mismatches
                only_roster = st.session_state.recon_only_roster
                only_esr = st.session_state.recon_only_esr
                common_count = st.session_state.recon_common_count
                
                # Fetch signed off discrepancies
                signed_offs = query("SELECT matching_key, field_name, signed_off_by, notes FROM reconciliation_signoffs WHERE project_id = ?", (pid,))
                signed_off_lookup = {}
                if not signed_offs.empty:
                    signed_off_lookup = {(r['matching_key'], r['field_name']): (r['signed_off_by'], r['notes']) for _, r in signed_offs.iterrows()}
                
                st.subheader("Reconciliation Summary")
                kcol1, kcol2, kcol3, kcol4 = st.columns(4)
                kcol1.metric("Matched Records", common_count)
                kcol2.metric("Only in Payroll (ESR)", len(only_esr))
                kcol3.metric("Only in Roster", len(only_roster))
                
                active_mismatches_count = 0
                for m in mismatches:
                    has_active = False
                    for field, f_data in m["fields"].items():
                        if f_data["mismatch"] and (m["key"], field) not in signed_off_lookup:
                            has_active = True
                    if has_active:
                        active_mismatches_count += 1
                        
                kcol4.metric("Active Mismatches", active_mismatches_count, delta=f"{len(mismatches) - active_mismatches_count} signed off", delta_color="normal")
                
                st.divider()
                
                if mismatches:
                    st.subheader("❌ Mismatched Staff Records")
                    st.caption("Review discrepancies, request AI analysis for semantic matches, and sign off approved differences.")
                    
                    for idx, m in enumerate(mismatches):
                        key_val = m["key"]
                        
                        mismatch_fields_to_show = []
                        for field, f_data in m["fields"].items():
                            if f_data["mismatch"]:
                                is_so = (key_val, field) in signed_off_lookup
                                mismatch_fields_to_show.append((field, f_data["roster"], f_data["esr"], is_so))
                                
                        if not mismatch_fields_to_show:
                            continue
                            
                        with st.container(border=True):
                            c_id, c_status = st.columns([0.7, 0.3])
                            c_id.markdown(f"👤 **Staff Identifier ({recon_key}):** `{key_val}`")
                            
                            all_signed_off = all(item[3] for item in mismatch_fields_to_show)
                            if all_signed_off:
                                c_status.success("✓ Fully Signed Off")
                            else:
                                c_status.error("⚠️ Actions Pending")
                                
                            for field, rost_val, esr_val, is_so in mismatch_fields_to_show:
                                f_col1, f_col2, f_col3 = st.columns([0.4, 0.4, 0.2])
                                f_col1.markdown(f"**{field} (Roster):** `{rost_val or '[Blank]'}`")
                                f_col2.markdown(f"**{field} (ESR Payroll):** `{esr_val or '[Blank]'}`")
                                if is_so:
                                    signee, notes = signed_off_lookup[(key_val, field)]
                                    f_col3.info(f"✓ Signed off by {signee}")
                                else:
                                    with f_col3:
                                        with st.popover('✍️ Sign Off', use_container_width=True):
                                            st.markdown(f"Sign off difference in **{field}**")
                                            so_notes = st.text_input("Sign-off Notes", placeholder="Approved mapping", key=f"notes_{key_val}_{field}_{idx}")
                                            so_name = st.text_input("Signed Off By", value=app_state.user.name if app_state.user else "System", key=f"name_{key_val}_{field}_{idx}")
                                            if st.button('Confirm Sign-off', key=f'btn_so_{key_val}_{field}_{idx}', use_container_width=True, type='primary'):
                                                execute(
                                                    "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO reconciliation_signoffs (project_id, matching_key, field_name, legacy_value, new_value, signed_off_by, notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                                                    (pid, key_val, field, rost_val, esr_val, so_name, so_notes)
                                                )
                                                log_audit_event(
                                                    "signoff_reconciliation_discrepancy",
                                                    "reconciliation_signoffs",
                                                    so_name,
                                                    app_state.user.role if app_state.user else "System",
                                                    details={"matching_key": key_val, "field": field, "project_id": pid}
                                                )
                                                st.success("Signed off!")
                                                st.rerun()
                                                
                            if not all_signed_off:
                                ai_rev_key = f"ai_review_{key_val}_{idx}"
                                if st.button('🤖 AI Match Review', key=f'btn_ai_{key_val}_{idx}', use_container_width=True):
                                    with st.spinner("AI is analyzing discrepancy..."):
                                        prompt_mismatch = f"""
                                        You are an NHS data migration expert. Analyze the following roster vs payroll database discrepancy for a single employee:
                                        - Matching Key: {key_val}
                                        Discrepancy:
                                        """
                                        for field, rost_val, esr_val, is_so in mismatch_fields_to_show:
                                            if not is_so:
                                                prompt_mismatch += f"- Field '{field}': Roster value is '{rost_val}', ESR Payroll value is '{esr_val}'\n"
                                        
                                        prompt_mismatch += """
                                        Determine:
                                        1. Is this a semantic variation (e.g. spelling abbreviation, equivalent job title) or a structural data conflict (e.g. different grade, completely different email)?
                                        2. Risk assessment (High/Medium/Low).
                                        3. Recommended resolution step.
                                        Provide a concise 2-3 sentence response.
                                        """
                                        resp = generate_ai_response(prompt_mismatch, temperature=0.2, bypass_cache=True)
                                        st.session_state[ai_rev_key] = resp
                                
                                if ai_rev_key in st.session_state:
                                    st.info(st.session_state[ai_rev_key])
                                    
                if only_esr:
                    with st.container(border=True):
                        st.warning(f"⚠️ {len(only_esr)} Employee(s) Active in Payroll (ESR) but NOT Roster:")
                        st.write(", ".join(only_esr[:20]) + ("..." if len(only_esr) > 20 else ""))
                        
                if only_roster:
                    with st.container(border=True):
                        st.warning(f"⚠️ {len(only_roster)} Employee(s) in Roster but NOT Payroll (ESR):")
                        st.write(", ".join(only_roster[:20]) + ("..." if len(only_roster) > 20 else ""))
                        
        except Exception as e:
            st.error(f"An error occurred during reconciliation: {e}")
    else:
        st.info("Upload both files to run the cross-system reconciliation engine.")

if selected_tab == "AI Cleansing Rules & Discrepancies":

                        row_num = idx + 2
                        
                        if sc_col:
                            sc_val = str(row[sc_col]).strip()
                            # Clean decimal point if read as float (e.g. 1234567890.0)
                            sc_val_clean = sc_val.split('.')[0] if '.' in sc_val else sc_val
                            if not sc_val_clean.isdigit() or len(sc_val_clean) != 10:
                                errors_list.append({
                                    "Row": row_num,
                                    "Column": sc_col,
                                    "Value": sc_val,

                                # Try to pad if short

                                    cleaned_df.at[idx, sc_col] = sc_val_clean.zfill(10)
                            else:
                                cleaned_df.at[idx, sc_col] = sc_val_clean

                            ods_val = str(row[ods_col]).strip().upper()
                            if not ods_val or not validate_ods_code_with_spine(ods_val):
                                errors_list.append({
                                    "Row": row_num,
                                    "Column": ods_col,
                                    "Value": ods_val,
                                    "Error": "Invalid ODS Code (could not verify online or fallback).",
                                    "Suggested Correction": "Change to a valid NHS ODS Code"
                                })
                            else:
                                cleaned_df.at[idx, ods_col] = ods_val
                                
                    if errors_list:
                        st.error(f"❌ Found {len(errors_list)} formatting discrepancies in the ODS/Smartcard records!")
                        df_errs = pd.DataFrame(errors_list)
                        st.dataframe(df_errs, use_container_width=True)
                        
                        st.info("💡 An auto-cleansed version has been prepared (e.g. padding Smartcard IDs with leading zeros). Download it below:")
                        csv_cleansed = cleaned_df.to_csv(index=False).encode('utf-8')
                        st.download_button(

                            data=csv_cleansed,
                            file_name=f"cleansed_ods_sc_{uploaded_ods_sc.name}",
                            mime="text/csv",
                            use_container_width=True,
                            key="btn_download_cleansed_ods_sc"
                        )
                    else:

if selected_tab == "Speed Cleanse Challenge":
    st.subheader("🎮 ODS & Smartcard 'Speed Cleanse' Challenge")
    st.caption("Test your data auditing speed and accuracy! You have 60 seconds to approve correct formats and reject incorrect ones.")

    # Initialize Leaderboard Table
    execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cleanse_leaderboard (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            username TEXT,
            score INTEGER,
            date_played TEXT
        )
    """)

    import random
    from datetime import datetime

    # Question Generator
    def generate_game_question():
        is_valid = random.choice([True, False])
        q_type = random.choice(['smartcard', 'ods'])
        
        if q_type == 'smartcard':
            if is_valid:
                val = "".join(random.choice("0123456789") for _ in range(10))
            else:
                if random.choice([True, False]):
                    val = "".join(random.choice("0123456789") for _ in range(random.choice([8, 9, 11, 12])))
                else:
                    val = "".join(random.choice("0123456789") for _ in range(9)) + random.choice("ABCXYZ")
        else: # ODS
            if is_valid:
                # Valid ODS is 3-5 uppercase characters/numbers
                val = "".join(random.choice("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789") for _ in range(random.choice([3, 4, 5])))
            else:
                if random.choice([True, False]):
                    val = "".join(random.choice("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz") for _ in range(random.choice([3, 4, 5])))
                else:
                    val = "".join(random.choice("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789!@#") for _ in range(random.choice([2, 6, 7])))
                    
        return val, q_type, is_valid

    # Game state initialization
    if 'game_active' not in st.session_state:
        st.session_state.game_active = False
        st.session_state.game_score = 0
        st.session_state.game_start_time = None
        st.session_state.game_current_val = ""
        st.session_state.game_current_type = ""
        st.session_state.game_current_is_valid = False

    # Start Game Trigger
    if not st.session_state.game_active:
        st.write("### Rules:")
        st.markdown("""
        *   **Smartcard IDs** must be exactly 10 numeric digits.
        *   **ODS Codes** must be 3 to 5 characters, entirely uppercase letters and numbers, with no symbols.
        *   Correct answers get **+10 points**. Incorrect answers deduct **-5 points**.
        *   Beat the clock and aim for the top of the leaderboard!
        """)
        
        if st.button('🎮 Start Challenge (60 Seconds)', use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state.game_active = True
            st.session_state.game_score = 0
            st.session_state.game_start_time = datetime.now()
            v, t, val = generate_game_question()
            st.session_state.game_current_val = v
            st.session_state.game_current_type = t
            st.session_state.game_current_is_valid = val
            st.rerun()

        # Render Leaderboard
        st.write("### 🏆 High Score Leaderboard")
        df_lb = query("SELECT username as 'Advisor', score as 'Score', date_played as 'Date' FROM cleanse_leaderboard ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10")
        if not df_lb.empty:
            st.dataframe(df_lb, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
        else:
            st.info("No scores recorded yet. Be the first to set a high score!")

    else:
        # Check Timer
        elapsed = (datetime.now() - st.session_state.game_start_time).total_seconds()
        time_left = int(60 - elapsed)

        if time_left <= 0:
            # Save score
            user_name = st.session_state.get("current_user", "Implementation Advisor")
            execute("INSERT INTO cleanse_leaderboard (username, score, date_played) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (user_name, st.session_state.game_score, datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')))
            st.session_state.game_active = False
            st.success(f"🎉 Time's up! You scored **{st.session_state.game_score}** points.")
            st.rerun()
        else:
            # Display stats
            col1, col2 = st.columns(2)
            col1.metric("Time Remaining", f"{time_left}s")
            col2.metric("Current Score", f"{st.session_state.game_score} pts")

            # Progress bar
            st.progress(max(0.0, min(1.0, time_left / 60.0)))

            # Card container
            with st.container(border=True):
                st.markdown(f"<p style='text-align: center; font-size: 16px; color: gray;'>Classify the following value:</p>", unsafe_allow_html=True)
                st.markdown(f"<h2 style='text-align: center; font-size: 36px; margin: 10px 0;'><code>{st.session_state.game_current_val}</code></h2>", unsafe_allow_html=True)
                st.markdown(f"<p style='text-align: center; font-weight: bold;'>Type: {st.session_state.game_current_type.upper()}</p>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

            # Interactive choice buttons
            c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
            
            # Helper logic for answer verification
            def process_answer(user_approved: bool):
                correct = (user_approved == st.session_state.game_current_is_valid)
                if correct:
                    st.session_state.game_score += 10
                    st.toast("✅ Correct! +10 pts")
                else:
                    st.session_state.game_score = max(0, st.session_state.game_score - 5)
                    st.toast("❌ Incorrect! -5 pts")
                    
                v, t, val = generate_game_question()
                st.session_state.game_current_val = v
                st.session_state.game_current_type = t
                st.session_state.game_current_is_valid = val
                st.rerun()

            if c1.button("✅ Approve (Valid format)", use_container_width=True, type="primary"):
                process_answer(True)
                
            if c2.button("❌ Reject (Formatting error)", use_container_width=True, type="secondary"):
                process_answer(False)

            # Cancel Game
            st.divider()
            if st.button('🚪 Quit Game', use_container_width=True, type='primary'):
                st.session_state.game_active = False
                st.rerun()

        p_options = dict(zip(df_all_p['label'], df_all_p['id'])) if not df_all_p.empty else {}
        selected_p_label = st.selectbox("Select Project for Assurance Pack", options=list(p_options.keys()))
        filters['project_id'] = p_options.get(selected_p_label)
    elif report_type == "ICB Regional Progress":
        icb_df = query("SELECT DISTINCT region FROM orgs WHERE region IS NOT NULL AND region != '' AND is_deleted = 0")
        icb_options = ["All ICBs"] + sorted(icb_df['region'].tolist()) if not icb_df.empty else ["All ICBs"]
        selected_icb = st.selectbox("Select ICB / Sub-Region", icb_options)
        filters['icb'] = selected_icb
 
    visualization_type = st.selectbox("Select Visualization Type", ["Table", "Bar Chart", "Line Chart"] if report_type not in ["Board Assurance Pack", "ICB Regional Progress"] else ["Table"])
 
    if st.button("Generate Report", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
        st.session_state['report_config'] = {
            'report_type': report_type,
            'filters': filters,
            'visualization_type': visualization_type,
            'master_filter': master_filter,
            'params': params,
            'selected_columns': selected_cols
        }
        st.rerun()

# --- 4. Report Generation Logic ---
if 'report_config' in st.session_state:
    config = st.session_state['report_config']
    report_type = config['report_type']
    filters = config['filters']
    visualization_type = config['visualization_type']
    master_filter = config['master_filter']
    params = config['params']

    st.subheader(f"Generated Report: {report_type}")
    report_title = report_type
    if report_type == "Board Assurance Pack":
        project_id = filters.get('project_id')
        if not project_id:
            st.warning("Please select a project to generate the Board Assurance Pack.")
        else:
            with st.spinner("Generating Board Assurance Pack PDF..."):
                from core.pdf_utils import generate_board_assurance_pack_pdf
                pdf_bytes = generate_board_assurance_pack_pdf(project_id)
                st.success("🎉 Board Assurance Pack successfully generated!")
                st.download_button(
                    label="📥 Download Board Assurance Pack PDF",
                    data=pdf_bytes,
                    file_name=f"Board_Assurance_Pack_Project_{project_id}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.pdf",
                    mime="application/pdf",
                    use_container_width=True
                )
    elif report_type == "ICB Regional Progress":
        icb = filters.get('icb', 'All ICBs')
        with st.spinner("Generating ICB Regional Progress Report..."):
            conditions = ["p.is_deleted = 0", "o.is_deleted = 0"]
            sql_params = []
            if icb != "All ICBs":
                conditions.append("o.region = ?")
                sql_params.append(icb)
            where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)
            
            df_icb = query(f"""
                SELECT 
                    o.name as [Organisation],
                    p.name as [Project Stream],
                    p.status as [Phase],
                    p.rag_status as [RAG Status],
                    p.due_date as [Go-Live Date],
                    p.cohort as [Cohort],
                    p.supplier_team as [Supplier Team]
                FROM projects p
                JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
                WHERE {where_clause}
                ORDER BY o.name, p.name
            """, tuple(sql_params))
            
            if df_icb.empty:
                st.info(f"No active projects found for {icb}.")
            else:
                st.subheader(f"ICB Status Summary: {icb}")
                st.dataframe(df_icb, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
                
                # Render Altair Chart
                chart = alt.Chart(df_icb).mark_bar().encode(
                    x=alt.X('Organisation:N', sort='y'),
                    y=alt.Y('count():Q', title="Project Count"),
                    color=alt.Color('RAG Status:N', scale=alt.Scale(
                        domain=['Green', 'Amber', 'Red', 'Grey'],
                        range=['#00703c', '#ffdd00', '#d4351c', '#f0f4f5']
                    ))
                ).properties(height=250, title=f"Project RAG Distribution in {icb}").interactive()
                st.altair_chart(chart, use_container_width=True)
                
                # Generate PDF Report
                report_title = f"ICB Regional Progress Report: {icb}"
                pdf = ReportPDF(title=report_title)
                pdf.add_page()
                pdf.chapter_title(report_title, level=1)
                pdf.chapter_body(f"Report Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
                pdf.chapter_body(f"Total Projects Tracked: {len(df_icb)}")
                
                # Add table
                col_widths = [120, 100, 70, 50, 60, 50, 70]
                pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_icb, col_widths=col_widths)
                
                pdf_bytes = bytes(pdf.output())
                st.download_button(
                    label="📥 Download ICB Progress Report PDF",
                    data=pdf_bytes,
                    file_name=f"ICB_Progress_Report_{icb.replace(' ', '_')}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.pdf",
                    mime="application/pdf",
                    use_container_width=True
                )
    else:
        df_report, chart, report_title = generate_report_from_config(config)

        if df_report.empty:
            st.info("No data found for the selected criteria.")
        else:
            # --- Visualization ---
            if visualization_type == "Table":
                st.dataframe(df_report, use_container_width=True)
            elif chart:
                st.altair_chart(chart, use_container_width=True)
            else:
                st.warning(f"A {visualization_type} visualization is not available for this report type or selected columns.")

            # --- PDF Export ---
            st.divider()
            pdf = ReportPDF(title=report_title)
            pdf.add_page()
            pdf.chapter_title(report_title, level=1)
            pdf.chapter_body(f"Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
            pdf.chapter_body(f"Filters: {', '.join([f'{k}: {v}' for k, v in filters.items() if v])}")
            
            # Add table to PDF
            if not df_report.empty:
                # Calculate column widths dynamically
                col_widths = []
                page_width = pdf.w - 2 * pdf.l_margin
                num_cols = len(df_report.columns)
                if num_cols > 0:
                    col_width = page_width / num_cols
                    col_widths = [col_width] * num_cols
                
                pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_report, col_widths=col_widths)

            # Add chart to PDF if generated
            if visualization_type != "Table" and chart is not None:
                pdf.add_page()
                pdf.chapter_title(f"{report_type} Visualization", level=1)
                try:
                    # Save chart as PNG to a buffer
                    chart_png_bytes = vlc.vegalite_to_png(chart.to_dict())
                    image_stream = io.BytesIO(chart_png_bytes)
                    pdf.image(image_stream, x=pdf.l_margin, w=page_width)
                except Exception as e:
                    pdf.chapter_body(f"Could not embed chart in PDF: {e}")

            pdf_bytes = bytes(pdf.output())
            st.download_button(
                label="📥 Download Report as PDF",
                data=pdf_bytes,
                file_name=f"{report_title.replace(' ', '_')}_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.pdf",
                mime="application/pdf",
                use_container_width=True
            )

    # --- NEW: Schedule Report Section ---
    st.divider()
    with st.expander("🗓️ Schedule This Report"):
        with st.form("schedule_report_form"):
            st.write("Configure this report to be generated and emailed automatically.")
            schedule_name = st.text_input("Schedule Name", value=f"{report_title} ({datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')})")
            schedule_freq = st.selectbox("Frequency", ["Daily", "Weekly", "Monthly"])
            schedule_recipients = st.text_input("Recipients (comma-separated emails)")

            if st.form_submit_button('Save Schedule', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
                if schedule_name and schedule_recipients:
                    # Save the current report configuration as a JSON string
                    config_json = json.dumps(config)
                    current_user = st.session_state.get("current_user", "System")
                    
                    execute(
                        """INSERT INTO scheduled_reports (report_name, report_config, frequency, recipients, created_by, created_date)
                           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                        (schedule_name, config_json, schedule_freq, schedule_recipients, current_user, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
                    ) # type: ignore
                    log_audit_event("CREATE", "ScheduledReport", current_user or "System", app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", None, details={"name": schedule_name, "frequency": schedule_freq})
                    st.success(f"Report '{schedule_name}' scheduled successfully!")
                else:
                    st.error("Schedule Name and at least one Recipient are required.")

# --- NEW: View Existing Schedules ---
st.divider()
st.header("Existing Scheduled Reports")
df_schedules = query("SELECT id, report_name, frequency, recipients, created_by, last_run_date, is_active FROM scheduled_reports WHERE is_deleted=0")

if not df_schedules.empty:
    st.dataframe(df_schedules, use_container_width=True)
