                    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
                    mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
                    mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = event => {
                        audioChunks.push(event.data);
                    };
                    mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
                        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: 'audio/wav' });
                        playback.src = URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob);
                        playback.style.display = "block";
                        status.innerText = "Recording saved!";
                        
                        const reader = new FileReader();
                        reader.readAsDataURL(audioBlob);
                        reader.onloadend = () => {
                            audioBase64 = reader.result.split(',')[1];
                        };
                    };
                    mediaRecorder.start();
                    btn.style.backgroundColor = "#323130";
                    btn.innerText = "⏹️ Stop Recording";
                    status.innerText = "Recording... (Max 60 seconds)";
                    
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state === "recording") {
                            toggleRecording();
                        }
                    }, 60000);
                } catch (err) {

                    status.innerText = "Microphone error";

                voice_memo_base64: audioBase64

                p_name_str = str(p_name) if pd.notna(p_name) else ""

                    curr_checklist = json.loads(curr_data[0])
                except Exception:
                    pass

            conflict_rows = []
            db_checklist_map = {item.get("Task ID"): item.get("Status", "Grey") for item in curr_checklist}
            for item in s_updated_checklist:
                tid = item.get("Task ID")
                sync_val = item.get("Status")
                db_val = db_checklist_map.get(tid, "Grey")
                if db_val != sync_val:
                    conflict_rows.append({
                        "Item": f"Checklist Activity: {tid}",
                        "Type": "Checklist",
                        "Key": tid,
                        "Current Database Value": db_val,
                        "Uploaded Sync Value": sync_val,
                        "Resolution Choice": "Use Uploaded"
                    })

            for r_up in s_updated_risks:
                r_desc = r_up.get("description")
                sync_mit = r_up.get("mitigation", "")
                db_r = fetch_one("SELECT mitigation FROM risks WHERE project_id=? AND description=? AND is_deleted=0", (s_pid, r_desc))
                db_mit = db_r[0] if db_r else ""
                if db_mit != sync_mit:
                    conflict_rows.append({
                        "Item": f"Risk Mitigation: {r_desc[:40]}...",
                        "Type": "Risk Mitigation",
                        "Key": r_desc,
                        "Current Database Value": db_mit,
                        "Uploaded Sync Value": sync_mit,
                        "Resolution Choice": "Use Uploaded"
                    })

            if conflict_rows:
                st.warning("⚠️ **Sync Mismatches Detected:** Some database entries differ from your offline file. Please select which values to keep below:")
                df_conflicts = pd.DataFrame(conflict_rows)
                edited_conflicts = st.data_editor(
                    df_conflicts,
                    column_config={
                        "Item": st.column_config.TextColumn("Item Item", width="medium", disabled=True),
                        "Type": st.column_config.TextColumn("Type", width="small", disabled=True),

                        "Resolution Choice": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn("Resolution", options=["Use Uploaded", "Keep Database"], width="medium", required=True)
                    },
                    hide_index=True,
                    use_container_width=True,
                    key=f"conflict_resolution_editor_{s_pid}"
                )
                
                # Populate resolution map
                for _, crow in edited_conflicts.iterrows():
                    resolved_dict[(crow["Type"], crow["Key"])] = crow["Resolution Choice"]

            if s_voice_memo:

                # 1. Log notes as a meeting entry

                    execute(

                        (s_pid, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "Offline Site Visit", s_notes, "Offline Notes", "Synced from offline file", "See offline actions", "Internal Advisory Update", 0.0)
                    )

                    try:

                        from core.database_utils import get_attachments_dir
                        import os
                        attachments_dir = get_attachments_dir()
                        audio_filename = f"offline_memo_{s_pid}_{int(datetime.now().timestamp())}.wav"
                        audio_path = os.path.join(attachments_dir, audio_filename)
                        
                        with open(audio_path, "wb") as af:
                            af.write(audio_data)
                            
                        # Transcribe audio using Whisper
                        from core.ai_utils import transcribe_audio, run_local_transcript_distiller
                        with st.spinner("Transcribing and distilling voice memo..."):
                            transcript = transcribe_audio(audio_path)
                            distilled_notes = run_local_transcript_distiller(transcript)
                            
                        # Insert voice memo as a meeting note entry
                        execute(
                            "INSERT INTO meetings (project_id, date, attendees, summary, thematic, decisions, next_steps, document_type, sentiment_score) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                            (s_pid, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "Offline Site Visit (Voice Memo)", distilled_notes, "Offline Recording", "Transcribed automatically", "Review actions in task list", "Internal Advisory Update", 0.0)
                        )
                        st.toast("Voice memo successfully transcribed and synced!")
                    except Exception as ex:
                        st.error(f"Failed to process offline voice memo: {ex}")
                # 2. Insert actions
                for act in s_actions:
                    execute(
                        "INSERT INTO actions (project_id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, status, latest_update, rag_status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (s_pid, act['task'], act.get('owner', 'Unassigned'), datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), act.get('due_date') or (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "Open", "Logged offline", "Grey")
                    )
                # 3. Insert risks
                for rsk in s_risks:
                    execute(
                        "INSERT INTO risks (project_id, impact, description, mitigation, status, owner) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (s_pid, rsk['impact'], rsk['description'], rsk['mitigation'], "Open", "Logged offline")
                    )
                # 4. Update checklist data
                if s_updated_checklist:
                    if curr_checklist:
                        status_updates = {item["Task ID"]: item["Status"] for item in s_updated_checklist}
                        for item in curr_checklist:
                            t_id = item.get("Task ID")
                            if t_id in status_updates:
                                # Check resolution choice
                                choice = resolved_dict.get(("Checklist", t_id), "Use Uploaded")
                                if choice == "Use Uploaded":
                                    item["Status"] = status_updates[t_id]

                # 5. Update risk mitigations
                for r_up in s_updated_risks:
                    r_desc = r_up["description"]
                    r_mit = r_up["mitigation"]
                    choice = resolved_dict.get(("Risk Mitigation", r_desc), "Use Uploaded")
                    if choice == "Use Uploaded":
                        execute("UPDATE risks SET mitigation=? WHERE project_id=? AND description=? AND is_deleted=0", (r_mit, s_pid, r_desc))
                st.success("Successfully synchronized all offline notes, checklist updates, risk edits, new action items, and new risks to the database!")
                st.rerun()
        except Exception as e:
            st.error(f"Failed to parse sync file: {e}")

    else:

        region_stats = []
        for reg in df_projects['region'].unique():
            reg_df = df_projects[df_projects['region'] == reg]
            
            # Calculate metrics
            total_projects = len(reg_df)
            red_count = len(reg_df[reg_df['rag_status'] == 'Red'])
            amber_count = len(reg_df[reg_df['rag_status'] == 'Amber'])
            green_count = len(reg_df[reg_df['rag_status'] == 'Green'])
            
            reg_scores = []
            for _, r in reg_df.iterrows():
                c_data = r['checklist_data']
                if c_data:
                    try:
                        items = json.loads(c_data)
                        completed = sum(1 for x in items if x.get('Status') in ['Green', 'Completed', 'Complete'])
                        total = len(items) if items else 1
                        reg_scores.append((completed / total) * 100)
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            avg_reg_score = sum(reg_scores) / len(reg_scores) if reg_scores else 0.0
            
            region_stats.append({
                "Region / ICB Group": reg or "Unknown Region",
                "Total Projects": total_projects,
                "Avg Readiness": f"{avg_reg_score:.1f}%",
                "🟢 Green": green_count,
                "🟡 Amber": amber_count,
                "🔴 Red": red_count,
            })
            
        df_region_stats = pd.DataFrame(region_stats)
        st.dataframe(df_region_stats, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
        
        # Show key risks per region
        st.write("#### ⚠️ Key Regional Risks & Issues (Critical/High)")
        pids_list = df_projects['project_id'].tolist()
        placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(pids_list))
        
        df_reg_risks = query(f"""
            SELECT o.region, o.name as org_name, p.name as project_name, r.description, r.impact, r.mitigation
            FROM risks r
            JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.id
            JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
            WHERE p.id IN ({placeholders}) AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'Open' AND r.impact IN ('High', 'Critical')
            ORDER BY o.region ASC, o.name ASC
        """, tuple(pids_list))
        
        if df_reg_risks.empty:
            st.success("🎉 No critical or high-impact risks logged across these regions!")
        else:
            st.dataframe(df_reg_risks, column_config={
                "region": "Region",
                "org_name": "Organisation",
                "project_name": "Project Stream",
                "description": "Risk Description",
                "impact": "Impact",
                "mitigation": "Mitigation Notes"
            }, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)

        st.divider()
        st.subheader("📥 Export ICB Executive Briefing Pack")
        st.caption("Generate a professional, ready-to-print executive PDF slide summary for the selected region.")
        
        from core.pdf_utils import generate_icb_executive_pdf
        
        report_region = selected_region
        if report_region == "All Regions":
            distinct_regs = [r for r in df_projects['region'].unique() if r]
            if distinct_regs:
                report_region = st.selectbox("Select Region for PDF Briefing", distinct_regs, key="report_region_selector")
            else:
                report_region = None
                
        if report_region:
            df_rep_projects = df_projects[df_projects['region'] == report_region]
            rep_pids = df_rep_projects['project_id'].tolist()
            if rep_pids:
                rep_placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(rep_pids))
                df_rep_risks = query(f"""
                    SELECT o.name as org_name, r.description, r.impact, r.mitigation
                    FROM risks r
                    JOIN projects p ON r.project_id = p.id
                    JOIN orgs o ON p.org_id = o.id
                    WHERE p.id IN ({rep_placeholders}) AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'Open' AND r.impact IN ('High', 'Critical')
                    ORDER BY o.name ASC
                """, tuple(rep_pids))
            else:
                df_rep_risks = pd.DataFrame()
                
            try:
                pdf_bytes = generate_icb_executive_pdf(report_region, df_rep_projects, df_rep_risks)
                st.download_button(
                    label=f"📥 Download ICB Executive PDF - {report_region}",
                    data=pdf_bytes,
                    file_name=f"ICB_Briefing_{report_region.replace(' ', '_')}.pdf",
                    mime="application/pdf",
                    use_container_width=True,
                    key="icb_pdf_download_btn"
                )
            except Exception as e:

            df_tasks_raw = pd.DataFrame(tasks_data)
            df_tasks_raw['Import'] = True
            df_tasks_raw['Due Offset (Days)'] = pd.to_numeric(df_tasks_raw['Due Offset (Days)'], errors='coerce').fillna(7).astype(int)

        if risks_data:
            df_risks_raw = pd.DataFrame(risks_data)
            df_risks_raw['Import'] = True

    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError) as e:
        st.error(f"Error parsing AI response. The format might be incorrect. Error: {e}")
        st.expander("View Raw AI Output").markdown(ai_response_text)

    # --- Editable Tasks ---
    st.markdown("#### Proposed Tasks")
    if not df_tasks_raw.empty:
        edited_tasks_df = st.data_editor(
            df_tasks_raw,
            column_config={
                "Import": st.column_config.CheckboxColumn("Import?"),
                "Task Description": st.column_config.TextColumn("Task Description", width="large"),
                "Assigned Role": st.column_config.TextColumn("Assigned Role"),
                "Due Offset (Days)": st.column_config.NumberColumn("Due Offset (Days)", min_value=0, step=1)
            },
            hide_index=True,
            use_container_width=True,
            key="ai_tasks_editor"
        )
    else:
        st.warning("AI did not generate any tasks. Please refine your goals or add manually.")
        edited_tasks_df = pd.DataFrame()

    # --- Editable Risks ---
    st.markdown("#### Potential Risks")
    if not df_risks_raw.empty:
        edited_risks_df = st.data_editor(
            df_risks_raw,
            column_config={
                "Import": st.column_config.CheckboxColumn("Import?"),
                "Description": st.column_config.TextColumn("Description", width="large"),
                "Impact": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn("Impact", options=RISK_IMPACTS),
                "Likelihood": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn("Likelihood", options=RISK_LIKELIHOODS),
                "Mitigation": st.column_config.TextColumn("Mitigation", width="large")
            },
            hide_index=True,
            use_container_width=True,
            key="ai_risks_editor"
        )
    else:
        st.warning("AI did not generate any risks. Please refine your goals or add manually.")
        edited_risks_df = pd.DataFrame()

    st.divider()
    if st.button("✅ Commit Selected to Project", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
        tasks_committed = 0
        risks_committed = 0
        
        # Commit Tasks
        for _, row in edited_tasks_df.iterrows():
            if row['Import']:
                task_desc = row['Task Description']
                assigned_to = row['Assigned Role']
                due_offset = row['Due Offset (Days)']
                
                due_date = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=due_offset)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                
                execute(
                    "INSERT INTO actions (project_id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, status, latest_update, rag_status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (pid, task_desc, assigned_to, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), due_date, "Open", "AI Generated Draft", "Grey")
                )
                tasks_committed += 1
        
        # Commit Risks
        for _, row in edited_risks_df.iterrows():
            if row['Import']:
                risk_desc = row['Description']
                impact = row['Impact']
                likelihood = row['Likelihood']
                mitigation = row['Mitigation']
                
                risk_score = calculate_risk_score(impact, likelihood)
                
                execute(
                    "INSERT INTO risks (project_id, description, impact, likelihood, risk_score, mitigation, owner, status, date_raised) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                    (pid, risk_desc, impact, likelihood, risk_score, mitigation, "AI Generated Draft", "Open", datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
                )
                risks_committed += 1
        
        if tasks_committed > 0 or risks_committed > 0:
            log_audit_event(
                "AI_PLAN_COMMIT", "Project", app_state.user.current_user, app_state.user.current_user_role, pid,
                details={
                    "project_goals": st.session_state['project_goals_for_plan'],
                    "tasks_committed": tasks_committed,
                    "risks_committed": risks_committed
                }
            )
            st.session_state['ai_planner_message'] = {"type": "success", "content": f"Committed {tasks_committed} tasks and {risks_committed} risks to the project!"}
            # Clear session state to reset the form
            del st.session_state['ai_draft_plan']
            del st.session_state['project_goals_for_plan']
            st.rerun()
        else:
            st.info("No tasks or risks were selected for commitment.")

    st.markdown("---")
    st.expander("View Raw AI Output").markdown(ai_response_text)

# --- Clear session state if project changes ---
if st.session_state.get("ai_planner_pid") != pid:
    st.session_state["ai_planner_pid"] = pid
    if 'ai_draft_plan' in st.session_state:
        del st.session_state['ai_draft_plan']
    if 'project_goals_for_plan' in st.session_state:
        del st.session_state['project_goals_for_plan']
    st.rerun()

def force_clean_field_extraction(raw_text: str, key_name: str) -> str:
    """
    Directly extracts field data from raw text looking like a JSON string 
    using literal text anchors. Switched away from f-strings to bypass 
    Python single-brace interpretation constraints completely.
    """
    # Safe manual string composition to ensure clean regex evaluation
    pattern = r'"' + re.escape(key_name) + r'"\s*:\s*"([\s\S]*?)"(?=\s*,\s*"\w+"\s*:|\s*\}\s*$|\s*"*\s*\}|$)'
    match = re.search(pattern, raw_text)
    if match:
        content = match.group(1)
        content = content.replace('\\"', '"').replace('\\n', '\n')
        return content.strip()
    return ""

def clean_and_parse_local_json(raw_ai_output: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Cleans local LLM noise, strips accidental markdown blocks, 
    and forces valid JSON extraction. Returning a distinct failure flag
    so it doesn't mask as real document data fields.
    """
    try:
        clean_output = re.sub(r'```.*?```', '', raw_ai_output, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
        return json.loads(clean_output)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        try:
            match = re.search(r'\{[\s\S]*\}', clean_output, re.DOTALL)
            if match:
                return json.loads(match.group(0))
        except Exception:
            pass
            
    return {
        "parsing_failed": True,
        "error_message": "AI JSON block could not be recovered cleanly."
    }

# Define a global list of headers for extraction
ALL_HEADERS_FOR_EXTRACTION = ["Subject", "Date", "Attendees", "Executive Summary", "Summary",
                                "Thematic Discussion", "Discussion", "Decisions Made", "Decisions",
                                "Action Item Table", "Action Items", "Actions", "Strategic Outlook", "Outlook"]

def extract_section_from_full_text(start_headers: List[str], end_headers: List[str], text: str) -> str:
    """
    Extracts text between start headers and end headers dynamically.
    Handles headers with trailing colons, dashes, or plain newlines.
    """
    end_pattern = r"(?=\n\s*(?:{}))|$".format("|".join(re.escape(h) for h in end_headers)) if end_headers else r"$"
    # MODIFIED: Removed the explicit newline `\n` to handle cases where content is on the same line as the header.
    pattern = rf"(?i)(?:{'|'.join(re.escape(h) for h in start_headers)})\s*(?::|-)?\s*(.*?){end_pattern}"
    match = re.search(pattern, text, re.DOTALL)
    return (match.group(1) or "").strip() if match else ""


def parse_structured_minutes_text(minutes_text: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    """
    Parses structured minutes text into a clean dictionary of components.
    """
    return {
        "subject": extract_section_from_full_text(["Subject"], ["Date"], minutes_text),
        "date": extract_section_from_full_text(["Date"], ["Attendees"], minutes_text),
        "attendees": extract_section_from_full_text(["Attendees"], ["Executive Summary", "Summary"], minutes_text),
        "summary": extract_section_from_full_text(["Executive Summary", "Summary"], ["Thematic Discussion", "Discussion"], minutes_text),
        "thematic": extract_section_from_full_text(["Thematic Discussion", "Discussion"], ["Decisions Made", "Decisions"], minutes_text),
        "decisions": extract_section_from_full_text(["Decisions Made", "Decisions"], ["Action Item Table", "Action Items", "Actions"], minutes_text),
        "actions_raw": extract_section_from_full_text(["Action Item Table", "Action Items", "Actions"], ["Strategic Outlook (Next Week's Focus)", "Strategic Outlook", "Outlook"], minutes_text),
        "outlook": extract_section_from_full_text(["Strategic Outlook (Next Week's Focus)", "Strategic Outlook", "Outlook"], [], minutes_text)
    }

        ]

        st.divider()
        st.subheader("📋 PM Review: Action Items Staging")

        st.caption("AI-extracted actions. Review, edit, and select which to import.")
        
        # Guard action item extraction and deduplication check in session state
        if 'staged_actions' not in st.session_state:
            staged_actions_list = []
            if not is_json_block and ("Action Description,Owner,Due Date" in shredded_actions_raw or "Action Description | Owner | Due Date" in shredded_actions_raw):
                # Normalizing markdown table pipes into comma-separated arrays for unified handling
                normalized_actions = shredded_actions_raw.replace(" | ", ",")
                lines = normalized_actions.split("\n")
                for line in lines:
                    if "," in line and "Action Description" not in line and "---" not in line:
                        parts = line.split(",")
                        if len(parts) >= 3:
                            staged_actions_list.append({
                                "Task": parts[0].replace("|", "").strip(),
                                "Owner": parts[1].replace("|", "").strip(),
                                "Due Date Raw": parts[2].replace("|", "").strip()
                            })
            
            # If standard CSV intercept was blank, default to model distillation wrapper
            if not staged_actions_list:
                with st.spinner("AI is extracting action items..."):
                    text_source_for_actions = full_text if not is_json_block else f"Actions:\n{shredded_actions_raw}\nDecisions:\n{shredded_decisions}"
                    staged_actions_list = extract_action_items_from_text(text_source_for_actions)
            
            # Smart Deduplication against current open records (only runs once per upload)
            existing_open_tasks_rows = fetch_all("SELECT task FROM actions WHERE project_id=? AND status='Open' AND is_deleted=0", (pid,))
            existing_open_tasks = {row[0] for row in existing_open_tasks_rows}

            for action in staged_actions_list:
                is_duplicate = action.get("Task") in existing_open_tasks
                action["Import"] = not is_duplicate
                action["Status"] = "⚠️ Duplicate" if is_duplicate else "🆕 New"
                
            st.session_state['staged_actions'] = staged_actions_list

        staged_actions = st.session_state['staged_actions']

        edited_actions = st.data_editor(
            staged_actions, 
            column_config={
                "Import": st.column_config.CheckboxColumn("Import?"), 
                "Task": st.column_config.TextColumn("Task Description", width="large"),
                "Owner": st.column_config.TextColumn("Owner"),
                "Due Date Raw": st.column_config.TextColumn("Due Date (Raw)"),
                "Status": st.column_config.TextColumn("System Check", disabled=True, help="Compares against open tasks in this project to prevent duplicates.")
            }, 
            hide_index=True, 
            use_container_width=True
        )

        # PREDICTIVE RISK STAGING
        st.divider()
        st.subheader("⚠️ PM Review: AI Predictive Risks")
        st.caption("AI scanning thematic discussion for systemic rollout blockers.")
        
        # Guard predictive risk scanning in session state
        if 'staged_risks' not in st.session_state:
            risks_detected_raw = detect_predictive_risks(f"{ms} {mt}")
            risks_detected_list = []
            for risk in risks_detected_raw:
                risk['Import'] = True
                risks_detected_list.append(risk)
            st.session_state['staged_risks'] = risks_detected_list

        staged_risks = st.session_state['staged_risks']

        edited_risks = st.data_editor(
            staged_risks, 
            column_config={
                "Import": st.column_config.CheckboxColumn("Import?"), 
                "Impact": st.column_config.SelectboxColumn("Impact", options=get_config('RISK')),
                "Description": st.column_config.TextColumn("Description", width="large"),
                "Mitigation": st.column_config.TextColumn("Mitigation", width="large"),
            }, 
            hide_index=True, 
            use_container_width=True
        )

        if st.form_submit_button('🚀 Confirm Review & Commit to Project Feed', type='primary', use_container_width=True):
            sentiment_text = f"{ms} {mt} {md_dec}"
            sentiment_score = analyze_sentiment(sentiment_text)['polarity'] if sentiment_text.strip() else 0.0
            
            meeting_id_to_link_attachments = None
            if selected_meeting_id == "new":
                new_meeting_id = execute("INSERT INTO meetings (project_id, date, attendees, summary, thematic, decisions, next_steps, document_type, sentiment_score) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                                         (pid, md.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), ma, ms, mt, md_dec, ns, doc_type, sentiment_score), return_lastrowid=True)
                meeting_id_to_link_attachments = new_meeting_id
                st.session_state['minutes_message'] = {"type": "success", "content": "New Meeting and Intelligence successfully committed to the Project Feed!"}
            else:
                execute("UPDATE meetings SET date=?, attendees=?, summary=?, thematic=?, decisions=?, next_steps=?, document_type=?, sentiment_score=? WHERE id=?",
                        (md.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), ma, ms, mt, md_dec, ns, doc_type, sentiment_score, selected_meeting_id))
                meeting_id_to_link_attachments = selected_meeting_id
                st.session_state['minutes_message'] = {"type": "success", "content": "Existing Meeting and Intelligence successfully updated in the Project Feed!"}

            # File Attachment Strategy
            if uploaded_word:
                timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
                safe_name = "".join(c for c in uploaded_word.name if c.isalnum() or c in " ._-")
                save_path = get_attachments_dir() / f"{pid}_{timestamp}_{safe_name}"
                with open(save_path, "wb") as f:
                    f.write(uploaded_word.getbuffer())
                encrypt_file(str(save_path))
                
                execute("INSERT INTO meeting_attachments (meeting_id, file_path, file_name, upload_timestamp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        (meeting_id_to_link_attachments, str(save_path), uploaded_word.name, datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")))

            # Commit Actions 
            for row in edited_actions:
                if row["Import"]:
                    try: clean_due = dparser.parse(row["Due Date Raw"], fuzzy=True, default=datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d") # type: ignore
                    except (dparser.ParserError, TypeError): clean_due = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=7)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                    execute("INSERT INTO actions (project_id, task, assigned_to, start_date, due_date, status, latest_update, rag_status) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                            (pid, row["Task"], row["Owner"], datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), clean_due, "Open", "Imported via Minutes Intelligence", "Grey"))

            # Commit Risks
            for r_row in edited_risks:
                if r_row["Import"]:
                    execute("INSERT INTO risks (project_id, impact, description, mitigation, status, owner) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                            (pid, r_row['Impact'], r_row['Description'], r_row['Mitigation'], "Open", "AI System Flag"))

            update_timestamp(current_org_id)
            
            # Flush pipeline buffers to reset form safely on update iteration
            for key in ['ai_shredder_buffer', 'doc_category', 'doc_text_hash', 'contract_analysis', 'ai_extracted_details', 'staged_actions', 'staged_risks']:
                if key in st.session_state:
                    del st.session_state[key]
            
            # Clear file uploaders by incrementing uploader counter
            st.session_state['uploader_counter'] = st.session_state.get('uploader_counter', 0) + 1
                
            st.session_state['minutes_message'] = {"type": "success", "content": "All Intelligence successfully committed to the Project Feed!"}
            st.rerun()

# --- PERMANENT COPILOT GUIDE SECTION  ---
st.divider()
with st.expander("✨ Need a Minutes Draft? Use the CoPilot Prompt", expanded=True):
    st.markdown("""
    If you have a **Meeting Transcript** from Teams or Zoom, use the prompt below in 
    **Microsoft CoPilot** to generate a standardized document ready for this parser.
    """)
    
    st.code(COPILOT_TRANSCRIPT_PROMPT, language=None)
    st.info("💡 **Tip:** Once CoPilot generates the Word doc, upload it above to sync actions and risks automatically.")

# pages/44_📄_Document_Summarizer.py
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd
import io
import pypdf
from docx import Document as DocxDocument

# Modular Imports
from core.style_utils import render_sidebar, handle_page_entry, render_page_navigation_buttons # type: ignore
from core.auth_utils import user_can # type: ignore
from core.state import get_app_state # type: ignore
from core.ai_utils import generate_ai_response # type: ignore
from core.prompts import ANALYZE_CONTRACT_PROMPT, CATEGORIZE_DOCUMENT_PROMPT, DOCUMENT_SUMMARY_PROMPT_TEMPLATE # type: ignore

# --- Page Setup & Security ---
handle_page_entry()
app_state = get_app_state()
can_view, reason = user_can("view_dashboard")
if not can_view:
    st.error(f"🔒 Access Denied: {reason}")
    st.stop()

app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Intelligence & AI"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

st.title("📄 AI Contract & Document Summarizer")
st.caption("Upload a supplier contract, NHS framework document, or technical spec. AI generates a plain-English summary, highlights key obligations, and flags risks.")
render_page_navigation_buttons(selected_org, selected_prj)

# --- Document Upload & Processing ---
with st.container(border=True):
    st.subheader("📥 Upload Document")
    uploaded_file = st.file_uploader("Upload a Document (.txt, .md, .csv, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx)", type=["txt", "md", "csv", "pdf", "docx", "xlsx", "xls"])

    document_text = ""
    if uploaded_file:
        try:
            file_ext = uploaded_file.name.split('.')[-1].lower()
            file_bytes = io.BytesIO(uploaded_file.getvalue())
            
            if file_ext == 'pdf':
                reader = pypdf.PdfReader(file_bytes)
                document_text = "\n".join([page.extract_text() for page in reader.pages if page.extract_text()])
            elif file_ext == 'docx':
                doc = DocxDocument(file_bytes)
                document_text = "\n".join([p.text for p in doc.paragraphs if p.text])
            elif file_ext in ['xlsx', 'xls']:
                xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_bytes, engine='openpyxl')
                full_text = []
                for sheet_name in xls.sheet_names:
                    df = xls.parse(sheet_name)
                    full_text.append(f"--- Sheet: {sheet_name} ---\n{df.to_string()}")
                document_text = "\n\n".join(full_text)
            elif file_ext == 'csv':
                df = pd.read_csv(uploaded_file)
                document_text = df.to_string()
            else:
                document_text = uploaded_file.getvalue().decode("utf-8", errors='ignore')
                
            st.success(f"File '{uploaded_file.name}' loaded successfully. ({len(document_text)} characters)")
            with st.expander("Preview Raw Text", expanded=False):
                st.text(document_text[:2000] + ("..." if len(document_text) > 2000 else ""))
        except Exception as e:
            st.error(f"Error reading file: {e}")

# --- AI Analysis Configuration ---
if document_text:
    st.divider()
    st.subheader("🤖 Configure AI Analysis")
    
    col_mode, col_format = st.columns(2)
    with col_mode:
        analysis_mode = st.radio(
            "Select Analysis Mode", 
            ["Contract / Legal Review", "General Document Summary", "Categorize Document Only"], 
            help="Choose the type of AI extraction to perform."
        )
    with col_format:
        if analysis_mode == "General Document Summary":
            summary_format = st.selectbox(
                "Summary Format", 
                ["Executive Summary", "Key Takeaways", "Detailed Points"]
            )
        else:
            st.write("") # Placeholder
            
    if st.button("🚀 Run AI Analysis", type="primary", use_container_width=True):
        with st.spinner("AI is analyzing the document. This may take a moment depending on the document size..."):
            try:
                # 1. Automatic Categorization (runs implicitly for context if not just categorizing)
                if analysis_mode != "Categorize Document Only":
                    cat_prompt = f"{CATEGORIZE_DOCUMENT_PROMPT}\n\nDocument Text:\n{document_text[:3000]}"
                    doc_category = generate_ai_response(prompt=cat_prompt, temperature=0.1).strip()
                    st.info(f"**Auto-Categorized as:** {doc_category}")

                # 2. Main Analysis
                if analysis_mode == "Contract / Legal Review":
                    prompt = f"{ANALYZE_CONTRACT_PROMPT}\n\nDocument Text:\n{document_text}"
                    response = generate_ai_response(prompt=prompt, temperature=0.2, bypass_cache=True)
                    st.session_state.doc_analysis_result = response
                    st.session_state.doc_analysis_title = "📑 Contract Analysis & Risk Flags"
                    
                elif analysis_mode == "General Document Summary":
                    prompt = DOCUMENT_SUMMARY_PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(summary_format=summary_format, document_text=document_text)
                    response = generate_ai_response(prompt=prompt, temperature=0.3, bypass_cache=True)
                    st.session_state.doc_analysis_result = response
                    st.session_state.doc_analysis_title = f"📝 {summary_format}"
                    
                elif analysis_mode == "Categorize Document Only":
                    prompt = f"{CATEGORIZE_DOCUMENT_PROMPT}\n\nDocument Text:\n{document_text[:3000]}"
                    response = generate_ai_response(prompt=prompt, temperature=0.1, bypass_cache=True)
                    st.session_state.doc_analysis_result = f"The AI categorized this document as: **{response.strip()}**"
                    st.session_state.doc_analysis_title = "🗂️ Document Category"
                    
            except Exception as e:
                st.error(f"An error occurred during AI analysis: {e}")

# --- Display Results ---
if 'doc_analysis_result' in st.session_state:
    st.divider()
    with st.container(border=True):
        st.subheader(st.session_state.doc_analysis_title)
        st.markdown(st.session_state.doc_analysis_result)
        
        c1, c2 = st.columns(2)
        with c1:
            st.download_button(
                "📥 Export Analysis (TXT)", 
                data=st.session_state.doc_analysis_result.encode("utf-8"), 
                file_name="AI_Document_Analysis.txt", 
                mime="text/plain",
                use_container_width=True
            )
        with c2:
            if st.button("🧹 Clear Results", use_container_width=True):
                del st.session_state.doc_analysis_result
                del st.session_state.doc_analysis_title
                st.rerun()

                    existing = fetch_one("SELECT id, name FROM project_templates WHERE name = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (inj_name.strip(),))
                    
                    if existing and inj_strategy == "Create as a new copy (adds unique suffix)":
                        i = 1
                        while True:
                            candidate_name = f"{inj_name.strip()} ({i})"
                            exists_cand = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM project_templates WHERE name = ? AND is_deleted = 0", (candidate_name,))
                            if not exists_cand:
                                final_name = candidate_name
                                break
                            i += 1
                        
                        target_template_id = execute(

                                """UPDATE project_templates

                            execute("DELETE FROM template_risks WHERE template_id = ?", (target_template_id,))
                            execute("DELETE FROM template_checklist_items WHERE template_id = ?", (target_template_id,))
                        else:
                            target_template_id = execute(
                                """INSERT INTO project_templates 
                                   (name, description, created_by, created_date, platform_association, is_deleted) 
                                   VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)""",
                                (
                                    inj_name.strip(),
                                    inj_desc.strip(),
                                    app_state.user.current_user or "System",

                            """INSERT INTO template_tasks

                               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",

                    risk_inserts = []

                        ))

                               (template_id, description, impact, likelihood, mitigation, owner_role) 
                               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",

                edited_ids = set(edited_tasks['id'].dropna().tolist()) if 'id' in edited_tasks.columns else set()
                deleted_ids = current_ids - edited_ids
                
                try:
                    if deleted_ids:
                        execute(f"DELETE FROM template_tasks WHERE id IN ({','.join('?' for _ in deleted_ids)})", list(deleted_ids))
                        
                    inserts = []
                    for _, row in edited_tasks.iterrows():
                        task_text = str(row['task']).strip() if pd.notna(row['task']) else ""
                        if not task_text:
                            continue
                        assigned_role = str(row['assigned_to_role']).strip() if pd.notna(row['assigned_to_role']) else ""
                        due_offset = int(row['due_offset_days']) if pd.notna(row['due_offset_days']) else 0
                        phase = str(row['project_phase']).strip() if pd.notna(row['project_phase']) else ""
                        group = str(row['task_group']).strip() if pd.notna(row['task_group']) else ""
                        
                        row_id = row.get('id')
                        if pd.notna(row_id) and int(row_id) in current_ids:
                            execute(
                                """UPDATE template_tasks 
                                   SET task = ?, assigned_to_role = ?, due_offset_days = ?, project_phase = ?, task_group = ? 
                                   WHERE id = ?""",
                                (task_text, assigned_role, due_offset, phase, group, int(row_id))
                            )
                        else:
                            inserts.append((template['id'], task_text, assigned_role, due_offset, phase, group))
                            
                    if inserts:
                        execute_many(
                            """INSERT INTO template_tasks 
                               (template_id, task, assigned_to_role, due_offset_days, project_phase, task_group) 
                               VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""", 
                            inserts
                        )
                        
                    log_audit_event(
                        "UPDATE", "TemplateTasks", 
                        app_state.user.current_user or "System", 
                        app_state.user.current_user_role or "System", 
                        template['id'], details={"message": f"Updated template tasks list. Added: {len(inserts)}, Deleted: {len(deleted_ids)}"}
                    )

                    st.rerun()
                except Exception as ex:
                    st.error(f"Error saving template tasks: {ex}")

                    "mitigation": st.column_config.TextColumn("Mitigation / Controls", width="large"),
                    "owner_role": st.column_config.TextColumn("Owner Role")
                },
                num_rows="dynamic",
                hide_index=True,
                use_container_width=True,
                key=f"tpl_risks_editor_{template['id']}"
            )

                current_ids = set(df_risks['id'].dropna().tolist())
                edited_ids = set(edited_risks['id'].dropna().tolist()) if 'id' in edited_risks.columns else set()
                deleted_ids = current_ids - edited_ids

                            continue
                        imp = str(row['impact']).strip() if pd.notna(row['impact']) else "Medium"
                        lik = str(row['likelihood']).strip() if pd.notna(row['likelihood']) else "Possible"
                        mit = str(row['mitigation']).strip() if pd.notna(row['mitigation']) else ""
                        owner = str(row['owner_role']).strip() if pd.notna(row['owner_role']) else ""
                        
                        row_id = row.get('id')
                        if pd.notna(row_id) and int(row_id) in current_ids:
                            execute(
                                """UPDATE template_risks 
                                   SET description = ?, impact = ?, likelihood = ?, mitigation = ?, owner_role = ? 
                                   WHERE id = ?""",
                                (desc, imp, lik, mit, owner, int(row_id))
                            )
                        else:
                            inserts.append((template['id'], desc, imp, lik, mit, owner))
                            
                    if inserts:
                        execute_many(
                            """INSERT INTO template_risks 
                               (template_id, description, impact, likelihood, mitigation, owner_role)

        # --- TAB: Checklist Items ---
        with t_checklist:

app_state = get_app_state()

# --- NEW: Interactive Chart State Handling ---
# When a bar on the pipeline chart is clicked, it sets a "phase_filter" query param.
# We read this into the app_state to make it persistent across reruns, then clear the param.
if "phase_filter" in st.query_params:
    app_state.filters.dashboard_phase_filter = st.query_params["phase_filter"]
    # Clear the query param to avoid it being picked up again unnecessarily.
    # A rerun is triggered, but the state is now securely in the app_state.
    st.query_params.clear()
    st.rerun()

selected_phase_from_chart = app_state.filters.dashboard_phase_filter

def update_inactive_filter():
    """Callback to update the filter state from the widget's session state."""
    if 'hide_inactive_toggle' in st.session_state:
        app_state.filters.hide_inactive_projects = st.session_state.hide_inactive_toggle

can_view, reason = user_can("view_dashboard")
if not can_view:
    st.error("🔒 Access Denied: You do not have permission to view this page.")
    st.stop()

# 2. Page Setup & Sidebar
# This handles the dropdowns and returns the currently selected values
app_state.navigation.active_sidebar_category = "Dashboards & Overviews"
selected_org, selected_prj, current_org_id = render_sidebar()

# --- NEW: Global "My Work" Filter ---
my_work_filter_on = app_state.filters.my_work_filter
current_user_name = app_state.user.current_user


# 3. GLOBAL FILTER LOGIC
f_sil = st.session_state.get('filter_sil', "All SILs") # These are now set by main.py
f_il = st.session_state.get('filter_il', "All ILs") # These are now set by main.py
f_im = st.session_state.get('filter_im', "All IMs") # These are now set by main.py

master_filter, params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im, hide_inactive_projects=app_state.filters.hide_inactive_projects)
join_logic = """
    JOIN orgs ON projects.org_id = orgs.id
    JOIN region_mapping m ON orgs.region = m.sub_region
"""

# 4. INITIALISE DATA & CONSTANTS
PHASES = get_config('PHASE')
RISK_IMPACTS = get_config('RISK')
today_date = datetime.now().date()
fortnight_date = (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=14)).date()

# --- WIDGET RENDERING FUNCTIONS ---
@profile_function
def render_executive_summary_widget(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, phase_counts_data: pd.DataFrame):
    @st.cache_data(ttl=60)
    def get_executive_summary_data(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, start_date: Any, end_date: Any, my_work_on: bool, user: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Fetches and calculates all data for the executive summary metrics."""
        data = {}
        
        live_count_df = query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND status IN ('Go-Live', 'Post-Live Support', 'Complete')", params=prms)
        data['live_count'] = live_count_df.iloc[0, 0] if not live_count_df.empty else 0

        risk_sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risks JOIN projects ON risks.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND risks.status='Open' AND risks.impact='Critical' AND risks.is_deleted=0"
        risk_params = list(prms)
        if my_work_on and user:
            risk_sql += " AND risks.owner = ?"
            risk_params.append(user)
        risk_count_df = query(risk_sql, params=tuple(risk_params))
        data['risk_count'] = risk_count_df.iloc[0, 0] if not risk_count_df.empty else 0

        ghost_sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risks JOIN projects ON risks.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND risks.status='Open' AND risks.impact IN ('Critical', 'High') AND (risks.mitigation IS NULL OR risks.mitigation = '') AND risks.is_deleted=0"
        ghost_params = list(prms)
        if my_work_on and user:
            ghost_sql += " AND risks.owner = ?"
            ghost_params.append(user)
        ghost_count_df = query(ghost_sql, params=tuple(ghost_params))
        data['ghost_count'] = ghost_count_df.iloc[0, 0] if not ghost_count_df.empty else 0

        breach_sql = f"""
            SELECT COUNT(actions.id) 
            FROM actions JOIN projects ON actions.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} 
            WHERE {m_filter} AND actions.status != 'Closed' AND actions.is_deleted = 0 AND actions.kpi_breach_notified = 1
        """
        breach_count_df = query(breach_sql, params=prms)
        data['breach_count'] = breach_count_df.iloc[0, 0] if not breach_count_df.empty else 0

        task_sql = f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actions JOIN projects ON actions.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND actions.status != 'Closed' AND actions.is_deleted=0 AND actions.due_date BETWEEN ? AND ?"
        task_params = list(prms) + [str(start_date), str(end_date)]
        if my_work_on and user:
            task_sql += " AND actions.assigned_to = ?"
            task_params.append(user)
        task_count_df = query(task_sql, params=tuple(task_params))
        data['task_count'] = task_count_df.iloc[0, 0] if not task_count_df.empty else 0

        email_vibe_df = query(f"SELECT AVG(sentiment_score) FROM emails JOIN projects ON emails.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND emails.sentiment_score IS NOT NULL", params=prms)
        data['email_vibe'] = email_vibe_df.iloc[0, 0] if not email_vibe_df.empty and pd.notnull(email_vibe_df.iloc[0, 0]) else 0

        meeting_sql = f"SELECT AVG(meetings.sentiment_score) FROM meetings JOIN projects ON meetings.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND meetings.sentiment_score IS NOT NULL AND meetings.document_type != 'Email Correspondence'"
        meeting_params = list(prms)
        if my_work_on and user:
            meeting_sql += " AND meetings.attendees LIKE ?"
            meeting_params.append(f"%{user}%")
        meeting_vibe_df = query(meeting_sql, params=tuple(meeting_params))
        data['meeting_vibe'] = meeting_vibe_df.iloc[0, 0] if not meeting_vibe_df.empty and pd.notnull(meeting_vibe_df.iloc[0, 0]) else 0

        action_vibe_df = query(f"SELECT AVG(actions.sentiment_score) FROM actions JOIN projects ON actions.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND actions.sentiment_score IS NOT NULL", params=prms)
        data['action_vibe'] = action_vibe_df.iloc[0, 0] if not action_vibe_df.empty and pd.notnull(action_vibe_df.iloc[0, 0]) else 0
        
        return data

    metrics_data = get_executive_summary_data(master_filter, tuple(params), today_date, fortnight_date, my_work_filter_on, current_user_name)

    # Calculate weighted average vibe score
    email_vibe = metrics_data.get('email_vibe', 0)
    meeting_vibe = metrics_data.get('meeting_vibe', 0)
    action_vibe = metrics_data.get('action_vibe', 0)
    avg_vibe = (email_vibe * 0.5) + (meeting_vibe * 0.3) + (action_vibe * 0.2)

    vibe_label = "Positive" if avg_vibe > 0.1 else "Negative" if avg_vibe < -0.1 else "Neutral"

    m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6 = st.columns(6) # type: ignore
    m1.metric("Live Streams", metrics_data.get('live_count', 0))
    m2.metric("Critical Risks", metrics_data.get('risk_count', 0))
    m3.metric("Stakeholder Vibe", vibe_label, delta=f"{avg_vibe:.1f}")
    m4.metric("Tasks (14d)", metrics_data.get('task_count', 0))
    m5.metric("Ghost Risks 👻", metrics_data.get('ghost_count', 0), help="Critical/High Risks with empty mitigation plans.")
    m6.metric("KPI Breaches 🎯", metrics_data.get('breach_count', 0), help="Tasks that have passed their due date by more than the configured KPI window.")

    st.divider()

    # Prepare data for PDF and Excel Export
    try:
        col_dl1, col_dl2 = st.columns(2)
        aliased_master_filter_red, red_params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im, proj_alias='p', org_alias='o', hide_inactive_projects=app_state.filters.hide_inactive_projects)
        df_red = get_red_alert_data(aliased_master_filter_red, tuple(red_params))
        all_scores = get_all_ia_workload_scores()
        burnout_list = [{"Name": name, "Score": score} for name, score in all_scores.items()]
        df_burnout = pd.DataFrame(burnout_list) # type: ignore

        # Generate the filter with correct aliases for the export queries
        aliased_master_filter_excel, excel_params = get_master_filter_where_clause(f_sil, f_il, f_im, proj_alias='p', org_alias='o', hide_inactive_projects=app_state.filters.hide_inactive_projects)

        col_dl1.download_button(
            label="📥 Download Executive National Briefing (PDF)",
            data=generate_national_pdf(df_red, phase_counts, df_burnout),
            file_name=f"National_Summary_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.pdf",
            mime="application/pdf",
            use_container_width=True,
            type="primary"
        )
        
        col_dl2.download_button(
            label="📥 Download Full Data Export (Excel)",
            data=generate_excel_export(aliased_master_filter_excel, tuple(excel_params)),
            file_name=f"National_Data_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.xlsx",
            mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
            use_container_width=True
        )
    except Exception as e:
        st.error(f"⚠️ Export Generators not available: {e}")

@profile_function
def render_pipeline_status_widget(phase_counts_data: pd.DataFrame, selected_phase: Optional[str] = None):
    st.subheader("🏁 Project Pipeline Status") # type: ignore
    if phase_counts_data.empty:
        st.info("No project data available for pipeline status.")
        return

    # Add a URL to each phase for href interactivity
    phase_counts_data['url'] = phase_counts_data['Phase'].apply(
        lambda x: f"?phase_filter={urllib.parse.quote(x)}"
    )

    base = alt.Chart(phase_counts_data).encode(x=alt.X('Phase:N', sort=active_phases, title=None))
    bars = base.mark_bar(cursor='pointer').encode(  # type: ignore
        y=alt.Y('Count:Q', axis=None),
        color=alt.condition(
            alt.datum.Phase == selected_phase,
            alt.value('#d25427' if st.session_state.get('app_state', None) and st.session_state.app_state.dark_mode else '#c74616'),  # Highlight color for selected bar,
            alt.Color('Phase:N', legend=None)   # Color by phase otherwise
        ),
        href='url:N' # Make bars clickable links
    )
    is_dark_theme = st.session_state.get('app_state', None) and st.session_state.app_state.dark_mode
    chart_text_color = '#d25427' if is_dark_theme else '#c74616'
    text = base.mark_text(align='center', baseline='bottom', dy=-15, color=chart_text_color, fontSize=25, fontWeight=900).encode(  # type: ignore
        y=alt.Y('Count:Q'), text=alt.Text('Count:Q'))
    st.altair_chart((bars + text).properties(height=350), use_container_width=True)
 
@profile_function
def render_phase_velocity_widget():
    st.subheader("🚀 Phase Velocity (National Avg)") # type: ignore
    velocity_df = query("""
        SELECT phase, AVG(julianday(end_date) - julianday(start_date)) as avg_duration
        FROM phase_history WHERE end_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY phase
    """)
    if not velocity_df.empty:
        st.caption("Average days spent per phase across all completed streams.")
        is_dark_theme = st.session_state.get('app_state', None) and st.session_state.app_state.dark_mode
        chart_color = '#d25427' if is_dark_theme else '#c74616'
        st.bar_chart(velocity_df, x="phase", y="avg_duration", color=chart_color)  # type: ignorechart_color)  # type: ignore


@profile_function
def render_rag_heatmap_widget(m_filter: str, prms: tuple, selected_phase: Optional[str] = None):
    st.subheader("🗺️ National RAG Heatmap (Action Grid)") # type: ignore
    st.caption("Click the button to jump directly to that project's dashboard.") # type: ignore

    heatmap_sql = f"""
        SELECT 
            orgs.name as Trust, 
            projects.name as Stream, 
            projects.rag_status as Health, 
            projects.status as Phase,
            projects.id as pid, 
            orgs.exclude_digest, 
            orgs.last_updated,
            so.name as secondary_org_name,
            (SELECT group_concat(o.name, ', ') FROM project_secondary_orgs pso JOIN orgs o ON pso.org_id = o.id WHERE pso.project_id = projects.id) as secondary_orgs_concat,
            projects.sentiment_alert_flag
        FROM projects {join_logic} LEFT JOIN orgs so ON projects.secondary_org_id = so.id WHERE {m_filter}
    """
    heatmap_params = list(prms)

    if my_work_filter_on and current_user_name:
        user_id_row = fetch_one("SELECT id FROM rit_team WHERE name = ?", (current_user_name,))
        if user_id_row:
            user_id = user_id_row[0]
            heatmap_sql += f"""
                AND projects.id IN (
                    -- Projects where user is an assigned resource (IA)
                    SELECT project_id FROM resource_allocations WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0
                    UNION
                    -- Projects in regions where user is a lead (IM, IL, SIL)
                    SELECT p_sub.id FROM projects p_sub
                    JOIN orgs o_sub ON p_sub.org_id = o_sub.id
                    JOIN region_mapping rm_sub ON o_sub.region = rm_sub.sub_region
                    WHERE (REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || rm_sub.im_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ? OR REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || rm_sub.il_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ? OR REPLACE(REPLACE(',' || rm_sub.sil_lead || ',', ', ', ','), ' ,', ',') LIKE ?)
                )
            """
            heatmap_params.append(user_id)
            like_user_name = f'%,{current_user_name},%'
            heatmap_params.extend([like_user_name, like_user_name, like_user_name])

    heatmap_sql += " ORDER BY orgs.name ASC"
    df_heatmap_full = query(heatmap_sql, params=tuple(heatmap_params))

    # --- NEW: Filter by selected phase if one is provided from the pipeline chart ---
    if selected_phase:
        df_heatmap_full = df_heatmap_full[df_heatmap_full['Phase'] == selected_phase].copy()


    def render_heatmap_table(df: pd.DataFrame, title: str): # type: ignore
        """Helper function to render a RAG heatmap table."""
        st.markdown(f"#### {title}")
        if df.empty:
            st.caption("No projects in this category for the current filter.")
            return

        # Group projects by Organisation and display each in an expander
        for trust_name, group_df in df.groupby('Trust'):
            # Get the most recent update timestamp for any project within the trust group
            last_updated_val = group_df['last_updated'].max()
            updated_caption = ""
            if pd.notnull(last_updated_val) and last_updated_val != '0':
                try:
                    ts = datetime.strptime(last_updated_val, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
                    updated_caption = f" (Last Update: {ts.strftime('%d %b %H:%M')})"
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    pass # Ignore if format is wrong

            with st.expander(f"**{trust_name}**{updated_caption}"):
                # Inside the expander, render each project stream
                for _, row in group_df.iterrows():
                    r_cols = st.columns([0.7, 0.3])
                    stream_display_text = row['Stream']
                    sec_orgs = row.get('secondary_orgs_concat')
                    if pd.notna(sec_orgs) and str(sec_orgs).strip():
                        stream_display_text += f" (with {sec_orgs})"
                    elif pd.notna(row.get('secondary_org_name')):
                        stream_display_text += f" (with {row['secondary_org_name']})"

                    if row['exclude_digest'] == 1: # Internal project, suppress RAG
                        r_cols[0].write(stream_display_text)
                    else: # External project, show RAG
                        rag_emoji = "🟢" if row['Health'] == "Green" else "🟡" if row['Health'] == "Amber" else "🔴"
                        if row.get('sentiment_alert_flag') == 1:
                            rag_emoji += " 🚨"
                        r_cols[0].write(f"{rag_emoji} {stream_display_text}")

                    # Action Buttons with session state transfer
                    if r_cols[1].button("Go to Dashboard ➔", key=f"dash_{row['pid']}", help="Project Dashboard", use_container_width=True):
                        clear_all_filters(rerun=False)
                        app_state.navigation.pending_org, app_state.navigation.pending_prj = row['Trust'], row['Stream']
                        st.switch_page("pages/02_🔍_Project_Dashboard.py")


    if not df_heatmap_full.empty:
        df_heatmap = df_heatmap_full.drop_duplicates(subset=['pid'])
        # Sort by Trust name to ensure consistent grouping order
        df_heatmap = df_heatmap.sort_values(by='Trust')
        df_external = df_heatmap[df_heatmap['exclude_digest'] == 0]
        df_internal = df_heatmap[df_heatmap['exclude_digest'] == 1]

        render_heatmap_table(df_external, "External Facing Projects")
        st.divider()
        render_heatmap_table(df_internal, "Internal Programme Streams")
    else:
        st.info("No rollout data found for this selection.")


@profile_function
def render_sentiment_trend_widget(m_filter: str, prms: tuple):
    st.subheader("🎭 Sentiment Trend") # type: ignore
    
    df_sentiment = query(f"""
        SELECT date_sent as date, sentiment_score as score
        FROM emails JOIN projects ON emails.project_id = projects.id {join_logic}
        WHERE {master_filter} AND emails.is_deleted=0 ORDER BY date_sent ASC
    """, params=tuple(params))
    if not df_sentiment.empty:
        is_dark_theme = st.session_state.get('app_state', None) and st.session_state.app_state.dark_mode
        chart_color = '#d25427' if is_dark_theme else '#c74616'
        vibe_chart = alt.Chart(df_sentiment).mark_line(color=chart_color, point=True).encode(  # type: ignore
                x=alt.X('date:T', title=None, axis=alt.Axis(format="%Y-%m-%d")),
            y=alt.Y('score:Q', title="Vibe Score", scale=alt.Scale(domain=[-1.2, 1.2]))
        ).properties(height=300)
        st.altair_chart(vibe_chart, use_container_width=True)
        
        # --- NEW: SENTIMENT ANOMALY DETECTION ---
        if len(df_sentiment) > 5: # Require at least 5 data points
            df_sentiment['rolling_avg'] = df_sentiment['score'].rolling(window=5, min_periods=1).mean()
            latest_score = df_sentiment['score'].iloc[-1]
            avg_score = df_sentiment['rolling_avg'].iloc[-1]
            
            # Trigger alert if the latest score is significantly more negative than the rolling average
            if latest_score < (avg_score * 0.5) and latest_score < -0.1:
                st.warning(f"""
                🚨 **Sentiment Anomaly Detected:** The most recent stakeholder vibe score ({latest_score:.2f}) is significantly more negative than the recent average ({avg_score:.2f}). 
                This may indicate an emerging issue requiring investigation.
                """)

@profile_function
def render_stakeholder_watchlist_widget(m_filter: str, prms: tuple):
    st.subheader("🎯 Strategic Stakeholder Watchlist") # type: ignore
    st.caption("Flags high-influence (Level 3+) communications with negative sentiment across the selected rollout tier.") # type: ignore
    
    df_watch = query(f"""
        SELECT orgs.name as Trust, projects.name as Stream, emails.date_sent as date, emails.subject as Subject, emails.influence_level as Influence
        FROM emails JOIN projects ON emails.project_id = projects.id {join_logic}
        WHERE {master_filter} AND emails.is_deleted=0 
        AND emails.sentiment_score < -0.1 AND emails.influence_level >= 3
        ORDER BY influence_level DESC, date DESC
    """, params=tuple(params))
    
    if not df_watch.empty:
        st.dataframe(
            df_watch, 
            column_config={
                "Trust": st.column_config.TextColumn("Organisation"),
                "Stream": st.column_config.TextColumn("Project Stream"),
                "date": st.column_config.DateColumn("Date"),
                "Subject": st.column_config.TextColumn("Communication Subject"),
                "Influence": st.column_config.NumberColumn("Influence Level", format="⭐ %d")
            },
            hide_index=True, 
            use_container_width=True
        )  # type: ignore
    else:
        st.success("No high-influence hostile sentiment detected in the current filter!")


@profile_function
def render_regional_risks_tasks_widget(m_filter: str, prms: tuple):
    st.subheader("⚠️ Regional Risk Summary") # type: ignore
    
    risk_sql = f"SELECT impact FROM risks JOIN projects ON risks.project_id = projects.id {join_logic} WHERE {m_filter} AND risks.status='Open' AND risks.is_deleted=0"
    risk_params = list(prms)
    if my_work_filter_on and current_user_name:
        risk_sql += " AND risks.owner = ?"
        risk_params.append(current_user_name)
    df_r_total = query(risk_sql, params=tuple(risk_params))
    risk_df = pd.DataFrame([{"Impact": imp, "Count": len(df_r_total[df_r_total['impact'] == imp])} for imp in RISK_IMPACTS])
    risk_colors = alt.Scale(domain=RISK_IMPACTS, range=['#d4351c', '#f47738', '#ffdd00', '#00703c'])
    st.altair_chart(alt.Chart(risk_df).mark_bar().encode(  # type: ignore
        x=alt.X('Impact:N', sort=RISK_IMPACTS, title="Impact Level"), 
        y=alt.Y('Count:Q', title="Active Risks"), 
        color=alt.Color('Impact:N', scale=risk_colors)
    ).properties(height=400), use_container_width=True)

    st.divider() # type: ignore
    st.subheader("🗓️ Task Radar (Next 14 Days)") # type: ignore
    radar_sql = f"""
        SELECT actions.task, actions.due_date, orgs.name as Trust
        FROM actions JOIN projects ON actions.project_id = projects.id {join_logic}
        WHERE {master_filter} AND actions.status != 'Closed' AND actions.is_deleted=0 AND actions.due_date BETWEEN ? AND ? 
    """
    radar_params = list(prms) + [str(today_date), str(fortnight_date)]
    if my_work_filter_on and current_user_name:
        radar_sql += " AND actions.assigned_to = ?"
        radar_params.append(current_user_name)
    radar_sql += " ORDER BY actions.due_date ASC"
    df_radar = query(radar_sql, params=tuple(radar_params))
    if not df_radar.empty:
        st.dataframe(
            df_radar, 
            use_container_width=True, 
            hide_index=True
        )  # type: ignore


def render_cohort_progress_widget(m_filter: str, prms: tuple):
    st.subheader("🌊 Cohort Wave Progress Report")
    st.caption("Aggregated rollout metrics grouped by cohort waves.")
    
    # Query all projects in cohort waves
    cohort_projects_df = query(f"""
        SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.cohort, projects.status, projects.checklist_data, orgs.name as Org
        FROM projects
        {join_logic}
        WHERE {m_filter} AND projects.cohort IS NOT NULL AND projects.cohort != '' AND projects.is_deleted = 0
    """, params=prms)
    
    if cohort_projects_df.empty:
        st.info("No projects are currently assigned to a cohort. You can assign cohorts in the Organisation / Project Stream settings.")
        return
        
    cohort_groups = cohort_projects_df.groupby('cohort')
    
    cohort_summaries = []
    for cohort_name, df_group in cohort_groups:
        total_trusts = len(df_group)
        live_trusts = len(df_group[df_group['status'].isin(['Go-Live', 'Post-Live Support', 'Complete'])])
        
        # Calculate avg readiness score
        total_score = 0.0
        trust_count_with_readiness = 0
        for _, row in df_group.iterrows():
            checklist_data = row.get('checklist_data')
            if checklist_data:
                try:
                    items = json.loads(checklist_data)
                    if items:
                        total_items = len(items)
                        completed = sum(1 for x in items if x.get('Status') in ['Green', 'Completed', 'Complete'])
                        total_score += (completed / total_items * 100)
                        trust_count_with_readiness += 1
                except Exception:
                    pass
        avg_readiness = (total_score / trust_count_with_readiness) if trust_count_with_readiness > 0 else 0.0
        
        # Calculate outstanding critical/high risks count
        project_ids = [int(pid) for pid in df_group['id'].tolist()]
        p_placeholders = ",".join(["?"] * len(project_ids))
        df_risks_count = query(f"""
            SELECT COUNT(*) FROM risks 
            WHERE project_id IN ({p_placeholders}) AND status = 'Open' AND impact IN ('Critical', 'High') AND risks.is_deleted = 0
        """, tuple(project_ids))
        outstanding_risks = df_risks_count.iloc[0, 0] if not df_risks_count.empty else 0
        
        status_counts_str = ", ".join([f"{status}: {len(df_sub)}" for status, df_sub in df_group.groupby('status')])
        
        cohort_summaries.append({
            "Cohort": cohort_name,
            "Total Trusts": total_trusts,
            "Live Trusts": live_trusts,
            "Avg Readiness": f"{avg_readiness:.1f}%",
            "Outstanding High Risks": outstanding_risks,
            "Phases Summary": status_counts_str
        })
        
    df_cohorts = pd.DataFrame(cohort_summaries).sort_values("Cohort")
    st.dataframe(df_cohorts, use_container_width=True, hide_index=True)
    
    csv_bytes = df_cohorts.to_csv(index=False).encode('utf-8')
    col_dl_c1, col_dl_c2 = st.columns(2)
    with col_dl_c1:
        st.download_button(
            "📥 Export Cohort Report to CSV",
            data=csv_bytes,
            file_name=f"Cohort_Wave_Progress_Report_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.csv",
            mime="text/csv",
            use_container_width=True,
            key="dl_cohorts_csv"
        )
    with col_dl_c2:
        try:
            pdf = ReportPDF(title="Cohort Wave Progress Report")
            pdf.add_page()
            pdf.chapter_title("Cohort Wave Progress Report", level=1)
            pdf.chapter_body(f"Generated: {datetime.now().strftime('%d %B %Y')}")
            # Total width is 180 (A4 with 15mm margins). Let's distribute: 30, 20, 20, 25, 25, 60
            pdf.add_df_to_pdf(df_cohorts, col_widths=[30, 20, 20, 25, 25, 60])
            pdf_bytes = bytes(pdf.output())
            st.download_button(
                "📄 Export Cohort Report to PDF",
                data=pdf_bytes,
                file_name=f"Cohort_Wave_Progress_Report_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d')}.pdf",
                mime="application/pdf",
                use_container_width=True,
                key="dl_cohorts_pdf"
            )
        except Exception as e:
            st.warning(f"PDF Exporter offline: {e}")


# --- USER CONFIGURATION & WIDGET LIBRARY ---
current_user = app_state.user.current_user
user_config = {}
if not current_user:

    "Thank you": {"color": "#005eb8", "emoji": "👏", "desc": "Expressing gratitude and appreciation for support."},
    "Happy birthday": {"color": "#41b6e6", "emoji": "🎂", "desc": "Celebrating birthday milestones with the team."},

    "Congratulations": {"color": "#00a9e0", "emoji": "🎉", "desc": "Celebrating successful rollouts, milestones, or presentations."},
    "Friendship": {"color": "#78be20", "emoji": "💚", "desc": "Supporting colleagues and fostering team camaraderie."}
}

# Helper to generate SVG Star representation
def get_star_svg(category, size=80):
    reg = STAR_REGISTRY.get(category, {"color": "#005eb8", "emoji": "⭐"})
    color = reg["color"]
    emoji = reg["emoji"]
    
    # Symmetrical 5-pointed star path with centered icon backing circle
    svg = f"""
    <svg width="{size}" height="{size}" viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display: inline-block; vertical-align: middle;">
        <!-- Star polygon -->
        <polygon points="50,5 64,36 98,36 71,57 82,90 50,70 18,90 29,57 2,36 36,36" fill="{color}" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" />
        <!-- White circular backing for icon -->
        <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="14" fill="#ffffff" />
        <!-- Centered Emoji Icon -->
        <text x="50" y="58" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle">{emoji}</text>
    </svg>
    """
    return svg

# Helper to fetch active awards
def get_user_awards(uid):
    return query("""
        SELECT id, date_received, received_from, value_category, citation 
        FROM we_care_awards 
        WHERE user_id = ? AND is_deleted = 0 
        ORDER BY date_received DESC
    """, (uid,))

# Save / Add / Update award logic
def save_award(award_id, date_rec, sender, category, citation_text):
    if not sender or not citation_text:
        st.error("Please fill in both the colleague name and the citation text.")
        return False
    
    if award_id:
        # Update existing
        execute("""
            UPDATE we_care_awards 
            SET date_received = ?, received_from = ?, value_category = ?, citation = ? 
            WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?
        """, (str(date_rec), sender, category, citation_text, award_id, user_id))
        st.toast("Award updated successfully!")
    else:
        # Insert new
        execute("""
            INSERT INTO we_care_awards (user_id, date_received, received_from, value_category, citation, is_deleted) 
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0)
        """, (user_id, str(date_rec), sender, category, citation_text))
        st.toast("Award logged successfully!")
    return True

# --- 2. STATISTICS CABINET HEADER ---
awards_df = get_user_awards(user_id)

with st.container(border=True):
    st.markdown("### 🏆 Your Star Cabinet")
    total_stars = len(awards_df) if not awards_df.empty else 0
    cats_counts = awards_df['value_category'].value_counts() if not awards_df.empty else pd.Series()
    
    # 9 Columns: 1 for Total, 8 for individual stars
    cabinet_cols = st.columns(9)
    with cabinet_cols[0]:
        st.metric("Total Stars", total_stars)
    
    for idx, cat in enumerate(STAR_REGISTRY.keys()):
        with cabinet_cols[idx + 1]:
            # Render Star SVG
            st.markdown(get_star_svg(cat, size=45), unsafe_allow_html=True)
            # Count
            st.markdown(f"<h5 style='text-align: center; margin: 2px 0 0 0;'>{cats_counts.get(cat, 0)}</h5>", unsafe_allow_html=True)
            # Short label
            st.markdown(f"<p style='text-align: center; font-size: 0.65rem; color: #718096; line-height: 1; margin: 0;'>{cat}</p>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

st.write("")

# Create Tabs
tab_timeline, tab_log, tab_appraisal = st.tabs([

    else:

        for _, row in awards_df.iterrows():

                            unsafe_allow_html=True
                        )
                    
                    st.markdown(f"*{row['citation']}*")
                    
                    # Edit and Delete buttons
                    col_act1, col_act2, _ = st.columns([0.15, 0.15, 0.7])

                        st.rerun()

# --- TAB 2: LOG / EDIT STAR ---
with tab_log:
    # Check if we are in editing mode
    editing_id = st.session_state.editing_award_id
    edit_row = None
    if editing_id:
        edit_row = fetch_one("SELECT date_received, received_from, value_category, citation FROM we_care_awards WHERE id = ?", (editing_id,))
        st.subheader("✏️ Edit Logged Star")
        st.info("You are currently editing a logged award. Save your changes below or click 'Cancel Edit'.")
    else:
        st.subheader("✍️ Log a We CARE Star")
        st.caption("Received a star from a colleague? Enter the details below to log it.")

    # Form Fields
    form_date = st.date_input(
        "Date Received", 
        value=datetime.strptime(edit_row[0], "%Y-%m-%d").date() if edit_row else datetime.today().date()
    )
    
    # Colleague Dropdown
    team_members = query("SELECT name FROM rit_team WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY name ASC")['name'].tolist()
    colleague_options = ["(Select a Colleague)"] + team_members + ["Other / External Colleague..."]
    
    # Pre-select colleague if editing
    default_sender_idx = 0
    if edit_row:
        sender_name = edit_row[1]
        if sender_name in team_members:
            default_sender_idx = team_members.index(sender_name) + 1
        else:
            default_sender_idx = len(colleague_options) - 1 # "Other / External Colleague..."
            
    sender_selection = st.selectbox("Received From", colleague_options, index=default_sender_idx)
    
    # If "Other" chosen or if the name wasn't in team members, show text input
    custom_sender = ""
    if sender_selection == "Other / External Colleague...":
        custom_sender = st.text_input(
            "Enter Sender Name", 
            value=edit_row[1] if edit_row and edit_row[1] not in team_members else "", 
            placeholder="e.g. Sarah Jenkins (Customer Service)"
        )
    
    # Value Category (8 types)
    categories_list = list(STAR_REGISTRY.keys())
    default_cat_idx = 0
    if edit_row and edit_row[2] in categories_list:
        default_cat_idx = categories_list.index(edit_row[2])
        
    form_category = st.selectbox("Star Type", categories_list, index=default_cat_idx)
    
    # Citation
    form_citation = st.text_area(
        "Star Citation / Message", 
        value=edit_row[3] if edit_row else "", 
        placeholder="e.g. Congratulations on a great presentation yesterday! You explained the technical aspects in a very accessible way.",
        height=150
    )
    
    # Action buttons
    col_f1, col_f2 = st.columns([0.5, 0.5])
    
    button_label = "💾 Save Changes" if editing_id else "🚀 Log Star"
    if col_f1.button(button_label, type="primary", use_container_width=True):
        final_sender = custom_sender if sender_selection == "Other / External Colleague..." else sender_selection
        if final_sender == "(Select a Colleague)":
            st.error("Please select a colleague or choose 'Other / External Colleague...' and write their name.")
        else:
            success = save_award(editing_id, form_date, final_sender, form_category, form_citation)
            if success:
                st.session_state.editing_award_id = None
                st.rerun()
                
    if editing_id:
        if col_f2.button("❌ Cancel Edit", use_container_width=True):
            st.session_state.editing_award_id = None
            st.rerun()
